    <div class="container">

        <!-- ====== 标题 ====== -->
        <h1>
            最大似然估计 (MLE) 与最大后验估计 (MAP)<br>
            <span style="font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:400;color:#2d3a4f;">从零开始的完整数学推导</span>
        </h1>
        <p style="font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:2rem;">
            本文从 <strong>一次抛硬币</strong> 出发，逐步推导出最大似然估计（MLE）和最大后验估计（MAP）的完整数学公式。
            全程只用到 <strong>乘法原理、加法原理、组合数、对数、求导</strong> 等高中知识，每一行代数变形都配有详细说明。
        </p>

        <!-- ============================================================ -->
        <!-- 第一部分：从零开始 —— 组合数 C(10,8) 是怎么来的                -->
        <!-- ============================================================ -->
        <h2>第一部分 · 从零开始：组合数 \(C_{10}^{8}\) 的由来</h2>
        <p>我们抛一枚硬币 10 次，记正面朝上的概率为 \(\theta\)。问：<strong>恰好出现 8 次正面</strong> 的概率是多少？</p>

        <h3>1.1 某一种特定顺序的概率</h3>
        <p>先规定一个 <strong>极其严格的顺序</strong>，比如「前 8 次正面，后 2 次反面」：</p>
        <div class="math-block">
            \[
            P(\text{正正正正正正正正 反反}) = \underbrace{\theta \times \cdots \times \theta}_{8\text{个}} \times
            \underbrace{(1-\theta) \times \cdots \times (1-\theta)}_{2\text{个}}
            = \theta^{8} (1-\theta)^{2}
            \]
        </div>
        <div class="derivation-note">
            <strong>【这一步在干什么？】</strong> 乘法原理：10 次独立抛掷同时发生的概率，等于每次概率的乘积。
            8 个 \(\theta\) 相乘得 \(\theta^8\)，2 个 \((1-\theta)\) 相乘得 \((1-\theta)^2\)。
        </div>

        <h3>1.2 有多少种这样的顺序？—— 组合数</h3>
        <p>题目只说「10 次里有 8 次正面」，<strong>并没有规定</strong> 这 8 次正面必须在前 8 次。这 8 次正面可以分布在 10 个位置中的任意 8 个位置上。</p>
        <div class="math-block">
            \[
            \text{选法数} = C_{10}^{8} = \frac{10!}{8! \cdot (10-8)!} = \frac{10!}{8! \cdot 2!} = 45
            \]
        </div>
        <div class="derivation-note">
            <strong>【为什么乘以组合数？】</strong> 这 45 种情况是 <strong>互斥</strong> 的（你不可能同时既是「1~8 次为正」又是「2~9 次为正」）。
            根据 <strong>加法原理</strong>，总概率 = 45 个相同概率相加 = \(45 \times \theta^8(1-\theta)^2\)。
        </div>

        <div class="math-block" style="background:#eef2f6;border-color:#cbd5e1;">
            <div class="formula-source">📖 原始概率公式（似然函数）</div>
            \[
            \boxed{L(\theta) = C_{10}^{8} \cdot \theta^{8} \cdot (1-\theta)^{2}}
            \]
            <p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#475569;margin-top:0.3rem;">其中 \(C_{10}^{8}=45\)
                是组合常数，<strong>不影响求最大值的位置</strong>，后续推导中会合法地忽略它。</p>
        </div>

        <hr class="hr-light">

        <!-- ============================================================ -->
        <!-- 第二部分：最大似然估计 (MLE) 全程推导                          -->
        <!-- ============================================================ -->
        <h2>第二部分 · 最大似然估计 (MLE) 全程推导</h2>
        <p><span class="theory-tag">核心理念</span> 找一个 \(\theta\)，使得 <strong>「观测到 10 次中 8 次正面」这一事件的概率最大</strong>。</p>

        <h3>2.1 写出似然函数（丢掉常数）</h3>
        <p>由于常数 \(C_{10}^{8}=45\) 在求导解方程时会被消掉（见下方证明），我们直接使用简化形式：</p>
        <div class="math-block">
            \[
            L(\theta) = \theta^{8} (1-\theta)^{2}
            \]
        </div>
        <div class="derivation-note">
            <strong>【为什么可以丢掉 45？】</strong> 设 \(L(\theta)=45 \cdot f(\theta)\)，则 \(L'(\theta)=45 \cdot f'(\theta)\)。
            令 \(L'(\theta)=0\)，两边同除以 45 得 \(f'(\theta)=0\)。最大值点完全相同，故常数可忽略。
        </div>

        <h3>2.2 取对数（化乘为加）</h3>
        <p>对 \(L(\theta)\) 取自然对数，记 \(\ell(\theta)=\ln L(\theta)\)：</p>
        <div class="derivation-step">
            <div class="math-block">
                \[
                \ell(\theta) = \ln\left[\theta^{8}(1-\theta)^{2}\right]
                = \ln(\theta^{8}) + \ln((1-\theta)^{2})
                = 8\ln\theta + 2\ln(1-\theta)
                \]
            </div>
            <div class="derivation-note">
                <strong>【为什么要取对数？】</strong> ① 对数函数 \(\ln\) 是单调递增的，\(L(\theta)\) 的最大值点和 \(\ln L(\theta)\) 的最大值点完全一致。
                ② 取对数后，<strong>乘法变加法，指数变系数</strong>，求导变得非常简单。
            </div>
        </div>

        <h3>2.3 对 \(\theta\) 求导</h3>
        <p>对 \(\ell(\theta)\) 关于 \(\theta\) 求导（注意链式法则）：</p>
        <div class="derivation-step">
            <div class="math-block">
                \[
                \ell'(\theta) = \frac{d}{d\theta}\big[8\ln\theta\big] + \frac{d}{d\theta}\big[2\ln(1-\theta)\big]
                = \frac{8}{\theta} - \frac{2}{1-\theta}
                \]
            </div>
            <div class="derivation-note">
                <strong>【求导细节】</strong> ① \((8\ln\theta)' = 8 \cdot \frac{1}{\theta} = \frac{8}{\theta}\)。<br>
                ② \((2\ln(1-\theta))' = 2 \cdot \frac{1}{1-\theta} \cdot (-1) = -\frac{2}{1-\theta}\)（链式法则）。
            </div>
        </div>

        <h3>2.4 令导数为 0，解方程</h3>
        <div class="derivation-step">
            <div class="math-block">
                \[
                \frac{8}{\theta} - \frac{2}{1-\theta} = 0
                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                \frac{8}{\theta} = \frac{2}{1-\theta}
                \]
            </div>
            <p>交叉相乘：</p>
            <div class="math-block">
                \[
                8(1-\theta) = 2\theta
                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                8 - 8\theta = 2\theta
                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                8 = 10\theta
                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                \theta = \frac{8}{10} = 0.8
                \]
            </div>
            <div class="derivation-note">
                <strong>【解方程思路】</strong> 移项 → 交叉相乘 → 合并同类项 → 系数化为 1。
            </div>
        </div>

        <h3>2.5 验证最大值（二阶导数）</h3>
        <div class="math-block">
            \[
            \ell''(\theta) = -\frac{8}{\theta^2} - \frac{2}{(1-\theta)^2} < 0 \] </div>
                <p>因为 \(\theta^2>0\) 且 \((1-\theta)^2>0\)，所以 \(\ell''(\theta)<0\) 恒成立，\(\theta=0.8\) 是 <strong>
                        最大值点</strong>。</p>

                <div class="math-block" style="background:#eef2f6;border-color:#cbd5e1;">
                    <div class="formula-source">✅ MLE 最终结论</div>
                    \[
                    \boxed{\hat{\theta}_{MLE} = \frac{8}{10} = 0.8}
                    \]
                    <p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#475569;margin-top:0.3rem;">最大似然估计认为：这枚硬币正面朝上的概率是
                        <strong>0.8</strong>（即 8/10）。
                    </p>
                </div>

                <hr class="hr-light">

                <!-- ============================================================ -->
                <!-- 第三部分：最大后验估计 (MAP) 全程推导                          -->
                <!-- ============================================================ -->
                <h2>第三部分 · 最大后验估计 (MAP) 全程推导</h2>
                <p><span class="theory-tag">核心理念</span> 在 MLE 的基础上，乘以一个 <strong>先验信念</strong> \(P(\theta)\)。
                    假设我们事先认为「大多数硬币是公平的」，用 \(P(\theta)=\theta(1-\theta)\) 来表达这种信念（该函数在 \(\theta=0.5\) 时取最大值）。</p>

                <h3>3.1 构造 MAP 目标函数（似然 × 先验）</h3>
                <div class="derivation-step">
                    <div class="math-block">
                        \[
                        \text{目标} = L(\theta) \times P(\theta)
                        = \big[\theta^{8}(1-\theta)^{2}\big] \times \big[\theta(1-\theta)\big]
                        \]
                    </div>
                    <p>合并同底数幂（指数相加）：</p>
                    <div class="math-block">
                        \[
                        \text{目标} = \theta^{8+1} \cdot (1-\theta)^{2+1}
                        = \theta^{9} (1-\theta)^{3}
                        \]
                    </div>
                    <div class="derivation-note">
                        <strong>【先验怎么变成指数的？】</strong> \(P(\theta)=\theta(1-\theta)\) 给 \(\theta\) 的指数加了 1，给
                        \((1-\theta)\) 的指数加了 1。
                        所以原来 8 变成 9，2 变成 3。
                    </div>
                </div>

                <h3>3.2 取对数</h3>
                <div class="math-block">
                    \[
                    \ell_{MAP}(\theta) = \ln\left[\theta^{9}(1-\theta)^{3}\right]
                    = 9\ln\theta + 3\ln(1-\theta)
                    \]
                </div>

                <h3>3.3 对 \(\theta\) 求导</h3>
                <div class="math-block">
                    \[
                    \ell_{MAP}'(\theta) = \frac{9}{\theta} - \frac{3}{1-\theta}
                    \]
                </div>

                <h3>3.4 令导数为 0，解方程</h3>
                <div class="derivation-step">
                    <div class="math-block">
                        \[
                        \frac{9}{\theta} - \frac{3}{1-\theta} = 0
                        \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                        \frac{9}{\theta} = \frac{3}{1-\theta}
                        \]
                    </div>
                    <p>交叉相乘：</p>
                    <div class="math-block">
                        \[
                        9(1-\theta) = 3\theta
                        \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                        9 - 9\theta = 3\theta
                        \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                        9 = 12\theta
                        \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                        \theta = \frac{9}{12} = 0.75
                        \]
                    </div>
                </div>

                <h3>3.5 验证最大值</h3>
                <div class="math-block">
                    \[
                    \ell_{MAP}''(\theta) = -\frac{9}{\theta^2} - \frac{3}{(1-\theta)^2} < 0 \] </div>

                        <div class="math-block" style="background:#eef2f6;border-color:#cbd5e1;">
                            <div class="formula-source">✅ MAP 最终结论</div>
                            \[
                            \boxed{\hat{\theta}_{MAP} = \frac{9}{12} = 0.75}
                            \]
                            <p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#475569;margin-top:0.3rem;">
                                最大后验估计认为：考虑了「硬币大多公平」的先验后，正面概率被拉向 0.5，估计值为 <strong>0.75</strong>。</p>
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <!-- 第四部分：MLE 与 MAP 的核心对比                               -->
                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <h2>第四部分 · MLE 与 MAP 的核心对比</h2>

                        <div class="compare-box">
                            <div class="compare-item">
                                <h4>📊 最大似然估计 (MLE)</h4>
                                <div class="math-block">
                                    \[
                                    \hat{\theta}_{MLE} = \arg\max_{\theta} P(\text{数据}|\theta)
                                    \]
                                </div>
                                <p><strong>只看数据</strong>，没有任何先验信念。</p>
                                <p>本例结果：\(\hat{\theta}_{MLE} = \dfrac{8}{10} = 0.8\)</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="compare-item">
                                <h4>📊 最大后验估计 (MAP)</h4>
                                <div class="math-block">
                                    \[
                                    \hat{\theta}_{MAP} = \arg\max_{\theta} P(\text{数据}|\theta) \cdot P(\theta)
                                    \]
                                </div>
                                <p><strong>数据 + 先验</strong>，先验 \(P(\theta)=\theta(1-\theta)\)。</p>
                                <p>本例结果：\(\hat{\theta}_{MAP} = \dfrac{9}{12} = 0.75\)</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <h3>4.1 公式对比（并排看）</h3>
                        <table>
                            <thead>
                                <tr>
                                    <th>方法</th>
                                    <th>目标函数（取对数前）</th>
                                    <th>目标函数（取对数后）</th>
                                    <th>解出的 \(\theta\)</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                                <tr>
                                    <td><strong>MLE</strong></td>
                                    <td>\(\theta^{8}(1-\theta)^{2}\)</td>
                                    <td>\(8\ln\theta + 2\ln(1-\theta)\)</td>
                                    <td>\(\dfrac{8}{10}=0.8\)</td>
                                </tr>
                                <tr>
                                    <td><strong>MAP</strong></td>
                                    <td>\(\theta^{9}(1-\theta)^{3}\)</td>
                                    <td>\(9\ln\theta + 3\ln(1-\theta)\)</td>
                                    <td>\(\dfrac{9}{12}=0.75\)</td>
                                </tr>
                            </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>【规律发现】</strong> MAP 仅仅是在 MLE 的指数上 <strong>各加了一个 1</strong>（来自先验
                            \(\theta(1-\theta)\)），
                            所以结果从 \(\frac{8}{10}\) 变成了 \(\frac{9}{12}\)。先验相当于 <strong>「虚拟数据」</strong>——提前看到了 1 次正面和 1
                            次反面。
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <!-- 第五部分：通用公式（n 个独立观测值）                           -->
                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <h2>第五部分 · 通用框架：\(n\) 个独立观测值</h2>
                        <p>现在把问题推广到 <strong>任意 \(n\) 次独立试验</strong>，观测值为 \(x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n\)。</p>

                        <h3>5.1 通用似然函数</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            L(\theta) = \prod_{i=1}^{n} P(x_i \mid \theta)
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>【含义】</strong> 连乘符号 \(\prod\) 表示把 \(n\) 个独立事件的概率乘在一起。
                            因为每次试验独立，所以联合概率等于各自概率的乘积。
                        </div>

                        <h3>5.2 取对数（通用）</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            \ell(\theta) = \ln L(\theta) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta)
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>【含义】</strong> 连乘变成连加（\(\sum\)），这是对数的核心威力。
                        </div>

                        <h3>5.3 MLE 通用极值方程</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            \boxed{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta) = 0}
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <p>解这个方程，得到的 \(\theta\) 就是最大似然估计值。</p>

                        <h3>5.4 MAP 通用极值方程</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            \boxed{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta) + \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln
                            P(\theta) = 0}
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>【对比】</strong> MAP 的方程比 MLE <strong>多了一项</strong> \(\frac{d}{d\theta}\ln P(\theta)\)，
                            这就是「先验」对估计值的 <strong>拉扯效应</strong>。
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <!-- 第六部分：抛硬币代入通用公式验证                              -->
                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <h2>第六部分 · 验证：把通用公式套回抛硬币</h2>
                        <p>抛 \(n\) 次硬币，正面出现 \(k\) 次。单个数据点 \(x_i \in \{1,0\}\) 的概率为：</p>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            P(x_i \mid \theta) = \theta^{x_i} (1-\theta)^{1-x_i}
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <p>（当 \(x_i=1\) 时为 \(\theta\)，当 \(x_i=0\) 时为 \(1-\theta\)，完美统一。）</p>

                        <h3>6.1 代入 MLE 通用公式</h3>
                        <div class="derivation-step">
                            <p>取对数：\(\ln P(x_i \mid \theta) = x_i \ln\theta + (1-x_i)\ln(1-\theta)\)</p>
                            <p>代入 \(\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{d}{d\theta}\ln P = 0\)：</p>
                            <div class="math-block">
                                \[
                                \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( \frac{x_i}{\theta} - \frac{1-x_i}{1-\theta} \right) = 0
                                \]
                            </div>
                            <p>因为 \(\sum x_i = k\)，\(\sum (1-x_i) = n-k\)：</p>
                            <div class="math-block">
                                \[
                                \frac{k}{\theta} - \frac{n-k}{1-\theta} = 0
                                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                                k(1-\theta) = (n-k)\theta
                                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                                \theta = \frac{k}{n}
                                \]
                            </div>
                            <div class="derivation-note">
                                <strong>✅ 完美吻合！</strong> MLE 的结果就是 <strong>频率</strong> \(k/n\)。
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <h3>6.2 代入 MAP 通用公式（先验 \(P(\theta)=\theta(1-\theta)\)）</h3>
                        <div class="derivation-step">
                            <p>先验对数：\(\ln P(\theta)=\ln\theta+\ln(1-\theta)\)，导数为 \(\frac{1}{\theta} -
                                \frac{1}{1-\theta}\)</p>
                            <p>代入 MAP 通式：</p>
                            <div class="math-block">
                                \[
                                \left( \frac{k}{\theta} - \frac{n-k}{1-\theta} \right)
                                + \left( \frac{1}{\theta} - \frac{1}{1-\theta} \right) = 0
                                \]
                            </div>
                            <p>合并同类项：</p>
                            <div class="math-block">
                                \[
                                \frac{k+1}{\theta} - \frac{n-k+1}{1-\theta} = 0
                                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                                (k+1)(1-\theta) = (n-k+1)\theta
                                \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
                                \theta = \frac{k+1}{n+2}
                                \]
                            </div>
                            <div class="derivation-note">
                                <strong>✅ 完美吻合！</strong> 对于 \(n=10, k=8\)，得 \(\frac{9}{12}=0.75\)。
                                先验给分子加了 1，分母加了 2（1 正 1 反）。
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <!-- 第七部分：终极总结                                              -->
                        <!-- ============================================================ -->
                        <h2>第七部分 · 终极总结（贴在笔记本扉页）</h2>

                        <div class="math-block" style="background:#eef2f6;border-color:#cbd5e1;">
                            <div class="formula-source">📖 两大核心公式</div>
                            <table style="box-shadow:none;margin:0.6rem 0;">
                                <thead>
                                    <tr>
                                        <th style="background:#1e293b;color:white;">方法</th>
                                        <th style="background:#1e293b;color:white;">目标函数（取对数后）</th>
                                        <th style="background:#1e293b;color:white;">极值方程（令导数为 0）</th>
                                    </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody>
                                    <tr>
                                        <td><strong>MLE</strong></td>
                                        <td>\(\displaystyle \ell(\theta) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta)\)</td>
                                        <td>\(\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta) =
                                            0\)</td>
                                    </tr>
                                    <tr>
                                        <td><strong>MAP</strong></td>
                                        <td>\(\displaystyle \ell_{MAP}(\theta) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta) +
                                            \ln P(\theta)\)</td>
                                        <td>\(\displaystyle \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln P(x_i \mid \theta) +
                                            \frac{d}{d\theta} \ln P(\theta) = 0\)</td>
                                    </tr>
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>

                        <div class="note-box">
                            <strong>🎯 操作口诀：</strong><br>
                            遇见数据多，先写似然乘积；<br>
                            取对数变求和，求导令零解方程。<br>
                            MLE 解数据，MAP 多加个先验导。
                        </div>

                        <div
                            style="background:#f0f7ff;padding:1.5rem 2rem;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #dbeafe;margin-top:1.5rem;">
                            <h4 style="margin-top:0;">📌 什么场景用什么？</h4>
                            <ul style="font-size:1.05rem;line-height:2.2;margin-left:1.2rem;">
                                <li><strong>有大量可靠数据</strong> → 用 <strong>MLE</strong>（简单直接，数据会淹没先验）。</li>
                                <li><strong>数据很少</strong> 或 <strong>先验非常强</strong>（如物理定律） → 用 <strong>MAP</strong>（更稳健）。
                                </li>
                                <li><strong>数据量极大时</strong>，MLE 和 MAP 结果 <strong>趋同</strong>（先验被稀释）。</li>
                            </ul>
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <h2>第八部分 · 多个事件（A、B、C 三类结果）</h2>
                        <p>当一次试验有 <strong>3 种互斥结果</strong>（如抽奖分红、黄、蓝），记为 A、B、C，对应概率 \(\theta_A, \theta_B, \theta_C\)，且
                            \(\theta_A+\theta_B+\theta_C=1\)。</p>
                        <p>重复 \(N\) 次，观察到 \(n_A, n_B, n_C\) 次，\(n_A+n_B+n_C=N\)。</p>

                        <h3>8.1 MLE 结果</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            \hat{\theta}_A^{MLE} = \frac{n_A}{N},\quad
                            \hat{\theta}_B^{MLE} = \frac{n_B}{N},\quad
                            \hat{\theta}_C^{MLE} = \frac{n_C}{N}
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>推导思路：</strong> 似然函数为 \(\theta_A^{n_A}\theta_B^{n_B}\theta_C^{n_C}\)，
                            在约束 \(\theta_A+\theta_B+\theta_C=1\) 下求偏导，得到频率比例。
                        </div>

                        <h3>8.2 MAP 结果（先验 \(\theta_A\theta_B\theta_C\)）</h3>
                        <div class="math-block">
                            \[
                            \hat{\theta}_A^{MAP} = \frac{n_A+1}{N+3},\quad
                            \hat{\theta}_B^{MAP} = \frac{n_B+1}{N+3},\quad
                            \hat{\theta}_C^{MAP} = \frac{n_C+1}{N+3}
                            \]
                        </div>
                        <div class="derivation-note">
                            <strong>【规律】</strong> 每个类别的分子加 1，分母加 3（共 3 个类别）。
                            这就是「虚拟数据」——提前看到 A、B、C 各一次。
                        </div>

                        <hr class="hr-light">

                        <div class="footer-meta">
                            📐 使用 KaTeX 渲染 &nbsp;|&nbsp; 从零推导 &nbsp;|&nbsp; 最大似然估计 · 最大后验估计
                        </div>

                </div>
</body>

</html>

// check-update.js
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const CHECK_INTERVAL = 30000;
    const VERSION_URL = 'https://dywritecode.github.io/version.json'; // 如果是项目站点，可能需要加仓库名前缀，如 '/仓库名/version.json'

    // ---------- 工具：获取当前版本（存在 localStorage） ----------
    function getLocalVersion() {
        return localStorage.getItem('app_version') || null;
    }

    function setLocalVersion(ver) {
        localStorage.setItem('app_version', ver);
    }

    // ---------- 检测更新 ----------
    function checkUpdate() {
        // 加随机参数破除缓存
        const url = VERSION_URL + '?t=' + Date.now();

        fetch(url)
            .then(res => {
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Version file not found');
                return res.json();
            })
            .then(data => {
                const remoteVer = data.version;
                const localVer = getLocalVersion();

                if (!remoteVer) return;

                // 首次访问：存下当前版本，不提示
                if (!localVer) {
                    setLocalVersion(remoteVer);
                    return;
                }

                // 如果远程版本与本地不同，说明有新部署
                if (remoteVer !== localVer) {
                    showUpdateNotification(remoteVer);
                }
            })
            .catch(err => {
                // 静默失败，不影响网站主逻辑
                // console.warn('Version check failed:', err);
            });
    }

    // ---------- 显示更新通知（定制样式，与你的网站风格一致） ----------
    function showUpdateNotification(remoteVer) {
        // 防止重复弹窗
        if (document.querySelector('.update-toast')) return;

        const toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = 'update-toast';
        toast.innerHTML = `
            <div class="update-toast-content">
                <span>🔄 网站已更新 <span style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.7;">(${remoteVer})</span></span>
                <button class="update-toast-btn">立即刷新</button>
            </div>
        `;

        // 样式设计（适配你网站暖色调）
        const style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = `
            .update-toast {
                position: fixed;
                bottom: 30px;
                left: 50%;
                transform: translateX(-50%);
                background: #3d352e;
                color: #f5f2eb;
                padding: 12px 24px;
                border-radius: 40px;
                box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
                z-index: 99999;
                font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
                font-size: 14px;
                border: 1px solid #b5654b;
                animation: slideUp 0.4s ease-out;
                backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
                background: rgba(45, 42, 36, 0.92);
            }
            .update-toast-content {
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: 18px;
            }
            .update-toast-btn {
                background: #b5654b;
                border: none;
                color: #fff;
                padding: 6px 20px;
                border-radius: 30px;
                font-weight: 600;
                font-size: 13px;
                cursor: pointer;
                transition: background 0.2s;
                letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(181, 101, 75, 0.3);
            }
            .update-toast-btn:hover {
                background: #9a4f38;
                transform: scale(1.02);
            }
            .update-toast-btn:active {
                transform: scale(0.96);
            }
            @keyframes slideUp {
                from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px); }
                to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
            }
            @media (max-width: 640px) {
                .update-toast {
                    width: 90%;
                    padding: 12px 16px;
                    bottom: 16px;
                    font-size: 13px;
                }
                .update-toast-content {
                    flex-wrap: wrap;
                    justify-content: center;
                    gap: 10px;
                }
            }
        `;

        document.head.appendChild(style);

        // 点击刷新按钮：更新本地存储并刷新页面
        const btn = toast.querySelector('.update-toast-btn');
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            setLocalVersion(remoteVer);
            window.location.reload();
        });

        // 也可以点击整个 Toast 刷新（可选）
        toast.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (e.target.tagName !== 'BUTTON') {
                setLocalVersion(remoteVer);
                window.location.reload();
            }
        });

        document.body.appendChild(toast);

        // 5分钟后自动关闭（可选）
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (toast.parentNode) {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                toast.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s';
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 500);
            }
        }, 300000);
    }

    // ---------- 启动轮询 ----------
    // 1. 首次加载立即检测
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
        checkUpdate();
    } else {
        window.addEventListener('load', checkUpdate);
    }

    // 2. 定时轮询
    setInterval(checkUpdate, CHECK_INTERVAL);

    // 3. 用户切回页面时（从后台恢复）主动检测一次
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
        if (!document.hidden) {
            // 切回页面时，延迟2秒检测（避免频繁请求）
            clearTimeout(window._visibilityTimer);
            window._visibilityTimer = setTimeout(checkUpdate, 2000);
        }
    });

})();

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // 创建涟漪容器（如果不存在）
    let container = document.querySelector('.ripple-container');
    if (!container) {
        container = document.createElement('div');
        container.className = 'ripple-container';
        document.body.appendChild(container);
    }

    // 随机颜色生成
    function getRandomColor() {
        const colors = ['radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.7) 0%, rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.4) 60%, rgba(0, 100, 200, 0) 100%)',
            'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.6) 0%, rgba(64, 224, 208, 0.4) 50%, rgba(0, 128, 128, 0) 100%)',
            'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 0%, rgba(135, 206, 250, 0.4) 50%, rgba(70, 130, 180, 0) 100%)',
            'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.7) 0%, rgba(0, 191, 255, 0.5) 60%, rgba(0, 0, 139, 0) 100%)',];
        return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    }

    // 点击涟漪效果
    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        const ripple = document.createElement('div');
        ripple.className = 'ripple';

        const x = e.clientX;
        const y = e.clientY;
        const size = 30 + Math.random() * 50; // 30~80px
        ripple.style.width = size + 'px';
        ripple.style.height = size + 'px';
        ripple.style.left = (x - size / 2) + 'px';
        ripple.style.top = (y - size / 2) + 'px';
        ripple.style.background = getRandomColor();

        container.appendChild(ripple);

        // 动画结束后移除元素
        ripple.addEventListener('animationend', function () {
            ripple.remove();
        });
    });
});

                    <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:12px;">发射 + 爆炸</span>
                </div>
                <div class="instance-list" id="fireworkList">
                    <div class="text-muted" style="padding:10px 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;">
                        暂无烟花，点击「添加烟花」创建
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="footnote">
            ⚡ 所有音频使用 Web Audio API · 页面启动时自动预加载 <code>config</code> 中的所有音频 · 截断参数在 <code>config.sounds</code> 中调整
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // ================================================================
        //  📦  CONFIG  —  声音路径 & 截断参数
        // ================================================================
        const config = {
            // 每个声音的配置：url（路径），start（起始秒），end（结束秒）
            sounds: {
                heartbeat: {
                    url: "https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/heart.mp3",
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 2.0,
                },
                city: {
                    url: 'https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/city.mp3',
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 6.0,
                },
                space: {
                    url: 'https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/space.mp3',
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 4.0,
                },
                meteor: {
                    url: 'https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/meteor.mp3',
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 3.5,
                },
                firework_launch: {
                    url: 'https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/firework_go.mp3',
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 1.8,
                },
                firework_explode: {
                    url: 'https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh/DyWriteCode/DyWriteCode.github.io/TEST_FUNCION/AUDIO/firework_boom.mp3',
                    start: 0.0,
                    end: 2.5,
                },
            },
            // 流星默认轨迹参数
            meteor: {
                panStart: -0.8, // 左声道起始 (-1 ~ 1)
                panEnd: 0.8, // 右声道终点
                volumeStart: 0.6,
                volumeEnd: 0.2,
                duration: 3.5, // 总时长（秒），会与截断取较小值
            },
            // 烟花默认参数
            firework: {
                launchDuration: 1.5,
                explodeDelay: 0.6, // 发射后多久爆炸
                panSpread: 0.6, // 爆炸时立体声扩散度
            },
        };
        // ================================================================
        //  🎛️  音频引擎 (Web Audio API)
        // ================================================================
        class AudioEngine {
            constructor() {
                this.ctx = null;
                this.buffers = {};
                this.activeSources = new Map();
                this.sourceIdCounter = 0;
                this.isPreloading = false;
            }

            getContext() {
                if (!this.ctx) {
                    this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
                }
                return this.ctx;
            }

            // 预加载所有配置的音频
            async preloadAll(soundConfigs) {
                this.isPreloading = true;
                const entries = Object.entries(soundConfigs);
                const loadPromises = entries.map(([key, cfg]) => {
                    if (cfg.url) {
                        // loadSound 内部会处理失败并回退到合成音
                        return this.loadSound(key, cfg.url).catch(err => {
                            console.warn(`预加载 ${key} 失败，使用合成后备音`, err);
                            return null;
                        });
                    }
                    return Promise.resolve();
                });
                await Promise.all(loadPromises);
                this.isPreloading = false;
                console.log('✅ 所有音频预加载完成');
            }

            async loadSound(key, url) {
                if (this.buffers[key]) return this.buffers[key];
                try {
                    const resp = await fetch(url);
                    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
                    const arrayBuffer = await resp.arrayBuffer();
                    const ctx = this.getContext();
                    const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
                    this.buffers[key] = audioBuffer;
                    return audioBuffer;
                } catch (err) {
                    console.warn(`⚠️ 加载音频 "${key}" 失败 (${url})，使用合成音代替`, err);
                    const synth = this.synthesizeFallback(key);
                    this.buffers[key] = synth;
                    return synth;
                }
            }

            // ----- 合成后备音 (与之前一致) -----
            synthesizeFallback(key) {
                const ctx = this.getContext();
                const sampleRate = ctx.sampleRate;
                let duration = 3.0;
                switch (key) {
                    case 'heartbeat':
                        duration = 2.0;
                        return this.synthHeartbeat(ctx, sampleRate);
                    case 'city':
                        duration = 6.0;
                        return this.synthCity(ctx, sampleRate);
                    case 'space':
                        duration = 4.0;
                        return this.synthSpace(ctx, sampleRate);
                    case 'meteor':
                        duration = 3.5;
                        return this.synthMeteor(ctx, sampleRate);
                    case 'firework_launch':
                        duration = 1.8;
                        return this.synthFireworkLaunch(ctx, sampleRate);
                    case 'firework_explode':
                        duration = 2.5;
                        return this.synthFireworkExplode(ctx, sampleRate);
                    default:
                        duration = 2.0;
                        return this.synthGeneric(ctx, sampleRate);
                }
            }

            synthHeartbeat(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 2.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    let env = 0;
                    if (t < 0.15) env = Math.sin(t / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                    else if (t < 0.3) env = Math.sin((t - 0.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.4;
                    else if (t > 1.0 && t < 1.15) env = Math.sin((t - 1.0) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.7;
                    else if (t > 1.15 && t < 1.3) env = Math.sin((t - 1.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.3;
                    const freq = 60 + 30 * Math.sin(t * 8);
                    d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthCity(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 6.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    let noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.3;
                    const hum = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 120 * t) * 0.1;
                    const ring = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 800 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.05;
                    const spike = (Math.random() > 0.995) ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 : 0;
                    const env = Math.exp(-t * 0.08) * 0.8 + 0.2;
                    d[i] = (noise + hum + ring + spike) * env * 0.6;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthSpace(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 4.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    const freq = 80 + 40 * Math.sin(t * 0.5);
                    const v = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * 0.3 +
                        Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (freq * 1.5) * t) * 0.1;
                    d[i] = v * Math.exp(-t * 0.05) * 0.6;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthMeteor(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 3.5;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    const freq = 800 - t * 200 + Math.sin(t * 30) * 50;
                    const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.2) * 0.7 + 0.1;
                    const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15 * env;
                    const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                    d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthFireworkLaunch(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 1.8;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    const freq = 150 + t * 600;
                    const env = Math.sin(t / dur * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                    const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 * env;
                    const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                    d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthFireworkExplode(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 2.5;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.8) * 0.9;
                    const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.6 * env;
                    const low = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 80 * t) * env * 0.3;
                    const mid = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 300 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 2.5) * 0.2;
                    d[i] = (noise + low + mid) * 0.6;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            synthGeneric(ctx, sr) {
                const dur = 2.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.3;
                }
                return buf;
            }

            // ----- 播放逻辑 (与之前一致) -----
            async playSound(key, startTime, endTime, volume = 0.8, pan = 0) {
                const buffer = await this.loadSound(key, config.sounds[key]?.url || '');
                if (!buffer) return null;

                const ctx = this.getContext();
                const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
                source.buffer = buffer;

                const gainNode = ctx.createGain();
                gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, volume));

                const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner();
                panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));

                source.connect(gainNode);
                gainNode.connect(panner);
                panner.connect(ctx.destination);

                const actualStart = Math.min(Math.max(0, startTime || 0), buffer.duration - 0.05);
                const actualEnd = Math.min(Math.max(actualStart + 0.05, endTime || buffer.duration), buffer.duration);
                const duration = actualEnd - actualStart;

                source.start(0, actualStart, duration);

                const id = ++this.sourceIdCounter;
                const entry = {
                    id,
                    key,
                    source,
                    gainNode,
                    panner,
                    startTime: actualStart,
                    endTime: actualEnd,
                    isPlaying: true,
                    stop: () => {
                        try { source.stop(); } catch (_) { }
                        entry.isPlaying = false;
                        this.activeSources.delete(id);
                    },
                };
                this.activeSources.set(id, entry);

                source.onended = () => {
                    entry.isPlaying = false;
                    this.activeSources.delete(id);
                };

                return entry;
            }

            stopSound(id) {
                const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
                if (entry) {
                    entry.stop();
                    this.activeSources.delete(id);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }

            stopAll() {
                for (const [id, entry] of this.activeSources) {
                    entry.stop();
                }
                this.activeSources.clear();
            }

            setVolume(id, vol) {
                const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
                if (entry) {
                    entry.gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, vol));
                }
            }

            setPan(id, pan) {
                const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
                if (entry) {
                    entry.panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));
                }
            }

            isPlaying(id) {
                const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
                return entry ? entry.isPlaying : false;
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  🧩  流星管理器 (与之前一致)
        // ================================================================
        class MeteorManager {
            constructor(engine) {
                this.engine = engine;
                this.meteors = [];
                this.idCounter = 0;
                this.onUpdate = null;
                this.animFrame = null;
                this.isRunning = false;
            }

            async addMeteor(panStart, panEnd, volStart, volEnd, duration) {
                const cfg = config.meteor;
                const startPan = panStart ?? cfg.panStart;
                const endPan = panEnd ?? cfg.panEnd;
                const startVol = volStart ?? cfg.volumeStart;
                const endVol = volEnd ?? cfg.volumeEnd;
                const dur = Math.min(duration ?? cfg.duration, config.sounds.meteor.end - config.sounds.meteor.start || 3.5);

                const id = ++this.idCounter;
                const meteor = {
                    id,
                    panStart: startPan,
                    panEnd: endPan,
                    volStart: startVol,
                    volEnd: endVol,
                    duration: dur,
                    elapsed: 0,
                    isPlaying: false,
                    sourceId: null,
                    progress: 0,
                    active: true,
                };

                this.meteors.push(meteor);
                this._startAnimation();
                this._updateUI();
                return meteor;
            }

            async playMeteor(meteor) {
                if (meteor.isPlaying) return;
                const key = 'meteor';
                const cfg = config.sounds.meteor;
                const entry = await this.engine.playSound(
                    key,
                    cfg.start,
                    cfg.end,
                    meteor.volStart,
                    meteor.panStart
                );
                if (entry) {
                    meteor.sourceId = entry.id;
                    meteor.isPlaying = true;
                    meteor.elapsed = 0;
                    meteor.progress = 0;
                    this._updateUI();
                }
            }

            stopMeteor(meteor) {
                if (meteor.sourceId) {
                    this.engine.stopSound(meteor.sourceId);
                    meteor.sourceId = null;
                }
                meteor.isPlaying = false;
                this._updateUI();
            }

            removeMeteor(meteor) {
                this.stopMeteor(meteor);
                meteor.active = false;
                this.meteors = this.meteors.filter(m => m !== meteor);
                if (this.meteors.length === 0) this._stopAnimation();
                this._updateUI();
            }

            clearAll() {
                for (const m of this.meteors) this.stopMeteor(m);
                this.meteors = [];
                this._stopAnimation();
                this._updateUI();
            }

            _startAnimation() {
                if (this.isRunning) return;
                this.isRunning = true;
                const step = () => {
                    if (!this.isRunning) return;
                    let hasActive = false;
                    for (const m of this.meteors) {
                        if (!m.isPlaying) continue;
                        hasActive = true;
                        m.elapsed += 0.04;
                        m.progress = Math.min(1, m.elapsed / m.duration);
                        const pan = m.panStart + (m.panEnd - m.panStart) * m.progress;
                        const vol = m.volStart + (m.volEnd - m.volStart) * m.progress;
                        this.engine.setPan(m.sourceId, pan);
                        this.engine.setVolume(m.sourceId, vol);
                        if (m.progress >= 1) this.stopMeteor(m);
                    }
                    this._updateUI();
                    if (hasActive || this.meteors.some(m => m.isPlaying)) {
                        this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    } else {
                        this.isRunning = false;
                        this.animFrame = null;
                    }
                };
                this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
            }

            _stopAnimation() {
                this.isRunning = false;
                if (this.animFrame) {
                    cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrame);
                    this.animFrame = null;
                }
            }

            _updateUI() { if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.meteors); }
            get count() { return this.meteors.length; }
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  🎆  烟花管理器 (与之前一致)
        // ================================================================
        class FireworkManager {
            constructor(engine) {
                this.engine = engine;
                this.fireworks = [];
                this.idCounter = 0;
                this.onUpdate = null;
                this.timeouts = [];
            }

            async addFirework() {
                const id = ++this.idCounter;
                const fw = { id, isPlaying: false, launchId: null, explodeId: null, active: true, phase: 'idle' };
                this.fireworks.push(fw);
                this._updateUI();
                await this._playFirework(fw);
                return fw;
            }

            async _playFirework(fw) {
                if (fw.isPlaying) return;
                fw.isPlaying = true;
                fw.phase = 'launching';
                this._updateUI();

                const launchCfg = config.sounds.firework_launch;
                const launchEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                    'firework_launch',
                    launchCfg.start,
                    launchCfg.end,
                    0.7,
                    0
                );
                fw.launchId = launchEntry?.id || null;

                let launchProgress = 0;
                const launchInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) { clearInterval(launchInterval); return; }
                    launchProgress += 0.05;
                    const vol = 0.4 + launchProgress * 0.5;
                    const pan = Math.sin(launchProgress * 3) * 0.2;
                    if (fw.launchId) {
                        this.engine.setVolume(fw.launchId, Math.min(1, vol));
                        this.engine.setPan(fw.launchId, pan);
                    }
                    if (launchProgress >= 1) clearInterval(launchInterval);
                }, 50);

                const delay = config.firework.explodeDelay || 0.6;
                const timeoutId = setTimeout(async () => {
                    if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) return;
                    if (fw.launchId) {
                        this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                        fw.launchId = null;
                    }
                    fw.phase = 'exploding';
                    this._updateUI();
                    const explodeCfg = config.sounds.firework_explode;
                    const panSpread = config.firework.panSpread || 0.6;
                    const pan = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * panSpread;
                    const explodeEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                        'firework_explode',
                        explodeCfg.start,
                        explodeCfg.end,
                        0.9,
                        pan
                    );
                    fw.explodeId = explodeEntry?.id || null;
                    if (explodeEntry) {
                        const checkDone = () => {
                            if (!fw.active) return;
                            if (!this.engine.isPlaying(explodeEntry.id)) {
                                fw.isPlaying = false;
                                fw.phase = 'done';
                                this._updateUI();
                            } else { setTimeout(checkDone, 200); }
                        };
                        setTimeout(checkDone, 100);
                    } else {
                        fw.isPlaying = false;
                        fw.phase = 'done';
                        this._updateUI();
                    }
                }, delay * 1000);

                this.timeouts.push(timeoutId);
                fw._cleanup = () => {
                    clearInterval(launchInterval);
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    if (fw.launchId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                    if (fw.explodeId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.explodeId);
                    fw.launchId = null;
                    fw.explodeId = null;
                    fw.isPlaying = false;
                };
            }

            stopFirework(fw) {
                if (fw._cleanup) fw._cleanup();
                fw.isPlaying = false;
                fw.phase = 'idle';
                this._updateUI();
            }
            removeFirework(fw) {
                this.stopFirework(fw);
                fw.active = false;
                this.fireworks = this.fireworks.filter(f => f !== fw);
                this._updateUI();
            }
            clearAll() {
                for (const fw of this.fireworks) this.stopFirework(fw);
                this.fireworks = [];
                this.timeouts.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
                this.timeouts = [];
                this._updateUI();
            }
            get count() { return this.fireworks.length; }
            _updateUI() { if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.fireworks); }
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  🖥️  UI 控制器 (包含预加载逻辑)
        // ================================================================
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const engine = new AudioEngine();
            const preloadStatus = document.getElementById('preloadStatus');

            // ----- 预加载所有音频 -----
            const allPlayBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.play-btn');
            const addMeteorBtn = document.getElementById('addMeteorBtn');
            const addFireworkBtn = document.getElementById('addFireworkBtn');

            // 初始禁用所有操作按钮
            const disableAllControls = (disabled = true) => {
                allPlayBtns.forEach(btn => btn.disabled = disabled);
                addMeteorBtn.disabled = disabled;
                addFireworkBtn.disabled = disabled;
                // 停止按钮不受影响，但保持逻辑
            };
            disableAllControls(true);

            preloadStatus.textContent = '⏳ 正在预加载音频文件...';
            preloadStatus.className = 'loading';

            // 开始预加载
            engine.preloadAll(config.sounds).then(() => {
                preloadStatus.textContent = '✅ 所有音频预加载完成，可以播放';
                preloadStatus.className = 'ready';
                disableAllControls(false);
                // 更新简单播放器的按钮状态（因为之前可能被手动禁用）
                for (const key of ['heartbeat', 'city', 'space']) {
                    const status = simpleStatusMap[key];
                    if (status) status.updateButtons();
                }
            }).catch(err => {
                // 理论上不会触发，因为 loadSound 捕获了所有错误
                preloadStatus.textContent = '⚠️ 预加载出现问题，但已使用合成音后备';
                preloadStatus.className = 'ready';
                disableAllControls(false);
                console.warn('预加载异常', err);
            });

            // ----- 简单声音播放器 (心跳 / 城市 / 太空) -----
            const simpleKeys = ['heartbeat', 'city', 'space'];
            const simpleStatusMap = {};

            for (const key of simpleKeys) {
                const cfg = config.sounds[key];
                const playBtn = document.querySelector(`.play-btn[data-sound="${key}"]`);
                const stopBtn = document.querySelector(`.stop-btn[data-sound="${key}"]`);
                const statusEl = document.getElementById(`${key}Status`);
                const rangeEl = document.getElementById(`${key}Range`);

                if (rangeEl) {
                    rangeEl.textContent = `${cfg.start.toFixed(2)} – ${cfg.end.toFixed(2)} s`;
                }

                let currentId = null;

                const updateButtons = () => {
                    const playing = currentId !== null && engine.isPlaying(currentId);
                    // 只有不在预加载状态时才启用（预加载完成后由 disableAllControls 控制）
                    const preloading = engine.isPreloading;
                    playBtn.disabled = playing || preloading;
                    stopBtn.disabled = !playing || preloading;
                    if (statusEl) {
                        statusEl.textContent = playing ? '▶ 播放中' : '● 就绪';
                        statusEl.className = 'status' + (playing ? ' playing' : '');
                    }
                };

                simpleStatusMap[key] = { updateButtons };

                playBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                    try {
                        const entry = await engine.playSound(
                            key,
                            cfg.start,
                            cfg.end,
                            0.8,
                            0
                        );
                        if (entry) {
                            currentId = entry.id;
                            updateButtons();
                            const checkDone = () => {
                                if (!engine.isPlaying(entry.id)) {
                                    currentId = null;
                                    updateButtons();
                                } else {
                                    setTimeout(checkDone, 200);
                                }
                            };
                            setTimeout(checkDone, 100);
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('播放失败', e);
                    }
                });

                stopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (currentId !== null) {
                        engine.stopSound(currentId);
                        currentId = null;
                        updateButtons();
                    }
                });

                // 初始更新
                updateButtons();
            }

            // ----- 流星管理器 -----
            const meteorManager = new MeteorManager(engine);
            const meteorList = document.getElementById('meteorList');
            const meteorCount = document.getElementById('meteorCount');
            const clearMeteorsBtn = document.getElementById('clearMeteorsBtn');

            const renderMeteors = (meteors) => {
                if (meteors.length === 0) {
                    meteorList.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-muted" style="padding:10px 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;">
                            🌠 暂无流星，点击「添加流星」创建
                        </div>
                    `;
                    meteorCount.textContent = '0 个';
                    clearMeteorsBtn.disabled = true;
                    return;
                }
                clearMeteorsBtn.disabled = false;
                meteorCount.textContent = `${meteors.length} 个`;

                let html = '';
                for (const m of meteors) {
                    const statusText = m.isPlaying ? '▶ 坠落中' : '● 待机';
                    const statusCls = m.isPlaying ? 'active' : '';
                    const progress = (m.progress * 100).toFixed(0);
                    html += `
                        <div class="instance-item" data-meteor-id="${m.id}">
                            <span class="name">☄️ #${m.id}</span>
                            <span class="trail">轨迹 ${m.panStart.toFixed(1)} → ${m.panEnd.toFixed(1)}</span>
                            <span class="mini-status ${statusCls}">${statusText}</span>
                            <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:11px;">${progress}%</span>
                            <div class="controls">
                                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm meteor-play" data-id="${m.id}" ${m.isPlaying ? 'disabled' : ''}>▶</button>
                                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm meteor-stop" data-id="${m.id}" ${!m.isPlaying ? 'disabled' : ''}>■</button>
                                <button class="btn btn-sm meteor-remove" data-id="${m.id}" style="background:#3a2a2a;border-color:#5a3a3a;">✕</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
                meteorList.innerHTML = html;

                meteorList.querySelectorAll('.meteor-play').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const id = parseInt(btn.dataset.id);
                        const meteor = meteorManager.meteors.find(m => m.id === id);
                        if (meteor) meteorManager.playMeteor(meteor);
                    });
                });
                meteorList.querySelectorAll('.meteor-stop').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const id = parseInt(btn.dataset.id);
                        const meteor = meteorManager.meteors.find(m => m.id === id);
                        if (meteor) meteorManager.stopMeteor(meteor);
                    });
                });
                meteorList.querySelectorAll('.meteor-remove').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const id = parseInt(btn.dataset.id);
                        const meteor = meteorManager.meteors.find(m => m.id === id);
                        if (meteor) meteorManager.removeMeteor(meteor);
                    });
                });
            };

            meteorManager.onUpdate = renderMeteors;

            addMeteorBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                const panStart = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.9;
                const panEnd = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.9;
                const volStart = 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4;
                const volEnd = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.2;
                const duration = 2.0 + Math.random() * 2.0;
                const meteor = await meteorManager.addMeteor(
                    panStart, panEnd, volStart, volEnd, duration
                );
                await meteorManager.playMeteor(meteor);
            });

            clearMeteorsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                meteorManager.clearAll();
            });

            // ----- 烟花管理器 -----
            const fireworkManager = new FireworkManager(engine);
            const fireworkList = document.getElementById('fireworkList');
            const fireworkCount = document.getElementById('fireworkCount');
            const clearFireworksBtn = document.getElementById('clearFireworksBtn');

            const renderFireworks = (fireworks) => {
                if (fireworks.length === 0) {
                    fireworkList.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="text-muted" style="padding:10px 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;">
                            🎆 暂无烟花，点击「添加烟花」创建
                        </div>
                    `;
                    fireworkCount.textContent = '0 个';
                    clearFireworksBtn.disabled = true;
                    return;
                }
                clearFireworksBtn.disabled = false;
                fireworkCount.textContent = `${fireworks.length} 个`;

                const phaseMap = { 'idle': '⏸ 待机', 'launching': '🚀 发射中', 'exploding': '💥 爆炸', 'done': '✅ 完成' };

                let html = '';
                for (const fw of fireworks) {
                    const phaseText = phaseMap[fw.phase] || fw.phase;
                    const isActive = fw.phase === 'launching' || fw.phase === 'exploding';
                    html += `
                        <div class="instance-item" data-firework-id="${fw.id}">
                            <span class="name">🎆 #${fw.id}</span>
                            <span class="trail">${phaseText}</span>
                            <span class="mini-status ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}">${isActive ? '▶ 播放中' : '●'}</span>
                            <div class="controls">
                                <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm firework-remove" data-id="${fw.id}" style="background:#3a2a2a;border-color:#5a3a3a;">✕ 移除</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
                fireworkList.innerHTML = html;

                fireworkList.querySelectorAll('.firework-remove').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        const id = parseInt(btn.dataset.id);
                        const fw = fireworkManager.fireworks.find(f => f.id === id);
                        if (fw) fireworkManager.removeFirework(fw);
                    });
                });
            };

            fireworkManager.onUpdate = renderFireworks;

            addFireworkBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                await fireworkManager.addFirework();
            });

            clearFireworksBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                fireworkManager.clearAll();
            });

            // ----- 初始渲染 -----
            renderMeteors([]);
            renderFireworks([]);

            // 暴露调试
            window.__audioDebug = { engine, config, meteorManager, fireworkManager };
            console.log('🔊 当前声音配置:');
            console.log(JSON.stringify(config, null, 2));
            console.log('💡 提示: 修改 config 对象即可调整音频路径和截断参数');
        });
    </script>
