// sound-configurator.js
/**
 * Sound Configurator - 声音配置与播放核心
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 管理心跳、城市、太空、流星、烟花等音效，支持预加载、轨迹控制
 * @dependencies 无 (使用原生 Web Audio API 和 fetch)
 *
 * @example
 * // 浏览器引入
 * <script src="sound-configurator.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const { engine, meteorManager, fireworkManager } = await SoundSystem.create({
 *       sounds: {
 *           heartbeat: { url: 'heartbeat.mp3', start: 0, end: 2 }
 *       }
 *   });
 *   await engine.playSound('heartbeat', 0, 2);
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // ES Module
 * import SoundSystem from './sound-configurator.js';
 * const system = await SoundSystem.create();
 * system.engine.playSound('space', 0, 4);
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 默认配置 (可直接覆盖)
    // ============================================================
    const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
        sounds: {
            heartbeat: { url: 'heartbeat.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 2.0 },
            city: { url: 'city_ambient.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 6.0 },
            space: { url: 'space_hum.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 4.0 },
            meteor: { url: 'meteor_fall.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 3.5 },
            firework_launch: { url: 'firework_launch.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 1.8 },
            firework_explode: { url: 'firework_explode.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 2.5 },
        },
        meteor: {
            panStart: -0.8,
            panEnd: 0.8,
            volumeStart: 0.6,
            volumeEnd: 0.2,
            duration: 3.5,
        },
        firework: {
            launchDuration: 1.5,
            explodeDelay: 0.6,
            panSpread: 0.6,
        },
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 音频引擎 (Web Audio API)
    // ============================================================
    class AudioEngine {
        constructor() {
            this.ctx = null;
            this.buffers = {};
            this.activeSources = new Map();
            this.sourceIdCounter = 0;
            this.isPreloading = false;
        }

        getContext() {
            if (!this.ctx) {
                this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            }
            return this.ctx;
        }

        async preloadAll(soundConfigs) {
            this.isPreloading = true;
            const entries = Object.entries(soundConfigs);
            await Promise.all(entries.map(([key, cfg]) => {
                if (cfg.url) {
                    return this.loadSound(key, cfg.url).catch(err => {
                        console.warn(`预加载 ${key} 失败，使用合成后备音`, err);
                        return null;
                    });
                }
                return Promise.resolve();
            }));
            this.isPreloading = false;
            console.log('✅ 所有音频预加载完成');
        }

        async loadSound(key, url) {
            if (this.buffers[key]) return this.buffers[key];
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url);
                if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
                const arrayBuffer = await resp.arrayBuffer();
                const ctx = this.getContext();
                const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
                this.buffers[key] = audioBuffer;
                return audioBuffer;
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn(`⚠️ 加载音频 "${key}" 失败 (${url})，使用合成音代替`, err);
                const synth = this._synthesizeFallback(key);
                this.buffers[key] = synth;
                return synth;
            }
        }

        // ----- 合成后备音 (内部) -----
        _synthesizeFallback(key) {
            const ctx = this.getContext();
            const sr = ctx.sampleRate;
            const synths = {
                heartbeat: () => {
                    const dur = 2.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        let env = 0;
                        if (t < 0.15) env = Math.sin(t / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                        else if (t < 0.3) env = Math.sin((t - 0.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.4;
                        else if (t > 1.0 && t < 1.15) env = Math.sin((t - 1.0) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.7;
                        else if (t > 1.15 && t < 1.3) env = Math.sin((t - 1.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.3;
                        const freq = 60 + 30 * Math.sin(t * 8);
                        d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                city: () => {
                    const dur = 6.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.3;
                        const hum = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 120 * t) * 0.1;
                        const ring = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 800 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.05;
                        const spike = (Math.random() > 0.995) ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 : 0;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 0.08) * 0.8 + 0.2;
                        d[i] = (noise + hum + ring + spike) * env * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                space: () => {
                    const dur = 4.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 80 + 40 * Math.sin(t * 0.5);
                        const v = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * 0.3 +
                            Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (freq * 1.5) * t) * 0.1;
                        d[i] = v * Math.exp(-t * 0.05) * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                meteor: () => {
                    const dur = 3.5;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 800 - t * 200 + Math.sin(t * 30) * 50;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.2) * 0.7 + 0.1;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15 * env;
                        const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                        d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                firework_launch: () => {
                    const dur = 1.8;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 150 + t * 600;
                        const env = Math.sin(t / dur * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 * env;
                        const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                        d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                firework_explode: () => {
                    const dur = 2.5;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.8) * 0.9;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.6 * env;
                        const low = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 80 * t) * env * 0.3;
                        const mid = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 300 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 2.5) * 0.2;
                        d[i] = (noise + low + mid) * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
            };
            const gen = synths[key] || (() => {
                const dur = 2.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.3;
                }
                return buf;
            });
            return gen();
        }

        // ----- 播放方法 -----
        async playSound(key, startTime, endTime, volume = 0.8, pan = 0) {
            const buffer = await this.loadSound(key, key); // 缓存中已有
            if (!buffer) return null;

            const ctx = this.getContext();
            const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
            source.buffer = buffer;

            const gainNode = ctx.createGain();
            gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, volume));

            const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner();
            panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));

            source.connect(gainNode);
            gainNode.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(ctx.destination);

            const actualStart = Math.min(Math.max(0, startTime || 0), buffer.duration - 0.05);
            const actualEnd = Math.min(Math.max(actualStart + 0.05, endTime || buffer.duration), buffer.duration);
            const duration = actualEnd - actualStart;

            source.start(0, actualStart, duration);

            const id = ++this.sourceIdCounter;
            const entry = {
                id,
                key,
                source,
                gainNode,
                panner,
                isPlaying: true,
                stop: () => {
                    try { source.stop(); } catch (_) { }
                    entry.isPlaying = false;
                    this.activeSources.delete(id);
                },
            };
            this.activeSources.set(id, entry);

            source.onended = () => {
                entry.isPlaying = false;
                this.activeSources.delete(id);
            };

            return entry;
        }

        stopSound(id) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.stop();
                this.activeSources.delete(id);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        stopAll() {
            for (const [id, entry] of this.activeSources) {
                entry.stop();
            }
            this.activeSources.clear();
        }

        setVolume(id, vol) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, vol));
            }
        }

        setPan(id, pan) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));
            }
        }

        isPlaying(id) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            return entry ? entry.isPlaying : false;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 流星管理器
    // ============================================================
    class MeteorManager {
        constructor(engine, config) {
            this.engine = engine;
            this.config = config;
            this.meteors = [];
            this.idCounter = 0;
            this.onUpdate = null;
            this.animFrame = null;
            this.isRunning = false;
        }

        async addMeteor(panStart, panEnd, volStart, volEnd, duration) {
            const cfg = this.config.meteor;
            const startPan = panStart ?? cfg.panStart;
            const endPan = panEnd ?? cfg.panEnd;
            const startVol = volStart ?? cfg.volumeStart;
            const endVol = volEnd ?? cfg.volumeEnd;
            const dur = Math.min(duration ?? cfg.duration, this.config.sounds.meteor.end - this.config.sounds.meteor.start || 3.5);

            const id = ++this.idCounter;
            const meteor = {
                id,
                panStart: startPan,
                panEnd: endPan,
                volStart: startVol,
                volEnd: endVol,
                duration: dur,
                elapsed: 0,
                isPlaying: false,
                sourceId: null,
                progress: 0,
                active: true,
            };

            this.meteors.push(meteor);
            this._startAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
            return meteor;
        }

        async playMeteor(meteor) {
            if (meteor.isPlaying) return;
            const cfg = this.config.sounds.meteor;
            const entry = await this.engine.playSound(
                'meteor',
                cfg.start,
                cfg.end,
                meteor.volStart,
                meteor.panStart
            );
            if (entry) {
                meteor.sourceId = entry.id;
                meteor.isPlaying = true;
                meteor.elapsed = 0;
                meteor.progress = 0;
                this._updateUI();
            }
        }

        stopMeteor(meteor) {
            if (meteor.sourceId) {
                this.engine.stopSound(meteor.sourceId);
                meteor.sourceId = null;
            }
            meteor.isPlaying = false;
            this._updateUI();
        }

        removeMeteor(meteor) {
            this.stopMeteor(meteor);
            meteor.active = false;
            this.meteors = this.meteors.filter(m => m !== meteor);
            if (this.meteors.length === 0) this._stopAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
        }

        clearAll() {
            for (const m of this.meteors) this.stopMeteor(m);
            this.meteors = [];
            this._stopAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
        }

        _startAnimation() {
            if (this.isRunning) return;
            this.isRunning = true;
            const step = () => {
                if (!this.isRunning) return;
                let hasActive = false;
                for (const m of this.meteors) {
                    if (!m.isPlaying) continue;
                    hasActive = true;
                    m.elapsed += 0.04;
                    m.progress = Math.min(1, m.elapsed / m.duration);
                    const pan = m.panStart + (m.panEnd - m.panStart) * m.progress;
                    const vol = m.volStart + (m.volEnd - m.volStart) * m.progress;
                    this.engine.setPan(m.sourceId, pan);
                    this.engine.setVolume(m.sourceId, vol);
                    if (m.progress >= 1) this.stopMeteor(m);
                }
                this._updateUI();
                if (hasActive || this.meteors.some(m => m.isPlaying)) {
                    this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
                } else {
                    this.isRunning = false;
                    this.animFrame = null;
                }
            };
            this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }

        _stopAnimation() {
            this.isRunning = false;
            if (this.animFrame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrame);
                this.animFrame = null;
            }
        }

        _updateUI() {
            if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.meteors);
        }

        get count() { return this.meteors.length; }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 烟花管理器
    // ============================================================
    class FireworkManager {
        constructor(engine, config) {
            this.engine = engine;
            this.config = config;
            this.fireworks = [];
            this.idCounter = 0;
            this.onUpdate = null;
            this.timeouts = [];
        }

        async addFirework() {
            const id = ++this.idCounter;
            const fw = {
                id,
                isPlaying: false,
                launchId: null,
                explodeId: null,
                active: true,
                phase: 'idle',
            };
            this.fireworks.push(fw);
            this._updateUI();
            await this._playFirework(fw);
            return fw;
        }

        async _playFirework(fw) {
            if (fw.isPlaying) return;
            fw.isPlaying = true;
            fw.phase = 'launching';
            this._updateUI();

            const launchCfg = this.config.sounds.firework_launch;
            const launchEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                'firework_launch',
                launchCfg.start,
                launchCfg.end,
                0.7,
                0
            );
            fw.launchId = launchEntry?.id || null;

            let launchProgress = 0;
            const launchInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) { clearInterval(launchInterval); return; }
                launchProgress += 0.05;
                const vol = 0.4 + launchProgress * 0.5;
                const pan = Math.sin(launchProgress * 3) * 0.2;
                if (fw.launchId) {
                    this.engine.setVolume(fw.launchId, Math.min(1, vol));
                    this.engine.setPan(fw.launchId, pan);
                }
                if (launchProgress >= 1) clearInterval(launchInterval);
            }, 50);

            const delay = this.config.firework.explodeDelay || 0.6;
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(async () => {
                if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) return;
                if (fw.launchId) {
                    this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                    fw.launchId = null;
                }
                fw.phase = 'exploding';
                this._updateUI();
                const explodeCfg = this.config.sounds.firework_explode;
                const panSpread = this.config.firework.panSpread || 0.6;
                const pan = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * panSpread;
                const explodeEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                    'firework_explode',
                    explodeCfg.start,
                    explodeCfg.end,
                    0.9,
                    pan
                );
                fw.explodeId = explodeEntry?.id || null;
                if (explodeEntry) {
                    const checkDone = () => {
                        if (!fw.active) return;
                        if (!this.engine.isPlaying(explodeEntry.id)) {
                            fw.isPlaying = false;
                            fw.phase = 'done';
                            this._updateUI();
                        } else {
                            setTimeout(checkDone, 200);
                        }
                    };
                    setTimeout(checkDone, 100);
                } else {
                    fw.isPlaying = false;
                    fw.phase = 'done';
                    this._updateUI();
                }
            }, delay * 1000);

            this.timeouts.push(timeoutId);
            fw._cleanup = () => {
                clearInterval(launchInterval);
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                if (fw.launchId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                if (fw.explodeId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.explodeId);
                fw.launchId = null;
                fw.explodeId = null;
                fw.isPlaying = false;
            };
        }

        stopFirework(fw) {
            if (fw._cleanup) fw._cleanup();
            fw.isPlaying = false;
            fw.phase = 'idle';
            this._updateUI();
        }

        removeFirework(fw) {
            this.stopFirework(fw);
            fw.active = false;
            this.fireworks = this.fireworks.filter(f => f !== fw);
            this._updateUI();
        }

        clearAll() {
            for (const fw of this.fireworks) this.stopFirework(fw);
            this.fireworks = [];
            this.timeouts.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
            this.timeouts = [];
            this._updateUI();
        }

        get count() { return this.fireworks.length; }

        _updateUI() {
            if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.fireworks);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 主入口：创建声音系统（含预加载）
    // ============================================================
    async function createSoundSystem(customConfig = {}) {
        // 深度合并配置
        const config = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_CONFIG));
        // 合并 sounds
        if (customConfig.sounds) {
            for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(customConfig.sounds)) {
                if (config.sounds[key]) {
                    Object.assign(config.sounds[key], val);
                } else {
                    config.sounds[key] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        if (customConfig.meteor) {
            Object.assign(config.meteor, customConfig.meteor);
        }
        if (customConfig.firework) {
            Object.assign(config.firework, customConfig.firework);
        }

        const engine = new AudioEngine();
        await engine.preloadAll(config.sounds);

        const meteorManager = new MeteorManager(engine, config);
        const fireworkManager = new FireworkManager(engine, config);

        return {
            engine,
            meteorManager,
            fireworkManager,
            config,
        };
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 导出
    // ============================================================
    const SoundSystem = {
        version: '1.0.0',
        DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        AudioEngine,
        MeteorManager,
        FireworkManager,
        create: createSoundSystem,
    };

    // 浏览器全局
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.SoundSystem = SoundSystem;
    }

    // CommonJS / Node.js
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = SoundSystem;
        module.exports.default = SoundSystem;
    }

    // AMD
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return SoundSystem;
        });
    }

    return SoundSystem;
})(this);

            }

            let blessings = []; let allParticles = []; let state = 'flying';

            function init() {

                ['生', '日', '快', '乐'].forEach((ch, i) => {
                    const cx = startX + i * (charWidth + gap) + charWidth / 2;
                    targetCharPositions.push({ char: ch, x: cx, y: centerY, fontSize: fs });
                });

                blessings = [];
                const groupTotal = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                const groupProgress = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                targetPositions.forEach(pos => { if (pos.group >= 0 && pos.group < 4) groupTotal[pos.group]++; });

                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const pos = targetPositions[i % targetPositions.length];
                    const base = groupBaseDelay[pos.group] || 0;
                    const idxInGroup = groupProgress[pos.group]++;
                    const currentGroupTotal = groupTotal[pos.group];
                    // ★★★ 核心优化：彻底移除 rand(-80, 80) 波动，改为绝对均匀排队 ★★★
                    const t = idxInGroup / currentGroupTotal;
                    const timeInGroup = t * CFG.jitterMax;
                    const startDelay = base + Math.max(0, timeInGroup);
                    blessings.push(createBlessingItem(BLESSINGS[i], i, count, pos, startDelay));
                }

                allParticles = blessings.map(b => ({
                    x: 0, y: 0, targetX: b.targetX, targetY: b.targetY, size: b.particleSize, r: b.color.r,
                    g: b.color.g, b: b.color.b, alpha: 0, progress: 0, startDelay: b.startDelay,
                    group: b.group, activated: false, done: false
                }));

                state = 'flying'; flyStartTime = 0; animTime = 0; lastTimestamp = 0;
                blessings.forEach(b => { b.progress = 0; b.done = false; b.activated = false; });
                allParticles.forEach(p => { p.alpha = 0; p.progress = 0; p.activated = false; p.done = false; });

                if (animationId) cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
                animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }

            function drawParticle(p) {
                if (p.alpha < 0.01) return;
                const size = p.size;
                const cr = 255, cg = 230, cb = 180;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.alpha * CFG.stableParticleAlpha, 0, 1);
                ctx.drawImage(particleTex, p.x - size / 2, p.y - size / 2, size, size);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${cr}, ${cg}, ${cb}, 0.8)`;
                ctx.fillRect(p.x - size / 2, p.y - size / 2, size, size);
                ctx.restore();
            }
            function drawAllParticles() { allParticles.forEach(p => drawParticle(p)); }

            function drawStableGlow() {
                const fs = CFG.targetFontSize;
                targetCharPositions.forEach(item => {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    ctx.font = `bold ${fs}px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;
                    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(item.x - fs / 2, item.y, item.x + fs / 2, item.y);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffb6c1');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, '#87ceeb');
                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.7)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 50;
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.fillText(item.char, item.x, item.y);
                    ctx.restore();
                });
            }

            function animate(timestamp) {
                const dt = lastTimestamp ? Math.min((timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 16.667, 3) : 1;
                lastTimestamp = timestamp; animTime += dt * 16.667;

                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                drawStars(animTime);

                if (state === 'flying') {
                    updateFlying(timestamp);
                } else if (state === 'stable') {
                    drawStableGlow();
                    drawAllParticles();
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }

            function updateFlying(timestamp) {
                if (flyStartTime === 0) flyStartTime = timestamp;
                const elapsed = timestamp - flyStartTime; let allDone = true;
                allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const b = blessings[idx];
                    if (!p.activated && elapsed >= p.startDelay) { p.activated = true; b.activated = true; }
                    if (!p.activated) { allDone = false; return; }
                    if (p.done) return;

                    const localElapsed = elapsed - p.startDelay;
                    const eased = easeInOutCubic(clamp(localElapsed / CFG.flyDuration, 0, 1));
                    p.progress = eased; b.progress = eased;

                    const t = eased; const mt = 1 - t;
                    const cx = mt * mt * b.startX + 2 * mt * t * b.cpX + t * t * b.targetX;
                    const cy = mt * mt * b.startY + 2 * mt * t * b.cpY + t * t * b.targetY;

                    const fadeStart = CFG.fadeStart; const fadeEnd = CFG.fadeEnd;
                    let textAlpha = 1; let textScale = 1;
                    if (eased > fadeStart) {
                        const fadeProgress = (eased - fadeStart) / (fadeEnd - fadeStart);
                        textAlpha = 1 - easeOutQuad(clamp(fadeProgress, 0, 1));
                        textScale = 1 - 0.5 * easeOutQuad(clamp(fadeProgress, 0, 1));
                    }
                    const currentFs = Math.max(b.fontSize * textScale, 0.05);

                    let particleAlpha = 0;
                    if (eased > fadeStart * 0.5) {
                        particleAlpha = easeOutQuad(clamp((eased - fadeStart * 0.5) / (fadeEnd * 1.2 - fadeStart * 0.5), 0, 1));
                    }

                    const mixPos = clamp((eased - fadeStart * 0.3) / (fadeEnd * 1.4 - fadeStart * 0.3), 0, 1);
                    const posEased = easeOutQuad(mixPos);
                    p.x = lerp(cx, b.targetX, posEased);
                    p.y = lerp(cy, b.targetY, posEased);
                    p.alpha = particleAlpha;
                    p.size = b.particleSize * (0.6 + 0.4 * particleAlpha);

                    if (textAlpha > 0.08 && currentFs > 3) {
                        drawGlowText(b.text, cx, cy, currentFs, textAlpha * 0.85, 40, 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5)');
                    }
                    if (p.alpha > 0.01) drawParticle(p);

                    if (eased >= 1) {
                        p.done = true; b.done = true;
                        p.x = b.targetX; p.y = b.targetY; p.alpha = 1; p.size = b.particleSize;
                    } else { allDone = false; }
                });

                if (allDone) {
                    allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                        p.x = blessings[idx].targetX; p.y = blessings[idx].targetY;
                        p.alpha = 1; p.size = blessings[idx].particleSize;
                    });
                    state = 'stable';
                }
            }

            function createBlessingItem(text, index, total, targetPos, startDelay) {
                const fs = rand(CFG.fontSizeMin, CFG.fontSizeMax);
                const dirs = ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom']; const dir = dirs[index % dirs.length];
                const margin = 50; let sx, sy;
                switch (dir) {
                    case 'left': sx = -margin - fs * text.length * 0.35; sy = rand(H * 0.08, H * 0.92); break;
                    case 'right': sx = W + margin + fs * text.length * 0.35; sy = rand(H * 0.08, H * 0.92); break;
                    case 'top': sx = rand(W * 0.05, W * 0.95); sy = -margin - fs; break;
                    case 'bottom': sx = rand(W * 0.05, W * 0.95); sy = H + margin + fs; break;
                }
                const tx = targetPos.x; const ty = targetPos.y;
                return {
                    text, fontSize: fs, startX: sx, startY: sy, targetX: tx, targetY: ty,
                    cpX: (sx + tx) / 2 + rand(-W * 0.15, W * 0.15), cpY: (sy + ty) / 2 + rand(-H * 0.15, H * 0.15),
                    index, progress: 0, done: false, particleSize: rand(CFG.particleSizeMin, CFG.particleSizeMax),
                    color: { r: 255, g: 240, b: 200 },
                    group: targetPos.group, startDelay, activated: false
                };
            }

            canvas.addEventListener('click', init);
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize(); initStars();
                clearTimeout(window._resizeTimer);
                window._resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (state === 'stable') init(); }, 300);
            });

            init();
            console.log('✨ 祝福化光 · 生日快乐 · 已彻底消除泊松分布（绝对均匀排队入场） ✨');
        });
    </script>
</body>

</html>

    <script>
        // ============================================================
        //  配置
        // ============================================================
        const W = 800;
        const H = 600;
        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        canvas.width = W;
        canvas.height = H;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        const DESK_Y = H * 0.78; // 468
        const DESK_H = H - DESK_Y;

        const CAKE_CX = W / 2;
        const LAYER_H = 50;
        const LAYERS = [
            { w: 180, color: '#5c3a1a' },
            { w: 140, color: '#e8a0a0' },
            { w: 100, color: '#f5ede3' },
        ];

        const CANDLE_COLORS = ['#ff4444', '#ffdd44', '#4488ff', '#44dd44', '#ff66aa'];
        const CANDLE_W = 8;
        const CANDLE_H = 25;
        const CANDLE_COUNT = 5;
        const FLAME_W = 10;
        const FLAME_H = 14;

        // ============================================================
        //  工具函数
        // ============================================================
        function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

        function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

        function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
            r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
            ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
            ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
            ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
            ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
            ctx.closePath();
        }

        function getCakeLayerY(index) {
            return DESK_Y - (index + 1) * LAYER_H;
        }

        function hexToRgb(hex) {
            const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
            return result ? {
                r: parseInt(result[1], 16),
                g: parseInt(result[2], 16),
                b: parseInt(result[3], 16)
            } : { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0 };
        }

        function rgbToHex(r, g, b) {
            return '#' + [r, g, b].map(c => clamp(Math.round(c), 0, 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
        }

        function lightenColor(hex, amount) {
            const { r, g, b } = hexToRgb(hex);
            return rgbToHex(
                Math.min(255, r + amount),
                Math.min(255, g + amount),
                Math.min(255, b + amount)
            );
        }

        function darkenColor(hex, amount) {
            const { r, g, b } = hexToRgb(hex);
            return rgbToHex(
                Math.max(0, r - amount),
                Math.max(0, g - amount),
                Math.max(0, b - amount)
            );
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  绘制函数（背景、桌面、蛋糕、蜡烛、火焰）
        // ============================================================
        function drawBackground() {
            const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 60, 30, CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 60, 450);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#2a1e18');
            grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#1e1612');
            grad.addColorStop(0.8, '#14100d');
            grad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0808');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            const grad2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(CAKE_CX, 0, 20, CAKE_CX, 0, 350);
            grad2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 180, 100, 0.04)');
            grad2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 180, 100, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad2;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            const envGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 40, 20, CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 40, 400);
            envGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 180, 100, 0.08)');
            envGlow.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 140, 70, 0.04)');
            envGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 100, 50, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = envGlow;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        }

        function drawDesk() {
            ctx.save();

            const shadowGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, DESK_Y, 0, H);
            shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
            shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.15, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)');
            shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)');
            ctx.fillStyle = shadowGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, DESK_Y, W, DESK_H);

            const deskGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, DESK_Y, 0, H);
            deskGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(70, 40, 25, 0.85)');
            deskGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(55, 32, 18, 0.90)');
            deskGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(40, 22, 12, 0.95)');
            ctx.fillStyle = deskGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, DESK_Y, W, DESK_H);

            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(90, 55, 35, 0.25)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            for (let y = DESK_Y + 4; y < H; y += 6) {
                const offset = Math.sin(y * 0.03) * 3 + Math.sin(y * 0.07 + 1) * 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 2) {
                    const wave = Math.sin(x * 0.02 + y * 0.01) * 1.5 + Math.sin(x * 0.05 + y * 0.02) * 0.8;
                    ctx.lineTo(x, y + wave + offset * 0.3);
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 80, 50, 0.12)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.3;
            for (let y = DESK_Y + 2; y < H; y += 9) {
                const offset = Math.sin(y * 0.04 + 2) * 4;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                for (let x = 0; x < W; x += 3) {
                    const wave = Math.sin(x * 0.015 + y * 0.008) * 2 + Math.sin(x * 0.04 + y * 0.015 + 1) * 1;
                    ctx.lineTo(x, y + wave + offset * 0.2);
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            const highlight = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, DESK_Y, 0, DESK_Y + 20);
            highlight.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(180, 130, 90, 0.10)');
            highlight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180, 130, 90, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = highlight;
            ctx.fillRect(0, DESK_Y, W, 20);

            ctx.restore();
        }

        function drawCandleGlow(time) {
            ctx.save();

            const glow1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 50, 20, CAKE_CX, DESK_Y - 50, 350);
            glow1.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 200, 120, ${0.06 + 0.02 * Math.sin(time * 0.5 + 1)})`);
            glow1.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(255, 170, 90, ${0.04 + 0.015 * Math.sin(time * 0.4 + 2)})`);
            glow1.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(255, 140, 70, ${0.02 + 0.01 * Math.sin(time * 0.3 + 3)})`);
            glow1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 100, 50, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = glow1;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            const candlePositions = getCandlePositions();
            for (let i = 0; i < candlePositions.length; i++) {

                const pulse = 0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(time * 1.2 + i * 1.8);
                const radius = 60 * pulse;
                const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 5, cx, cy, radius);
                const alpha = 0.12 + 0.06 * Math.sin(time * 0.7 + i * 1.2);

            }

            const deskGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(CAKE_CX, DESK_Y + 20, 30, CAKE_CX, DESK_Y + 20, 240);
            deskGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 190, 110, ${0.04 + 0.02 * Math.sin(time * 0.6 + 0.5)})`);
            deskGlow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 160, 80, ${0.02 + 0.01 * Math.sin(time * 0.5 + 1.5)})`);
            deskGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 130, 60, 0)');

            ctx.fillRect(0, DESK_Y, W, DESK_H);

        }

        // ---- 蛋糕 ----
        function drawCake() {
            ctx.save();

            for (let i = 1; i < LAYERS.length; i++) {
                const layer = LAYERS[i];
                const w = layer.w;
                const x = CAKE_CX - w / 2;
                const y = getCakeLayerY(i);
                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)';
                ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y + 2, w - 8, 6);
                ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < LAYERS.length; i++) {
                const layer = LAYERS[i];
                const w = layer.w;
                const x = CAKE_CX - w / 2;
                const y = getCakeLayerY(i);
                const h = LAYER_H;

                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
                ctx.shadowOffsetX = 3;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 5;

                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + w, y);
                grad.addColorStop(0, darkenColor(layer.color, 30));
                grad.addColorStop(0.2, lightenColor(layer.color, 10));
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, layer.color);
                grad.addColorStop(0.8, darkenColor(layer.color, 15));
                grad.addColorStop(1, darkenColor(layer.color, 40));
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 5);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

                const hlGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y + 3, x + w, y + 8);
                hlGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
                hlGrad.addColorStop(0.25, `rgba(255,255,255,${i === 2 ? 0.4 : 0.2})`);
                hlGrad.addColorStop(0.75, `rgba(255,255,255,${i === 2 ? 0.3 : 0.12})`);
                hlGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = hlGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(x + 8, y + 3, w - 16, 6);

                const sideGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x + w - 10, y, x + w, y + h);
                sideGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)');
                sideGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)');
                sideGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)');
                ctx.fillStyle = sideGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(x + w - 10, y, 10, h);

                const leftGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + 5, y + h);
                leftGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
                leftGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
                leftGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = leftGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(x, y, 5, h);

                drawCreamPiping(i);
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ---- 奶油裱花 ----
        function drawCreamPiping(layerIndex) {
            const layer = LAYERS[layerIndex];
            const w = layer.w;
            const x = CAKE_CX - w / 2;
            const y = getCakeLayerY(layerIndex);

            let mainColor, dotColor;
            if (layerIndex === 0) {
                mainColor = 'rgba(255, 180, 170, 0.9)';
                dotColor = 'rgba(255, 210, 200, 0.7)';
            } else if (layerIndex === 1) {
                mainColor = 'rgba(255, 220, 160, 0.9)';
                dotColor = 'rgba(255, 235, 190, 0.7)';
            } else {
                mainColor = 'rgba(190, 220, 255, 0.9)';
                dotColor = 'rgba(210, 235, 255, 0.7)';
            }

            const radius = layerIndex === 0 ? 11 : (layerIndex === 1 ? 9 : 8);
            const spacing = layerIndex === 0 ? 22 : (layerIndex === 1 ? 20 : 18);
            const topY = y + 3;

            ctx.save();

            const startX = x + radius + 5;
            const endX = x + w - radius - 5;

            for (let px = startX; px < endX; px += spacing) {
                const offset = Math.sin(px * 0.5 + layerIndex * 2) * 1.5;
                const cx = px + offset;
                const cy = topY;

                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, Math.PI, 0, false);
                ctx.strokeStyle = mainColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';
                ctx.stroke();

                ctx.fillStyle = dotColor;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx - 2, cy - 2, radius * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            if (layerIndex === 2) {
                for (let px = x + 18; px < x + w - 18; px += 24) {
                    const cx = px + Math.sin(px * 0.5) * 3;
                    const cy = topY + 8 + Math.sin(px * 0.4 + 1) * 5;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 180, 0.8)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx - 2, cy - 2, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else if (layerIndex === 1) {
                for (let px = x + 14; px < x + w - 14; px += 26) {
                    const cx = px + Math.sin(px * 0.6 + 2) * 2;
                    const cy = topY + 6 + Math.sin(px * 0.5 + 1.5) * 4;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 230, 170, 0.8)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else {
                for (let px = x + 12; px < x + w - 12; px += 28) {
                    const cx = px + Math.sin(px * 0.7 + 1) * 2;
                    const cy = topY + 5 + Math.sin(px * 0.6 + 2) * 3;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 190, 0.7)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ---- 蜡烛 ----
        function getCandlePositions() {
            const topW = LAYERS[2].w;
            const startX = CAKE_CX - topW / 2 + 8;
            const endX = CAKE_CX + topW / 2 - 8;
            const positions = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < CANDLE_COUNT; i++) {
                const t = (i + 0.5) / CANDLE_COUNT;
                positions.push(lerp(startX, endX, t));
            }
            return positions;
        }

        function drawCandles() {
            const positions = getCandlePositions();
            const topY = getCakeLayerY(2);

            ctx.save();

            for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
                const cx = positions[i];
                const cy = topY;
                const color = CANDLE_COLORS[i % CANDLE_COLORS.length];

                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
                ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;

                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - CANDLE_W / 2, cy, cx + CANDLE_W / 2, cy);
                grad.addColorStop(0, darkenColor(color, 25));
                grad.addColorStop(0.3, lightenColor(color, 20));
                grad.addColorStop(0.7, color);
                grad.addColorStop(1, darkenColor(color, 15));

                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                roundRect(ctx, cx - CANDLE_W / 2, cy - CANDLE_H, CANDLE_W, CANDLE_H, 1.5);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

                const hlGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - CANDLE_W / 2, cy - CANDLE_H, cx - CANDLE_W / 2 + 2.5, cy);
                hlGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)');
                hlGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)');
                hlGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
                ctx.fillStyle = hlGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(cx - CANDLE_W / 2 + 0.5, cy - CANDLE_H + 1, 2, CANDLE_H - 2);

                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 240, 220, 0.25)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - CANDLE_H + 0.5, CANDLE_W / 2 - 0.5, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx, cy - CANDLE_H + 1, 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ---- 火焰（微动） ----
        function drawFlames(time) {
            const positions = getCandlePositions();
            const topY = getCakeLayerY(2);

            ctx.save();

            for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
                const cx = positions[i];
                const baseY = topY - CANDLE_H + 1;

                const phase = i * 1.3 + 0.7;
                const scaleX = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(time * 1.2 + phase);
                const scaleY = 0.90 + 0.10 * Math.sin(time * 1.6 + phase * 0.7);
                const offsetY = 1.2 * Math.sin(time * 2.0 + phase * 1.2);

                const flameX = cx;
                const flameY = baseY + offsetY - 2;

                const glowRadius = 18 * (0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(time * 1.0 + phase));
                const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(flameX, flameY, 2, flameX, flameY, glowRadius);
                glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 200, 100, ${0.12 + 0.05 * Math.sin(time * 0.7 + phase)})`);
                glow.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 160, 70, ${0.05 + 0.03 * Math.sin(time * 0.5 + phase * 0.8)})`);
                glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 120, 50, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = glow;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(flameX, flameY, glowRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(flameX, flameY);
                ctx.scale(scaleX, scaleY);

                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -3, 1, 0, 0, FLAME_H * 0.6);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#fffbe6');
                grad.addColorStop(0.15, '#ffdd44');
                grad.addColorStop(0.4, '#ffaa00');
                grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#ff7700');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff4400');

                ctx.beginPath();
                const w = FLAME_W / 2;
                const h = FLAME_H / 2;
                ctx.moveTo(0, -h);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(w * 0.8, -h * 0.4, w, -h * 0.1, w, h * 0.2);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(w, h * 0.6, w * 0.6, h, 0, h * 0.85);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(-w * 0.6, h, -w, h * 0.6, -w, h * 0.2);
                ctx.bezierCurveTo(-w, -h * 0.1, -w * 0.8, -h * 0.4, 0, -h);
                ctx.closePath();

                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fill();

                const coreGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -2, 0.5, 0, 0, FLAME_H * 0.25);
                coreGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 240, 0.9)');
                coreGrad.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(255, 230, 150, 0.6)');
                coreGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 200, 80, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = coreGrad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(0, -2, FLAME_W * 0.25, FLAME_H * 0.25, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.restore();

                const baseGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, baseY + 1, 1, cx, baseY + 1, 12);
                baseGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 200, 100, ${0.15 + 0.08 * Math.sin(time * 0.8 + phase)})`);
                baseGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 150, 70, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = baseGlow;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx, baseY + 1, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  装饰：礼物堆（物理堆叠，无抖动）+ 动态气球 + 横幅
        // ============================================================

        // ---- 绘制单个礼物盒 ----
        function drawGift(x, y, w, h, boxColor, ribbonColor, shadowOffset) {
            shadowOffset = shadowOffset || 5;
            if (!isFinite(x) || !isFinite(y) || !isFinite(w) || !isFinite(h) || w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
                return;
            }
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
            ctx.shadowOffsetX = 3;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = shadowOffset;

            const gradBox = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + w, y + h);
            gradBox.addColorStop(0, lightenColor(boxColor, 25));
            gradBox.addColorStop(0.5, boxColor);
            gradBox.addColorStop(1, darkenColor(boxColor, 30));
            ctx.fillStyle = gradBox;
            roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 4);
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;

            // 丝带
            ctx.fillStyle = ribbonColor;
            ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 3, y, 6, h);
            ctx.fillRect(x, y + h / 2 - 3, w, 6);

            // 蝴蝶结
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x + w / 2 - 7, y - 3, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x + w / 2 + 7, y - 3, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
            ctx.fillRect(x + 6, y + 3, w - 12, 4);
            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ---- 礼物堆：物理堆叠，无抖动，无缝无空隙，且尺寸更大 ----
        const giftPyramidData = (() => {
            // 从原来的5层增加到了6层，且单个体积更大，顶层高度远超蛋糕
            const layerDefs = [
                { layer: 5, yBase: -160, count: 1, xStart: 140, xEnd: 170, sizeMin: 30, sizeMax: 40 },
                { layer: 4, yBase: -128, count: 2, xStart: 120, xEnd: 190, sizeMin: 34, sizeMax: 44 },
                { layer: 3, yBase: -96, count: 3, xStart: 100, xEnd: 210, sizeMin: 38, sizeMax: 48 },
                { layer: 2, yBase: -64, count: 4, xStart: 80, xEnd: 225, sizeMin: 42, sizeMax: 54 },
                { layer: 1, yBase: -32, count: 5, xStart: 60, xEnd: 240, sizeMin: 46, sizeMax: 58 },
                { layer: 0, yBase: 0, count: 6, xStart: 40, xEnd: 260, sizeMin: 50, sizeMax: 64 },
            ];

            const allGifts = [];
            const colorPalette = [
                ['#e74c3c', '#f1c40f'], ['#2980b9', '#ecf0f1'], ['#27ae60', '#f1c40f'],
                ['#f39c12', '#e74c3c'], ['#8e44ad', '#f1c40f'], ['#1abc9c', '#e67e22'],
                ['#e67e22', '#2c3e50'], ['#2c3e50', '#f1c40f'], ['#c0392b', '#ecf0f1'],
                ['#16a085', '#f39c12'], ['#d35400', '#f1c40f'], ['#9b59b6', '#ecf0f1'],
            ];

            let idx = 0;
            for (let ld of layerDefs) {
                const { layer, yBase, count, xStart, xEnd, sizeMin, sizeMax } = ld;
                const availableWidth = xEnd - xStart;

                let rawWidths = [];
                let totalRawWidth = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    let w = sizeMin + Math.random() * (sizeMax - sizeMin);
                    rawWidths.push(w);
                    totalRawWidth += w;
                }

                let scale = availableWidth / totalRawWidth;
                let currentX = xStart;

                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const w = rawWidths[i] * scale;
                    const h = w * (0.78 + Math.random() * 0.12);
                    const x = currentX;
                    const y = DESK_Y + yBase - h;

                    const ci = idx % colorPalette.length;
                    const [boxColor, ribbonColor] = colorPalette[ci];
                    const darkAmt = (5 - layer) * 2;
                    const finalColor = darkenColor(boxColor, darkAmt);
                    const shadowOff = Math.max(3, 8 - layer);

                    allGifts.push({
                        x, y, w, h,
                        color: finalColor, ribbon: ribbonColor,
                        layer: layer, shadowOff: shadowOff
                    });

                    currentX += w;
                    idx++;
                }
            }

            allGifts.sort((a, b) => b.layer - a.layer);
            return allGifts;
        })();

        // ---- 绘制礼物堆 ----
        function drawGiftPyramid() {
            for (let g of giftPyramidData) {
                drawGift(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, g.color, g.ribbon, g.shadowOff);
            }
        }

        // ---- 气球（带基座） ----
        const balloons = [];
        const balloonColors = ['#ff6b81', '#ffd93d', '#6bcfff', '#a29bfe', '#ff9ff3', '#ff9f43', '#00d2d3', '#f368e0', '#ff6b81',
            '#ffd93d'
        ];
        const numBalloons = 12;

        for (let i = 0; i < numBalloons; i++) {
            balloons.push({
                x: 570 + Math.random() * 210,
                y: 210 + Math.random() * 160,
                color: balloonColors[i % balloonColors.length],
                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                speed: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.3,
                swingSpeed: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.015,
                radius: 14 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8)
            });
        }

        function drawBalloons(time) {
            for (let b of balloons) {
                const baseX = b.x;
                const baseY = DESK_Y - 2;

                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(baseX, baseY, 1, baseX, baseY, 10);
                grad.addColorStop(0, b.color);
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, lightenColor(b.color, 50));
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(baseX, baseY, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(baseX, baseY, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(baseX - 1.5, baseY - 1.5, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            for (let b of balloons) {
                const floatOffset = Math.sin(time * b.speed + b.phase) * 5;
                const swingOffset = Math.sin(time * b.swingSpeed * 2 + b.phase) * 4;

                const currentX = b.x + swingOffset;
                const currentY = b.y + floatOffset;

                const baseX = b.x;
                const baseY = DESK_Y - 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(currentX, currentY + b.radius * 0.9);
                ctx.lineTo(baseX, baseY);
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,200,200,0.3)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
                ctx.stroke();

                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
                ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
                ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;

                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(currentX, currentY, b.radius, b.radius * 1.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(currentX - b.radius * 0.25, currentY - b.radius * 0.3, b.radius * 0.3, b.radius * 0.4, -0.2, 0,
                    Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(currentX, currentY + b.radius * 0.9);
                ctx.lineTo(currentX - 2, currentY + b.radius * 1.1);
                ctx.lineTo(currentX + 2, currentY + b.radius * 1.1);
                ctx.fillStyle = darkenColor(b.color, 30);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // ---- "生日快乐" 横幅（拉长拉高，受重力向下弯曲，内容丰富） ----
        function drawBanner() {
            // 拉长占满 canvas，拉高到顶部位置
            const bannerW = W - 20; // 左右各留10像素
            const bannerH = 55;
            const bx = (W - bannerW) / 2;
            const by = 80; // 提升到较高的位置
            const curveDepth = 22; // 中间下垂的深度

            ctx.save();

            // 绘制布条主体 (中间受重力下弯)
            const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, '#e74c3c');
            gradient.addColorStop(0.5, '#c0392b');
            gradient.addColorStop(1, '#a93226');

            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
            ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(bx, by);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CAKE_CX, by + curveDepth, bx + bannerW, by);
            ctx.lineTo(bx + bannerW, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CAKE_CX, by + bannerH + curveDepth * 2, bx, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

            // 绘制边缘金边
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#f1c40f';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(bx, by);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CAKE_CX, by + curveDepth, bx + bannerW, by);
            ctx.lineTo(bx + bannerW, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(CAKE_CX, by + bannerH + curveDepth * 2, bx, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.stroke();

            // 三角形旗帜（两端）
            const triSize = 20;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(bx, by);
            ctx.lineTo(bx - triSize, by + curveDepth / 2 + bannerH / 2);
            ctx.lineTo(bx, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(bx + bannerW, by);
            ctx.lineTo(bx + bannerW + triSize, by + curveDepth / 2 + bannerH / 2);
            ctx.lineTo(bx + bannerW, by + bannerH + curveDepth);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();

            // 添加迷你图案：在两侧画一个小蛋糕和小礼物
            // 小蛋糕（左侧）
            const cakeX = CAKE_CX - 150;
            const cakeY = by + bannerH / 2 + curveDepth * 0.8;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
            ctx.fillRect(cakeX - 12, cakeY, 24, 14);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(cakeX, cakeY, 12, Math.PI, 0);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(cakeX, cakeY - 3, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();

            // 小礼物（右侧）
            const giftX = CAKE_CX + 150;
            const giftY = by + bannerH / 2 + curveDepth * 0.8;
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e67e22';
            ctx.fillRect(giftX - 10, giftY - 14, 20, 16);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(giftX - 10, giftY - 14, 20, 16);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
            ctx.fillRect(giftX - 4, giftY - 14, 8, 16);

            // 绘制文字“生日快乐” (顺着下垂的弧度)
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.font = 'bold 40px "Arial", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif';
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
            ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1;
            ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;

            const text = '生日快乐';
            const chars = text.split('');
            const charWidth = 50;
            const startX = CAKE_CX - (chars.length - 1) * charWidth / 2;

            for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
                const x = startX + i * charWidth;
                const normalizedX = (2 * (x - CAKE_CX)) / bannerW;
                const droop = curveDepth * (1 - normalizedX * normalizedX);

                const y = by + bannerH / 2 + droop;

                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.fillText(chars[i], x, y + 1);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff8e7';
                ctx.fillText(chars[i], x, y);
            }

            // 绘制英文小字，顺着弯曲的弧度，且与主标题拉开距离
            ctx.font = 'bold 14px "Arial", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif';
            const enText = 'HAPPY BIRTHDAY';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
            // 下移了12像素，留出更明显的间距
            const enY = by + bannerH + curveDepth + 3;
            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
            ctx.fillText(enText, CAKE_CX, enY);

            // 点缀星星和彩点
            ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.8)';
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const angle = i / 10 * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3;
                const dist = 130 + Math.sin(i * 1.3) * 15;
                const sx = CAKE_CX + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                const sy = by + bannerH / 2 + Math.sin(angle) * dist * 0.35;
                ctx.beginPath();
                for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                    const a = (j * 4 * Math.PI / 5) - Math.PI / 2;
                    const px = sx + 4 * Math.cos(a);
                    const py = sy + 4 * Math.sin(a);
                    if (j === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
                    else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
                }
                ctx.closePath();
                ctx.fill();
            }
            // 加一些彩色的圆点点缀
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)';
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                const sx = bx + 40 + i * (bannerW / 8);
                const normalizedX = (2 * (sx - CAKE_CX)) / bannerW;
                const droop = curveDepth * (1 - normalizedX * normalizedX);
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(sx, by + 12 + droop * 0.6, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.restore();
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  主循环
        // ============================================================
        let startTime = performance.now();

        function render() {
            const now = performance.now();
            const time = (now - startTime) / 1000;

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

            drawBackground();
            drawDesk();
            drawCandleGlow(time);
            drawCake();

            drawGiftPyramid();
            drawBalloons(time);
            drawBanner();

            drawCandles();
            drawFlames(time);

            requestAnimationFrame(render);
        }

        render();

        function resizeCanvas() {
            const container = canvas.parentElement;
            const containerWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;
            const containerHeight = window.innerHeight - 40;
            const scale = Math.min(containerWidth / W, containerHeight / H, 1.2);
            canvas.style.width = (W * scale) + 'px';
            canvas.style.height = (H * scale) + 'px';
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
        resizeCanvas();

        console.log('🎂 礼物放大加层 + 无缝物理堆叠 + 重力下弯横幅 + 丰富图案 🎉');
    </script>
</body>

</html>
