    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('cityCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // ---- 固定辉光强度（0~1），值越大光污染越明显 ----
        const GLOW_INTENSITY = 0.7;

        function resizeCanvas() {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            drawScene();
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

        // ============================================================
        //  主绘制
        // ============================================================
        function drawScene() {
            const w = canvas.width;
            const h = canvas.height;

            // ---- 夜空背景 ----
            const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
            bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#020305');
            bgGrad.addColorStop(0.15, '#040810');
            bgGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#08101c');
            bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a1220');
            ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

            // ---- 生成建筑 ----
            const buildings = generateBuildings(w, h);
            buildings.sort((a, b) => (a.y + a.h) - (b.y + b.h));

            // ---- 绘制建筑（含窗户灯光） ----
            buildings.forEach(b => drawBuilding(b, h));

            // ---- 绘制光污染：基于建筑位置的辉光（更稀疏、有层次） ----
            drawGlowFromBuildings(buildings, w, h);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  光污染核心：从建筑顶部散发辉光（避免连片）
        // ============================================================
        function drawGlowFromBuildings(buildings, w, h) {
            const glowFactor = GLOW_INTENSITY;
            if (glowFactor < 0.005) return;

            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

            // 分组：近处、中间、远处
            const nearBuildings = [];
            const midBuildings = [];
            const farBuildings = [];

            buildings.forEach(b => {
                if (b.type === 'near') nearBuildings.push(b);
                else if (b.type === 'mid') midBuildings.push(b);
                else farBuildings.push(b);
            });

            // 先画远处，再画近处（近处覆盖远处）
            drawGlowBatch(farBuildings, glowFactor, w, h);
            drawGlowBatch(midBuildings, glowFactor, w, h);
            drawGlowBatch(nearBuildings, glowFactor, w, h);

            // ---- 底部地面反射（轻微） ----
            const groundGlow = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, h, 0, h * 0.5);
            const alphaGround = 0.05 * glowFactor;
            groundGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 180, 90, ${alphaGround})`);
            groundGlow.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255, 150, 60, 0)`);
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
            ctx.fillStyle = groundGlow;
            ctx.fillRect(0, h * 0.5, w, h * 0.5);

            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        }

        // ---- 批量绘制辉光（优化后：更小范围、随机跳过、衰减更快） ----
        function drawGlowBatch(buildings, glowFactor, w, h) {
            if (buildings.length === 0) return;

            const isNear = buildings[0].type === 'near';
            const isMid = buildings[0].type === 'mid';
            const isFar = buildings[0].type === 'far';

            // 调整基础参数：缩小半径、降低透明度
            let baseRadiusMult, baseAlpha, radiusOffset, skipRate;
            if (isNear) {
                baseRadiusMult = 1.4; // 之前2.6
                baseAlpha = 0.20; // 之前0.35
                radiusOffset = 8;
                skipRate = 0.25; // 25%建筑不发光
            } else if (isMid) {
                baseRadiusMult = 1.0;
                baseAlpha = 0.12;
                radiusOffset = 4;
                skipRate = 0.35;
            } else {
                baseRadiusMult = 0.6;
                baseAlpha = 0.06;
                radiusOffset = 2;
                skipRate = 0.5;
            }

            buildings.forEach((b, index) => {
                // 随机跳过部分建筑
                if (Math.random() < skipRate) return;

                const t = b.t || 0.5;
                const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
                const cy = b.y;

                // 辉光半径：与建筑宽度相关，但大幅缩小
                const sizeBase = Math.max(b.w * 0.4, b.h * 0.15);
                const radius = sizeBase * (baseRadiusMult + t * 0.5) + radiusOffset;

                // 透明度计算
                const depthFactor = 0.5 + t * 0.5;
                let alpha = baseAlpha * depthFactor * glowFactor;

                // 近处建筑微随机
                if (isNear) {
                    alpha *= (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(index * 2.1 + b.x * 0.02));
                }
                if (isFar) alpha *= 0.6;
                alpha = Math.min(alpha, 0.35);

                if (alpha < 0.002) return;

                // 暖色辉光
                const r = 255;
                const g = 180 + Math.random() * 25;
                const bl = 60 + Math.random() * 30;

                // 径向渐变：更快的衰减（让边缘更锐利）
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius);
                grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${bl}, ${alpha * 0.9})`);
                grad.addColorStop(0.1, `rgba(${r}, ${g - 5}, ${bl - 5}, ${alpha * 0.7})`);
                grad.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(${r - 15}, ${g - 15}, ${bl - 10}, ${alpha * 0.35})`);
                grad.addColorStop(0.6, `rgba(${r - 30}, ${g - 25}, ${bl - 15}, ${alpha * 0.12})`);
                grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r - 50}, ${g - 35}, ${bl - 20}, 0)`);

                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // 小核心高亮（仅近处随机）
                if (isNear && alpha > 0.08 && Math.random() > 0.5) {
                    const coreRadius = radius * 0.1;
                    const coreGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, coreRadius);
                    coreGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 230, 180, ${alpha * 0.4})`);
                    coreGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(255, 200, 140, 0)`);
                    ctx.fillStyle = coreGrad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, coreRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            });
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  以下建筑生成和绘制函数（保持不变）
        // ============================================================
        function generateBuildings(w, h) {
            const buildings = [];
            const horizonY = h * 0.20;

            function perspective(baseY) {
                let t = (baseY - horizonY) / (h * 0.85 - horizonY);
                t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
                return t;
            }

            function fillRow(yRangeMin, yRangeMax, cellW, layerType) {
                const rows = Math.max(1, Math.round((yRangeMax - yRangeMin) / (h * 0.045)));
                const rowH = (yRangeMax - yRangeMin) / rows;
                const layerPhase = Math.random() * cellW;
                const cols = Math.ceil(w / cellW) + 1;
                for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                    const rowOffset = layerPhase + (r % 2 === 1 ? cellW * 0.5 : 0) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * cellW * 0.3;
                    let prevBh = -1;
                    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                        if (Math.random() < 0.08) continue;
                        const baseY = yRangeMin + r * rowH + Math.random() * rowH;
                        const t = perspective(baseY);
                        let bw, bh;
                        if (layerType === 'far') {
                            bw = 5 + Math.random() * 5 + t * 6;
                            const tFar = 1 - t;
                            bh = (13 + Math.random() * 14) * (0.60 + tFar * 1.15);
                            if (Math.random() < 0.07) bh *= 1.5 + Math.random() * 0.6;
                        } else if (layerType === 'mid') {
                            bw = 14 + Math.random() * 14 + t * 14;
                            bh = (30 + Math.random() * 26) * (0.45 + t * 1.1);
                        } else {
                            bw = 34 + Math.random() * 26 + t * 24;
                            bh = (60 + Math.random() * 46) * (0.5 + t * 0.9);
                        }
                        if (prevBh > 0 && Math.abs(bh - prevBh) < prevBh * 0.12) {
                            bh *= Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1.25 : 0.78;
                        }
                        prevBh = bh;
                        bw = Math.min(bw, cellW * 0.85);
                        const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * cellW * 0.5;
                        const bx = c * cellW + rowOffset + jitter;
                        if (bx + bw < 0 || bx > w) continue;
                        buildings.push({ type: layerType, x: bx, y: baseY - bh, w: bw, h: bh, t });
                    }
                }
            }

            fillRow(h * 0.20, h * 0.38, 14, 'far');
            fillRow(h * 0.30, h * 0.62, 34, 'mid');
            fillRow(h * 0.52, h * 0.98, 78, 'near');
            return buildings;
        }

        function drawBuilding(b, canvasH) {
            const { type, x, y, w, h, t } = b;
            const fog = type === 'far' ? 0.55 : (type === 'mid' ? 0.30 : 0.10);
            const depth = 0.35 + t * 0.65;

            // 建筑主体
            if (type === 'far') {
                const base = 18 + t * 10;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${base}, ${base + 8}, ${base + 22}, ${0.65 + t * 0.35})`;
            } else if (type === 'mid') {
                const r = (20 + Math.random() * 8) * depth + fog * 20;
                const g = (32 + Math.random() * 10) * depth + fog * 26;
                const bl = (52 + Math.random() * 14) * depth + fog * 38;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r | 0},${g | 0},${bl | 0})`;
            } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${(13 * depth) | 0},${(22 * depth + 6) | 0},${(36 * depth + 8) | 0})`;
            }
            ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);

            // 边框
            let borderAlpha, borderR, borderG, borderB, borderWidth;
            if (type === 'far') {
                borderAlpha = 0.08 + t * 0.10;
                borderR = 100;
                borderG = 140;
                borderB = 190;
                borderWidth = 0.4 + t * 0.3;
            } else if (type === 'mid') {
                borderAlpha = 0.12 + t * 0.12;
                borderR = 120;
                borderG = 160;
                borderB = 210;
                borderWidth = 0.5 + t * 0.3;
            } else {
                borderAlpha = 0.15 + t * 0.15;
                borderR = 140;
                borderG = 180;
                borderB = 220;
                borderWidth = 0.6 + t * 0.4;
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${borderR}, ${borderG}, ${borderB}, ${borderAlpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = borderWidth;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
            ctx.lineTo(x + w, y);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x, y);
            ctx.lineTo(x, y + h);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x + w, y);
            ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h);
            ctx.stroke();

            // 顶部高光线
            if (type !== 'far') {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 200, 240, ${0.15 + t * 0.20})`;
                ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 1.0);
            } else {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(130, 180, 230, ${0.05 + t * 0.10})`;
                ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 0.8);
            }

            // 天线/装饰
            if (type !== 'far' && Math.random() > 0.5) {
                const ah = 4 + Math.random() * 8;
                const ax = x + Math.random() * w;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 200, 240, ${0.08 + t * 0.15})`;
                ctx.fillRect(ax, y - ah, 1.0, ah);
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 200, ${0.05 + Math.random() * 0.1})`;
                ctx.fillRect(ax - 0.5, y - ah - 1, 2.0, 1.5);
            } else if (type === 'far' && h > 40 && Math.random() > 0.4) {
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(160, 200, 240, ${0.05 + t * 0.10})`;
                ctx.fillRect(x + w * 0.5, y - (3 + Math.random() * 4), 1.0, 6);
            }

            // 窗户
            if (type === 'far') drawFarWindows(x, y, w, h);
            else if (type === 'mid') drawMidWindows(x, y, w, h, t);
            else drawNearWindows(x, y, w, h, t);
        }

        // ---- 窗户绘制 ----
        function drawGridWindows(bx, by, bw, bh, winW, winH, gapX, gapY, padX, padY, config) {
            const stepX = winW + gapX;
            const stepY = winH + gapY;
            const cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor((bw - 2 * padX + gapX) / stepX));
            const rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor((bh - 2 * padY + gapY) / stepY));
            const totalW = cols * stepX - gapX;
            const totalH = rows * stepY - gapY;
            const startX = bx + padX + (bw - 2 * padX - totalW) / 2;
            const startY = by + padY + (bh - 2 * padY - totalH) / 2;
            const rowStates = [];
            let cr = 0;
            while (cr < rows) {
                const lc = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
                const dc = 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
                for (let i = 0; i < lc && cr < rows; i++) {
                    rowStates.push(true);
                    cr++;
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < dc && cr < rows; i++) {
                    rowStates.push(false);
                    cr++;
                }
            }
            for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                if (!rowStates[r]) continue;
                for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                    if (Math.random() > config.lightRate) continue;
                    const wx = startX + c * stepX;
                    const wy = startY + r * stepY;
                    const rand = Math.random();
                    let color;
                    if (rand < config.redRate) color = config.redColor;
                    else if (rand < config.redRate + config.blueRate) color = config.blueColor;
                    else color = Math.random() > 0.5 ? config.yellowColor1 : config.yellowColor2;
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${color}, ${config.alphaMin + Math.random() * (config.alphaMax - config.alphaMin)})`;
                    ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, winW, winH);
                }
            }
        }

        function drawFarWindows(x, y, w, h) {
            const winCount = 3 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
            for (let i = 0; i < winCount; i++) {
                const wx = x + 1 + Math.random() * (w - 2);
                const wy = y + 1 + Math.random() * (h - 2);
                const wh = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 2 : 1;
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(251, 191, 36, ${0.2 + Math.random() * 0.4})`;
                ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 1, wh);
            }
        }

        function drawMidWindows(x, y, w, h, t) {
            const scale = 0.8 + t * 0.4;
            drawGridWindows(x, y, w, h, 3 * scale, 5 * scale, 4, 4, 4, 6, {
                lightRate: 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.2,
                redRate: 0.02,
                blueRate: 0.08,
                redColor: '248, 113, 113',
                blueColor: '122, 183, 212',
                yellowColor1: '251, 191, 36',
                yellowColor2: '252, 211, 77',
                alphaMin: 0.3,
                alphaMax: 1.0
            });
        }

        function drawNearWindows(x, y, w, h, t) {
            const scale = 0.85 + t * 0.35;
            drawGridWindows(x, y, w, h, 5 * scale, 7 * scale, 3, 3, 5, 8, {
                lightRate: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.15,
                redRate: 0.01,
                blueRate: 0.05,
                redColor: '248, 113, 113',
                blueColor: '122, 183, 212',
                yellowColor1: '252, 211, 77',
                yellowColor2: '253, 224, 100',
                alphaMin: 0.7,
                alphaMax: 1.0
            });
        }

        // ---- 启动 ----
        resizeCanvas();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<body>
    <canvas id="mainCanvas"></canvas>
    <div id="info">✦ 晚安，好梦 ✦</div>
    <button id="restart-btn">重新睁开</button>

    <script>
        (function () {
            'use strict';

            // ============================================================
            // 1. Canvas 初始化
            // ============================================================
            const canvas = document.getElementById('mainCanvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });
            let W, H;

            function resize() {
                W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            }
            window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

            // ============================================================
            // 2. 配置参数
            // ============================================================
            const CONFIG = {
                closeDuration: 6000, // 闭眼过程持续时间 (ms)
                closeDelay: 2000,    // 开始闭眼前的等待时间 (ms)
                starCount: 350,
                cloudCount: 30,
            };

            // ============================================================
            // 3. 工具函数
            // ============================================================
            function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

            // 缓动函数：先慢后快再慢，模拟眼皮沉重的感觉
            function easeInOutSine(t) {
                return -(Math.cos(Math.PI * t) - 1) / 2;
            }

            function smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x) {
                const t = clamp((x - edge0) / (edge1 - edge0), 0, 1);
                return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
            }

            function hash(x, y) {
                let h = x * 374761393 + y * 668265263;
                h = (h ^ (h >> 13)) * 1274126177;
                return ((h ^ (h >> 16)) & 0x7fffffff) / 0x7fffffff;
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 4. 星空系统
            // ============================================================
            const STAR_COLORS = [
                { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 }, // 白
                { r: 200, g: 220, b: 255 }, // 蓝白
                { r: 255, g: 240, b: 200 }, // 暖白
                { r: 180, g: 200, b: 255 }, // 淡蓝
            ];
            let stars = [];

            function generateStars(w, h) {
                stars = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.starCount; i++) {
                    const x = Math.random() * w;
                    const y = Math.random() * h;
                    const size = 0.5 + Math.random() * 2.0;
                    const brightness = Math.random();
                    const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
                    const phase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    const color = STAR_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * STAR_COLORS.length)];

                    stars.push({ x, y, size, brightness, speed, phase, color });
                }
            }

            function drawStars(time, closeProgress) {
                // 随着闭眼，星星整体变暗
                const globalDimming = 1 - closeProgress * 0.8;

                for (const star of stars) {
                    // 闪烁逻辑
                    const flicker = Math.sin(time * star.speed + star.phase);
                    const alphaBase = 0.3 + star.brightness * 0.7;
                    const alpha = alphaBase * (0.8 + 0.2 * flicker) * globalDimming;

                    if (alpha < 0.01) continue;

                    const { x, y, size, color } = star;
                    const { r, g, b } = color;

                    // 绘制星芒 (仅较亮的星星)
                    if (star.brightness > 0.8 && size > 1.5) {
                        const glowSize = size * 3;
                        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, glowSize);
                        grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${alpha * 0.4})`);
                        grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`);
                        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(x, y, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }

                    // 绘制星点
                    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x, y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 5. 星云/云层系统 (增加氛围感)
            // ============================================================
            let clouds = [];

            function generateClouds(w, h) {
                clouds = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.cloudCount; i++) {
                    clouds.push({
                        x: Math.random() * w,
                        y: Math.random() * h,
                        radius: 100 + Math.random() * 300,
                        alpha: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.04,
                        color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? '100,120,200' : '150,100,180',
                        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
                        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
                    });
                }
            }

            function drawClouds(time) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
                for (const c of clouds) {
                    // 缓慢移动
                    c.x += c.vx;
                    c.y += c.vy;
                    if (c.x < -c.radius) c.x = W + c.radius;
                    if (c.x > W + c.radius) c.x = -c.radius;

                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, 0, c.x, c.y, c.radius);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${c.color}, ${c.alpha})`);
                    grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${c.color}, 0)`);
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                ctx.restore();
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 6. 场景绘制
            // ============================================================
            function drawFullScene(time) {
                // 深空背景
                const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
                bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#020205');
                bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0a15');
                ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

                drawClouds(time);
                drawStars(time, 0); // 正常亮度
            }

            // ============================================================
            // ★★★ 核心逻辑：闭眼遮罩 (Reverse Eye Mask) ★★★
            // ============================================================
            function drawEyeCloseMask(progress, time) {
                const p = Math.min(Math.max(progress, 0), 1);

                // 如果完全闭上，直接画全黑，不需要计算裁剪
                if (p >= 1) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
                    return;
                }

                ctx.save();

                // 1. 先绘制完整的世界（在裁剪区域外也会被画，但马上会被覆盖）
                // 为了性能，其实应该只画裁剪区内的，但Canvas没有直接的"反向裁剪"，
                // 所以策略是：画全世界 -> 画一个黑色的层 -> 在这个黑色层上挖个洞(或者反过来)

                // 更好的策略：
                // 1. 绘制全世界 (drawFullScene)
                // 2. 设置裁剪区域为“眼睛看到的范围”
                // 3. 在这个裁剪区域内，什么都不做（保留刚才画的世界）
                // 4. 恢复裁剪
                // 5. 用黑色填充整个屏幕（除了刚才裁剪保留的区域？不行，fillRect会覆盖）

                // 正确的高效策略：
                // 1. 绘制全世界。
                // 2. 创建一个新的临时层或者直接操作：
                //    我们想要的是：中间亮，四周黑。
                //    使用 radial gradient 模拟眼睑闭合可能更柔和，但题目要求参考椭圆逻辑。

                // 采用“挖孔法”：
                // 1. 绘制全世界。
                // 2. 设置混合模式或路径，将非可视区域涂黑。

                // 让我们用最稳妥的 Clip 方法：
                // 先画好全世界。
                // 然后，我们要把“看不见”的地方涂黑。
                // Canvas 无法直接“反选”，所以我们需要画一个巨大的矩形，中间挖个椭圆洞。

                // 方法 B (视觉欺骗法 - 性能更好且边缘柔和):
                // 在全屏画一个径向渐变，中心透明，周围黑色。
                // 渐变的中心透明半径随着 progress 变小。

                const cx = W / 2;
                const cy = H / 2;
                const maxR = Math.max(W, H) * 0.8; // 初始最大视野

                // 当前剩余的视野半径
                // 使用 easeInOutSine 让闭合过程更有质感
                const currentR = maxR * (1 - easeInOutSine(p));

                // 绘制覆盖层
                // 我们不能简单用 clip，因为我们要保留中间，涂黑外面。
                // 我们可以画一个巨大的环形渐变，或者使用 even-odd 规则路径。

                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

                // 创建路径：大矩形 减去 中间的椭圆
                ctx.beginPath();
                // 外框 (覆盖全屏)
                ctx.rect(0, 0, W, H);
                // 内框 (可视区域) - 逆时针绘制以形成空洞
                ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, currentR, currentR * 0.75, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2, true);

                // 填充黑色
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.fill();

                // 为了让边缘不那么生硬，加一点模糊或者渐变过渡？
                // 简单的 fill 会有锯齿。我们可以叠加一个径向渐变来柔化边缘。

                // 柔化边缘层
                const softEdgeWidth = 50 + p * 100; // 边缘模糊带
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, Math.max(0, currentR - softEdgeWidth), cx, cy, currentR + softEdgeWidth);
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');       // 内部透明
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');   // 中间半黑
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');       // 外部全黑

                // 注意：上面的 even-odd 填充已经把外面填黑了，这里我们用 screen 或者 lighter 可能会破坏纯黑。
                // 其实上面的 even-odd 填充对于“硬边”闭眼是可以的。
                // 如果想要“肉感”的闭眼，最好是用径向渐变覆盖全屏。

                ctx.restore();

                // --- 替代方案：更柔和的渐变覆盖 (推荐) ---
                // 这种方式比 even-odd 路径更平滑，模拟眼皮合拢的光线衰减
                /*
                const gradSoft = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, maxR);
                // 当 p=0, 透明半径=maxR (全可见)
                // 当 p=1, 透明半径=0 (全黑)
                const visibleRadius = maxR * (1 - easeInOutSine(p));
                
                gradSoft.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                gradSoft.addColorStop(Math.min(1, visibleRadius/maxR), 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                gradSoft.addColorStop(Math.min(1, (visibleRadius + 100)/maxR), 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
                gradSoft.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradSoft;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
                */

                // 为了严格遵循“参考真眼逻辑”的椭圆裁剪感，我们结合两者：
                // 使用 Path 裁剪出可视区，然后在可视区外画黑。
                // 但由于 Canvas 限制，最简单的“反向遮罩”其实是画一个全屏黑，然后用 destination-out 擦除中间？
                // 不，destination-out 会变透明，露出下面的 CSS 背景。如果 CSS 背景是黑的，那就没问题。

                // 最终决定方案：
                // 1. 保持 drawFullScene 绘制的内容。
                // 2. 创建一个全屏的黑色覆盖层。
                // 3. 使用 destination-out 在黑色覆盖层上“擦除”出一个椭圆。
                // 这样中间就透明了（露出了下面的星空），周围是黑的。

                ctx.save();
                // 这一步是关键：我们在现有的星空之上，再画一层东西
                // 我们不改变已有的星空，我们画一个“黑布”，然后把黑布中间剪个洞

                // 由于不能轻易使用 destination-out (因为它会影响下面已经画好的星空吗？不会，它影响的是当前绘图上下文的目标像素)
                // 实际上，如果我在星空上面画一个黑色矩形，然后用 destination-out 擦除中间，
                // 结果是：中间变透明（露出下面的星空？不，destination-out 是把目标像素的 Alpha 变为 0）。
                // 如果下面是星空，Alpha 变为 0 就会变成完全透明。如果 body 背景是黑的，那就对了。

                // 但是，为了保险起见（防止 body 背景不是纯黑或有其他问题），我们还是用“正向绘制黑边”的方法。

                // 让我们回到最稳健的：径向渐变覆盖。
                const eyeR = maxR * (1 - easeInOutSine(p));
                const blur = 150; // 边缘模糊度

                const overlayGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, Math.max(0, eyeR - blur), cx, cy, eyeR + blur);
                overlayGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');      // 中心完全透明
                overlayGrad.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)');  // 过渡
                overlayGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)');      // 边缘全黑

                // 确保覆盖整个屏幕
                // 如果 eyeR + blur < maxR，外面还是会有缝隙，所以最后要补一个全黑填充，但用 clip 限制？
                // 简单点：直接画这个渐变，它覆盖了从中心到 eyeR+blur 的范围。
                // 剩下的外围区域，我们需要确保是黑的。

                ctx.fillStyle = overlayGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

                // 补充：如果 eyeR+blur 还没覆盖到角落，角落必须是黑的
                // 我们可以画一个巨大的圆环，或者直接判断
                if (eyeR + blur < Math.max(W, H) / 2) {
                    // 这种情况发生在闭眼快结束时，中间很小，周围很大
                    // 上面的渐变只画到了 eyeR+blur。
                    // 我们需要把 (eyeR+blur) 以外的地方也涂黑。
                    // 可以使用 even-odd 路径填充外部
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.rect(0, 0, W, H);
                    ctx.arc(cx, cy, eyeR + blur, 0, Math.PI * 2, true); // 逆时针挖洞
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                    ctx.fill();
                }

                ctx.restore();
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 7. 渲染循环
            // ============================================================
            let startTime = 0;
            let animId = null;
            let isClosed = false;

            function render(timestamp) {
                if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
                const elapsed = timestamp - startTime;
                const time = timestamp / 100;

                // 清除画布
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

                // 1. 绘制基础星空场景
                drawFullScene(time);

                // 2. 计算闭眼进度
                let closeProgress = 0;
                if (elapsed > CONFIG.closeDelay) {
                    const closeElapsed = elapsed - CONFIG.closeDelay;
                    closeProgress = Math.min(closeElapsed / CONFIG.closeDuration, 1);
                }

                // 3. 应用闭眼遮罩
                if (closeProgress > 0) {
                    drawEyeCloseMask(closeProgress, time);
                }

                // 4. UI 状态更新
                const infoEl = document.getElementById('info');
                if (closeProgress >= 1 && !isClosed) {
                    isClosed = true;
                    infoEl.classList.add('show');
                } else if (closeProgress < 1 && isClosed) {
                    isClosed = false;
                    infoEl.classList.remove('show');
                }

                animId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 8. 启动与交互
            // ============================================================
            function init() {
                resize();
                generateStars(W, H);
                generateClouds(W, H);

                // 重置状态
                startTime = 0;
                isClosed = false;
                document.getElementById('info').classList.remove('show');

                if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
                animId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }

            document.getElementById('restart-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                init();
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                generateStars(W, H);
                generateClouds(W, H);
            });

            if (document.readyState === 'complete') init();
            else window.addEventListener('load', init);

        })();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

    <meta charset="UTF-8" />

    <title>🎆 灵动之魂 · 拟真物理</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;

        body {
            background: #000005;
            /* 极深空蓝黑 */
            overflow: hidden;
            height: 100vh;
            width: 100vw;
        }

        canvas {
            display: block;
            cursor: crosshair;
        }

        .ui {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;

<body>
    <canvas id="c"></canvas>
    <div class="ui">✦ Sparkle & Flow ✦</div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        let W, H;
        function resize() {
            W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }
        resize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

        let rockets = [];
        let particles = [];

        // 全局微风
        let wind = 0;
        let windTarget = 0;

        const CONFIG = {
            gravity: 0.03, // 轻微重力
            drag: 0.94,    // 强空气阻力 (关键：制造爆发后的悬停感)
            trailFade: 0.15, // 拖尾保留时间
            autoLaunchRate: 55
        };

        let timerTick = 0;
        let mouseX = W / 2, mouseY = H / 2;
        let isMouseDown = false;

        const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
        const randInt = (a, b) => Math.floor(rand(a, b + 1));
        const hsl = (h, s, l, a = 1) => `hsla(${h % 360}, ${s}%, ${l}%, ${a})`;

        /**
         * 粒子类 - 增加闪烁和双色渐变
         */
        class Particle {
            constructor(x, y, vx, vy, opts = {}) {
                this.x = x; this.y = y;
                this.vx = vx; this.vy = vy;

                this.gravity = opts.gravity || CONFIG.gravity;
                this.drag = opts.drag || CONFIG.drag;

                // 颜色系统：主色 + 偏移色
                this.hue = opts.hue !== undefined ? opts.hue : rand(0, 360);
                this.hueOffset = opts.hueOffset || rand(-20, 20); // 边缘色偏
                this.sat = opts.sat || 100;
                this.lit = opts.lit || rand(50, 70);

                this.size = opts.size || rand(1.5, 3);
                this.life = opts.life || rand(60, 100);
                this.maxLife = this.life;

                this.isGold = opts.isGold || false;
                this.isWhite = opts.isWhite || false;

                this.trail = [];
                this.trailLength = opts.trailLength || 6;

                // 灵动关键：闪烁参数
                this.twinkleSpeed = rand(0.1, 0.3);
                this.twinklePhase = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
                this.windSensitivity = rand(0.5, 1.5);
            }

            update() {
                this.life--;

                // 物理更新
                this.vx += (wind * this.windSensitivity) * 0.02;
                this.vy += this.gravity;

                this.vx *= this.drag;
                this.vy *= this.drag;

                this.x += this.vx;
                this.y += this.vy;

                this.trail.push({ x: this.x, y: this.y });
                if (this.trail.length > this.trailLength) this.trail.shift();

                return this.life > 0;
            }

            draw() {
                let progress = 1 - (this.life / this.maxLife);
                // 生命曲线：前快后慢，最后阶段快速消失
                let alpha = 1 - Math.pow(progress, 0.5);
                if (alpha <= 0) return;

                // 闪烁计算
                let twinkle = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005 * this.twinkleSpeed + this.twinklePhase);
                alpha *= twinkle;

                let currentHue = this.hue;
                let currentLit = this.lit;

                if (this.isGold) { currentHue = 45; currentLit = 70; }
                if (this.isWhite) { currentHue = 0; currentLit = 100; }

                // 1. 绘制拖尾 (使用主色)
                for (let i = 0; i < this.trail.length; i++) {
                    let t = i / this.trail.length;
                    let p = this.trail[i];
                    // 拖尾透明度非线性衰减
                    let trailAlpha = alpha * t * 0.4;
                    let trailSize = this.size * t * 0.8;

                    if (trailSize > 0.1) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, trailSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = hsl(currentHue, this.sat, currentLit, trailAlpha);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                }

                // 2. 绘制主粒子 (径向渐变：中心白/亮 -> 边缘主色/暗)
                let glowSize = this.size * (2.5 + (1 - progress) * 1.5);
                let grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, 0, this.x, this.y, glowSize);

                // 核心：高亮白光
                grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`);
                // 中间层：主色
                grad.addColorStop(0.3, hsl(currentHue, this.sat, Math.min(90, currentLit + 30), alpha * 0.9));
                // 边缘层：偏移色 (增加色彩丰富度)
                grad.addColorStop(1, hsl(currentHue + this.hueOffset, this.sat, currentLit, 0));

                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        /**
         * 火箭类
         */
        class Rocket {
            constructor(sx, sy, tx, ty) {
                this.x = sx; this.y = sy;
                this.tx = tx; this.ty = ty;

                this.distTotal = Math.hypot(tx - sx, ty - sy);
                this.distTraveled = 0;

                this.angle = Math.atan2(ty - sy, tx - sx);
                this.speed = 2;
                this.acc = 1.06;

                this.hue = rand(0, 360);
                this.type = randInt(0, 4);
            }

            update() {
                this.speed *= this.acc;
                let vx = Math.cos(this.angle) * this.speed;
                let vy = Math.sin(this.angle) * this.speed;

                this.x += vx;
                this.y += vy;
                this.distTraveled += this.speed;

                // 尾迹火星
                if (Math.random() < 0.6) {
                    particles.push(new Particle(
                        this.x, this.y,
                        rand(-0.5, 0.5), rand(0.5, 2),
                        { hue: 40, sat: 100, lit: 60, life: 15, size: 1, gravity: 0.02, drag: 0.9 }
                    ));
                }

                if (this.distTraveled >= this.distTotal * 0.95 || this.y < this.ty) {
                    this.explode();
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            }

            draw() {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${this.hue}, 100%, 80%)`;
                ctx.fill();
            }

            explode() {
                let x = this.x, y = this.y, hue = this.hue;

                // 核心填充 (高密度慢速粒子)
                for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                    let angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
                    let speed = rand(0.5, 2.5);
                    particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed, {
                        hue: hue, life: 50, size: 2, drag: 0.90, // 高阻力，快速悬停
                        hueOffset: 0
                    }));
                }

                // 1. 蓬松星云 (Fluffy Sphere)
                if (this.type === 0) {
                    for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
                        let angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
                        // 速度分布：多数中等，少数极快，少数极慢
                        let speed = rand(2, 9) * (Math.random() < 0.2 ? 1.5 : 1);
                        particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed, {
                            hue: hue + rand(-20, 20), life: rand(70, 100), size: rand(2, 4),
                            hueOffset: rand(10, 30) // 边缘色偏大
                        }));
                    }
                }

                // 2. 破碎光环 (Shattered Ring)
                else if (this.type === 1) {
                    let count = 100;
                    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                        let angle = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2;
                        // 随机断裂：跳过一些角度
                        if (Math.random() < 0.1) continue;

                        let radiusNoise = rand(0.8, 1.2);
                        let speed = 7 * radiusNoise;
                        particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed, {
                            hue: hue, life: 90, size: 2.5, drag: 0.96,
                            hueOffset: -10
                        }));
                    }
                }

                // 3. 飘逸垂柳 (Weeping Willow)
                else if (this.type === 2) {
                    for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
                        let angle = rand(-Math.PI * 0.9, Math.PI * 0.9);
                        let speed = rand(4, 9);
                        particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3, {
                            hue: hue, life: 150, size: 1.8,
                            gravity: 0.08, drag: 0.97, trailLength: 15,
                            windSensitivity: rand(1.2, 2.0), // 极易受风影响
                            isGold: Math.random() < 0.5
                        }));
                    }
                }

                // 4. 有机菊花 (Organic Ray)
                else if (this.type === 3) {
                    let rays = randInt(16, 28);
                    for (let r = 0; r < rays; r++) {
                        let angle = (r / rays) * Math.PI * 2;
                        let perRay = randInt(5, 10);
                        for (let j = 0; j < perRay; j++) {
                            let speed = 2 + j * 1.4 + rand(-0.3, 0.3);
                            particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed, {
                                hue: hue + j * 4, life: 100, size: 2.5, drag: 0.95, trailLength: 10
                            }));
                        }
                    }
                }

                // 5. 闪烁星尘 (Twinkle Dust)
                else {
                    for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
                        let angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
                        let speed = rand(1, 11);
                        particles.push(new Particle(x, y, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed, {
                            hue: hue + rand(-40, 40), life: rand(60, 90), size: rand(1.5, 3.5),
                            isWhite: Math.random() < 0.3,
                            twinkleSpeed: rand(0.2, 0.8) // 快速闪烁
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /**
         * 主循环
         */
        function loop() {
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);

            // 动态风力
            wind += (windTarget - wind) * 0.005;
            if (Math.random() < 0.005) windTarget = rand(-1.5, 1.5);

            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
            ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 0, 5, ${CONFIG.trailFade})`;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

            for (let i = rockets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                let alive = rockets[i].update();
                rockets[i].draw();
                if (!alive) rockets.splice(i, 1);
            }

            for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                let alive = particles[i].update();
                particles[i].draw();
                if (!alive) particles.splice(i, 1);
            }

            timerTick++;
            if (timerTick > CONFIG.autoLaunchRate) {
                let count = Math.random() < 0.15 ? 2 : 1;
                for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
                    let sx = rand(W * 0.1, W * 0.9);
                    let tx = rand(W * 0.1, W * 0.9);
                    let ty = rand(H * 0.1, H * 0.4);
                    rockets.push(new Rocket(sx, H, tx, ty));
                }
                timerTick = 0;
            }

            if (isMouseDown && timerTick % 4 === 0) {
                rockets.push(new Rocket(mouseX + rand(-20, 20), H, mouseX, mouseY));
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { mouseX = e.clientX; mouseY = e.clientY; });
        window.addEventListener('mousedown', () => isMouseDown = true);
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => isMouseDown = false);
        window.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
            isMouseDown = true;
            mouseX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            mouseY = e.touches[0].clientY;
        });
        window.addEventListener('touchend', () => isMouseDown = false);

        loop();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />

    <title>陨石追踪 · 特写跟随</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        body {
            background: #000;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        canvas {
            display: block;
            width: 100vw;

<body>

    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>

    <script>
        (function () {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            let W, H;

            function resize() {
                W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            }
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                initScene();
            });
            resize();

            // ---------- 背景星星 ----------
            const BG_STAR_COUNT = 600;
            let bgStars = [];

            function initBackgroundStars() {
                bgStars = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < BG_STAR_COUNT; i++) {
                    bgStars.push({
                        x: Math.random() * W,
                        y: Math.random() * H,
                        r: 0.3 + Math.random() * 1.8,
                        phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                        speed: 0.002 + Math.random() * 0.015,
                        baseAlpha: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7,
                    });
                }
            }
            initBackgroundStars();

            // ---------- 工具函数 ----------
            function lighten(hex, amt) {
                let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16),
                    g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16),
                    b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
                r = Math.min(255, r + amt);
                g = Math.min(255, g + amt);
                b = Math.min(255, b + amt);
                return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
            }

            function darken(hex, amt) {
                let r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16),
                    g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16),
                    b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
                r = Math.max(0, r - amt);
                g = Math.max(0, g - amt);
                b = Math.max(0, b - amt);
                return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
            }

            // ---------- 视口系统 ----------
            let viewport = {
                cx: W / 2,
                cy: H / 2,
                scale: 1,
                targetCx: W / 2,
                targetCy: H / 2,
                targetScale: 1,
                startCx: W / 2,
                startCy: H / 2,
                startScale: 1,
                transitionProgress: 1,
                transitionDuration: 60,
                isTransitioning: false,
                // 新增：是否处于跟随模式
                followMode: false,
            };

            function updateViewport() {
                if (viewport.isTransitioning) {
                    viewport.transitionProgress += 1 / viewport.transitionDuration;
                    if (viewport.transitionProgress >= 1) {
                        viewport.transitionProgress = 1;
                        viewport.isTransitioning = false;
                    }
                    const t = viewport.transitionProgress;
                    const ease = t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : -1 + (4 - 2 * t) * t;
                    viewport.cx = viewport.startCx + (viewport.targetCx - viewport.startCx) * ease;
                    viewport.cy = viewport.startCy + (viewport.targetCy - viewport.startCy) * ease;
                    viewport.scale = viewport.startScale + (viewport.targetScale - viewport.startScale) * ease;
                } else if (viewport.followMode) {
                    // 跟随模式：直接设置位置为目标（保持放大），不做缓动（或可以缓动但为了简洁直接赋值）
                    // 但为了平滑，我们让视口缓慢靠近目标，使用 lerp
                    const lerpFactor = 0.1;
                    viewport.cx += (viewport.targetCx - viewport.cx) * lerpFactor;
                    viewport.cy += (viewport.targetCy - viewport.cy) * lerpFactor;
                    viewport.scale += (viewport.targetScale - viewport.scale) * lerpFactor;
                }
            }

            function transitionViewport(toCx, toCy, toScale, duration) {
                viewport.startCx = viewport.cx;
                viewport.startCy = viewport.cy;
                viewport.startScale = viewport.scale;
                viewport.targetCx = toCx;
                viewport.targetCy = toCy;
                viewport.targetScale = toScale;
                viewport.transitionProgress = 0;
                viewport.transitionDuration = duration || 60;
                viewport.isTransitioning = true;
                viewport.followMode = false; // 过渡期间关闭跟随模式
            }

            // 开始跟随模式（持续追踪目标）
            function startFollowMode(toCx, toCy, toScale) {
                viewport.targetCx = toCx;
                viewport.targetCy = toCy;
                viewport.targetScale = toScale;
                viewport.followMode = true;
                viewport.isTransitioning = false;
                // 如果当前视口与目标差距较大，直接跳转到目标附近
                viewport.cx = toCx;
                viewport.cy = toCy;
                viewport.scale = toScale;
            }

            // 更新跟随目标（在跟随模式下更新目标位置）
            function updateFollowTarget(toCx, toCy) {
                if (viewport.followMode) {
                    viewport.targetCx = toCx;
                    viewport.targetCy = toCy;
                    // 保持目标缩放不变
                }
            }

            function resetViewport(duration) {
                transitionViewport(W / 2, H / 2, 1, duration || 60);
                viewport.followMode = false;
            }

            // ---------- 行星类 (固定位置，星环自转) ----------
            class Planet {
                constructor(x, y, radius, color, ringLayers, craterCount) {
                    this.x = x;
                    this.y = y;
                    this.radius = radius;
                    this.color = color;
                    this.ringLayers = ringLayers;
                    this.craterCount = craterCount || 20;
                    this.rotation = 0;
                    this.craters = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < this.craterCount; i++) {
                        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                        const dist = Math.random() * this.radius * 0.85;
                        const x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                        const y = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
                        const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 6;
                        const depth = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7;
                        this.craters.push({ x, y, r, depth });
                    }
                }

                update() {
                    this.rotation += 0.001;
                    for (const layer of this.ringLayers) {
                        layer.angle += layer.speed;
                    }
                }

                draw(ctx) {
                    const p = this;
                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                        p.x - p.radius * 0.3, p.y - p.radius * 0.3, p.radius * 0.1,
                        p.x, p.y, p.radius
                    );
                    const base = p.color;
                    grad.addColorStop(0, lighten(base, 40));
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, base);
                    grad.addColorStop(1, darken(base, 60));
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.fill();

                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(180, 200, 255, 0.12)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 35;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius * 0.98, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200, 220, 255, 0.04)';
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                    // 陨石坑
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
                    ctx.rotate(p.rotation);
                    for (const c of p.craters) {
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.ellipse(c.x, c.y, c.r * 0.8, c.r * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.15 + c.depth * 0.2})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.ellipse(c.x - c.r * 0.1, c.y - c.r * 0.1, c.r * 0.7, c.r * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,240,${0.05 + c.depth * 0.1})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                        if (c.depth > 0.6) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(c.x - c.r * 0.3, c.y - c.r * 0.3, c.r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
                            ctx.fill();
                        }
                    }
                    ctx.restore();

                    // 亮斑
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
                    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                        const dist = p.radius * (0.3 + Math.random() * 0.6);
                        const x = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                        const y = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(x, y, 2 + Math.random() * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,240,${0.03 + Math.random() * 0.08})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                drawRings(ctx) {
                    for (const layer of this.ringLayers) {
                        this.drawRingLayer(ctx, layer);
                    }
                }

                drawRingLayer(ctx, layer) {
                    const { particles, a, b, tilt, angle, color } = layer;
                    const cosT = Math.cos(tilt);
                    const sinT = Math.sin(tilt);

                    for (const p of particles) {
                        if (p.detached) continue;
                        const totalAngle = p.angleOffset + angle;
                        const rx = a + p.radialOffset;
                        const ry = b + p.radialOffset * 0.6;
                        const x0 = rx * Math.cos(totalAngle);
                        const y0 = ry * Math.sin(totalAngle);
                        const localX = x0 * cosT - y0 * sinT;
                        const localY = x0 * sinT + y0 * cosT;
                        const wx = this.x + localX;
                        const wy = this.y + localY;

                        const brightness = 0.6 + 0.4 * (1 - Math.hypot(localX, localY) / (a * 1.2));
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(wx, wy, p.size * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = color;
                        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * brightness;
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 3;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(wx - p.size * 0.2, wy - p.size * 0.2, p.size * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)';
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                    }
                    ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                }

                getParticlePosition(layerIndex, particleIndex) {
                    const layer = this.ringLayers[layerIndex];
                    const p = layer.particles[particleIndex];
                    const totalAngle = p.angleOffset + layer.angle;
                    const rx = layer.a + p.radialOffset;
                    const ry = layer.b + p.radialOffset * 0.6;
                    const x0 = rx * Math.cos(totalAngle);
                    const y0 = ry * Math.sin(totalAngle);
                    const cosT = Math.cos(layer.tilt);
                    const sinT = Math.sin(layer.tilt);
                    const localX = x0 * cosT - y0 * sinT;
                    const localY = x0 * sinT + y0 * cosT;
                    return { x: this.x + localX, y: this.y + localY };
                }

                getParticleTangent(layerIndex, particleIndex) {
                    const layer = this.ringLayers[layerIndex];
                    const p = layer.particles[particleIndex];
                    const totalAngle = p.angleOffset + layer.angle;
                    const rx = layer.a + p.radialOffset;
                    const ry = layer.b + p.radialOffset * 0.6;
                    const tx = -rx * Math.sin(totalAngle);
                    const ty = ry * Math.cos(totalAngle);
                    const cosT = Math.cos(layer.tilt);
                    const sinT = Math.sin(layer.tilt);
                    const localTx = tx * cosT - ty * sinT;
                    const localTy = tx * sinT + ty * cosT;
                    return Math.atan2(localTy, localTx);
                }

                detachParticle(layerIndex, particleIndex) {
                    const layer = this.ringLayers[layerIndex];
                    const p = layer.particles[particleIndex];
                    p.detached = true;
                    return p;
                }

                resetAllParticles() {
                    for (const layer of this.ringLayers) {
                        for (const p of layer.particles) {
                            p.detached = false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                getAvailableParticles() {
                    const list = [];
                    for (let li = 0; li < this.ringLayers.length; li++) {
                        const layer = this.ringLayers[li];
                        for (let pi = 0; pi < layer.particles.length; pi++) {
                            const p = layer.particles[pi];
                            if (!p.detached) {
                                list.push({ layerIndex: li, particleIndex: pi, particle: p });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return list;
                }
            }

            // ---------- 创建碎石 ----------
            function createRingParticles(count, a, b) {
                const particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const angleOffset = (i / count) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.02;
                    const size = 1.8 + Math.random() * 3.2;
                    const radialOffset = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15;
                    particles.push({
                        angleOffset: angleOffset,
                        size: size,
                        radialOffset: radialOffset,
                        detached: false,
                    });
                }
                return particles;
            }

            // ---------- 场景 ----------
            let planets = [];
            let mainPlanet = null;
            // 陨石状态
            let meteor = {
                state: 'attached',
                attachedPlanet: null,
                attachedLayerIndex: 0,
                attachedParticleIndex: 0,
                orbitCounter: 0,
                totalOrbits: 2,
                detachFrame: 0,
                x: 0,
                y: 0,
                vx: 0,
                vy: 0,
                speed: 0,
                shadowBlur: 0,
                history: [],
                detachedParticleRef: null,
                gravity: 0.06,
                follow: false, // 是否持续跟踪
            };

            const FLIGHT_ANGLE = 30 * Math.PI / 180;
            const START_SPEED = 3;
            const MAX_SPEED = 11;
            const START_BLUR = 15;
            const MAX_BLUR = 55;
            const ACCEL_FRAMES = 280;
            const METEOR_HISTORY = 22;

            // ---------- 初始化场景 ----------
            function initScene() {
                planets = [];
                const minDim = Math.min(W, H);

                const positions = [
                    { x: W * 0.28, y: H * 0.38 },
                    { x: W * 0.72, y: H * 0.22 },
                    { x: W * 0.20, y: H * 0.78 },
                    { x: W * 0.75, y: H * 0.72 },
                    { x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.15 }
                ];

                const configs = [
                    { radius: minDim * 0.08, color: '#b8a088', layers: 3, tiltBase: 0.2 },
                    { radius: minDim * 0.06, color: '#a09080', layers: 2, tiltBase: 0.8 },
                    { radius: minDim * 0.055, color: '#908880', layers: 2, tiltBase: 1.0 },
                    { radius: minDim * 0.07, color: '#8a9a7a', layers: 2, tiltBase: 0.5 },
                    { radius: minDim * 0.05, color: '#9a8a8a', layers: 1, tiltBase: 1.2 }
                ];

                for (let idx = 0; idx < 5; idx++) {
                    const pos = positions[idx];
                    const cfg = configs[idx];
                    const radius = cfg.radius;
                    const color = cfg.color;
                    const layerCount = cfg.layers;
                    const tiltBase = cfg.tiltBase;

                    const ringLayers = [];
                    for (let i = 0; i < layerCount; i++) {
                        const a = radius * (2.2 + i * 1.2);
                        const b = a * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.25);
                        const tilt = tiltBase + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
                        const speed = (0.005 + Math.random() * 0.005) * (i + 1) * 0.5;
                        const count = Math.floor(120 + Math.random() * 100);
                        const colors = ['#8a7a6a', '#7a8a7a', '#9a8a7a', '#8a8a7a', '#7a7a7a'];
                        const col = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                        const particles = createRingParticles(count, a, b);
                        ringLayers.push({
                            particles: particles,
                            a: a,
                            b: b,
                            tilt: tilt,
                            angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                            speed: speed,
                            color: col,
                        });
                    }

                    const planet = new Planet(pos.x, pos.y, radius, color, ringLayers, 25 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20));
                    planets.push(planet);
                }

                mainPlanet = planets[0];
                resetMeteor();
                viewport.cx = W / 2;
                viewport.cy = H / 2;
                viewport.scale = 1;
                viewport.followMode = false;
            }

            // ---------- 重置陨石 ----------
            function resetMeteor() {
                for (const p of planets) {
                    p.resetAllParticles();
                }

                if (!mainPlanet) {
                    initScene();
                    return;
                }

                const avail = mainPlanet.getAvailableParticles();
                if (avail.length === 0) {
                    mainPlanet.resetAllParticles();
                    return resetMeteor();
                }

                // 筛选右偏上区域
                const targetMinAngle = -Math.PI / 3;
                const targetMaxAngle = -Math.PI / 6;
                let candidates = avail.filter(item => {
                    const layer = mainPlanet.ringLayers[item.layerIndex];
                    const totalAngle = item.particle.angleOffset + layer.angle;
                    let angle = totalAngle % (2 * Math.PI);
                    if (angle > Math.PI) angle -= 2 * Math.PI;
                    if (angle < -Math.PI) angle += 2 * Math.PI;
                    return angle >= targetMinAngle && angle <= targetMaxAngle;
                });

                if (candidates.length === 0) candidates = avail;

                const chosen = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
                meteor.state = 'attached';
                meteor.attachedPlanet = mainPlanet;
                meteor.attachedLayerIndex = chosen.layerIndex;
                meteor.attachedParticleIndex = chosen.particleIndex;
                meteor.orbitCounter = 0;
                meteor.totalOrbits = 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5;
                meteor.detachFrame = 0;
                meteor.history = [];
                meteor.detachedParticleRef = null;
                meteor.vx = 0;
                meteor.vy = 0;
                meteor.speed = START_SPEED;
                meteor.shadowBlur = START_BLUR;
                meteor.follow = false;

                const pos = mainPlanet.getParticlePosition(chosen.layerIndex, chosen.particleIndex);
                meteor.x = pos.x;
                meteor.y = pos.y;
                for (let i = 0; i < METEOR_HISTORY; i++) {
                    const t = i * 2.2;
                    meteor.history.push({
                        x: meteor.x - t * Math.cos(FLIGHT_ANGLE),
                        y: meteor.y - t * Math.sin(FLIGHT_ANGLE),
                    });
                }
            }

            // ---------- 更新陨石 ----------
            function updateMeteor() {
                if (meteor.state === 'attached') {
                    if (!meteor.attachedPlanet) {
                        resetMeteor();
                        return;
                    }
                    const planet = meteor.attachedPlanet;
                    const li = meteor.attachedLayerIndex;
                    const pi = meteor.attachedParticleIndex;
                    const pos = planet.getParticlePosition(li, pi);
                    meteor.x = pos.x;
                    meteor.y = pos.y;

                    meteor.orbitCounter++;
                    const layer = planet.ringLayers[li];
                    if (!layer) {
                        resetMeteor();
                        return;
                    }
                    const speed = layer.speed;
                    const framesPerOrbit = (2 * Math.PI) / speed;
                    const totalFrames = framesPerOrbit * meteor.totalOrbits;
                    if (meteor.orbitCounter > totalFrames) {
                        triggerDetachFromAttached();
                    }
                } else if (meteor.state === 'detaching') {
                    meteor.detachFrame++;
                    const progress = Math.min(meteor.detachFrame / ACCEL_FRAMES, 1);
                    meteor.speed = START_SPEED + (MAX_SPEED - START_SPEED) * progress;
                    meteor.shadowBlur = START_BLUR + (MAX_BLUR - START_BLUR) * progress;

                    meteor.vy += meteor.gravity;
                    const angle = Math.atan2(meteor.vy, meteor.vx);
                    const currentSpeed = meteor.speed;
                    meteor.vx = currentSpeed * Math.cos(angle);
                    meteor.vy = currentSpeed * Math.sin(angle);

                    meteor.x += meteor.vx;
                    meteor.y += meteor.vy;

                    meteor.history.push({ x: meteor.x, y: meteor.y });
                    if (meteor.history.length > METEOR_HISTORY) {
                        meteor.history.shift();
                    }

                    // 如果处于跟随模式，更新视口目标为陨石位置
                    if (meteor.follow) {
                        updateFollowTarget(meteor.x, meteor.y);
                    }

                    const buffer = 150;
                    if (meteor.x > W + buffer || meteor.y > H + buffer || meteor.x < -buffer || meteor.y < -buffer ||
                        meteor.detachFrame > 1000) {
                        // 恢复碎片
                        if (meteor.detachedParticleRef && meteor.attachedPlanet) {
                            const planet = meteor.attachedPlanet;
                            const li = meteor.attachedLayerIndex;
                            const pi = meteor.attachedParticleIndex;
                            if (planet.ringLayers[li] && planet.ringLayers[li].particles[pi]) {
                                planet.ringLayers[li].particles[pi].detached = false;
                            }
                            meteor.detachedParticleRef = null;
                        }
                        meteor.state = 'attached';
                        meteor.orbitCounter = 0;
                        meteor.follow = false;
                        resetMeteor();
                        resetViewport(40);
                    }
                }
            }

            // 触发脱离
            function triggerDetachFromAttached() {
                if (meteor.state !== 'attached') return;
                if (!meteor.attachedPlanet) {
                    resetMeteor();
                    return;
                }
                const planet = meteor.attachedPlanet;
                const li = meteor.attachedLayerIndex;
                const pi = meteor.attachedParticleIndex;
                planet.detachParticle(li, pi);
                meteor.detachedParticleRef = planet.ringLayers[li].particles[pi];
                const pos = planet.getParticlePosition(li, pi);
                const tangent = planet.getParticleTangent(li, pi);
                meteor.vx = START_SPEED * Math.cos(tangent);
                meteor.vy = START_SPEED * Math.sin(tangent);
                meteor.speed = START_SPEED;
                meteor.shadowBlur = START_BLUR;
                meteor.detachFrame = 0;
                meteor.x = pos.x;
                meteor.y = pos.y;
                meteor.history = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < METEOR_HISTORY; i++) {
                    const t = i * 2.2;
                    meteor.history.push({
                        x: meteor.x - t * Math.cos(tangent),
                        y: meteor.y - t * Math.sin(tangent),
                    });
                }
                meteor.state = 'detaching';
                meteor.orbitCounter = 0;

                // 启动跟随模式
                meteor.follow = true;
                // 直接进入跟随模式，放大2.2倍
                startFollowMode(meteor.x, meteor.y, 2.2);
            }

            // 手动触发
            function triggerDetachManually() {
                if (meteor.state === 'detaching') return;
                if (meteor.state === 'attached') {
                    triggerDetachFromAttached();
                } else {
                    resetMeteor();
                }
            }

            // ---------- 绘图 ----------
            function drawBackground() {
                for (const b of bgStars) {
                    const flicker = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(Date.now() * b.speed + b.phase);
                    const alpha = b.baseAlpha * flicker;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha})`;
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, 100);
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,220,180,0.10)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,220,180,0)');
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, 100, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fill();
            }

            function drawMeteor() {
                if (meteor.state === 'attached') {
                    if (!meteor.attachedPlanet) return;
                    const pos = meteor.attachedPlanet.getParticlePosition(
                        meteor.attachedLayerIndex,
                        meteor.attachedParticleIndex
                    );
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,150,0.5)';
                    ctx.fill();
                    return;
                }

                if (meteor.state !== 'detaching') return;
                const hist = meteor.history;
                const len = hist.length;
                if (len === 0) return;

                for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                    const pos = hist[i];
                    const t = (i + 1) / len;
                    const alpha = 0.08 + 0.82 * t;
                    const radius = 0.8 + 2.8 * t;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${alpha * 0.85})`;
                    ctx.fill();
                    if (t > 0.4) {
                        const glowAlpha = (t - 0.4) / 0.6 * 0.15;
                        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 14 * t;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, radius * 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${glowAlpha})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                    }
                }

                const pos = hist[len - 1];
                const blur = meteor.shadowBlur;

                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = blur;

                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    pos.x, pos.y, 0,
                    pos.x, pos.y, 10
                );
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)');
                grad.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.shadowBlur = blur * 0.6;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                if (blur > 30) {
                    const len2 = 16 + (blur - 30) / 25 * 18;
                    const alpha = 0.06 + (blur - 30) / 25 * 0.14;
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.translate(pos.x, pos.y);
                    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        const angle = i * Math.PI / 2 + Date.now() * 0.0003;
                        ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
                        const ex = len2 * Math.cos(angle);
                        const ey = len2 * Math.sin(angle);
                        ctx.lineTo(ex, ey);
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1.0 + (blur - 30) / 25 * 1.5;
                        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
                        ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    ctx.restore();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }

                if (blur > 30) {
                    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                        const dist = 5 + Math.random() * 14;
                        const dx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                        const dy = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(pos.x + dx, pos.y + dy, 0.8 + Math.random() * 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${0.15 + Math.random() * 0.3})`;
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                }
            }

            function drawUI() {
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
                ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
                ctx.fillText('点击画面 · 触发陨石脱离（特写跟随）', 20, 30);
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
                ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
                ctx.fillText('镜头持续跟随陨石直至飞出屏幕', 20, 50);
            }

            // ---------- 动画循环 ----------
            function animate() {
                for (const p of planets) {
                    p.update();
                }

                updateMeteor();
                updateViewport();

                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                drawBackground();

                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(viewport.cx, viewport.cy);
                ctx.scale(viewport.scale, viewport.scale);
                ctx.translate(-viewport.cx, -viewport.cy);

                for (const p of planets) {
                    p.drawRings(ctx);
                }
                for (const p of planets) {
                    p.draw(ctx);
                }

                drawMeteor();

                ctx.restore();

                drawUI();

                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }

            animate();

            canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
                triggerDetachManually();
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                initScene();
            });

            initScene();
            console.log('🌌 陨石特写跟随已启动！点击画面触发。');
        })();
    </script>

</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" />

    <style>
