                        sy = rand(H * 0.08, H * 0.92);
                        break;
                    case 'top':
                        sx = rand(W * 0.05, W * 0.95);
                        sy = -margin - fs;
                        break;
                    case 'bottom':
                        sx = rand(W * 0.05, W * 0.95);
                        sy = H + margin + fs;
                        break;
                }
                return {
                    text,
                    fontSize: fs,
                    startX: sx,
                    startY: sy,
                    targetX: targetPos.x,
                    targetY: targetPos.y,
                    cpX: (sx + targetPos.x) / 2 + rand(-W * 0.15, W * 0.15),
                    cpY: (sy + targetPos.y) / 2 + rand(-H * 0.15, H * 0.15),
                    index,
                    progress: 0,
                    done: false,
                    particleSize: rand(PARTICLE_CFG.particleSizeMin, PARTICLE_CFG.particleSizeMax),
                    color: { r: 255, g: 240, b: 200 },
                    group: targetPos.group,
                    startDelay,
                    activated: false
                };
            }

            function initParticles() {
                const targetPos = buildTargetPositions();
                const count = Math.min(BLESSINGS.length, targetPos.length);
                const groupBaseDelay = [0, 1500, 3000, 4500];
                targetCharPositions = [];
                const fs = PARTICLE_CFG.targetFontSize,
                    gap = PARTICLE_CFG.charGap;
                const charWidth = fs * 0.62;
                const totalW = 4 * charWidth + 3 * gap;
                const startX = (W - totalW) / 2;
                const centerY = H * 0.30;
                ['生', '日', '快', '乐'].forEach((ch, i) => {
                    const cx = startX + i * (charWidth + gap) + charWidth / 2;
                    targetCharPositions.push({ char: ch, x: cx, y: centerY, fontSize: fs });
                });
                blessings = [];
                const groupTotal = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                const groupProgress = [0, 0, 0, 0];
                targetPos.forEach(pos => { if (pos.group >= 0 && pos.group < 4) groupTotal[pos.group]++; });
                for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    const pos = targetPos[i % targetPos.length];
                    const base = groupBaseDelay[pos.group] || 0;
                    const idxInGroup = groupProgress[pos.group]++;
                    const currentGroupTotal = groupTotal[pos.group];
                    const t = idxInGroup / currentGroupTotal;
                    const timeInGroup = t * PARTICLE_CFG.jitterMax;
                    const startDelay = base + Math.max(0, timeInGroup);
                    blessings.push(createBlessingItem(BLESSINGS[i], i, count, pos, startDelay));
                }
                allParticles = blessings.map(b => ({
                    x: 0,
                    y: 0,
                    targetX: b.targetX,
                    targetY: b.targetY,
                    size: b.particleSize,
                    r: b.color.r,
                    g: b.color.g,
                    b: b.color.b,
                    alpha: 0,
                    progress: 0,
                    startDelay: b.startDelay,
                    group: b.group,
                    activated: false,
                    done: false
                }));
                particleState = 'idle';
                flyStartTime = 0;
                blessings.forEach(b => {
                    b.progress = 0;
                    b.done = false;
                    b.activated = false;
                });
                allParticles.forEach(p => {
                    p.alpha = 0;
                    p.progress = 0;
                    p.activated = false;
                    p.done = false;
                });
                particlesReady = true;
            }

            function drawParticle(p) {
                if (p.alpha < 0.01) return;
                const size = p.size;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.alpha * PARTICLE_CFG.stableParticleAlpha, 0, 1);
                ctx.drawImage(particleTex, p.x - size / 2, p.y - size / 2, size, size);
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,230,180,0.8)`;
                ctx.fillRect(p.x - size / 2, p.y - size / 2, size, size);
                ctx.restore();
            }

            function drawGlowText(text, x, y, fs, alpha, blur, color) {
                alpha = alpha || 1;
                blur = blur || 40;
                color = color || 'rgba(255,215,0,0.5)';
                if (alpha < 0.05 || fs < 3) return;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.font = `bold ${fs}px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;
                ctx.shadowColor = color;
                ctx.shadowBlur = blur;
                ctx.fillStyle = PARTICLE_CFG.textColor;
                ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
                ctx.restore();
            }

            function drawStableGlow() {
                const fs = PARTICLE_CFG.targetFontSize;
                if (!targetCharPositions || targetCharPositions.length === 0) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    ctx.font = `bold ${fs}px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;
                    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - fs, H * 0.30, W / 2 + fs, H * 0.30);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffb6c1');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, '#87ceeb');
                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 50;
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.fillText('生日快乐', W / 2, H * 0.30);
                    ctx.restore();
                    return;
                }
                targetCharPositions.forEach(item => {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                    ctx.font = `bold ${fs}px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;
                    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(item.x - fs / 2, item.y, item.x + fs / 2, item.y);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffb6c1');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, '#87ceeb');
                    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)';
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 50;
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.fillText(item.char, item.x, item.y);
                    ctx.restore();
                });
            }

            function updateParticles(timestamp) {
                if (particleState !== 'flying') return;
                if (flyStartTime === 0) flyStartTime = timestamp;
                const elapsed = timestamp - flyStartTime;
                let allDone = true;
                allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const b = blessings[idx];
                    if (!p.activated && elapsed >= p.startDelay) {
                        p.activated = true;
                        b.activated = true;
                    }
                    if (!p.activated) { allDone = false; return; }
                    if (p.done) return;
                    const localElapsed = elapsed - p.startDelay;
                    const eased = easeInOutCubic(clamp(localElapsed / PARTICLE_CFG.flyDuration, 0, 1));
                    p.progress = eased;
                    b.progress = eased;
                    const t = eased,
                        mt = 1 - t;
                    const cx = mt * mt * b.startX + 2 * mt * t * b.cpX + t * t * b.targetX;
                    const cy = mt * mt * b.startY + 2 * mt * t * b.cpY + t * t * b.targetY;
                    const fadeStart = PARTICLE_CFG.fadeStart,
                        fadeEnd = PARTICLE_CFG.fadeEnd;
                    let textAlpha = 1,
                        textScale = 1;
                    if (eased > fadeStart) {
                        const fp = (eased - fadeStart) / (fadeEnd - fadeStart);
                        textAlpha = 1 - easeOutQuad(clamp(fp, 0, 1));
                        textScale = 1 - 0.5 * easeOutQuad(clamp(fp, 0, 1));
                    }
                    const currentFs = Math.max(b.fontSize * textScale, 0.05);
                    let particleAlpha = 0;
                    if (eased > fadeStart * 0.5) {
                        particleAlpha = easeOutQuad(clamp((eased - fadeStart * 0.5) / (fadeEnd * 1.2 - fadeStart * 0.5),
                            0, 1));
                    }
                    const mixPos = clamp((eased - fadeStart * 0.3) / (fadeEnd * 1.4 - fadeStart * 0.3), 0, 1);
                    const posEased = easeOutQuad(mixPos);
                    p.x = lerp(cx, b.targetX, posEased);
                    p.y = lerp(cy, b.targetY, posEased);
                    p.alpha = particleAlpha;
                    p.size = b.particleSize * (0.6 + 0.4 * particleAlpha);
                    if (textAlpha > 0.08 && currentFs > 3) {
                        drawGlowText(b.text, cx, cy, currentFs, textAlpha * 0.85, 40, 'rgba(255,215,0,0.5)');
                    }
                    if (p.alpha > 0.01) drawParticle(p);
                    if (eased >= 1) {
                        p.done = true;
                        b.done = true;
                        p.x = b.targetX;
                        p.y = b.targetY;
                        p.alpha = 1;
                        p.size = b.particleSize;
                    } else {
                        allDone = false;
                    }
                });
                if (allDone) {
                    allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                        p.x = blessings[idx].targetX;
                        p.y = blessings[idx].targetY;
                        p.alpha = 1;
                        p.size = blessings[idx].particleSize;
                    });
                    particleState = 'stable';
                    infoEl.classList.add('show');
                    infoEl.textContent = '✨ 星河祝福 · 生日快乐 ✨';
                    statusTip.textContent = '✦ 祝福化光 · 生日快乐 ✦';
                    statusTip.classList.add('show');
                    setTimeout(() => statusTip.classList.remove('show'), 4000);
                }
            }

            function startParticles() {
                if (!allParticles || allParticles.length === 0 || !blessings || blessings.length === 0) {
                    initParticles();
                    particlesReady = true;
                }
                if (particleState === 'flying' || particleState === 'stable') {
                    return;
                }
                allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                    const b = blessings[idx];
                    if (b) {
                        p.x = b.startX;
                        p.y = b.startY;
                        p.alpha = 0;
                        p.progress = 0;
                        p.activated = false;
                        p.done = false;
                        b.progress = 0;
                        b.done = false;
                        b.activated = false;
                    }
                });
                particleState = 'flying';
                flyStartTime = 0;
            }

            // 蛋糕流程主函数
            function initCakeFlow() {
                flamesExtinguished = false;
                cakeCloseState.phase = 'idle';
                cakeCloseState.progress = 0;
                cakeCloseState.isClosed = false;
                cakeCloseState.isOpening = false;
                cakeBlowDone = false;
                cakeSmokeActive = false;
                cakeSmokeParticles = [];
                cakeTransitionPhase = 'idle';
                cakeTransitionAlpha = 0;
                cakeScene = 'cake';
                particleState = 'idle';
                particlesReady = false;
                cakeSmokeStartTime = 0;
                drawCakeScene(0);
                if (!particlesReady) {
                    initParticles();
                    particlesReady = true;
                }
            }

            function startCakeFlow() {
                if (cakeCloseState.phase !== 'idle') return;
                cakeCloseState.phase = 'closing';
                cakeCloseState.startTime = performance.now();
                cakeCloseState.progress = 0;
                cakeCloseState.isClosed = false;
                cakeCloseState.isOpening = false;
                flamesExtinguished = false;
                cakeBlowDone = false;
                cakeSmokeActive = false;
                cakeSmokeParticles = [];
                particleState = 'idle';
                cakeTransitionPhase = 'idle';
                cakeTransitionAlpha = 0;
                cakeScene = 'cake';
                statusTip.textContent = '✦ 闭上眼睛许个愿 ✦';
                statusTip.classList.add('show');
                infoEl.classList.remove('show');
                drawCakeScene(performance.now() / 100);
                if (!particlesReady) {
                    initParticles();
                    particlesReady = true;
                }
                if (soundInitialized && !soundMuted) {
                    playCakeSound();
                }
            }

            function updateCakeFlow(timestamp) {
                function checkAndDoTransition() {
                    if (cakeBlowDone && cakeScene === 'cake') {
                        if (cakeTransitionPhase === 'idle') {
                            if (!cakeSmokeStartTime) cakeSmokeStartTime = timestamp;
                            if (timestamp - cakeSmokeStartTime > CAKE_SMOKE_WAIT_DURATION) {
                                cakeTransitionPhase = 'fading';
                                cakeTransitionStart = timestamp;
                                if (soundInitialized && !soundMuted) {
                                    stopHeartbeat();
                                    stopSpaceAmbient();
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (cakeTransitionPhase === 'fading') {
                            let progress = (timestamp - cakeTransitionStart) / CAKE_TRANSITION_DURATION;
                            if (progress >= 1) {
                                progress = 1;
                                cakeTransitionPhase = 'done';
                                cakeTransitionAlpha = 0;
                                cakeScene = 'stars';
                                stars_initScene();
                                if (!particlesReady) {
                                    initParticles();
                                    particlesReady = true;
                                }
                                startParticles();
                                statusTip.textContent = '✦ 祝福化光 · 生日快乐 ✦';
                                statusTip.classList.add('show');
                                setTimeout(() => statusTip.classList.remove('show'), 4000);
                                infoEl.classList.add('show');
                                infoEl.textContent = '✨ 星河祝福 · 生日快乐 ✨';
                                if (soundInitialized && !soundMuted) {
                                    playSpaceAmbient();
                                    soundEngine.playSound('heartbeat', 0, 2, 0.2, 0);
                                }
                            } else {
                                let alpha = 0;
                                if (progress < 0.5) {
                                    alpha = (progress / 0.5) * 0.6;
                                } else {
                                    alpha = ((1 - progress) / 0.5) * 0.6;
                                }
                                cakeTransitionAlpha = alpha;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'idle') {
                    checkAndDoTransition();
                    return;
                }

                const elapsed = timestamp - cakeCloseState.startTime;

                if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'closing') {
                    const p = clamp(elapsed / CAKE_CLOSE_DURATION, 0, 1);
                    const eased = easeInOutSine(p);
                    cakeCloseState.progress = eased;
                    if (p >= 1) {
                        cakeCloseState.progress = 1;
                        cakeCloseState.phase = 'closed';
                        cakeCloseState.isClosed = true;
                        cakeCloseState.startTime = timestamp;
                        statusTip.textContent = '✦ 默念心愿 2s ✦';
                    }
                } else if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'closed') {
                    if (elapsed >= CAKE_HOLD_DURATION) {
                        cakeCloseState.phase = 'opening';
                        cakeCloseState.startTime = timestamp;
                        cakeCloseState.isOpening = true;
                        statusTip.textContent = '✦ 睁开眼睛 ✦';
                    }
                } else if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'opening') {
                    const p = clamp(elapsed / CAKE_OPEN_DURATION, 0, 1);
                    cakeCloseState.progress = 1 - easeOutCubic(p);
                    if (p >= 1) {
                        cakeCloseState.progress = 0;
                        cakeCloseState.phase = 'idle';
                        cakeCloseState.isClosed = false;
                        cakeCloseState.isOpening = false;
                        if (!cakeBlowDone) {
                            cakeBlowDone = true;
                            flamesExtinguished = true;
                            createCakeSmoke();
                            cakeSmokeStartTime = performance.now();
                            statusTip.textContent = '✦ 蜡烛吹灭啦 ✦';
                            if (soundInitialized && !soundMuted && soundEngine) {
                                soundEngine.playSound('meteor', 0, 1.0, 0.3, 0);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (cakeSmokeActive) updateCakeSmoke();
                checkAndDoTransition();

                if (particleState === 'flying') {
                    updateParticles(timestamp);
                }
            }

            function drawCakeFlow(timestamp) {
                const time = timestamp / 100;

                if (cakeScene === 'cake') {
                    drawCakeScene(time);
                    if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'closing' || cakeCloseState.phase === 'closed' || cakeCloseState
                        .phase === 'opening') {
                        if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'closing') {
                            drawCakeEyeCloseMask(cakeCloseState.progress);
                        } else if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'closed') {
                            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
                        } else if (cakeCloseState.phase === 'opening') {
                            const openProgress = 1 - cakeCloseState.progress;
                            drawCakeWithOpenMask(openProgress);
                            if (cakeSmokeActive) drawCakeSmoke();
                        }
                    } else {
                        drawCakeToMain();
                        if (cakeSmokeActive) drawCakeSmoke();
                    }
                } else {
                    stars_drawFullScene(time);
                    if (particleState === 'flying') {
                        updateParticles(timestamp);
                    }
                    if (particleState === 'flying' || particleState === 'stable') {
                        allParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
                            if (!p || p.done) return;
                            const b = blessings[idx];
                            if (!b) return;
                            if (p.progress <= 0) return;
                            const eased = p.progress;
                            const fadeStart = PARTICLE_CFG.fadeStart,
                                fadeEnd = PARTICLE_CFG.fadeEnd;
                            let textAlpha = 1,
                                textScale = 1;
                            if (eased > fadeStart) {
                                const fp = (eased - fadeStart) / (fadeEnd - fadeStart);
                                textAlpha = 1 - easeOutQuad(clamp(fp, 0, 1));
                                textScale = 1 - 0.5 * easeOutQuad(clamp(fp, 0, 1));
                            }
                            const currentFs = Math.max(b.fontSize * textScale, 0.05);
                            if (textAlpha > 0.08 && currentFs > 3) {
                                drawGlowText(b.text, p.x, p.y, currentFs, textAlpha * 0.85, 40,
                                    'rgba(255,215,0,0.5)');
                            }
                            if (p.alpha > 0.01) {
                                drawParticle(p);
                            }
                        });
                        if (particleState === 'stable') {
                            drawStableGlow();
                            ctx.save();
                            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                            const fs = PARTICLE_CFG.targetFontSize;
                            ctx.font = `bold ${fs}px "PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif`;
                            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(W / 2 - fs, H * 0.30, W / 2 + fs, H * 0.30);
                            grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffd700');
                            grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffb6c1');
                            grad.addColorStop(1, '#87ceeb');
                            ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,200,100,0.7)';
                            ctx.shadowBlur = 50;
                            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                            ctx.fillText('生日快乐', W / 2, H * 0.30);
                            ctx.restore();
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (cakeTransitionPhase === 'fading' || cakeTransitionPhase === 'done') {
                    if (cakeTransitionAlpha > 0.01) {
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${cakeTransitionAlpha})`;
                        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
                    }
                }
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 11. 主渲染循环
            // ============================================================
            let masterStartTime = 0;
            let fwOpenProgress = 0;
            let animationStarted = false;

            function masterRender(timestamp) {
                if (!masterStartTime) {
                    masterStartTime = timestamp;
                    initEpic();
                }

                const time = timestamp / 100;

                switch (currentPhase) {
                    case MASTER_PHASE.EPIC:
                        updateEpic(timestamp);
                        drawEpic(timestamp);
                        break;
                    case MASTER_PHASE.CLOSING:
                        updateEpic(timestamp);
                        drawClosing(timestamp);
                        updateClosing(timestamp);
                        break;
                    case MASTER_PHASE.FIREWORKS:
                        updateEpic(timestamp);
                        fwOpenProgress = updateFireworks(timestamp);
                        drawFireworks(fwOpenProgress, time);
                        break;
                    case MASTER_PHASE.CAKE_TRANSITION:
                        updateCakeTransition(timestamp);
                        drawCakeTransition(timestamp);
                        break;
                    case MASTER_PHASE.CAKE_FLOW:
                        updateCakeFlow(timestamp);
                        drawCakeFlow(timestamp);
                        break;
                }

                animId = requestAnimationFrame(masterRender);
            }

            // ============================================================
            // 12. 初始化流程 (由按钮触发)
            // ============================================================
            function initMaster() {
                if (animationStarted) return;
                animationStarted = true;

                resize();
                generateCityStars();
                initSpaceStars();
                initClouds();
                initFloatParticles();
                generateBuildings();
                initPlanets();
                generateFwStars();
                currentPhase = MASTER_PHASE.EPIC;
                masterStartTime = 0;
                fwOpenProgress = 0;
                infoEl.textContent = '✦ 华灯 · 陨星 · 星河 ✦';
                infoEl.classList.remove('fireworks');
                infoEl.classList.remove('show');
                statusTip.textContent = '';
                statusTip.classList.remove('show');

                soundToggle.classList.add('show');

                initCakeFlow();

                if (animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
                animId = requestAnimationFrame(masterRender);
            }

            // ----- 点击“开始”按钮的处理 (预加载 + 心跳前奏) -----
            startBtn.addEventListener('click', async function (e) {
                e.preventDefault();

                // 1. 禁用按钮，显示加载状态
                startBtn.disabled = true;
                startBtn.textContent = '加载中…';

                try {
                    // 2. 初始化声音系统（内部包含预加载）
                    // 这里会等待所有音频（包括后备合成音）加载完成
                    if (!soundInitialized) {
                        await initSoundSystem();
                    }
                    // 确保声音开启
                    if (soundEngine) {
                        soundEngine.setMuted(false);
                        soundMuted = false;
                        soundToggle.textContent = '🔊 音效已开启';
                    }

                    // 预加载完成，现在开始心跳前奏
                    // 3. 播放心跳声 (2秒后自动停止)
                    playHeartbeat();

                    // 4. 隐藏覆盖层 (淡出)
                    startOverlay.classList.add('hidden');

                    // 5. 黑屏2秒后启动动画 (与心跳时长对齐)
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        initMaster();
                    }, 2000);

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('预加载失败:', err);
                    startBtn.textContent = '重 试';
                    startBtn.disabled = false;
                    alert('音频加载失败，请检查网络后重试');
                }
            });

            // 窗口resize处理
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resize();
                generateCityStars();
                initSpaceStars();
                initClouds();
                initFloatParticles();
                generateBuildings();
                generateFwStars();
                const minDim = Math.min(W, H);
                const pos = [{ x: W * 0.28, y: H * 0.38 }, { x: W * 0.72, y: H * 0.22 },
                { x: W * 0.20, y: H * 0.78 }, { x: W * 0.75, y: H * 0.72 },
                { x: W * 0.50, y: H * 0.15 }];
                const rads = [0.08, 0.06, 0.055, 0.07, 0.05];
                for (let i = 0; i < planets.length && i < pos.length; i++) {
                    planets[i].x = pos[i].x;
                    planets[i].y = pos[i].y;
                    const r = rads[i] * minDim;
                    planets[i].radius = r;
                    planets[i].origRadius = r;
                    for (let li = 0; li < planets[i].ringLayers.length; li++) {
                        const layer = planets[i].ringLayers[li];
                        const baseA = r * (2.2 + li * 1.2);
                        layer.a = baseA;
                        layer.b = baseA * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.25);
                    }
                }
                if (mainPlanet) {
                    const li = 1,
                        ang = -0.6;
                    let best = null,
                        bestDiff = Infinity;
                    const layer = mainPlanet.ringLayers[li];
                    if (layer) {
                        for (let pi = 0; pi < layer.particles.length; pi++) {
                            const p = layer.particles[pi];
                            const totalA = p.angleOffset + layer.angle;
                            let diff = totalA - ang;
                            diff = ((diff % (2 * Math.PI)) + 3 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI) - Math.PI;
                            if (Math.abs(diff) < bestDiff) {
                                bestDiff = Math.abs(diff);
                                best = pi;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (best !== null) {
                        const pos2 = mainPlanet.getParticlePosition(li, best);
                        const tangent = mainPlanet.getParticleTangent(li, best);
                        attachInfo.x = pos2.x;
                        attachInfo.y = pos2.y;
                        attachInfo.tangentX = tangent ? Math.cos(tangent) : 1;
                        attachInfo.tangentY = tangent ? Math.sin(tangent) : 0;
                    }
                    if (meteor.state === 'attached' || epicFlowState === 'space_open') {
                        meteor.x = attachInfo.x;
                        meteor.y = attachInfo.y;
                    }
                }
                updateCakeDrawInfo();
                if (cakeScene === 'cake') drawCakeScene(performance.now() / 100);
                else stars_initScene();
                if (particlesReady) initParticles();
            });

            console.log('✦ 星河入梦 · 花火 → 蛋糕许愿 · 星河祝福 ✦ (含预加载 + 心跳前奏)');
            console.log('🔊 点击“开始”后先预加载音频，再心跳2秒后睁眼');
        })();
    </script>
</body>

// sound-configurator.js
/**
 * Sound Configurator - 声音配置与播放核心
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 管理心跳、城市、太空、流星、烟花等音效，支持预加载、轨迹控制
 * @dependencies 无 (使用原生 Web Audio API 和 fetch)
 *
 * @example
 * // 浏览器引入
 * <script src="sound-configurator.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const { engine, meteorManager, fireworkManager } = await SoundSystem.create({
 *       sounds: {
 *           heartbeat: { url: 'heartbeat.mp3', start: 0, end: 2 }
 *       }
 *   });
 *   await engine.playSound('heartbeat', 0, 2);
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // ES Module
 * import SoundSystem from './sound-configurator.js';
 * const system = await SoundSystem.create();
 * system.engine.playSound('space', 0, 4);
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 默认配置 (可直接覆盖)
    // ============================================================
    const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
        sounds: {
            heartbeat: { url: 'heartbeat.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 2.0 },
            city: { url: 'city_ambient.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 6.0 },
            space: { url: 'space_hum.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 4.0 },
            meteor: { url: 'meteor_fall.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 3.5 },
            firework_launch: { url: 'firework_launch.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 1.8 },
            firework_explode: { url: 'firework_explode.mp3', start: 0.0, end: 2.5 },
        },
        meteor: {
            panStart: -0.8,
            panEnd: 0.8,
            volumeStart: 0.6,
            volumeEnd: 0.2,
            duration: 3.5,
        },
        firework: {
            launchDuration: 1.5,
            explodeDelay: 0.6,
            panSpread: 0.6,
        },
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 音频引擎 (Web Audio API)
    // ============================================================
    class AudioEngine {
        constructor() {
            this.ctx = null;
            this.buffers = {};
            this.activeSources = new Map();
            this.sourceIdCounter = 0;
            this.isPreloading = false;
        }

        getContext() {
            if (!this.ctx) {
                this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            }
            return this.ctx;
        }

        async preloadAll(soundConfigs) {
            this.isPreloading = true;
            const entries = Object.entries(soundConfigs);
            await Promise.all(entries.map(([key, cfg]) => {
                if (cfg.url) {
                    return this.loadSound(key, cfg.url).catch(err => {
                        console.warn(`预加载 ${key} 失败，使用合成后备音`, err);
                        return null;
                    });
                }
                return Promise.resolve();
            }));
            this.isPreloading = false;
            console.log('✅ 所有音频预加载完成');
        }

        async loadSound(key, url) {
            if (this.buffers[key]) return this.buffers[key];
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url);
                if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
                const arrayBuffer = await resp.arrayBuffer();
                const ctx = this.getContext();
                const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
                this.buffers[key] = audioBuffer;
                return audioBuffer;
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn(`⚠️ 加载音频 "${key}" 失败 (${url})，使用合成音代替`, err);
                const synth = this._synthesizeFallback(key);
                this.buffers[key] = synth;
                return synth;
            }
        }

        // ----- 合成后备音 (内部) -----
        _synthesizeFallback(key) {
            const ctx = this.getContext();
            const sr = ctx.sampleRate;
            const synths = {
                heartbeat: () => {
                    const dur = 2.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        let env = 0;
                        if (t < 0.15) env = Math.sin(t / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                        else if (t < 0.3) env = Math.sin((t - 0.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.4;
                        else if (t > 1.0 && t < 1.15) env = Math.sin((t - 1.0) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.7;
                        else if (t > 1.15 && t < 1.3) env = Math.sin((t - 1.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) * 0.3;
                        const freq = 60 + 30 * Math.sin(t * 8);
                        d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                city: () => {
                    const dur = 6.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.3;
                        const hum = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 120 * t) * 0.1;
                        const ring = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 800 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.05;
                        const spike = (Math.random() > 0.995) ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 : 0;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 0.08) * 0.8 + 0.2;
                        d[i] = (noise + hum + ring + spike) * env * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                space: () => {
                    const dur = 4.0;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 80 + 40 * Math.sin(t * 0.5);
                        const v = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * 0.3 +
                            Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * (freq * 1.5) * t) * 0.1;
                        d[i] = v * Math.exp(-t * 0.05) * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                meteor: () => {
                    const dur = 3.5;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 800 - t * 200 + Math.sin(t * 30) * 50;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.2) * 0.7 + 0.1;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.15 * env;
                        const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                        d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                firework_launch: () => {
                    const dur = 1.8;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const freq = 150 + t * 600;
                        const env = Math.sin(t / dur * Math.PI) * 0.8;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.2 * env;
                        const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * freq * t) * env * 0.5;
                        d[i] = (tone + noise) * 0.5;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
                firework_explode: () => {
                    const dur = 2.5;
                    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                        const t = i / sr;
                        const env = Math.exp(-t * 1.8) * 0.9;
                        const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.6 * env;
                        const low = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 80 * t) * env * 0.3;
                        const mid = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 300 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 2.5) * 0.2;
                        d[i] = (noise + low + mid) * 0.6;
                    }
                    return buf;
                },
            };
            const gen = synths[key] || (() => {
                const dur = 2.0;
                const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, sr * dur, sr);
                const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
                for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
                    const t = i / sr;
                    d[i] = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 440 * t) * Math.exp(-t * 0.5) * 0.3;
                }
                return buf;
            });
            return gen();
        }

        // ----- 播放方法 -----
        async playSound(key, startTime, endTime, volume = 0.8, pan = 0) {
            const buffer = await this.loadSound(key, key); // 缓存中已有
            if (!buffer) return null;

            const ctx = this.getContext();
            const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
            source.buffer = buffer;

            const gainNode = ctx.createGain();
            gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, volume));

            const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner();
            panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));

            source.connect(gainNode);
            gainNode.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(ctx.destination);

            const actualStart = Math.min(Math.max(0, startTime || 0), buffer.duration - 0.05);
            const actualEnd = Math.min(Math.max(actualStart + 0.05, endTime || buffer.duration), buffer.duration);
            const duration = actualEnd - actualStart;

            source.start(0, actualStart, duration);

            const id = ++this.sourceIdCounter;
            const entry = {
                id,
                key,
                source,
                gainNode,
                panner,
                isPlaying: true,
                stop: () => {
                    try { source.stop(); } catch (_) { }
                    entry.isPlaying = false;
                    this.activeSources.delete(id);
                },
            };
            this.activeSources.set(id, entry);

            source.onended = () => {
                entry.isPlaying = false;
                this.activeSources.delete(id);
            };

            return entry;
        }

        stopSound(id) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.stop();
                this.activeSources.delete(id);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        stopAll() {
            for (const [id, entry] of this.activeSources) {
                entry.stop();
            }
            this.activeSources.clear();
        }

        setVolume(id, vol) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.gainNode.gain.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, vol));
            }
        }

        setPan(id, pan) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            if (entry) {
                entry.panner.pan.value = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, pan));
            }
        }

        isPlaying(id) {
            const entry = this.activeSources.get(id);
            return entry ? entry.isPlaying : false;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 流星管理器
    // ============================================================
    class MeteorManager {
        constructor(engine, config) {
            this.engine = engine;
            this.config = config;
            this.meteors = [];
            this.idCounter = 0;
            this.onUpdate = null;
            this.animFrame = null;
            this.isRunning = false;
        }

        async addMeteor(panStart, panEnd, volStart, volEnd, duration) {
            const cfg = this.config.meteor;
            const startPan = panStart ?? cfg.panStart;
            const endPan = panEnd ?? cfg.panEnd;
            const startVol = volStart ?? cfg.volumeStart;
            const endVol = volEnd ?? cfg.volumeEnd;
            const dur = Math.min(duration ?? cfg.duration, this.config.sounds.meteor.end - this.config.sounds.meteor.start || 3.5);

            const id = ++this.idCounter;
            const meteor = {
                id,
                panStart: startPan,
                panEnd: endPan,
                volStart: startVol,
                volEnd: endVol,
                duration: dur,
                elapsed: 0,
                isPlaying: false,
                sourceId: null,
                progress: 0,
                active: true,
            };

            this.meteors.push(meteor);
            this._startAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
            return meteor;
        }

        async playMeteor(meteor) {
            if (meteor.isPlaying) return;
            const cfg = this.config.sounds.meteor;
            const entry = await this.engine.playSound(
                'meteor',
                cfg.start,
                cfg.end,
                meteor.volStart,
                meteor.panStart
            );
            if (entry) {
                meteor.sourceId = entry.id;
                meteor.isPlaying = true;
                meteor.elapsed = 0;
                meteor.progress = 0;
                this._updateUI();
            }
        }

        stopMeteor(meteor) {
            if (meteor.sourceId) {
                this.engine.stopSound(meteor.sourceId);
                meteor.sourceId = null;
            }
            meteor.isPlaying = false;
            this._updateUI();
        }

        removeMeteor(meteor) {
            this.stopMeteor(meteor);
            meteor.active = false;
            this.meteors = this.meteors.filter(m => m !== meteor);
            if (this.meteors.length === 0) this._stopAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
        }

        clearAll() {
            for (const m of this.meteors) this.stopMeteor(m);
            this.meteors = [];
            this._stopAnimation();
            this._updateUI();
        }

        _startAnimation() {
            if (this.isRunning) return;
            this.isRunning = true;
            const step = () => {
                if (!this.isRunning) return;
                let hasActive = false;
                for (const m of this.meteors) {
                    if (!m.isPlaying) continue;
                    hasActive = true;
                    m.elapsed += 0.04;
                    m.progress = Math.min(1, m.elapsed / m.duration);
                    const pan = m.panStart + (m.panEnd - m.panStart) * m.progress;
                    const vol = m.volStart + (m.volEnd - m.volStart) * m.progress;
                    this.engine.setPan(m.sourceId, pan);
                    this.engine.setVolume(m.sourceId, vol);
                    if (m.progress >= 1) this.stopMeteor(m);
                }
                this._updateUI();
                if (hasActive || this.meteors.some(m => m.isPlaying)) {
                    this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
                } else {
                    this.isRunning = false;
                    this.animFrame = null;
                }
            };
            this.animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }

        _stopAnimation() {
            this.isRunning = false;
            if (this.animFrame) {
                cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrame);
                this.animFrame = null;
            }
        }

        _updateUI() {
            if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.meteors);
        }

        get count() { return this.meteors.length; }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 烟花管理器
    // ============================================================
    class FireworkManager {
        constructor(engine, config) {
            this.engine = engine;
            this.config = config;
            this.fireworks = [];
            this.idCounter = 0;
            this.onUpdate = null;
            this.timeouts = [];
        }

        async addFirework() {
            const id = ++this.idCounter;
            const fw = {
                id,
                isPlaying: false,
                launchId: null,
                explodeId: null,
                active: true,
                phase: 'idle',
            };
            this.fireworks.push(fw);
            this._updateUI();
            await this._playFirework(fw);
            return fw;
        }

        async _playFirework(fw) {
            if (fw.isPlaying) return;
            fw.isPlaying = true;
            fw.phase = 'launching';
            this._updateUI();

            const launchCfg = this.config.sounds.firework_launch;
            const launchEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                'firework_launch',
                launchCfg.start,
                launchCfg.end,
                0.7,
                0
            );
            fw.launchId = launchEntry?.id || null;

            let launchProgress = 0;
            const launchInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) { clearInterval(launchInterval); return; }
                launchProgress += 0.05;
                const vol = 0.4 + launchProgress * 0.5;
                const pan = Math.sin(launchProgress * 3) * 0.2;
                if (fw.launchId) {
                    this.engine.setVolume(fw.launchId, Math.min(1, vol));
                    this.engine.setPan(fw.launchId, pan);
                }
                if (launchProgress >= 1) clearInterval(launchInterval);
            }, 50);

            const delay = this.config.firework.explodeDelay || 0.6;
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(async () => {
                if (!fw.active || !fw.isPlaying) return;
                if (fw.launchId) {
                    this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                    fw.launchId = null;
                }
                fw.phase = 'exploding';
                this._updateUI();
                const explodeCfg = this.config.sounds.firework_explode;
                const panSpread = this.config.firework.panSpread || 0.6;
                const pan = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * panSpread;
                const explodeEntry = await this.engine.playSound(
                    'firework_explode',
                    explodeCfg.start,
                    explodeCfg.end,
                    0.9,
                    pan
                );
                fw.explodeId = explodeEntry?.id || null;
                if (explodeEntry) {
                    const checkDone = () => {
                        if (!fw.active) return;
                        if (!this.engine.isPlaying(explodeEntry.id)) {
                            fw.isPlaying = false;
                            fw.phase = 'done';
                            this._updateUI();
                        } else {
                            setTimeout(checkDone, 200);
                        }
                    };
                    setTimeout(checkDone, 100);
                } else {
                    fw.isPlaying = false;
                    fw.phase = 'done';
                    this._updateUI();
                }
            }, delay * 1000);

            this.timeouts.push(timeoutId);
            fw._cleanup = () => {
                clearInterval(launchInterval);
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                if (fw.launchId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.launchId);
                if (fw.explodeId) this.engine.stopSound(fw.explodeId);
                fw.launchId = null;
                fw.explodeId = null;
                fw.isPlaying = false;
            };
        }

        stopFirework(fw) {
            if (fw._cleanup) fw._cleanup();
            fw.isPlaying = false;
            fw.phase = 'idle';
            this._updateUI();
        }

        removeFirework(fw) {
            this.stopFirework(fw);
            fw.active = false;
            this.fireworks = this.fireworks.filter(f => f !== fw);
            this._updateUI();
        }

        clearAll() {
            for (const fw of this.fireworks) this.stopFirework(fw);
            this.fireworks = [];
            this.timeouts.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
            this.timeouts = [];
            this._updateUI();
        }

        get count() { return this.fireworks.length; }

        _updateUI() {
            if (this.onUpdate) this.onUpdate(this.fireworks);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 主入口：创建声音系统（含预加载）
    // ============================================================
    async function createSoundSystem(customConfig = {}) {
        // 深度合并配置
        const config = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_CONFIG));
        // 合并 sounds
        if (customConfig.sounds) {
            for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(customConfig.sounds)) {
                if (config.sounds[key]) {
                    Object.assign(config.sounds[key], val);
                } else {
                    config.sounds[key] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        if (customConfig.meteor) {
            Object.assign(config.meteor, customConfig.meteor);
        }
        if (customConfig.firework) {
            Object.assign(config.firework, customConfig.firework);
        }

        const engine = new AudioEngine();
        await engine.preloadAll(config.sounds);

        const meteorManager = new MeteorManager(engine, config);
        const fireworkManager = new FireworkManager(engine, config);

        return {
            engine,
            meteorManager,
            fireworkManager,
            config,
        };
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 导出
    // ============================================================
    const SoundSystem = {
        version: '1.0.0',
        DEFAULT_CONFIG,
        AudioEngine,
        MeteorManager,
        FireworkManager,
        create: createSoundSystem,
    };

    // 浏览器全局
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.SoundSystem = SoundSystem;
    }

    // CommonJS / Node.js
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = SoundSystem;
        module.exports.default = SoundSystem;
    }

    // AMD
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return SoundSystem;
        });
    }

    return SoundSystem;
})(this);

        <!-- 操作按钮 -->

    <script>
        (function () {
            // DOM 引用
            const codeInput = document.getElementById('codeInput');
            const languageSelect = document.getElementById('languageSelect');
            const stdinInput = document.getElementById('stdinInput');
            const runBtn = document.getElementById('runBtn');
            const runLabel = document.getElementById('runLabel');
            const runSpinner = document.getElementById('runSpinner');
            const statusBadge = document.getElementById('statusBadge');
            const outputDisplay = document.getElementById('outputDisplay');
            const metaDisplay = document.getElementById('metaDisplay');

            // Judge0 CE 公共 API 地址[reference:5][reference:6]
            const API_BASE = 'https://ce.judge0.com';

            /**
             * 更新状态徽章
             */
            function setStatus(text, isError = false) {
                statusBadge.textContent = text;
                statusBadge.style.color = isError ? '#cf222e' : '#57606a';
                statusBadge.style.background = isError ? '#ffebe9' : '#f0f2f4';
            }

            /**
             * 显示输出结果
             */
            function renderResult(data) {
                // 提取关键字段
                const stdout = data.stdout || '';
                const stderr = data.stderr || '';
                const compileOutput = data.compile_output || '';
                const message = data.message || '';
                const status = data.status || {};
                const statusDesc = status.description || '未知';
                const time = data.time !== undefined && data.time !== null ? parseFloat(data.time).toFixed(3) : '—';
                const memory = data.memory !== undefined && data.memory !== null ? Math.round(parseFloat(data.memory)) : '—';

                // 组装输出文本（优先级：stderr > compile_output > stdout > 占位）
                let outputText = '';
                let isError = false;

                if (stderr && stderr.trim() !== '') {
                    outputText = stderr;
                    isError = true;
                } else if (compileOutput && compileOutput.trim() !== '') {
                    outputText = compileOutput;
                    isError = true;
                } else if (stdout && stdout.trim() !== '') {
                    outputText = stdout;
                } else if (message && message.trim() !== '') {
                    outputText = message;
                    isError = true;
                } else {
                    outputText = '（无输出）';
                }

                // 渲染输出
                if (isError) {
                    outputDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="error">${escapeHtml(outputText)}</span>`;
                } else {
                    outputDisplay.textContent = outputText;
                }

                // 渲染元数据
                metaDisplay.innerHTML = `
                <span>⏱ 时间: ${time} s</span>
                <span>🧠 内存: ${memory} KB</span>
                <span>📊 状态: ${escapeHtml(statusDesc)}</span>
            `;

                // 状态徽章
                const statusId = status.id;
                if (statusId === 3) {
                    setStatus('✅ 执行成功');
                } else if (statusId === 4 || statusId === 5 || statusId === 6) {
                    setStatus('⚠️ 运行时错误', true);
                } else if (statusId === 11 || statusId === 12) {
                    setStatus('❌ 编译错误', true);
                } else if (statusId === 13 || statusId === 14) {
                    setStatus('⏳ 超时', true);
                } else if (statusId === 15 || statusId === 16) {
                    setStatus('💥 内存超限', true);
                } else if (statusId) {
                    setStatus(`📌 ${escapeHtml(statusDesc)}`, statusId !== 3);
                } else {
                    setStatus('✅ 完成');
                }
            }

            /**
             * 简单的转义，防止 XSS
             */
            function escapeHtml(str) {
                if (!str) return '';
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.textContent = str;
                return div.innerHTML;
            }

            /**
             * 显示错误信息
             */
            function showError(msg) {
                outputDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="error">❌ ${escapeHtml(msg)}</span>`;
                metaDisplay.innerHTML = `
                <span>⏱ 时间: —</span>
                <span>🧠 内存: —</span>
                <span>📊 状态: 错误</span>
            `;
                setStatus('❌ 错误', true);
            }

            /**
             * 执行代码的主流程
             */
            async function runCode() {
                const sourceCode = codeInput.value.trim();
                if (!sourceCode) {
                    showError('请先输入要执行的代码');
                    return;
                }

                const languageId = parseInt(languageSelect.value, 10);
                const stdin = stdinInput.value || '';

                // UI 状态: 加载中
                runBtn.disabled = true;
                runLabel.textContent = '执行中';
                runSpinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
                setStatus('⏳ 提交中 ...');
                outputDisplay.innerHTML = '<span class="placeholder">⏳ 正在执行，请稍候...</span>';
                metaDisplay.innerHTML = `
                <span>⏱ 时间: —</span>
                <span>🧠 内存: —</span>
                <span>📊 状态: 执行中</span>
            `;

                try {
                    // 1. 创建提交 (使用 wait=true 同步等待结果)[reference:7][reference:8]
                    const submitPayload = {
                        language_id: languageId,
                        source_code: sourceCode,
                        stdin: stdin,
                        // 可选: 设置合理的资源限制[reference:9]
                        cpu_time_limit: 5,
                        memory_limit: 256000, // 256 MB
                    };

                    const submitUrl = `${API_BASE}/submissions?base64_encoded=false&wait=true`;

                    const submitResp = await fetch(submitUrl, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify(submitPayload),
                    });

                    if (!submitResp.ok) {
                        let errMsg = `API 请求失败 (HTTP ${submitResp.status})`;
                        try {
                            const errJson = await submitResp.json();
                            if (errJson && errJson.error) {
                                errMsg = errJson.error;
                            } else if (errJson && typeof errJson === 'object') {
                                errMsg = JSON.stringify(errJson);
                            }
                        } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                        throw new Error(errMsg);
                    }

                    const result = await submitResp.json();

                    // 2. 检查结果中是否有错误标记
                    if (result.error) {
                        throw new Error(result.error);
                    }

                    // 3. 渲染结果
                    renderResult(result);

                    // 如果 status 不存在或 id 不是 3 (Accepted)，但至少我们有输出
                    if (!result.status || result.status.id !== 3) {
                        // 但 renderResult 已经处理了状态显示
                    }

                    setStatus('✅ 完成');

                } catch (err) {
                    console.error('执行出错:', err);
                    showError(err.message || '未知错误，请查看控制台');
                } finally {
                    // 恢复 UI 状态
                    runBtn.disabled = false;
                    runLabel.textContent = '▶ 运行';
                    runSpinner.style.display = 'none';
                    // 如果状态还是 "提交中" 或 "执行中"，重置为就绪
                    if (statusBadge.textContent === '⏳ 提交中 ...' || statusBadge.textContent === '⏳ 执行中') {
                        setStatus('就绪');
                    }
                }
            }

            // ---------- 事件绑定 ----------
            runBtn.addEventListener('click', runCode);

            // Ctrl+Enter 快捷键运行
            codeInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    runBtn.click();
                }
            });

            // 初始示例代码
            // (已经写在 textarea 里了)

            // 页面加载完成后，设置默认状态
            setStatus('就绪');
            // 如果 textarea 有内容，显示一个友好的提示
            if (codeInput.value.trim()) {
                // 不做特殊处理
            }

            console.log('🚀 Judge0 代码执行器已加载');
            console.log(`📡 API 端点: ${API_BASE}`);
            console.log('💡 提示: 按 Ctrl+Enter 快速运行');
        })();
    </script>

</body>

</html>

/**
 * Judge0 代码执行器 - 轻量核心
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 通过语言常量或名称执行代码，内置语言常量集合
 * @dependencies 无 (使用原生 fetch)
 *
 * @example
 * // 浏览器引入
 * <script src="judge0-executor.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const result = await Judge0Executor.execute({
 *       source_code: 'print("Hello")',
 *       language: Judge0Executor.Language.PYTHON   // 使用常量
 *   });
 *   console.log(result.stdout);
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // ES Module
 * import Judge0Executor from './judge0-executor.js';
 * const result = await Judge0Executor.execute({
 *     source_code: 'console.log("Hi")',
 *     language: Judge0Executor.Language.JAVASCRIPT
 * });
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 语言常量集合 (枚举)
    // ============================================================

        FSHARP: 52,

        RLANG: 80,
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 辅助：字符串名称映射（可选，便于兼容）
    // ============================================================
    const LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP = {
        python: 71,
        python3: 71,
        python2: 70,
        javascript: 63,
        nodejs: 63,
        js: 63,

        fsharp: 52,
        vbnet: 53,
        sqlite: 55,
        postgresql: 56,
        mysql: 57,
        rlang: 80,
    };

    /**
     * 解析语言参数：接受数字 ID、字符串名称或 undefined
     * @param {number|string} lang - 语言 ID 或名称
     * @returns {number} 语言 ID
     * @throws {Error} 如果无法识别
     */
    function resolveLanguage(lang) {
        if (typeof lang === 'number') {
            return lang;
        }
        if (typeof lang === 'string') {
            const key = lang.toLowerCase().trim();
            const id = LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP[key];
            if (id === undefined) {
                throw new Error(`未知语言名称 "${lang}"`);
            }
            return id;
        }
        throw new Error('language 参数必须是数字或字符串');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 核心执行函数
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 在 Judge0 上执行代码
     * @param {Object} params
     * @param {string} params.source_code - 源代码
     * @param {number|string} params.language - 语言 ID 或名称（推荐使用 Language 常量）
     * @param {string} [params.stdin=''] - 标准输入
     * @param {number} [params.cpu_time_limit=5] - CPU 时间限制（秒）
     * @param {number} [params.memory_limit=256000] - 内存限制（KB）
     * @param {string} [params.apiBase='https://ce.judge0.com'] - API 地址
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} 执行结果
     */
    async function executeCode(params) {
        const {
            source_code,
            language,
            stdin = '',
            cpu_time_limit = 5,
            memory_limit = 256000,
            apiBase = 'https://ce.judge0.com',
        } = params;

        if (!source_code || source_code.trim() === '') {
            throw new Error('源代码不能为空');
        }

        const language_id = resolveLanguage(language);

        const payload = {
            language_id,
            source_code,
            stdin,
            cpu_time_limit,
            memory_limit,
        };

        const url = `${apiBase}/submissions?base64_encoded=false&wait=true`;

        const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            let errMsg = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
            try {
                const errJson = await response.json();
                errMsg = errJson.error || errMsg;
            } catch (_) { }
            throw new Error(`API 请求失败: ${errMsg}`);
        }

        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.error) {
            throw new Error(result.error);
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 导出
    // ============================================================

    const Judge0Executor = {
        version: '1.0.0',
        Language,               // 语言常量集合
        execute: executeCode,
        // 工具函数（可选）
        resolveLanguage,
        languageNameMap: LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP,
    };

    // 浏览器全局
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.Judge0Executor = Judge0Executor;
    }

    // CommonJS / Node.js
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = Judge0Executor;
        module.exports.default = Judge0Executor;
    }

    // AMD
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return Judge0Executor;
        });
    }

    return Judge0Executor;
})(this);

    <script>
        (function () {
            'use strict';

            // ======================================================================
            //  密文（固定 IV + CBC 模式，10 轮加密）
            // ======================================================================
            var CIPHER_TEXT =
                "";

            var FIXED_IV = CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse('0123456789abcdef');

            function multiDecrypt(ciphertext, password, times) {
                var data = ciphertext.trim();
                if (!data) throw new Error('密文为空');
                for (var i = 0; i < times; i++) {
                    try {
                        var decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(data, password, {
                            iv: FIXED_IV,
                            mode: CryptoJS.mode.CBC,
                            padding: CryptoJS.pad.Pkcs7
                        });
                        if (decrypted.sigBytes === 0) throw new Error('第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 次解密结果为空');
                        if (i === times - 1) {
                            var result = decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);
                            if (result === '') {
                                var latin = decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Latin1);
                                if (latin) throw new Error('最终明文 UTF-8 解码为空，Latin1 解码为: ' + latin);
                                throw new Error('最终明文无法解码（sigBytes=' + decrypted.sigBytes + '）');
                            }
                            data = result;
                        } else {
                            data = decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        throw new Error('第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 次解密失败: ' + e.message);
                    }
                }
                return data;
            }

            // ===== 辅助函数 =====
            function getVal(el) { return el.value ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

            function normalizePath(p) {
                return p.replace(/%2F/gi, '/');
            }

            function utf8ToBase64(str) {
                var encoder = new TextEncoder();
                var bytes = encoder.encode(str);
                var binary = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
                return btoa(binary);
            }

            function base64ToUtf8(base64) {
                var binary = atob(base64);
                var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
                for (var i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
                return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);
            }

            function formatSize(bytes) {
                if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
                if (bytes < 1048576) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';
                return (bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB';
            }

            function escapeHtml(str) {
                if (!str) return '';
                return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
            }

            function apiHeaders() {
                return {
                    'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + getVal(tokenInput),
                    'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
                };
            }

            function getFileIcon(name, type) {
                if (type === 'tree') return '📁';
                var ext = name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
                var icons = {
                    js: '🟨',
                    ts: '🔷',
                    jsx: '⚛️',
                    tsx: '⚛️',
                    html: '🌐',
                    css: '🎨',
                    scss: '🎨',
                    less: '🎨',
                    json: '📋',
                    xml: '📋',
                    yaml: '📋',
                    yml: '📋',
                    toml: '📋',
                    md: '📝',
                    txt: '📄',
                    csv: '📊',
                    py: '🐍',
                    rb: '💎',
                    go: '🔵',
                    rs: '🦀',
                    java: '☕',
                    php: '🐘',
                    c: '🔧',
                    cpp: '🔧',
                    h: '🔧',
                    sh: '⚙️',
                    bash: '⚙️',
                    zsh: '⚙️',
                    svg: '🖼️',
                    png: '🖼️',
                    jpg: '🖼️',
                    gif: '🖼️',
                    ico: '🖼️',
                    lock: '🔒',
                    gitignore: '🙈',
                    env: '🔐',
                };
                return icons[ext] || '📄';
            }

            function highlightText(text, filter) {
                if (!filter) return escapeHtml(text);
                var idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(filter.toLowerCase());
                if (idx === -1) return escapeHtml(text);
                return escapeHtml(text.substring(0, idx)) +
                    '<span class="highlight">' + escapeHtml(text.substring(idx, idx + filter.length)) + '</span>' +
                    escapeHtml(text.substring(idx + filter.length));
            }

            function setLoading(btn, loading) {
                if (loading) {
                    btn.disabled = true;
                    btn.dataset.originalText = btn.innerHTML;
                    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span> 处理中…';
                } else {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    if (btn.dataset.originalText) {
                        btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset.originalText;
                        delete btn.dataset.originalText;
                    }
                }
            }

            function showLoading(show) {
                loadingOverlay.classList.toggle('visible', show);
            }

                resultIcon.className = 'status-icon ' + (isError ? 'error' : (status === 'success' ? 'success' : 'info'));
                resultTitle.textContent = title;
                resultBody.innerHTML = bodyHTML;
                resultArea.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
            }

            function clearResult() {
