            // ---- 自动生成提交信息（强制更新） ----
            function setCommitMessage(type, path) {
                var cleanPath = path.replace(/\/$/, '');
                var parts = cleanPath.split('/');
                var name = parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : 'file';
                var msg = '';
                switch (type) {
                    case 'add':
                        msg = 'add: ' + name;
                        break;
                    case 'update':
                        msg = 'update: ' + name;
                        break;
                    case 'delete':
                        msg = 'del: ' + name;
                        break;
                    case 'deleteFolder':
                        msg = 'del: ' + name + '/';
                        break;
                    default:
                        msg = 'update: ' + name;
                }
                messageInput.value = msg;
                messageInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
            }

            // ===== 目录树构建 =====
            function buildTree(flatTree) {
                childrenMap = {};
                flatTree.sort(function (a, b) {
                    var aIsDir = a.type === 'tree' ? 0 : 1;
                    var bIsDir = b.type === 'tree' ? 0 : 1;
                    if (aIsDir !== bIsDir) return aIsDir - bIsDir;
                    return a.path.localeCompare(b.path);
                });
                for (var i = 0; i < flatTree.length; i++) {
                    var node = flatTree[i];
                    var parts = node.path.split('/');
                    var parentPath = parts.slice(0, -1).join('/');
                    if (!childrenMap[parentPath]) childrenMap[parentPath] = [];
                    childrenMap[parentPath].push(node);
                }
            }

            function renderTree(filter) {
                var f = (filter || '').toLowerCase().trim();
                treeContent.innerHTML = '';
                var filteredPaths = repoTree;
                if (f) {
                    filteredPaths = repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.path.toLowerCase().includes(f); });
                }
                if (filteredPaths.length === 0) {
                    treeContent.innerHTML = '<div class="tree-empty">' + (f ? '没有匹配的文件' : '仓库为空') + '</div>';
                    treeStats.textContent = '0 项';
                    return;
                }
                var rootChildren = childrenMap[''] || [];
                if (rootChildren.length === 0 && !f) {
                    treeContent.innerHTML = '<div class="tree-empty">仓库为空</div>';
                    treeStats.textContent = '0 项';
                    return;
                }
                if (f) {
                    renderFlatList(filteredPaths, f);
                } else {
                    var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                    for (var i = 0; i < rootChildren.length; i++) {
                        fragment.appendChild(createTreeNode(rootChildren[i], 0));
                    }
                    treeContent.appendChild(fragment);
                }
                var dirCount = repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.type === 'tree'; }).length;
                var fileCount = repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.type === 'blob'; }).length;
                treeStats.textContent = dirCount + ' 目录, ' + fileCount + ' 文件';
            }

            function renderFlatList(nodes, filter) {
                var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
                    var node = nodes[i];
                    var row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'tree-node-row';
                    row.style.paddingLeft = '14px';
                    var icon = getFileIcon(node.path.split('/').pop(), node.type);
                    row.innerHTML =
                        '<span class="node-icon">' + icon + '</span>' +
                        '<span class="node-name">' + highlightText(node.path, filter) + '</span>';
                    row.addEventListener('click', function (n) {
                        return function () { handleNodeClick(n); };
                    }(node));
                    row.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (n) {
                        return function (e) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            showContextMenu(e.clientX, e.clientY, n);
                        };
                    }(node));
                    fragment.appendChild(row);
                }
                treeContent.appendChild(fragment);
            }

            function createTreeNode(node, depth) {
                var container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'tree-node';
                var name = node.path.split('/').pop();
                var isDir = node.type === 'tree';
                var hasChildren = childrenMap[node.path] && childrenMap[node.path].length > 0;
                var icon = getFileIcon(name, node.type);
                var row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'tree-node-row';
                row.style.paddingLeft = (14 + depth * 20) + 'px';
                row.dataset.path = node.path;
                row.dataset.type = node.type;
                var toggleClass = 'toggle';
                if (!isDir) toggleClass += ' hidden';
                row.innerHTML =
                    '<span class="' + toggleClass + '">▶</span>' +
                    '<span class="node-icon">' + icon + '</span>' +
                    '<span class="node-name">' + escapeHtml(name) + '</span>' +
                    (isDir && hasChildren ? '<span class="node-meta">' + childrenMap[node.path].length + '</span>' : '');
                var childContainer = document.createElement('div');
                childContainer.className = 'tree-children';
                if (isDir && hasChildren) {
                    var children = childrenMap[node.path];
                    for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                        childContainer.appendChild(createTreeNode(children[i], depth + 1));
                    }
                }
                row.addEventListener('click', function (n) {
                    return function (e) {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (isDir) {
                            var toggle = row.querySelector('.toggle');
                            var isExpanded = childContainer.classList.contains('expanded');
                            if (isExpanded) {
                                childContainer.classList.remove('expanded');
                                toggle.classList.remove('expanded');
                            } else {
                                childContainer.classList.add('expanded');
                                toggle.classList.add('expanded');
                            }
                            pathInput.value = normalizePath(n.path + '/');
                            updateBreadcrumb(pathInput.value);
                            hideFileStatus();
                            shaInput.value = '';
                            contentInput.value = '';
                            clearSelected();
                            row.classList.add('selected');
                            setCommitMessage('add', pathInput.value);
                        } else {
                            handleNodeClick(n);
                        }
                    };
                }(node));
                row.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (n) {
                    return function (e) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        showContextMenu(e.clientX, e.clientY, n);
                    };
                }(node));
                container.appendChild(row);
                container.appendChild(childContainer);
                return container;
            }

            function clearSelected() {
                var rows = treeContent.querySelectorAll('.tree-node-row.selected');
                for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) rows[i].classList.remove('selected');
            }

            // ===== 处理节点点击（文件 → 获取内容） =====
            async function handleNodeClick(node) {
                var cleanPath = normalizePath(node.path);
                if (node.type === 'tree') {
                    pathInput.value = cleanPath + '/';
                    updateBreadcrumb(pathInput.value);
                    hideFileStatus();
                    shaInput.value = '';
                    contentInput.value = '';
                    clearSelected();
                    var rows = treeContent.querySelectorAll('.tree-node-row');
                    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                        if (rows[i].dataset.path === node.path) rows[i].classList.add('selected');
                    }
                    setCommitMessage('add', pathInput.value);
                    return;
                }
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;
                if (!token || !owner || !repo || !branch) {
                    showResult('error', '信息不完整', '请先验证 Token 并加载仓库。', true);
                    return;
                }
                pathInput.value = cleanPath;
                updateBreadcrumb(cleanPath);
                clearSelected();
                var rows2 = treeContent.querySelectorAll('.tree-node-row');
                for (var j = 0; j < rows2.length; j++) {
                    if (rows2[j].dataset.path === node.path) rows2[j].classList.add('selected');
                }
                showFileStatus('checking', '⏳', '正在获取文件内容…');
                try {
                    var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(cleanPath) +
                        '?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(branch);
                    var resp = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        var err = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                        showFileStatus('error', '❌', '获取失败: ' + (err.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status));
                        return;
                    }
                    var data = await resp.json();
                    if (data.encoding === 'base64' && data.content) {
                        var decoded = base64ToUtf8(data.content);
                        contentInput.value = decoded;
                        shaInput.value = data.sha || '';
                        fileExistsCache[cleanPath] = { exists: true, sha: data.sha, size: data.size };
                        showFileStatus('update', '✅', '已加载文件内容 · SHA: <code>' + (data.sha ? data.sha.substring(0,
                            10) + '…' : '') + '</code> · 大小: ' + formatSize(data.size));
                        setCommitMessage('update', cleanPath);
                        contentInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
                        contentInput.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    } else {
                        showFileStatus('error', '❌', '文件内容格式不支持（仅支持文本文件）');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    showFileStatus('error', '❌', '网络错误: ' + (err.message || '请求失败'));
                }
            }

            // ===== 面包屑 =====
            function updateBreadcrumb(path) {
                breadcrumb.innerHTML = '';
                if (!path) return;
                var parts = path.split('/').filter(Boolean);
                var accumulated = '';
                var rootCrumb = document.createElement('span');
                rootCrumb.className = 'crumb';
                rootCrumb.textContent = '📁 ' + (getVal(repoInput) || 'repo');
                rootCrumb.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    pathInput.value = '';
                    updateBreadcrumb('');
                    hideFileStatus();
                    contentInput.value = '';
                });
                breadcrumb.appendChild(rootCrumb);
                for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                    var sep = document.createElement('span');
                    sep.className = 'sep';
                    sep.textContent = '›';
                    breadcrumb.appendChild(sep);
                    accumulated += (accumulated ? '/' : '') + parts[i];
                    var crumb = document.createElement('span');
                    var isLast = (i === parts.length - 1);
                    if (isLast && !path.endsWith('/')) {
                        crumb.className = 'crumb current';
                    } else {
                        crumb.className = 'crumb';
                        var targetPath = accumulated + (isLast && path.endsWith('/') ? '/' : '');
                        crumb.addEventListener('click', function (tp) {
                            return function () {
                                if (isLast && path.endsWith('/')) {
                                    pathInput.value = accumulated + '/';
                                } else {
                                    pathInput.value = tp;
                                }
                                updateBreadcrumb(pathInput.value);
                                autoDetectFile(pathInput.value);
                            };
                        }(targetPath));
                    }
                    crumb.textContent = parts[i];
                    breadcrumb.appendChild(crumb);
                }
            }

            // ===== 自动检测文件（并填充 commit 消息） =====
            async function autoDetectFile(path) {
                path = normalizePath(path);
                if (!path || path.endsWith('/')) {
                    hideFileStatus();
                    shaInput.value = '';
                    setCommitMessage('add', path || 'file');
                    return;
                }
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                if (!token || !owner || !repo) return;
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;
                if (!branch) return;
                if (fileExistsCache[path] !== undefined) {
                    var cached = fileExistsCache[path];
                    if (cached.exists) {
                        showFileStatus('update', '🔄',
                            '文件已存在 · SHA: <code>' + cached.sha.substring(0, 10) + '…</code> · 大小: ' + formatSize(
                                cached.size) + ' · 将执行 <strong>更新</strong> 操作');
                        shaInput.value = cached.sha;
                        setCommitMessage('update', path);
                    } else {
                        showFileStatus('create', '✨', '文件不存在 · 将执行 <strong>创建</strong> 新文件操作');
                        shaInput.value = '';
                        setCommitMessage('add', path);
                    }
                    return;
                }
                showFileStatus('checking', '⏳', '正在检测文件状态…');
                try {
                    var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(path) +
                        '?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(branch);
                    var resp = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                    if (resp.ok) {
                        var data = await resp.json();
                        fileExistsCache[path] = { exists: true, sha: data.sha, size: data.size };
                        showFileStatus('update', '🔄',
                            '文件已存在 · SHA: <code>' + data.sha.substring(0, 10) + '…</code> · 大小: ' + formatSize(
                                data.size) + ' · 将执行 <strong>更新</strong> 操作');
                        shaInput.value = data.sha;
                        setCommitMessage('update', path);
                    } else if (resp.status === 404) {
                        fileExistsCache[path] = { exists: false, sha: '', size: 0 };
                        showFileStatus('create', '✨', '文件不存在 · 将执行 <strong>创建</strong> 新文件操作');
                        shaInput.value = '';
                        setCommitMessage('add', path);
                    } else {
                        hideFileStatus();
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    hideFileStatus();
                }
            }

            // ===== 右键菜单 =====
            function showContextMenu(x, y, node) {
                contextTargetNode = node;
                var isDir = node.type === 'tree';
                var isRoot = node.path === '';
                var items = contextMenu.querySelectorAll('.menu-item');
                for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                    var item = items[i];
                    var action = item.dataset.action;
                    item.style.display = 'flex';
                    if (action === 'newFile' || action === 'newFolder') {
                        item.style.display = isDir ? 'flex' : 'none';
                    } else if (action === 'deleteFile') {
                        item.style.display = (!isDir && !isRoot) ? 'flex' : 'none';
                    } else if (action === 'deleteFolder') {
                        item.style.display = (isDir && !isRoot) ? 'flex' : 'none';
                    } else if (action === 'getContent') {
                        item.style.display = (!isDir) ? 'flex' : 'none';
                    }
                }
                contextMenu.style.left = Math.min(x, window.innerWidth - 220) + 'px';
                contextMenu.style.top = Math.min(y, window.innerHeight - 300) + 'px';
                contextMenu.style.display = 'block';
                isContextMenuOpen = true;
                clearSelected();
                var rows = treeContent.querySelectorAll('.tree-node-row');
                for (var j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
                    if (rows[j].dataset.path === node.path) rows[j].classList.add('selected');
                }
            }

            function hideContextMenu() {
                contextMenu.style.display = 'none';
                isContextMenuOpen = false;
                contextTargetNode = null;
            }

            // ===== 右键菜单操作（接收 node 参数） =====
            async function menuNewFile(node) {
                if (!node) return;
                var dirPath = normalizePath(node.path);
                var fileName = prompt('请输入新文件名：', 'new-file.js');
                if (!fileName) return;
                var fullPath = dirPath ? dirPath + '/' + fileName : fileName;
                fullPath = normalizePath(fullPath);
                pathInput.value = fullPath;
                updateBreadcrumb(fullPath);
                contentInput.value = '';
                shaInput.value = '';
                hideFileStatus();
                setCommitMessage('add', fullPath);
                clearSelected();
                contentInput.focus();
                showResult('info', '📄 新建文件', '已准备创建文件 <strong>' + fullPath + '</strong>，请填写内容后点击「提交文件」。', false);
            }

            async function menuNewFolder(node) {
                if (!node) return;
                var dirPath = normalizePath(node.path);
                var folderName = prompt('请输入新文件夹名：', 'new-folder');
                if (!folderName) return;
                var fullPath = dirPath ? dirPath + '/' + folderName : folderName;
                fullPath = normalizePath(fullPath);
                var keepPath = fullPath + '/.gitkeep';
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;
                if (!token || !owner || !repo || !branch) {
                    showResult('error', '信息不完整', '请先验证 Token 并加载仓库。', true);
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    showLoading(true);
                    var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(keepPath);
                    var payload = {
                        message: 'add: ' + folderName + '/',
                        content: utf8ToBase64(''),
                        branch: branch,
                    };
                    var resp = await fetch(url, {
                        method: 'PUT',
                        headers: Object.assign(apiHeaders(), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
                        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                    });
                    var data = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        showResult('error', '创建文件夹失败', '<strong>' + (data.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status) + '</strong>',
                            true);
                        return;
                    }
                    showResult('success', '📁 文件夹已创建', '文件夹 <strong>' + fullPath + '</strong> 已创建（通过 .gitkeep 占位）。', false);
                    await loadRepo(true);
                    pathInput.value = fullPath + '/';
                    updateBreadcrumb(pathInput.value);
                    contentInput.value = '';
                    shaInput.value = '';
                    hideFileStatus();
                    setCommitMessage('add', fullPath + '/');
                } catch (err) {
                    showResult('error', '创建文件夹失败', '⚠️ ' + (err.message || '未知错误'), true);
                } finally {
                    showLoading(false);
                    hideContextMenu();
                }
            }

            // 🛠️ 核心修复：删除文件直接使用 node.sha，不再额外请求
            async function menuDeleteFile(node) {
                if (!node) return;
                var filePath = normalizePath(node.path);
                if (!confirm('⚠️ 确定要删除文件「' + filePath + '」吗？此操作不可撤销！')) return;

                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;

                // 优先使用节点自带的 sha
                var sha = node.sha;
                if (!sha) {
                    // 若节点无 sha（极少数情况），尝试从缓存或网络获取
                    try {
                        var checkUrl = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(
                            filePath) + '?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(branch);
                        var checkResp = await fetch(checkUrl, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                        if (!checkResp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + checkResp.status);
                        var checkData = await checkResp.json();
                        sha = checkData.sha;
                    } catch (err) {
                        showResult('error', '删除失败', '⚠️ 无法获取文件 SHA: ' + (err.message || '未知错误'), true);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                try {
                    showLoading(true);
                    var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(filePath);
                    var payload = {
                        message: 'del: ' + filePath.split('/').pop(),
                        sha: sha,
                        branch: branch,
                    };
                    var resp = await fetch(url, {
                        method: 'DELETE',
                        headers: Object.assign(apiHeaders(), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
                        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                    });
                    var data = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        showResult('error', '删除失败', '<strong>' + (data.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status) + '</strong>',
                            true);
                        return;
                    }
                    showResult('success', '🗑️ 文件已删除', '文件 <strong>' + filePath + '</strong> 已成功删除。', false);
                    delete fileExistsCache[filePath];
                    if (getVal(pathInput) === filePath) {
                        pathInput.value = '';
                        shaInput.value = '';
                        contentInput.value = '';
                        hideFileStatus();
                    }
                    await loadRepo(true);
                } catch (err) {
                    showResult('error', '删除失败', '⚠️ ' + (err.message || '未知错误'), true);
                } finally {
                    showLoading(false);
                    hideContextMenu();
                }
            }

            async function menuDeleteFolder(node) {
                if (!node) return;
                var folderPath = normalizePath(node.path);
                if (!confirm('⚠️ 确定要删除文件夹「' + folderPath + '」及其所有内容吗？此操作不可撤销！')) return;
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;
                if (!token || !owner || !repo || !branch) {
                    showResult('error', '信息不完整', '请先验证 Token 并加载仓库。', true);
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    showLoading(true);
                    var allFiles = repoTree.filter(function (n) {
                        return n.type === 'blob' && n.path.startsWith(folderPath + '/');
                    });
                    if (allFiles.length === 0) {
                        showResult('error', '删除失败', '文件夹 <strong>' + folderPath + '</strong> 为空或不存在。', true);
                        return;
                    }
                    var deleted = 0;
                    var failed = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < allFiles.length; i++) {
                        var file = allFiles[i];
                        try {
                            var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(
                                file.path);
                            var payload = {
                                message: 'del: ' + file.path.split('/').pop(),
                                sha: file.sha,
                                branch: branch,
                            };
                            var resp = await fetch(url, {
                                method: 'DELETE',
                                headers: Object.assign(apiHeaders(), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
                                body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                            });
                            if (resp.ok) {
                                deleted++;
                                delete fileExistsCache[file.path];
                            } else {
                                var errData = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                                failed.push(file.path + ' (' + (errData.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status) + ')');
                            }
                        } catch (e) {
                            failed.push(file.path + ' (' + e.message + ')');
                        }
                    }
                    var msg = '删除了 ' + deleted + ' 个文件';
                    if (failed.length > 0) {
                        msg += '，<span style="color:var(--danger);">' + failed.length + ' 个失败</span>：' + failed.join('; ');
                    } else {
                        msg += '，文件夹 <strong>' + folderPath + '</strong> 已清空。';
                    }
                    showResult('success', '🗑️ 删除完成', msg, false);
                    await loadRepo(true);
                    if (getVal(pathInput) === folderPath || getVal(pathInput).startsWith(folderPath + '/')) {
                        pathInput.value = '';
                        shaInput.value = '';
                        contentInput.value = '';
                        hideFileStatus();
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    showResult('error', '删除失败', '⚠️ ' + (err.message || '未知错误'), true);
                } finally {
                    showLoading(false);
                    hideContextMenu();
                }
            }

            async function menuGetContent(node) {
                if (!node) return;
                await handleNodeClick(node);
                hideContextMenu();
            }

            // ===== Token 验证 & 仓库操作 =====
            async function verifyToken(showStatus) {
                if (showStatus === undefined) showStatus = true;
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                if (!token) {
                    if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('error', '⚠️ 请先输入 Personal Access Token');
                    return false;
                }
                token = token.trim();
                if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('loading', '正在验证 Token…');
                try {
                    var resp = await fetch('https://api.github.com/user', {
                        headers: {
                            'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token,
                            'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
                        }
                    });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        var err = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                        if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('error', '❌ Token 无效: ' + (err.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status));
                        return false;
                    }
                    var user = await resp.json();
                    currentUser = user;
                    ownerInput.value = user.login;
                    if (showStatus) {
                        showTokenStatus('success', '验证成功', {
                            login: user.login,
                            name: user.name || '',
                            avatar_url: user.avatar_url || '',
                            public_repos: user.public_repos || 0,
                        });
                    }
                    await fetchUserRepos(showStatus);
                    return true;
                } catch (err) {
                    if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('error', '❌ 网络错误: ' + (err.message || '请求失败'));
                    return false;
                }
            }

            async function fetchUserRepos(showStatus) {
                if (showStatus === undefined) showStatus = true;
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                if (!token) return;
                try {
                    var resp = await fetch('https://api.github.com/user/repos?per_page=100&sort=updated&type=all', {
                        headers: {
                            'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token,
                            'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
                        }
                    });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('error', '❌ 获取仓库列表失败: HTTP ' + resp.status);
                        return;
                    }
                    var repos = await resp.json();
                    repoList = repos.map(function (r) {
                        return {
                            name: r.name,
                            description: r.description || '',
                            default_branch: r.default_branch || 'main',
                        };
                    });
                    repoDatalist.innerHTML = '';
                    for (var i = 0; i < repoList.length; i++) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = repoList[i].name;
                        repoDatalist.appendChild(opt);
                    }
                    if (showStatus) {
                        var user = currentUser;
                        if (user && tokenStatus.classList.contains('visible')) {
                            showTokenStatus('success', '已加载 ' + repoList.length + ' 个仓库', {
                                login: user.login,
                                name: user.name || '',
                                avatar_url: user.avatar_url || '',
                                public_repos: user.public_repos || 0,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    if (showStatus) showTokenStatus('error', '❌ 获取仓库列表失败: ' + (err.message || '请求失败'));
                }
            }

            function updateRepoInfo(repoName) {
                var found = repoList.find(function (r) { return r.name === repoName; });
                if (found) {
                    repoDesc.textContent = found.description || '（无简介）';
                    repoDesc.className = 'repo-desc';
                    loadBranches(repoName);
                } else {
                    repoDesc.textContent = '未找到仓库信息';
                    repoDesc.className = 'repo-desc empty';
                    branchSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">— 请选择仓库 —</option>';
                }
            }

            async function loadBranches(repoName) {
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                if (!token || !owner || !repoName) {
                    branchSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">— 请先选择仓库 —</option>';
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    var resp = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repoName + '/branches', {
                        headers: apiHeaders()
                    });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        branchSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">— 获取分支失败 —</option>';
                        return;
                    }
                    var branches = await resp.json();
                    currentRepoBranches = branches.map(function (b) { return b.name; });
                    branchSelect.innerHTML = '';
                    for (var i = 0; i < currentRepoBranches.length; i++) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = currentRepoBranches[i];
                        opt.textContent = currentRepoBranches[i];
                        branchSelect.appendChild(opt);
                    }
                    var found = repoList.find(function (r) { return r.name === repoName; });
                    var defaultBranch = found ? found.default_branch : (currentRepoBranches.length > 0 ? currentRepoBranches[
                        0] : '');
                    if (defaultBranch && currentRepoBranches.includes(defaultBranch)) {
                        branchSelect.value = defaultBranch;
                    } else if (currentRepoBranches.length > 0) {
                        branchSelect.value = currentRepoBranches[0];
                    }
                    branchInput.value = branchSelect.value;
                } catch (err) {
                    branchSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">— 加载分支失败 —</option>';
                }
            }

            async function loadRepo(preserveResult) {
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                if (!token || !owner || !repo) {
                    showResult('error', '信息不完整', '请填写 Token、仓库所有者和仓库名称。', true);
                    return;
                }
                setLoading(btnLoadRepo, true);
                showRepoStatus('loading', '正在获取仓库信息…');
                if (!preserveResult) {
                    clearResult();
                }
                fileExistsCache = {};
                try {
                    var repoUrl = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo;
                    var repoResp = await fetch(repoUrl, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                    if (!repoResp.ok) {
                        var err = await repoResp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                        showRepoStatus('error', '获取仓库失败: ' + (err.message || 'HTTP ' + repoResp.status));
                        treeBrowser.classList.remove('visible');
                        treeVisible = false;
                        btnToggleTree.textContent = '📁 浏览';
                        setLoading(btnLoadRepo, false);
                        return;
                    }
                    var repoData = await repoResp.json();
                    repoDefaultBranch = repoData.default_branch || 'main';
                    if (!branchSelect.value) {
                        branchSelect.value = repoDefaultBranch;
                    }
                    branchInput.value = branchSelect.value;
                    showRepoStatus('loading', '正在获取目录结构 (' + branchSelect.value + ')…');
                    var treeUrl = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/git/trees/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(branchSelect.value) + '?recursive=1';
                    var treeResp = await fetch(treeUrl, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                    if (!treeResp.ok) {
                        var err2 = await treeResp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                        showRepoStatus('error', '获取目录失败: ' + (err2.message || 'HTTP ' + treeResp.status));
                        setLoading(btnLoadRepo, false);
                        return;
                    }
                    var treeData = await treeResp.json();
                    repoTree = treeData.tree || [];
                    repoTree = repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.type === 'tree' || n.type === 'blob'; });
                    buildTree(repoTree);
                    showRepoStatus('success',
                        '✅ ' + owner + '/' + repo + ' · 分支: ' + branchSelect.value +
                        ' · ' + repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.type === 'tree'; }).length + ' 目录, ' +
                        repoTree.filter(function (n) { return n.type === 'blob'; }).length + ' 文件');
                    treeBrowser.classList.add('visible');
                    treeVisible = true;
                    btnToggleTree.textContent = '📁 收起';
                    renderTree('');
                    treeSearch.value = '';
                } catch (err) {
                    showRepoStatus('error', '网络错误: ' + (err.message || '请求失败'));
                } finally {
                    setLoading(btnLoadRepo, false);
                }
            }

            // ===== 提交文件 =====
            async function submitFile(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                var token = getVal(tokenInput);
                var owner = getVal(ownerInput);
                var repo = getVal(repoInput);
                var path = getVal(pathInput);
                path = normalizePath(path);
                var message = getVal(messageInput);
                var contentRaw = contentInput.value;
                var sha = getVal(shaInput) || undefined;
                var branch = getVal(branchSelect) || repoDefaultBranch;
                var fields = [
                    { val: token, name: 'Token' },
                    { val: owner, name: '仓库所有者' },
                    { val: repo, name: '仓库名称' },
                    { val: path, name: '文件路径' },
                    { val: message, name: '提交信息' },
                    { val: contentRaw, name: '文件内容' },
                ];
                for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
                    if (!fields[i].val) {
                        showResult('error', '表单不完整', '<strong>请填写「' + fields[i].name + '」字段。</strong>', true);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                if (!branch) {
                    showResult('error', '分支未选择', '请从分支下拉框中选择一个分支。', true);
                    return;
                }
                path = path.replace(/\/+$/, '');
                if (!sha) {
                    try {
                        var checkUrl = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(
                            path) + '?ref=' + encodeURIComponent(branch);
                        var checkResp = await fetch(checkUrl, { headers: apiHeaders() });
                        if (checkResp.ok) {
                            var checkData = await checkResp.json();
                            sha = checkData.sha;
                            shaInput.value = sha;
                        }
                    } catch (_) { /* ignore */ }
                }
                var contentBase64;
                try {
                    contentBase64 = utf8ToBase64(contentRaw);
                } catch (encErr) {
                    showResult('error', '编码失败', '⚠️ 文件内容编码失败：' + (encErr.message || '未知错误'), true);
                    return;
                }
                var url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + owner + '/' + repo + '/contents/' + encodeURI(path);
                var payload = {
                    message: message,
                    content: contentBase64,
                    branch: branch,
                };
                if (sha) payload.sha = sha;
                try {
                    setLoading(btnSubmit, true);
                    clearResult();
                    var resp = await fetch(url, {
                        method: 'PUT',
                        headers: Object.assign(apiHeaders(), { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
                        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
                    });
                    var data = await resp.json().catch(function () { return {}; });
                    if (!resp.ok) {
                        if (resp.status === 409) {
                            showResult('error', '文件冲突',
                                '⚠️ 文件 <strong>' + path + '</strong> 已存在，但未提供正确的 SHA。<br>已尝试自动获取，请重试或手动填写 SHA。',
                                true);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (resp.status === 422) {
                            showResult('error', '验证失败',
                                '<strong>' + (data.message || '请求参数有误') + '</strong><br>' +
                                '<details style="margin-top:8px;"><summary style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--primary);">查看详情</summary>' +
                                '<pre style="background:var(--gray-100);padding:10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;overflow:auto;margin-top:6px;">' +
                                escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)) + '</pre></details>', true);
                            return;
                        }
                        showResult('error', '提交失败',
                            '<strong>' + (data.message || 'HTTP ' + resp.status) + '</strong><br>' +
                            '<details style="margin-top:8px;"><summary style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--primary);">查看详情</summary>' +
                            '<pre style="background:var(--gray-100);padding:10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;overflow:auto;margin-top:6px;">' +
                            escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)) + '</pre></details>', true);
                        return;
                    }
                    var commitUrl = data.commit && data.commit.html_url || '';
                    var fileUrl = data.content && data.content.html_url || '';
                    var shaResult = (data.content && data.content.sha) || '';
                    var isUpdate = !!sha;
                    var successHTML =
                        '✅ 文件 <strong>' + path + '</strong> 已成功' + (isUpdate ? '更新' : '创建') + '！' +
                        '<div style="margin-top:12px;background:var(--gray-100);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;">' +
                        '<div class="detail-row"><span class="label">SHA</span><span style="font-family:monospace;">' +
                        shaResult + '</span></div>' +
                        '<div class="detail-row"><span class="label">提交信息</span><span>' + escapeHtml(message) +
                        '</span></div>' +
                        '<div class="detail-row"><span class="label">分支</span><span>' + escapeHtml(branch) +
                        '</span></div>' +
                        '<div class="detail-row"><span class="label">操作</span><span>' + (isUpdate ? '更新文件' :
                            '创建新文件') + '</span></div>' +
                        '</div>';
                    if (fileUrl) successHTML += '<div style="margin-top:12px;">🔗 <a href="' + fileUrl +
                        '" target="_blank" class="link">查看文件 on GitHub</a></div>';
                    if (commitUrl) successHTML += '<div style="margin-top:4px;">🔗 <a href="' + commitUrl +
                        '" target="_blank" class="link">查看提交记录</a></div>';
                    showResult('success', '提交成功', successHTML, false);
                    delete fileExistsCache[path];
                    shaInput.value = '';
                    hideFileStatus();
                    await loadRepo(true);
                    pathInput.value = path;
                    updateBreadcrumb(path);
                } catch (err) {
                    showResult('error', '网络错误', '⚠️ ' + (err.message || '请求失败，请检查网络连接。'), true);
                } finally {
                    setLoading(btnSubmit, false);
                }
            }

            // ===== 文件选择 =====
            function handleFileSelect() {
                var input = document.createElement('input');
                input.type = 'file';
                input.accept =
                    '.js,.ts,.jsx,.tsx,.html,.css,.scss,.less,.json,.xml,.yaml,.yml,.toml,.md,.txt,.py,.rb,.go,.rs,.java,.php,.c,.cpp,.h,.sh,.bash,.zsh,.gitignore,.env,.lock,.svg,.png,.jpg,.gif,.ico';
                input.onchange = function (e) {
                    var file = e.target.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    var reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onload = function (ev) {
                        try {
                            var text = ev.target.result;
                            contentInput.value = text;
                            var fileName = file.name;
                            var currentPath = getVal(pathInput);
                            if (!currentPath || !currentPath.includes('/')) {
                                pathInput.value = fileName;
                            } else {
                                var dir = currentPath.substring(0, currentPath.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
                                pathInput.value = dir + fileName;
                            }
                            selectedFileName.textContent = '📎 ' + fileName;
                            pathInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));
                        } catch (err) {
                            showResult('error', '读取文件失败', '⚠️ 无法读取文件内容：' + (err.message || '未知错误'), true);
                        }
                    };
                    reader.onerror = function () {
                        showResult('error', '读取文件失败', '⚠️ 文件读取出错，请重试。', true);
                    };
                    reader.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
                };
                input.click();
            }

            // ===== 密码获取 Token =====
            function showPwdStatus(type, text) {
                pwdStatus.className = 'pwd-status visible ' + type;
                pwdStatusText.textContent = text;
                pwdSpinner.style.display = type === 'loading' ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
            }

            function hidePwdStatus() { pwdStatus.classList.remove('visible'); }

            function togglePwdBody() {
                pwdBodyOpen = !pwdBodyOpen;
                pwdBody.classList.toggle('open', pwdBodyOpen);
                pwdToggleIcon.classList.toggle('open', pwdBodyOpen);
                if (pwdBodyOpen) pwdInput.focus();
            }

            async function handlePwdGetToken() {
                var password = pwdInput.value;
                if (!password) {
                    showPwdStatus('error', '⚠️ 请输入密码');
                    return;
                }
                setLoading(btnPwdGetToken, true);
                showPwdStatus('loading', '🔐 正在解密… 第 1/10 轮');
                try {
                    var token = multiDecrypt(CIPHER_TEXT, password, 10);
                    token = token.trim();
                    if (token && token.startsWith('github_pat_') && token.length >= 40) {
                        tokenInput.value = token;
                        tokenInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                        showPwdStatus('success', '✅ Token 解密成功！已自动填入，正在验证…');
                        var ok = await verifyToken(true);
                        if (ok) {
                            showPwdStatus('success', '✅ Token 有效，已自动填入并验证通过');
                        } else {
                            showPwdStatus('error', '⚠️ Token 已填入但验证失败，请检查 Token 权限或重新获取。');
                        }
                    } else {
                        showPwdStatus('error', '❌ 解密结果不是有效的 Token，请检查密码是否正确。');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    showPwdStatus('error', '❌ 解密出错：' + (err.message || '未知错误'));
                } finally {
                    setLoading(btnPwdGetToken, false);
                }
            }

            // ===== 事件绑定 =====

                    treeVisible = false;
                    btnToggleTree.textContent = '📁 浏览';

            contextMenu.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                var item = e.target.closest('.menu-item');
                if (!item) return;
                var action = item.dataset.action;
                var node = contextTargetNode;
                if (!node) {
                    // fallback: 从选中的行获取
                    var selectedRow = treeContent.querySelector('.tree-node-row.selected');
                    if (selectedRow) {
                        var path = selectedRow.dataset.path;
                        var type = selectedRow.dataset.type;
                        // 从 repoTree 中查找完整节点
                        var found = repoTree.find(function (n) { return n.path === path; });
                        if (found) node = found;
                    }
                }
                hideContextMenu();
                if (!node) {
                    showResult('error', '操作失败', '未能获取目标节点，请重试。', true);
                    return;
                }
                switch (action) {
                    case 'newFile':
                        menuNewFile(node);
                        break;
                    case 'newFolder':
                        menuNewFolder(node);
                        break;
                    case 'deleteFile':
                        menuDeleteFile(node);
                        break;
                    case 'deleteFolder':
                        menuDeleteFolder(node);
                        break;
                    case 'getContent':
                        menuGetContent(node);
                        break;
                    default:
                        break;
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                if (isContextMenuOpen && !contextMenu.contains(e.target)) {
                    hideContextMenu();
                }
            });
            document.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
                if (isContextMenuOpen) hideContextMenu();
            });
            window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
                if (isContextMenuOpen) hideContextMenu();

                    pwdEyeBtn.textContent = '🙈';
                } else {
                    input.type = 'password';
                    pwdEyeBtn.textContent = '👁';
                }
            });
            btnPwdClear.addEventListener('click', function () {
                pwdInput.value = '';
                hidePwdStatus();
                pwdInput.focus();
            });

            if (getVal(tokenInput)) {
                setTimeout(function () { verifyToken(true); }, 500);
            }

            console.log('✅ GitHub 文件管理工具（最终修复版）已加载');
            console.log('💡 修复：删除文件直接使用节点 SHA，不再额外请求，稳定可靠。');
        })();

    <script>
        (function () {
            'use strict';

            const DEBUG = true;

            const latexInput = document.getElementById('latexInput');
            const formulaDisplay = document.getElementById('formulaDisplay');
            const resultDisplay = document.getElementById('resultDisplay');
            const convertedDisplay = document.getElementById('convertedDisplay');
            const debugCard = document.getElementById('debugCard');
            const calcBtn = document.getElementById('calcBtn');
            const convertBtn = document.getElementById('convertBtn');
            const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clearBtn');

            let lastLatex = '';
            let lastResult = null;
            let lastConverted = '';

            function log(...args) {
                if (DEBUG) console.log(...args);
            }

            // ---------- 数值积分（复合辛普森法，默认1000等分） ----------
            function numericalIntegral(expr, varName, a, b, n = 1000) {
                if (n % 2 === 1) n++;
                const h = (b - a) / n;
                let sum = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                    const x = a + i * h;
                    const y = math.evaluate(expr, { [varName]: x });
                    if (i === 0 || i === n) sum += y;
                    else if (i % 2 === 0) sum += 2 * y;
                    else sum += 4 * y;
                }
                return sum * h / 3;
            }

            // ---------- 主转换函数 ----------
            function latexToMathJS(latex) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') return '';
                let s = latex.trim();
                s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

                // ---- 0. 预处理：移除 \limits 和 \, ----
                s = s.replace(/\\limits/g, '');
                s = s.replace(/\\,/g, ' ');

                // ---- 1. 三角函数等（递归处理参数） ----
                const funcMap = {
                    'sin': 'sin',
                    'cos': 'cos',
                    'tan': 'tan',
                    'cot': 'cot',
                    'sec': 'sec',
                    'csc': 'csc',
                    'arcsin': 'asin',
                    'arccos': 'acos',
                    'arctan': 'atan',
                    'log': 'log',
                    'ln': 'log',
                    'lg': 'log10',
                    'exp': 'exp',
                    'sinh': 'sinh',
                    'cosh': 'cosh',
                    'tanh': 'tanh'
                };
                let prevTrig;
                do {
                    prevTrig = s;
                    for (const [latexCmd, mathFn] of Object.entries(funcMap)) {
                        const regex1 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\{([^}]*)\\}', 'g');
                        const regex2 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\(([^)]*)\\)', 'g');
                        s = s.replace(regex1, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
                        s = s.replace(regex2, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
                    }
                } while (s !== prevTrig);

                // ---- 2. 分数 ----
                let prev;
                do {
                    prev = s;
                    s = s.replace(/\\frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, num, den) => {
                        return `${latexToMathJS(num)}/${latexToMathJS(den)}`;
                    });
                } while (s !== prev);

                // ---- 3. 根号 ----
                do {
                    prev = s;
                    s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\[([^{}]*)\]\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, n, expr) => {
                        return `(${latexToMathJS(expr)})^(1/(${latexToMathJS(n)}))`;
                    });
                    s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, expr) => {
                        return `sqrt(${latexToMathJS(expr)})`;
                    });
                } while (s !== prev);

                // ---- 4. 常数替换（提前到积分之前，使上下限中的常量可被 math.evaluate 识别） ----
                const constMap = {
                    '\\pi': 'pi',
                    '\\Pi': 'pi',
                    '\\infty': 'Infinity',
                    '\\e': 'e',
                    '\\E': 'e',
                    '\\mathrm{e}': 'e',
                    '\\mathrm{E}': 'e'
                };
                for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(constMap)) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
                }

                // ---- 5. 希腊字母（同样提前） ----
                const greekMap = {
                    '\\alpha': 'alpha',
                    '\\beta': 'beta',
                    '\\gamma': 'gamma',
                    '\\delta': 'delta',
                    '\\epsilon': 'epsilon',
                    '\\zeta': 'zeta',
                    '\\eta': 'eta',
                    '\\theta': 'theta',
                    '\\iota': 'iota',
                    '\\kappa': 'kappa',
                    '\\lambda': 'lambda',
                    '\\mu': 'mu',
                    '\\nu': 'nu',
                    '\\xi': 'xi',
                    '\\omicron': 'omicron',
                    '\\pi': 'pi',
                    '\\rho': 'rho',
                    '\\sigma': 'sigma',
                    '\\tau': 'tau',
                    '\\upsilon': 'upsilon',
                    '\\phi': 'phi',
                    '\\chi': 'chi',
                    '\\psi': 'psi',
                    '\\omega': 'omega',
                    '\\Gamma': 'Gamma',
                    '\\Delta': 'Delta',
                    '\\Theta': 'Theta',
                    '\\Lambda': 'Lambda',
                    '\\Xi': 'Xi',
                    '\\Pi': 'Pi',
                    '\\Sigma': 'Sigma',
                    '\\Upsilon': 'Upsilon',
                    '\\Phi': 'Phi',
                    '\\Psi': 'Psi',
                    '\\Omega': 'Omega'
                };
                for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(greekMap)) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
                }

                // ---- 6. 求和与连乘（直接数值计算） ----
                let prev2 = '';
                let maxIter = 80;
                while (maxIter-- > 0 && s !== prev2) {
                    prev2 = s;
                    s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'sum');
                    s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'prod');
                }
                if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(s)) {
                    throw new Error(`转换失败，残留求和/连乘命令: ${s}`);
                }

                // ---- 7. 定积分（使用字符串解析代替正则捕获） ----
                s = processIntegrals(s);

                // ---- 8. 运算符映射 ----
                const opMap = {
                    '\\times': '*',
                    '\\cdot': '*',
                    '\\div': '/',
                    '\\pm': '±',
                    '\\mp': '∓',
                    '\\left(': '(',
                    '\\right)': ')',
                    '\\left[': '[',
                    '\\right]': ']',
                    '\\left\\{': '{',
                    '\\right\\}': '}',
                    '\\left|': 'abs(',
                    '\\right|': ')',
                    '\\left.': '',
                    '\\right.': '',
                    '\\left': '',
                    '\\right': ''
                };
                for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(opMap)) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
                }

                // ---- 9. 阶乘支持 (i! -> factorial(i)) ----
                s = s.replace(/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\s*!/g, 'factorial($1)');

                // ---- 10. 清理孤立的 { } ----
                s = s.replace(/\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, content) => {
                    if (!/[+\-*/^=<>]/.test(content)) return content;
                    return `(${content})`;
                });

                s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
                return s;
            }

            // ---------- 积分处理函数（替代正则） ----------
            function processIntegrals(s) {
                // 循环处理所有积分，直到没有积分标记
                let newS = s;
                let maxLoop = 50;
                while (maxLoop-- > 0) {
                    const idx = newS.indexOf('\\int');
                    if (idx === -1) break;

                    // 找到 \int 后的 _ 和 ^ 以及上下限
                    let rest = newS.slice(idx + 4); // 跳过 '\int'
                    // 去除前导空格
                    rest = rest.trimStart();
                    if (!rest.startsWith('_')) break; // 格式不符，退出
                    rest = rest.slice(1); // 去掉 '_'
                    // 提取下限：可能是 { ... } 或直接数字
                    let lower = '';
                    let lowerEnd = 0;
                    if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                        let braceCount = 1;
                        let i = 1;
                        while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                            if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                            else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                            i++;
                        }
                        lower = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                        lowerEnd = i;
                    } else {
                        // 直接数字或表达式直到 ^ 或空格
                        let i = 0;
                        while (i < rest.length && rest[i] !== '^' && !/\s/.test(rest[i])) i++;
                        lower = rest.slice(0, i);
                        lowerEnd = i;
                    }
                    if (lowerEnd >= rest.length) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(lowerEnd);
                    rest = rest.trimStart();
                    if (!rest.startsWith('^')) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(1);
                    // 提取上限
                    let upper = '';
                    let upperEnd = 0;
                    if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                        let braceCount = 1;
                        let i = 1;
                        while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                            if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                            else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                            i++;
                        }
                        upper = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                        upperEnd = i;
                    } else {
                        let i = 0;
                        while (i < rest.length && !/\s/.test(rest[i]) && rest[i] !== 'd') i++;
                        upper = rest.slice(0, i);
                        upperEnd = i;
                    }
                    if (upperEnd >= rest.length) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(upperEnd);
                    // 现在 rest 是被积表达式 + dx
                    // 找到 dx 的位置
                    const dxIndex = rest.search(/\s*d\s*x\s*/);
                    if (dxIndex === -1) break;
                    let expr = rest.slice(0, dxIndex).trim();
                    // 去除外层花括号
                    if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
                    // 递归转换上下限和表达式
                    const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
                    const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
                    const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);
                    let a, b;
                    try {
                        a = math.evaluate(lowerC);
                        b = math.evaluate(upperC);
                    } catch (_) {
                        const aNum = parseFloat(lowerC);
                        const bNum = parseFloat(upperC);
                        if (!isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
                            a = aNum;
                            b = bNum;
                        } else {
                            break; // 无法求值，退出循环
                        }
                    }
                    if (typeof a !== 'number' || typeof b !== 'number' || !isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)) break;
                    let result;
                    try {
                        result = numericalIntegral(exprC, 'x', a, b);
                        if (!isFinite(result)) break;
                    } catch (_) {
                        break;
                    }
                    // 构造替换字符串：\int...dx 替换为结果
                    const fullMatch = newS.slice(idx, newS.indexOf('dx', idx) + 2);
                    // 但可能 dx 后有空格，需要完整替换
                    // 找到 dx 后的空格，但为了安全，取到 'dx' 后可能还有空格，但我们可以直接用替换
                    // 使用更精确：将整个匹配替换
                    const matchEnd = newS.indexOf('dx', idx) + 2;
                    // 检查后面是否有空格，可以保留，但替换为结果字符串
                    newS = newS.slice(0, idx) + result.toString() + newS.slice(matchEnd);
                    // 注意：如果 dx 后有空格，会被保留？但结果字符串后面可能跟着空格，没关系。
                }
                return newS;
            }

            // ---------- 替换求和/连乘 ----------
            function replaceSumOrProd(s, type) {
                const cmd = type === 'sum' ? 'sum' : 'prod';
                const regex = new RegExp(
                    `\\\\${cmd}\\s*_\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*\\^\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*((?:\\{[^}]*\\})|\\S+)`,
                    'g'
                );

                let newS = s;
                let match;
                while ((match = regex.exec(newS)) !== null) {
                    const fullMatch = match[0];
                    const lower = match[1];
                    const upper = match[2];
                    let expr = match[3];
                    if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) {
                        expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
                    }

                    if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(expr)) {
                        regex.lastIndex = match.index + fullMatch.length;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
                    const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
                    const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);

                    let varName = 'x';
                    let lowerVal = lowerC;
                    const eqIdx = lowerC.indexOf('=');
                    if (eqIdx !== -1) {
                        varName = lowerC.substring(0, eqIdx).trim();
                        lowerVal = lowerC.substring(eqIdx + 1).trim();
                    } else {
                        varName = 'i';
                        lowerVal = lowerC;
                    }

                    const upperVal = upperC;

                    function isNumeric(str) {
                        return /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(str.trim());
                    }

                    let replacement = '';

                    if (isNumeric(lowerVal) && isNumeric(upperVal)) {
                        const lowerNum = parseFloat(lowerVal);
                        const upperNum = parseFloat(upperVal);
                        if (lowerNum <= upperNum) {
                            const exprWithVar = exprC.replace(new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\b`, 'g'), 'x');
                            let result;
                            if (type === 'sum') {
                                result = 0;
                                for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                                    result += math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                                }
                            } else {
                                result = 1;
                                for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                                    result *= math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                                }
                            }
                            replacement = result.toString();
                        } else {
                            replacement = type === 'sum' ? '0' : '1';
                        }
                    } else {
                        replacement = `(function(){ throw new Error("求和/积的上下限必须为数值"); })()`;
                    }

                    newS = newS.replace(fullMatch, replacement);
                    regex.lastIndex = 0;
                    if (!newS.includes(`\\${cmd}`)) break;
                }

                return newS;
            }

            // ---------- 计算 ----------
            function compute(latex) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
                    return { success: false, error: '请输入 LaTeX 公式' };
                }
                try {
                    log('🚀 开始转换...');
                    const mathExpr = latexToMathJS(latex);
                    log('📐 转换后表达式:', mathExpr);
                    if (!mathExpr || mathExpr.trim() === '') {
                        return { success: false, error: '转换后的表达式为空' };
                    }
                    if (mathExpr.includes('throw new Error')) {
                        const errMatch = mathExpr.match(/throw new Error\("([^"]*)"\)/);
                        if (errMatch) return { success: false, error: errMatch[1] };
                    }
                    log('📐 准备计算表达式:', mathExpr);
                    const result = math.evaluate(mathExpr);
                    let displayResult;
                    if (typeof result === 'number') {
                        if (Number.isInteger(result)) displayResult = result.toString();
                        else displayResult = parseFloat(result.toPrecision(12)).toString();
                    } else if (typeof result === 'string') {
                        displayResult = result;
                    } else if (result && typeof result === 'object' && result.toString) {
                        displayResult = result.toString();
                    } else {
                        displayResult = String(result);
                    }
                    return { success: true, result: displayResult, mathExpr };
                } catch (err) {
                    let msg = err.message || '计算错误';
                    if (msg.includes('undefined')) {
                        msg = '表达式包含未定义的变量，请确保所有变量都有数值';
                    }
                    const debugInfo = `转换结果: ${lastConverted || '无'}\n错误: ${err.stack || err.message}`;
                    log('❌ 计算异常:', debugInfo);
                    return { success: false, error: msg + '\n\n' + debugInfo };
                }
            }

            // ---------- 渲染 ----------
            function renderLatex(latex, target) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
                    target.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">等待输入…</span>`;
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    const html = katex.renderToString(latex, {
                        throwOnError: false,
                        displayMode: true,
                        trust: true,
                    });
                    target.innerHTML = html;
                } catch (err) {
                    target.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:16px;">⚠️ 渲染失败: ${err.message}</span>`;
                }
            }

            // ---------- 更新界面 ----------
            function updateAll(latex, doCompute = true) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
                    formulaDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">等待输入…</span>`;
                    resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">等待计算…</span>`;
                    convertedDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">暂无转换结果</span>`;
                    debugCard.style.display = 'none';
                    return;
                }
                renderLatex(latex, formulaDisplay);
                if (doCompute) {
                    const res = compute(latex);
                    if (res.success) {
                        resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#0b1e3a;">${res.result}</span>`;
                        convertedDisplay.textContent = res.mathExpr || '(空)';
                        debugCard.style.display = 'block';
                        lastResult = res.result;
                        lastConverted = res.mathExpr || '';
                    } else {
                        resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="error-msg">❌ ${res.error.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</span>`;
                        convertedDisplay.textContent = lastConverted || '(转换失败)';
                        debugCard.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                } else {
                    try {
                        const mathExpr = latexToMathJS(latex);
                        lastConverted = mathExpr;
                        convertedDisplay.textContent = mathExpr || '(空)';
                        debugCard.style.display = 'block';
                        resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">点击「计算」查看结果</span>`;
                    } catch (err) {
                        convertedDisplay.textContent = `转换错误: ${err.message}`;
                        debugCard.style.display = 'block';
                        resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="error-msg">❌ 转换失败: ${err.message}</span>`;
                    }
                }
            }

            // ---------- 事件绑定 ----------
            function handleCalculate() {
                const latex = latexInput.value.trim();
                lastLatex = latex;
                updateAll(latex, true);
            }

            function handleConvert() {
                const latex = latexInput.value.trim();
                lastLatex = latex;
                updateAll(latex, false);
            }

            function handleClear() {
                latexInput.value = '';
                formulaDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">等待输入…</span>`;
                resultDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">等待计算…</span>`;
                convertedDisplay.innerHTML = `<span class="empty-hint">暂无转换结果</span>`;
                debugCard.style.display = 'none';
                lastLatex = '';
                lastResult = null;
                lastConverted = '';
                latexInput.focus();
            }

            latexInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleCalculate();
                }
            });
            calcBtn.addEventListener('click', handleCalculate);
            convertBtn.addEventListener('click', handleConvert);
            clearBtn.addEventListener('click', handleClear);

            document.querySelectorAll('.example-tag').forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    latexInput.value = this.dataset.example;
                    handleCalculate();
                });
            });

            window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { setTimeout(handleCalculate, 300); });

            window.__test = { latexToMathJS, compute, renderLatex, numericalIntegral };
            console.log('📐 LaTeX 公式计算器已加载 (终极修复版)');
        })();
    </script>
</body>

</html>

FILE: TEST_FUNCION/MATH_CACL/DIST/latex-calculator.js
