/**
 * LaTeX 公式计算器 - 独立核心库
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 支持 LaTeX 公式转 MathJS 表达式、数值计算、KaTeX 渲染
 * @dependencies mathjs (全局 math), katex (全局 katex)
 *
 * @example
 * // 在 HTML 中通过 script 标签引入
 * <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mathjs/11.8.0/math.min.js"></script>
 * <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/KaTeX/0.16.9/katex.min.js"></script>
 * <script src="latex-calculator.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const result = LaTeXCalculator.compute('\\sum_{i=1}^{10} i');
 *   console.log(result); // { success: true, result: '55', mathExpr: '55' }
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // 在 ES Module 中使用
 * import LaTeXCalculator from './latex-calculator.js';
 * const result = LaTeXCalculator.compute('\\int_{0}^{1} {x^2} dx');
 * console.log(result.result); // 0.3333333333333333
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 1. 依赖检查
    // ============================================================
    if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 mathjs 全局对象，请先加载 mathjs 库。');
    }
    if (typeof katex === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 katex 全局对象，请先加载 katex 库。');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 2. 工具函数 - 数值积分（复合辛普森法）
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 使用复合辛普森法计算数值积分
     * @param {string} expr - MathJS 表达式，变量名为 varName
     * @param {string} varName - 积分变量名（默认 'x'）
     * @param {number} a - 积分下限
     * @param {number} b - 积分上限
     * @param {number} [n=1000] - 等分数（自动调整为偶数）
     * @returns {number} 积分近似值
     * @throws {Error} 如果表达式求值失败
     */
    function numericalIntegral(expr, varName, a, b, n) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法进行数值积分');
        }
        if (n === undefined || n < 2) n = 1000;
        if (n % 2 === 1) n++; // 确保为偶数
        const h = (b - a) / n;
        let sum = 0;
        const vars = {};
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            const x = a + i * h;
            vars[varName] = x;
            const y = math.evaluate(expr, vars);
            if (i === 0 || i === n) {
                sum += y;
            } else if (i % 2 === 0) {
                sum += 2 * y;
            } else {
                sum += 4 * y;
            }
        }
        return (sum * h) / 3;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3. 核心转换函数 - LaTeX → MathJS
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 将 LaTeX 公式转换为 MathJS 可计算的表达式字符串
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
     * @throws {Error} 如果转换失败
     */
    function latexToMathJS(latex) {
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') return '';
        let s = latex.trim();
        s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

        // ---- 0. 预处理：移除 \limits 和 \, ----
        s = s.replace(/\\limits/g, '');
        s = s.replace(/\\,/g, ' ');

        // ---- 1. 三角函数等（递归处理参数） ----
        const funcMap = {
            'sin': 'sin',
            'cos': 'cos',
            'tan': 'tan',
            'cot': 'cot',
            'sec': 'sec',
            'csc': 'csc',
            'arcsin': 'asin',
            'arccos': 'acos',
            'arctan': 'atan',
            'log': 'log',
            'ln': 'log',
            'lg': 'log10',
            'exp': 'exp',
            'sinh': 'sinh',
            'cosh': 'cosh',
            'tanh': 'tanh'
        };
        let prevTrig;
        do {
            prevTrig = s;
            for (const [latexCmd, mathFn] of Object.entries(funcMap)) {
                const regex1 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\{([^}]*)\\}', 'g');
                const regex2 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\(([^)]*)\\)', 'g');
                s = s.replace(regex1, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
                s = s.replace(regex2, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
            }
        } while (s !== prevTrig);

        // ---- 2. 分数 ----
        let prev;
        do {
            prev = s;
            s = s.replace(/\\frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, num, den) => {
                return `${latexToMathJS(num)}/${latexToMathJS(den)}`;
            });
        } while (s !== prev);

        // ---- 3. 根号 ----
        do {
            prev = s;
            s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\[([^{}]*)\]\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, n, expr) => {
                return `(${latexToMathJS(expr)})^(1/(${latexToMathJS(n)}))`;
            });
            s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, expr) => {
                return `sqrt(${latexToMathJS(expr)})`;
            });
        } while (s !== prev);

        // ---- 4. 常数替换 ----
        const constMap = {
            '\\pi': 'pi',
            '\\Pi': 'pi',
            '\\infty': 'Infinity',
            '\\e': 'e',
            '\\E': 'e',
            '\\mathrm{e}': 'e',
            '\\mathrm{E}': 'e'
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(constMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 5. 希腊字母 ----
        const greekMap = {
            '\\alpha': 'alpha',
            '\\beta': 'beta',
            '\\gamma': 'gamma',
            '\\delta': 'delta',
            '\\epsilon': 'epsilon',
            '\\zeta': 'zeta',
            '\\eta': 'eta',
            '\\theta': 'theta',
            '\\iota': 'iota',
            '\\kappa': 'kappa',
            '\\lambda': 'lambda',
            '\\mu': 'mu',
            '\\nu': 'nu',
            '\\xi': 'xi',
            '\\omicron': 'omicron',
            '\\pi': 'pi',
            '\\rho': 'rho',
            '\\sigma': 'sigma',
            '\\tau': 'tau',
            '\\upsilon': 'upsilon',
            '\\phi': 'phi',
            '\\chi': 'chi',
            '\\psi': 'psi',
            '\\omega': 'omega',
            '\\Gamma': 'Gamma',
            '\\Delta': 'Delta',
            '\\Theta': 'Theta',
            '\\Lambda': 'Lambda',
            '\\Xi': 'Xi',
            '\\Pi': 'Pi',
            '\\Sigma': 'Sigma',
            '\\Upsilon': 'Upsilon',
            '\\Phi': 'Phi',
            '\\Psi': 'Psi',
            '\\Omega': 'Omega'
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(greekMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 6. 求和与连乘 ----
        let prev2 = '';
        let maxIter = 80;
        while (maxIter-- > 0 && s !== prev2) {
            prev2 = s;
            s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'sum');
            s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'prod');
        }
        if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(s)) {
            throw new Error('转换失败，残留求和/连乘命令: ' + s);
        }

        // ---- 7. 定积分 ----
        s = processIntegrals(s);

        // ---- 8. 运算符映射 ----
        const opMap = {
            '\\times': '*',
            '\\cdot': '*',
            '\\div': '/',
            '\\pm': '±',
            '\\mp': '∓',
            '\\left(': '(',
            '\\right)': ')',
            '\\left[': '[',
            '\\right]': ']',
            '\\left\\{': '{',
            '\\right\\}': '}',
            '\\left|': 'abs(',
            '\\right|': ')',
            '\\left.': '',
            '\\right.': '',
            '\\left': '',
            '\\right': ''
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(opMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 9. 阶乘支持 (i! → factorial(i)) ----
        s = s.replace(/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\s*!/g, 'factorial($1)');

        // ---- 10. 清理孤立的 { } ----
        s = s.replace(/\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, content) => {
            if (!/[+\-*/^=<>]/.test(content)) return content;
            return `(${content})`;
        });

        s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        return s;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 4. 辅助函数 - 处理求和 / 连乘
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 替换 LaTeX 中的 \sum 或 \prod 为数值计算结果
     * @param {string} s - 当前字符串
     * @param {string} type - 'sum' 或 'prod'
     * @returns {string} 替换后的字符串
     */
    function replaceSumOrProd(s, type) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法计算求和/连乘');
        }
        const cmd = type === 'sum' ? 'sum' : 'prod';
        const regex = new RegExp(
            `\\\\${cmd}\\s*_\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*\\^\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*((?:\\{[^}]*\\})|\\S+)`,
            'g'
        );

        let newS = s;
        let match;
        while ((match = regex.exec(newS)) !== null) {
            const fullMatch = match[0];
            const lower = match[1];
            const upper = match[2];
            let expr = match[3];
            if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) {
                expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
            }

            if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(expr)) {
                regex.lastIndex = match.index + fullMatch.length;
                continue;
            }

            const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
            const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
            const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);

            let varName = 'x';
            let lowerVal = lowerC;
            const eqIdx = lowerC.indexOf('=');
            if (eqIdx !== -1) {
                varName = lowerC.substring(0, eqIdx).trim();
                lowerVal = lowerC.substring(eqIdx + 1).trim();
            } else {
                varName = 'i';
                lowerVal = lowerC;
            }

            const upperVal = upperC;

            function isNumeric(str) {
                return /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(str.trim());
            }

            let replacement = '';
            if (isNumeric(lowerVal) && isNumeric(upperVal)) {
                const lowerNum = parseFloat(lowerVal);
                const upperNum = parseFloat(upperVal);
                if (lowerNum <= upperNum) {
                    const exprWithVar = exprC.replace(new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\b`, 'g'), 'x');
                    let result;
                    if (type === 'sum') {
                        result = 0;
                        for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                            result += math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                        }
                    } else {
                        result = 1;
                        for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                            result *= math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                        }
                    }
                    replacement = result.toString();
                } else {
                    replacement = type === 'sum' ? '0' : '1';
                }
            } else {
                replacement = `(function(){ throw new Error("求和/积的上下限必须为数值"); })()`;
            }

            newS = newS.replace(fullMatch, replacement);
            regex.lastIndex = 0;
            if (!newS.includes(`\\${cmd}`)) break;
        }
        return newS;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 5. 辅助函数 - 处理定积分
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 处理 LaTeX 中的 \int 定积分，替换为数值计算结果
     * @param {string} s - 当前字符串
     * @returns {string} 替换后的字符串
     */
    function processIntegrals(s) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法计算定积分');
        }
        let newS = s;
        let maxLoop = 50;
        while (maxLoop-- > 0) {
            const idx = newS.indexOf('\\int');
            if (idx === -1) break;

            let rest = newS.slice(idx + 4);
            rest = rest.trimStart();
            if (!rest.startsWith('_')) break;
            rest = rest.slice(1);

            // 提取下限
            let lower = '';
            let lowerEnd = 0;
            if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                let braceCount = 1;
                let i = 1;
                while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                    if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                    else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                    i++;
                }
                lower = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                lowerEnd = i;
            } else {
                let i = 0;
                while (i < rest.length && rest[i] !== '^' && !/\s/.test(rest[i])) i++;
                lower = rest.slice(0, i);
                lowerEnd = i;
            }
            if (lowerEnd >= rest.length) break;
            rest = rest.slice(lowerEnd);
            rest = rest.trimStart();
            if (!rest.startsWith('^')) break;
            rest = rest.slice(1);

            // 提取上限
            let upper = '';
            let upperEnd = 0;
            if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                let braceCount = 1;
                let i = 1;
                while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                    if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                    else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                    i++;
                }
                upper = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                upperEnd = i;
            } else {
                let i = 0;
                while (i < rest.length && !/\s/.test(rest[i]) && rest[i] !== 'd') i++;
                upper = rest.slice(0, i);
                upperEnd = i;
            }
            if (upperEnd >= rest.length) break;
            rest = rest.slice(upperEnd);

            // 找到 dx 位置
            const dxIndex = rest.search(/\s*d\s*x\s*/);
            if (dxIndex === -1) break;
            let expr = rest.slice(0, dxIndex).trim();
            if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) expr = expr.slice(1, -1);

            const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
            const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
            const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);

            let a, b;
            try {
                a = math.evaluate(lowerC);
                b = math.evaluate(upperC);
            } catch (_) {
                const aNum = parseFloat(lowerC);
                const bNum = parseFloat(upperC);
                if (!isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
                    a = aNum;
                    b = bNum;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (typeof a !== 'number' || typeof b !== 'number' || !isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)) break;

            let result;
            try {
                result = numericalIntegral(exprC, 'x', a, b);
                if (!isFinite(result)) break;
            } catch (_) {
                break;
            }

            const matchEnd = newS.indexOf('dx', idx) + 2;
            newS = newS.slice(0, idx) + result.toString() + newS.slice(matchEnd);
        }
        return newS;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 6. 高层 API - 计算与渲染
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 计算 LaTeX 公式
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @param {Object} [options] - 可选配置
     * @param {number} [options.integralSteps=1000] - 积分等分数
     * @returns {Object} { success: boolean, result?: string, mathExpr?: string, error?: string }
     */
    function compute(latex, options) {
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
            return { success: false, error: '请输入 LaTeX 公式' };
        }
        try {
            const mathExpr = latexToMathJS(latex);
            if (!mathExpr || mathExpr.trim() === '') {
                return { success: false, error: '转换后的表达式为空' };
            }
            if (mathExpr.includes('throw new Error')) {
                const errMatch = mathExpr.match(/throw new Error\("([^"]*)"\)/);
                if (errMatch) return { success: false, error: errMatch[1] };
            }
            if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
                return { success: false, error: 'mathjs 库未加载，无法计算' };
            }
            const result = math.evaluate(mathExpr);
            let displayResult;
            if (typeof result === 'number') {
                if (Number.isInteger(result)) {
                    displayResult = result.toString();
                } else {
                    displayResult = parseFloat(result.toPrecision(12)).toString();
                }
            } else if (typeof result === 'string') {
                displayResult = result;
            } else if (result && typeof result === 'object' && result.toString) {
                displayResult = result.toString();
            } else {
                displayResult = String(result);
            }
            return { success: true, result: displayResult, mathExpr };
        } catch (err) {
            let msg = err.message || '计算错误';
            if (msg.includes('undefined')) {
                msg = '表达式包含未定义的变量，请确保所有变量都有数值';
            }
            return { success: false, error: msg };
        }
    }

    /**
     * 将 LaTeX 转换为 MathJS 表达式字符串（不计算）
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
     * @throws {Error} 如果转换失败
     */
    function parse(latex) {
        return latexToMathJS(latex);
    }

    /**
     * 使用 KaTeX 渲染 LaTeX 到目标 DOM 元素
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @param {HTMLElement} target - 目标 DOM 元素
     * @param {Object} [options] - KaTeX 渲染选项
     * @returns {boolean} 是否渲染成功
     */
    function render(latex, target, options) {
        if (!target) return false;
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
            target.innerHTML = '';
            return false;
        }
        if (typeof katex === 'undefined') {
            target.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#c0392b;">⚠️ KaTeX 库未加载</span>';
            return false;
        }
        try {
            const html = katex.renderToString(latex, Object.assign({
                throwOnError: false,
                displayMode: true,
                trust: true,
            }, options || {}));
            target.innerHTML = html;
            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            target.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:16px;">⚠️ 渲染失败: ${err.message}</span>`;
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 7. 导出
    // ============================================================

    const LaTeXCalculator = {
        /**
         * 计算 LaTeX 公式
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @param {Object} [options] - 可选配置
         * @returns {Object} { success, result, mathExpr } 或 { success, error }
         */
        compute: compute,

        /**
         * 将 LaTeX 转换为 MathJS 表达式字符串（不计算）
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
         */
        parse: parse,

        /**
         * 使用 KaTeX 渲染 LaTeX 到 DOM 元素
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @param {HTMLElement} target - 目标元素
         * @param {Object} [options] - KaTeX 选项
         * @returns {boolean} 是否成功
         */
        render: render,

        /**
         * 数值积分工具函数（复合辛普森法）
         * @param {string} expr - MathJS 表达式
         * @param {string} varName - 变量名
         * @param {number} a - 下限
         * @param {number} b - 上限
         * @param {number} [n=1000] - 等分数
         * @returns {number} 积分值
         */
        integral: numericalIntegral,

        /**
         * 版本号
         */
        version: '1.0.0',

        /**
         * 依赖检查
         */
        deps: {
            mathjs: typeof math !== 'undefined',
            katex: typeof katex !== 'undefined'
        }
    };

    // ---- 浏览器全局 ----
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.LaTeXCalculator = LaTeXCalculator;
    }

    // ---- CommonJS / Node.js ----
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = LaTeXCalculator;
        module.exports.default = LaTeXCalculator;
    }

    // ---- AMD ----
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return LaTeXCalculator;
        });
    }

    // ---- 返回（用于 IIFE 链式调用） ----
    return LaTeXCalculator;

})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis :
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window :
        typeof global !== 'undefined' ? global :
            this);

// =====================================================================
// 1. 配置 Marked + Highlight
// =====================================================================
const hljs = window.hljs;
const renderer = new marked.Renderer();
renderer.code = function (code, language) {
    const lang = language || '';
    let highlighted = '';
    if (hljs && lang && hljs.getLanguage(lang)) {
        try { highlighted = hljs.highlight(code, { language: lang }).value; } catch (_) { }
    }
    if (!highlighted) {
        highlighted = code.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    }
    return `<pre data-lang="${lang}" data-code="${encodeURIComponent(code)}"><button class="run-btn" onclick="runCode(this, \`${encodeURIComponent(code)}\`)">▶ 运行</button><code class="language-${lang} hljs">${highlighted}</code></pre>`;
};
renderer.table = function (header, body) { return `<table><thead>${header}</thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table>`; };
renderer.image = function (href, title, text) { return `<img src="${href}?v=20260819035723" alt="${text || ''}" ${title ? `title="${title}"` : ''} loading="lazy" />`; };
renderer.link = function (href, title, text) { return `<a href="${href}?v=20260819035723" ${title ? `title="${title}"` : ''} target="_blank" rel="noopener">${text}</a>`; };
const markedOptions = { renderer, gfm: true, breaks: true };

// =====================================================================
// 5. 渲染函数
// =====================================================================
function renderMarkdown(text) {
    fullMarkdown = text;
    if (!text.trim()) {
        preview.innerHTML =
            `<div class='empty-hint'>✨ 开始书写 Markdown …<br>支持数学 $E=mc^2$ 和代码块 \`\`\`js<br>单击任意内容开始编辑，点击空白处新增段落</div>`;
        updateStatus();
        allBlocks = [];
        return;
    }
    let html = '';
    try { html = marked.parse(text, markedOptions); } catch (e) {
        preview.innerHTML = `<p style="color:#ef4444;">⚠️ 渲染错误: ${e.message}</p>`;
        updateStatus();
        return;
    }
    const temp = document.createElement('div');
    temp.innerHTML = html;
    processMath(temp);
    preview.innerHTML = temp.innerHTML;
    attachClickListeners();
    updateStatus();
    allBlocks = Array.from(preview.querySelectorAll(
        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'));
    preview.querySelectorAll('pre').forEach(pre => {
        const lang = pre.dataset.lang || '';
        const selector = document.createElement('div');
        selector.className = 'code-lang-selector';
        selector.innerHTML =
            `<select onchange="changeCodeLang(this, event)"><option value="">自动</option>${getLangOptions(lang)}</select>`;
        pre.style.position = 'relative';
        pre.prepend(selector);
    });
}

function getLangOptions(selected) {
    const langs = Object.keys(LANGUAGE_IDS);
    return langs.map(l => `<option value="${l}" ${l === selected ? 'selected' : ''}>${l}</option>`).join('');
}

function changeCodeLang(select, e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const pre = select.closest('pre');
    if (!pre) return;
    const lang = select.value;
    const code = pre.querySelector('code');
    if (code) {
        pre.dataset.lang = lang;
        code.className = `language-${lang} hljs`;
        const text = code.textContent;
        if (hljs && lang && hljs.getLanguage(lang)) {
            try { code.innerHTML = hljs.highlight(text, { language: lang }).value; } catch (_) { }
        }
    }
}

function processMath(node) {
    if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
        let text = node.textContent;
        let newHtml = text.replace(/\$\$(.*?)\$\$/gs, (m, c) => {
            try {
                return katex.renderToString(c.trim(), {
                    displayMode: true, throwOnError: false,
                    trust: true
                });
            } catch (_) { return m; }
        });
        newHtml = newHtml.replace(/\$(.*?)\$/gs, (m, c) => {
            if (m.startsWith('$$')) return m;
            try {
                return katex.renderToString(c.trim(), {
                    displayMode: false, throwOnError: false,
                    trust: true
                });
            } catch (_) { return m; }
        });
        if (newHtml !== text) {
            const span = document.createElement('span');
            span.innerHTML = newHtml;
            node.parentNode.replaceChild(span, node);
            processMath(span);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
        if (node.tagName === 'CODE' || node.tagName === 'PRE' || node.tagName === 'SCRIPT' || node.tagName ===
            'STYLE') return;
        const children = Array.from(node.childNodes);
        for (const child of children) processMath(child);
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// 6. 单击编辑 —— 彻底修复
// =====================================================================
function attachClickListeners() {
    const elements = preview.querySelectorAll(
        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, div, li, th, td');
    elements.forEach(el => {
        el.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
        el.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    });
    preview.removeEventListener('click', handlePreviewClick);
    preview.addEventListener('click', handlePreviewClick);
}

function ensureEditingStateValid() {
    if (editingElement && !document.contains(editingElement)) {
        clearEditingState();
    }
}

// ---------- 修复后的 handleClick ----------
function handleClick(e) {
    ensureEditingStateValid();

    if (e.target.closest('.run-btn') || e.target.closest('.code-lang-selector')) return;
    if (e.target.closest('a')) { e.preventDefault(); }

    let target = e.target.closest(
        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'
    );
    if (!target) {
        const mathParent = e.target.closest('.katex-display, .katex');
        if (mathParent) {
            target = mathParent.closest(
                'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'
            );
        }
    }
    if (target && (target.tagName === 'UL' || target.tagName === 'OL')) {
        const parentLi = target.closest('li');
        if (parentLi) target = parentLi;
    }
    if (!target) return;

    if (editingElement) {
        if (editingBlockElement === target) {
            editingElement.focus();
            editingElement.select();
            return;
        } else {
            saveEdit();
            // 保存后重新获取鼠标下的新元素
            setTimeout(() => {
                const newTarget = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
                if (newTarget) {
                    const block = newTarget.closest(
                        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'
                    );
                    if (block) startEdit(block);
                }
            }, 10);
            return;
        }
    }
    startEdit(target);
}

// ---------- 修复后的 handlePreviewClick ----------
function handlePreviewClick(e) {
    ensureEditingStateValid();

    // 编辑框内点击不触发新建段落
    if (e.target.closest('textarea.edit-source')) {
        return;
    }

    if (e.target.closest(
        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'
    )) {
        return;
    }
    if (e.target.closest('.run-btn') || e.target.closest('.code-lang-selector') ||
        e.target.closest('.context-menu') || e.target.closest('.math-panel') ||
        e.target.closest('.math-builder') || e.target.closest('.suggest-box')) {
        return;
    }

    const x = e.clientX,
        y = e.clientY;
    const elementsAtPoint = document.elementsFromPoint(x, y);
    let block = null;
    for (const el of elementsAtPoint) {
        if (el.matches &&
            el.matches(
                'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'
            )) {
            block = el;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (block) {
        insertNewParagraphAfterBlock(block);
    } else {
        if (editingElement) saveEdit();
        fullMarkdown += '\n\n新段落内容';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allP = preview.querySelectorAll('p');
            const newP = allP[allP.length - 1];
            if (newP) startEdit(newP);
        }, 50);
    }
}

function insertNewParagraphAfterBlock(block) {
    if (editingElement) saveEdit();

    const blockText = block.textContent;
    let insertIndex = fullMarkdown.indexOf(blockText);
    if (insertIndex === -1) {
        fullMarkdown += '\n\n新段落内容';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
        setTimeout(() => {
            const allP = preview.querySelectorAll('p');
            const newP = allP[allP.length - 1];
            if (newP) startEdit(newP);
        }, 50);
        return;
    }
    let endIndex = insertIndex + blockText.length;
    const insertText = '\n\n新段落内容';
    fullMarkdown = fullMarkdown.slice(0, endIndex) + insertText + fullMarkdown.slice(endIndex);
    renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    setTimeout(() => {
        const allP = preview.querySelectorAll('p');
        const newP = allP[allP.length - 1];
        if (newP) startEdit(newP);
    }, 50);
}

// =====================================================================
// 7. 编辑核心 —— 加强事件拦截
// =====================================================================
function startEdit(element) {
    if (editingElement) return;
    let textContent = element.textContent;
    let isCodeBlock = false;
    let codeLang = '';
    if (element.tagName === 'PRE') {
        const codeEl = element.querySelector('code');
        if (codeEl) textContent = codeEl.textContent;
        isCodeBlock = true;
        codeLang = element.dataset.lang || '';
    }
    editingOldText = textContent;
    editingOriginalHTML = element.outerHTML;
    editingBlockElement = element;

    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.className = 'edit-source active';
    textarea.value = textContent;
    const style = getComputedStyle(element);
    textarea.style.width = '100%';
    textarea.style.minHeight = Math.max(40, element.offsetHeight) + 'px';
    textarea.style.fontFamily = style.fontFamily || 'inherit';
    textarea.style.fontSize = style.fontSize || 'inherit';
    textarea.style.lineHeight = style.lineHeight || 'inherit';
    textarea.style.padding = style.padding || '8px 12px';
    textarea.style.border = '2px solid #3b82f6';
    textarea.style.borderRadius = '6px';
    textarea.style.background = '#fafcff';
    textarea.style.outline = 'none';
    textarea.style.resize = 'vertical';
    textarea.style.color = style.color || '#0b1a2f';
    textarea.spellcheck = true;

    // 自动高度
    textarea.style.height = 'auto';
    textarea.style.height = Math.min(textarea.scrollHeight, 300) + 'px';
    textarea.addEventListener('input', function () {
        this.style.height = 'auto';
        this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 300) + 'px';
    });

    // ---------- 关键修复：阻止所有键盘事件冒泡 ----------
    textarea.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止冒泡
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            cancelEdit();
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
            saveEdit();
        } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && !e.shiftKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            saveEdit();
            const idx = allBlocks.indexOf(editingBlockElement);
            if (idx !== -1 && idx < allBlocks.length - 1) {
                setTimeout(() => startEdit(allBlocks[idx + 1]), 10);
            }
        } else if (e.key === 'Tab' && e.shiftKey) {
            e.preventDefault();
            saveEdit();
            const idx = allBlocks.indexOf(editingBlockElement);
            if (idx > 0) {
                setTimeout(() => startEdit(allBlocks[idx - 1]), 10);
            }
        }
    });
    textarea.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    textarea.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

    // ---------- 阻止鼠标事件冒泡 ----------
    textarea.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    textarea.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
    textarea.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

    // 包装层
    let wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.style.position = 'relative';
    if (isCodeBlock) {
        const selector = document.createElement('div');
        selector.className = 'code-lang-selector active';
        selector.style.position = 'absolute';
        selector.style.top = '-30px';
        selector.style.left = '0';
        selector.style.background = '#fff';
        selector.style.border = '1px solid var(--border)';
        selector.style.borderRadius = '4px 4px 0 0';
        selector.style.padding = '2px 8px';
        selector.style.zIndex = '5';
        selector.innerHTML =
            `<select onchange="updateEditingCodeLang(this)"><option value="">自动</option>${getLangOptions(codeLang)}</select>`;
        wrapper.appendChild(selector);
    }
    wrapper.appendChild(textarea);

    try {
        element.replaceWith(wrapper);
    } catch (e) {
        element.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, element);
        element.remove();
    }
    editingElement = textarea;
    textarea.focus();
    textarea.select();

    // 保存失焦 —— 使用 focusout 事件更可靠
    const saveOnFocusOut = function (e) {
        // 如果焦点移出 textarea 且没有进入其内部（比如点击其他元素）
        if (editingElement && !editingElement.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
            saveEdit();
            document.removeEventListener('focusout', saveOnFocusOut);
        }
    };
    textarea.addEventListener('focusout', saveOnFocusOut);

    // 补全功能
    textarea.addEventListener('input', function () { checkSuggestForTextarea(textarea); });
    textarea.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { handleSuggestKeydown(e, textarea); });
}

function updateEditingCodeLang(select) {
    const wrapper = select.closest('div');
    if (!wrapper) return;
    const textarea = wrapper.querySelector('textarea');
    if (textarea) textarea.dataset.editingLang = select.value;
}

function saveEdit() {
    if (!editingElement) return;
    const textarea = editingElement;
    const wrapper = textarea.parentNode;
    if (!wrapper || !wrapper.parentNode) {
        clearEditingState();
        return;
    }

    const newContent = textarea.value;
    const oldText = editingOldText;

    let codeLang = '';
    if (wrapper.tagName === 'DIV' && wrapper.querySelector('.code-lang-selector')) {
        const select = wrapper.querySelector('.code-lang-selector select');
        if (select) codeLang = select.value;
    }

    if (oldText && newContent !== oldText) {
        const escapedOld = oldText.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
        const regex = new RegExp(escapedOld);
        if (fullMarkdown.includes(oldText)) {
            fullMarkdown = fullMarkdown.replace(regex, newContent);
        } else {
            fullMarkdown += '\n' + newContent;
        }
    }

    const parent = wrapper.parentNode;
    if (!parent) {
        clearEditingState();
        return;
    }

    const temp = document.createElement('div');
    temp.innerHTML = editingOriginalHTML;
    const originalElement = temp.firstElementChild;

    if (originalElement) {
        if (originalElement.tagName === 'PRE' && codeLang) {
            originalElement.dataset.lang = codeLang;
            const codeEl = originalElement.querySelector('code');
            if (codeEl) {
                codeEl.className = `language-${codeLang} hljs`;
                if (hljs && codeLang && hljs.getLanguage(codeLang)) {
                    try {
                        codeEl.innerHTML = hljs.highlight(newContent, { language: codeLang }).value;
                    } catch (_) { }
                }
            }
        }
        try {
            parent.replaceChild(originalElement, wrapper);
        } catch (e) {
            parent.insertBefore(originalElement, wrapper);
            wrapper.remove();
        }
    } else {
        const span = document.createElement('span');
        span.textContent = newContent;
        try {
            parent.replaceChild(span, wrapper);
        } catch (e) {
            parent.insertBefore(span, wrapper);
            wrapper.remove();
        }
    }

    clearEditingState();
    renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    allBlocks = Array.from(preview.querySelectorAll(
        'p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote, pre, ul, ol, table, li, th, td'));
}

function cancelEdit() {
    if (!editingElement) return;
    const textarea = editingElement;
    const wrapper = textarea.parentNode;
    if (!wrapper || !wrapper.parentNode) {
        clearEditingState();
        return;
    }
    const parent = wrapper.parentNode;
    const temp = document.createElement('div');
    temp.innerHTML = editingOriginalHTML;
    const originalElement = temp.firstElementChild;
    if (originalElement) {
        try {
            parent.replaceChild(originalElement, wrapper);
        } catch (e) {
            parent.insertBefore(originalElement, wrapper);
            wrapper.remove();
        }
    } else {
        wrapper.remove();
    }
    clearEditingState();
}

function clearEditingState() {
    editingElement = null;
    editingOriginalHTML = '';
    editingOldText = '';
    editingBlockElement = null;
}

// =====================================================================
// 8. 代码运行（保持不变）
// =====================================================================
async function runCode(btn, encodedCode) {
    const code = decodeURIComponent(encodedCode);
    const pre = btn.closest('pre');
    if (!pre) return;
    const lang = pre.dataset.lang || '';

    const oldOutput = pre.nextElementSibling;
    if (oldOutput && oldOutput.classList.contains('code-output')) {
        oldOutput.remove();
    }

    let output = document.createElement('div');
    output.className = 'code-output';
    pre.after(output);
    output.textContent = '⏳ 提交到 Judge0 ...';

    try {
        const languageId = LANGUAGE_IDS[lang];
        if (!languageId) {
            output.textContent = `❌ 不支持的语言: ${lang}`;
            output.classList.add('error');
            return;
        }

        const encodedSource = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(code)));

        const url = `https://ce.judge0.com/submissions?wait=true&base64_encoded=true`;
        const body = {
            source_code: encodedSource,
            language_id: languageId,
            stdin: '',
        };

        const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify(body)
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (!response.ok) {
            const errMsg = data.message || data.error || JSON.stringify(data);
            throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${errMsg}`);
        }
        if (data.error) {
            throw new Error(data.error);
        }

        const decodeBase64 = (str) => {
            if (!str) return '';
            try {
                return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(str)));
            } catch (e) {
                return str;
            }
        };

        let outputText = '';
        const stdout = decodeBase64(data.stdout);
        const stderr = decodeBase64(data.stderr);
        const compile_output = decodeBase64(data.compile_output);
        const message = data.message ? decodeBase64(data.message) : '';

        if (stdout) outputText += stdout;
        if (stderr) {
            if (outputText) outputText += '\n--- stderr ---\n';
            outputText += stderr;
            output.classList.add('error');
        }
        if (compile_output) {
            if (outputText) outputText += '\n--- compile ---\n';
            outputText += compile_output;
            output.classList.add('error');
        }
        if (message) {
            if (outputText) outputText += '\n--- message ---\n';
            outputText += message;
        }

        if (!outputText) {
            const statusName = data.status ? data.status.description : 'Unknown';
            outputText = `✅ 执行成功 (${statusName})`;
        }

        output.textContent = outputText;

    } catch (err) {
        output.textContent = '❌ 错误: ' + err.message;
        output.classList.add('error');
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// 9. 补全系统（完整实现）
// =====================================================================
function checkSuggestForTextarea(textarea) {
    const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
    const text = textarea.value;
    const before = text.substring(0, pos);
    const codeInfo = getCodeBlockInfo(text, pos);
    if (codeInfo.inside) {
        showCodeSuggestForTextarea(codeInfo.lang, before, pos, textarea);
        return;
    }
    const inlineMatch = before.match(/\$([^$]*)$/);
    if (inlineMatch && !before.match(/\$\$[^$]*$/)) {
        const dollarCount = (before.match(/\$/g) || []).length;
        if (dollarCount % 2 === 1) {
            showMathSuggestForTextarea(inlineMatch[1], pos, textarea);
            return;
        }
    }
    const blockMatch = before.match(/\$\$([^$]*)$/);
    if (blockMatch) {
        const dollarCount = (before.match(/\$\$/g) || []).length;
        if (dollarCount % 2 === 1) {
            showMathSuggestForTextarea(blockMatch[1], pos, textarea);
            return;
        }
    }
    hideSuggest();
}

function getCodeBlockInfo(text, pos) {
    const before = text.substring(0, pos);
    const start = before.lastIndexOf('```');
    if (start === -1) return { inside: false };
    const afterStart = text.substring(start + 3);
    const end = afterStart.indexOf('```');
    if (end === -1 || end > pos - start - 3) {
        const langMatch = text.substring(start + 3, start + 3 + 20).match(/^(\w+)/);
        const lang = langMatch ? langMatch[1] : '';
        return { inside: true, lang };
    }
    return { inside: false };
}

function showCodeSuggestForTextarea(lang, beforeText, cursorPos, textarea) {
    const keywords = codeKeywords[lang] || codeKeywords['javascript'] || [];
    const match = beforeText.match(/\b(\w*)$/);
    const prefix = match ? match[1] : '';
    const items = keywords.filter(k => k.startsWith(prefix)).slice(0, 50).map(k => ({
        label: k, type: 'code',
        tag: lang || 'code'
    }));
    if (!items.length) { hideSuggest(); return; }
    showSuggestForTextarea(items, cursorPos, textarea, 'code');
}

function showMathSuggestForTextarea(prefix, cursorPos, textarea) {
    const p = prefix || '';
    const items = mathSymbols.filter(s => s.sym.startsWith(p) || s.desc.includes(p)).slice(0, 45).map(s => ({
        label: s
            .sym, desc: s.desc, type: 'math', tag: 'LaTeX'
    }));
    if (!items.length) { hideSuggest(); return; }
    showSuggestForTextarea(items, cursorPos, textarea, 'math');
}

function showSuggestForTextarea(items, cursorPos, textarea, mode) {
    suggestItems = items;
    suggestIndex = -1;
    suggestMode = mode;
    suggestActive = true;
    const rect = getCursorCoordsForTextarea(textarea);
    if (!rect) { hideSuggest(); return; }
    const box = suggestBox;
    box.innerHTML = '';
    items.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 's-item';
        div.dataset.index = idx;
        const labelSpan = document.createElement('span');
        labelSpan.textContent = item.label;
        div.appendChild(labelSpan);
        if (item.desc) {
            const descSpan = document.createElement('span');
            descSpan.className = 's-desc';
            descSpan.textContent = item.desc;
            div.appendChild(descSpan);
        }
        if (item.tag) {
            const tagSpan = document.createElement('span');
            tagSpan.className = 's-tag';
            tagSpan.textContent = item.tag;
            div.appendChild(tagSpan);
        }
        div.addEventListener('click', () => {
            applySuggestForTextarea(item, textarea);
            hideSuggest();
        });
        div.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            suggestIndex = idx;
            updateSuggestHighlight();
        });
        box.appendChild(div);
    });
    let top = rect.top + rect.height + 4;
    let left = rect.left;
    const boxWidth = 280;
    const boxHeight = Math.min(items.length * 32 + 8, 200);
    if (left + boxWidth > window.innerWidth - 20) left = Math.max(20, window.innerWidth - boxWidth - 20);
    if (top + boxHeight > window.innerHeight - 20) top = Math.max(20, rect.top - boxHeight - 6);
    box.style.left = left + 'px';
    box.style.top = top + 'px';
    box.style.display = 'block';
    box.style.maxHeight = Math.min(200, window.innerHeight - top - 30) + 'px';
}

function getCursorCoordsForTextarea(textarea) {
    const rect = textarea.getBoundingClientRect();
    const start = textarea.selectionStart;
    const text = textarea.value;
    const before = text.substring(0, start);
    const lines = before.split('\n');
    const row = lines.length - 1;
    const col = lines[row].length;
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    const style = getComputedStyle(textarea);
    span.style.cssText =
        `font:${style.font};font-family:${style.fontFamily};font-size:${style.fontSize};letter-spacing:${style.letterSpacing};visibility:hidden;white-space:pre;`;
    span.textContent = lines[row] || '';
    document.body.appendChild(span);
    const width = span.offsetWidth;
    document.body.removeChild(span);
    const lineHeight = parseFloat(style.lineHeight) || parseFloat(style.fontSize) * 1.6;
    const lineSpan = document.createElement('span');
    lineSpan.style.cssText =
        `font:${style.font};font-family:${style.fontFamily};font-size:${style.fontSize};visibility:hidden;white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word;width:${style.width};`;
    lineSpan.textContent = lines.slice(0, -1).join('\n') + (lines.length > 1 ? '\n' : '');
    document.body.appendChild(lineSpan);
    const heightBefore = lineSpan.offsetHeight;
    document.body.removeChild(lineSpan);
    const padLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft) || 0;
    const padTop = parseFloat(style.paddingTop) || 0;
    const borderLeft = parseFloat(style.borderLeftWidth) || 0;
    const scrollTop = textarea.scrollTop;
    return {
        top: rect.top + padTop + borderLeft + heightBefore - scrollTop,
        left: rect.left + padLeft + borderLeft + width,
        height: lineHeight
    };
}

function applySuggestForTextarea(item, textarea) {
    const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
    const text = textarea.value;
    const before = text.substring(0, pos);
    const after = text.substring(pos);
    if (suggestMode === 'code') {
        const wordMatch = before.match(/\b\w*$/);
        if (wordMatch) {
            const start = pos - wordMatch[0].length;
            textarea.value = text.substring(0, start) + item.label + after;
            textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + item.label.length;
        }
    } else if (suggestMode === 'math') {
        let m = before.match(/\$([^$]*)$/);
        if (m) {
            const start = pos - m[1].length;
            const prefix = before.substring(0, start);
            textarea.value = prefix + item.label + after;
            textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + item.label.length;
        } else {
            m = before.match(/\$\$([^$]*)$/);
            if (m) {
                const start = pos - m[1].length;
                const prefix = before.substring(0, start);
                textarea.value = prefix + item.label + after;
                textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + item.label.length;
            }
        }
    }
    hideSuggest();
}

function handleSuggestKeydown(e, textarea) {
    if (suggestActive) {
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault();
            suggestIndex = Math.min(suggestIndex + 1, suggestItems.length - 1);
            updateSuggestHighlight();
            return;
        }
        if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
            e.preventDefault();
            suggestIndex = Math.max(suggestIndex - 1, 0);
            updateSuggestHighlight();
            return;
        }
        if (e.key === 'Tab' || e.key === 'Enter') {
            if (suggestIndex >= 0 && suggestIndex < suggestItems.length) {
                e.preventDefault();
                applySuggestForTextarea(suggestItems[suggestIndex], textarea);
                hideSuggest();
                return;
            }
        }
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            e.preventDefault();
            hideSuggest();
            return;
        }
    }
}

function updateSuggestHighlight() {
    const items = suggestBox.querySelectorAll('.s-item');
    items.forEach((el, idx) => el.classList.toggle('active', idx === suggestIndex));
}

function hideSuggest() {
    suggestBox.style.display = 'none';
    suggestActive = false;
    suggestItems = [];
    suggestIndex = -1;
    suggestMode = '';
}

// 10. 图形化数学构建器（完整实现）
// =====================================================================
const mathTemplates = {
    '分数': { latex: '\\frac{', params: ['分子', '分母'] },
    '根号': { latex: '\\sqrt{', params: ['被开方数'] },
    '指数': { latex: '^{', params: ['指数'] },
    '下标': { latex: '_{', params: ['下标'] },
    '积分': { latex: '\\int_{', params: ['下限', '上限', '被积表达式'] },
    '求和': { latex: '\\sum_{', params: ['下限', '上限', '求和表达式'] },
    '极限': { latex: '\\lim_{', params: ['变量', '趋向值', '表达式'] },
    '矩阵': { latex: '\\begin{bmatrix}', params: ['行数', '列数', '内容'] },
    '行列式': { latex: '\\begin{vmatrix}', params: ['行数', '列数', '内容'] },
    '方程组': { latex: '\\begin{cases}', params: ['方程列表'] },
    '向量': { latex: '\\vec{', params: ['向量名'] },
    '点积': { latex: '\\cdot', params: [] },
    '叉积': { latex: '\\times', params: [] },
    '偏导': { latex: '\\partial', params: [] },
    '梯度': { latex: '\\nabla', params: [] },
    '无穷': { latex: '\\infty', params: [] },
    '约等于': { latex: '\\approx', params: [] },
    '不等于': { latex: '\\neq', params: [] },
    '小于等于': { latex: '\\leq', params: [] },
    '大于等于': { latex: '\\geq', params: [] },
    '圆周率': { latex: '\\pi', params: [] },
    '自然对数底': { latex: 'e', params: [] },
};

function openMathBuilder() {
    mathBuilder.style.display = 'flex';
    const palette = document.getElementById('symbolPalette');
    palette.innerHTML = '';
    Object.keys(mathTemplates).forEach(name => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.textContent = name;
        btn.dataset.template = name;
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => selectMathTemplate(name));
        palette.appendChild(btn);
    });
    const first = Object.keys(mathTemplates)[0];
    if (first) selectMathTemplate(first);
}

function closeMathBuilder() { mathBuilder.style.display = 'none'; }

let currentTemplate = null;

function selectMathTemplate(name) {
    currentTemplate = name;
    const template = mathTemplates[name];
    const paramsDiv = document.getElementById('formulaParams');
    paramsDiv.innerHTML = '';
    template.params.forEach(p => {
        const label = document.createElement('label');
        label.textContent = p + ':';
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'text';
        input.placeholder = p;
        input.dataset.param = p;
        label.appendChild(input);
        paramsDiv.appendChild(label);
    });
    updateFormulaPreview();
}

function updateFormulaPreview() {
    if (!currentTemplate) return;
    const template = mathTemplates[currentTemplate];
    const params = template.params;
    const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('#formulaParams input');
    let latex = template.latex;
    if (params.length === 0) {
        latex = template.latex;
    } else if (params.length === 1) {
        const val = inputs[0] ? inputs[0].value || '?' : '?';
        latex = template.latex + val + '}';
    } else if (params.length === 2) {
        const val1 = inputs[0] ? inputs[0].value || '?' : '?';
        const val2 = inputs[1] ? inputs[1].value || '?' : '?';
        latex = template.latex + val1 + '}^{' + val2 + '}';
    } else if (params.length === 3) {
        const val1 = inputs[0] ? inputs[0].value || '?' : '?';
        const val2 = inputs[1] ? inputs[1].value || '?' : '?';
        const val3 = inputs[2] ? inputs[2].value || '?' : '?';
        if (template.latex.includes('int') || template.latex.includes('sum')) {
            latex = template.latex + val1 + '}^{' + val2 + '} ' + val3;
        } else if (template.latex.includes('lim')) {
            latex = template.latex + val1 + '\\to ' + val2 + '} ' + val3;
        } else {
            latex = template.latex + val1 + '}^{' + val2 + '} ' + val3;
        }
    } else if (params.length >= 4) {
        const rows = parseInt(inputs[0]?.value) || 2;
        const cols = parseInt(inputs[1]?.value) || 2;
        const content = inputs[2]?.value || 'a & b ; c & d';
        const rowsData = content.split(';').map(r => r.trim().split('&').map(c => c.trim()));
        const finalRows = Math.min(rowsData.length, rows);
        const finalCols = Math.min(rowsData[0] ? rowsData[0].length : cols, cols);
        let matrixStr = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < finalRows; i++) {
            const row = rowsData[i] || [];
            const cells = [];
            for (let j = 0; j < finalCols; j++) {
                cells.push(row[j] || '0');
            }
            matrixStr += cells.join(' & ');
            if (i < finalRows - 1) matrixStr += ' \\\\ ';
        }
        latex = template.latex + matrixStr + '\\end{bmatrix}';
    } else {
        latex = template.latex;
    }
    const previewDiv = document.getElementById('formulaPreview');
    try {
        const rendered = katex.renderToString(latex, { displayMode: true, throwOnError: false });
        previewDiv.innerHTML = rendered;
    } catch (e) {
        previewDiv.textContent = 'LaTeX: ' + latex + ' (渲染错误: ' + e.message + ')';
    }
    previewDiv.dataset.latex = latex;
}

document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest('#formulaParams')) updateFormulaPreview();
});

document.getElementById('insertFormulaBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    const previewDiv = document.getElementById('formulaPreview');
    const latex = previewDiv.dataset.latex || '';
    if (latex) {
        if (editingElement) {
            insertAtCursor(editingElement, '$', '$', latex);
        } else {
            fullMarkdown += '\n$$' + latex + '$$';
            renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
        }
        closeMathBuilder();
    }
});

function quickMath(type) {
    const map = { 'frac': '分数', 'sqrt': '根号', 'sum': '求和', 'int': '积分', 'matrix': '矩阵' };
    const name = map[type];
    if (name) {
        openMathBuilder();
        selectMathTemplate(name);
    }
}

function updateStatus() {
    const lines = fullMarkdown.split('\n');
    const wordCount = fullMarkdown.replace(/\s/g, '').length;
    statusInfo.textContent = `行 ${lines.length} · 字 ${wordCount}`;
}

// =====================================================================
// 12. 插入辅助函数（完整）
// =====================================================================
function insertAtCursor(textarea, before, after, customContent) {
    if (!textarea) {
        fullMarkdown += '\n' + before + (customContent || '') + after;
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
        return;
    }
    const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
    const endPos = textarea.selectionEnd;
    const text = textarea.value;
    const selected = text.substring(pos, endPos);
    const content = customContent !== undefined ? customContent : (selected || '内容');
    const insertText = before + content + after;
    textarea.value = text.substring(0, pos) + insertText + text.substring(endPos);
    const newPos = pos + before.length + content.length;
    textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = newPos;
    textarea.focus();
}

function insertWrapAtCursor(before, after) {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, before, after);
    else {
        fullMarkdown += '\n' + before + '内容' + after;
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertListAtCursor(type) {
    if (!editingElement) {
        fullMarkdown += '\n' + (type === 'ul' ? '- ' : '1. ') + '列表项';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
        return;
    }
    const textarea = editingElement;
    const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
    const text = textarea.value;
    const before = text.substring(0, pos);
    const lineStart = before.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1;
    const indent = before.substring(lineStart).match(/^\s*/)[0];
    const insert = type === 'ul' ? indent + '- ' : indent + '1. ';
    textarea.value = text.substring(0, lineStart) + insert + text.substring(lineStart);
    const newPos = lineStart + insert.length;
    textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = newPos;
    textarea.focus();
}

function insertCodeBlockAtCursor() {
    const lang = document.getElementById('codeLangSelect').value || '';
    const code = lang ? '```' + lang + '\n\n```' : '```\n\n```';
    if (editingElement) {
        insertAtCursor(editingElement, code, '');
        const textarea = editingElement;
        const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
        const text = textarea.value;
        const openPos = text.lastIndexOf('```', pos);
        if (openPos !== -1) {
            const afterOpen = text.indexOf('\n', openPos);
            if (afterOpen !== -1) textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = afterOpen + 1;
        }
    } else {
        fullMarkdown += '\n' + code;
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertMathInlineAtCursor() {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, '$', '$');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += ' $ $ ';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertMathBlockAtCursor() {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, '$$\n', '\n$$');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += '\n$$\n\n$$\n';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertTableAtCursor() {
    const table = '\n| 列1 | 列2 | 列3 |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 数据 | 数据 | 数据 |\n';
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, table, '');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += table;
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertLinkAtCursor() {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, '[', '](url)');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += ' [链接文字](url) ';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertImageAtCursor() {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, '![', '](url)');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += ' ![图片描述](url) ';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

function insertHrAtCursor() {
    if (editingElement) insertAtCursor(editingElement, '\n---\n', '');
    else {
        fullMarkdown += '\n---\n';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// 13. 右键菜单（完整）
// =====================================================================
let isRightClick = false;
document.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) {
    isRightClick = (e.button === 2);
});

previewArea.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    showContextMenu(e.clientX, e.clientY);
});

document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (isRightClick) {
        isRightClick = false;
        return;
    }
    if (contextMenu.contains(e.target)) return;
    contextMenu.style.display = 'none';
});

function showContextMenu(x, y) {
    const menu = contextMenu;
    menu.style.display = 'block';
    let left = x,
        top = y;
    if (left + 190 > window.innerWidth) left = window.innerWidth - 200;
    if (top + 300 > window.innerHeight) top = window.innerHeight - 310;
    menu.style.left = left + 'px';
    menu.style.top = top + 'px';
}

contextMenu.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const item = e.target.closest('.menu-item');
    if (!item) return;
    const action = item.dataset.action;
    contextMenu.style.display = 'none';
    if (action === 'cancel-edit') { if (editingElement) cancelEdit(); return; }
    switch (action) {
        case 'h2':
            insertWrapAtCursor('## ', '\n');
            break;
        case 'h3':
            insertWrapAtCursor('### ', '\n');
            break;
        case 'h4':
            insertWrapAtCursor('#### ', '\n');
            break;
        case 'list-ul':
            insertListAtCursor('ul');
            break;
        case 'list-ol':
            insertListAtCursor('ol');
            break;
        case 'quote':
            insertWrapAtCursor('> ', '\n');
            break;
        case 'code-block':
            insertCodeBlockAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'math-inline':
            insertMathInlineAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'math-block':
            insertMathBlockAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'table':
            insertTableAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'link':
            insertLinkAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'image':
            insertImageAtCursor();
            break;
        case 'hr':
            insertHrAtCursor();
            break;
    }
});

// =====================================================================
// 14. 数学符号面板（完整）
// =====================================================================
function toggleMathPanel() {
    if (mathPanel.style.display === 'grid') { mathPanel.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    mathPanel.innerHTML = '';
    const symbols = mathSymbols.slice(0, 120);
    symbols.forEach(s => {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'math-item';
        div.innerHTML = `${s.sym} <span class="desc">${s.desc}</span>`;
        div.title = s.sym;
        div.addEventListener('click', () => {
            insertMathSymbol(s.sym);
            mathPanel.style.display = 'none';
        });
        mathPanel.appendChild(div);
    });
    const rect = previewArea.getBoundingClientRect();
    let left = rect.left + 20,
        top = rect.top + 60;
    if (left + 400 > window.innerWidth) left = window.innerWidth - 420;
    if (top + 300 > window.innerHeight) top = window.innerHeight - 320;
    mathPanel.style.left = left + 'px';
    mathPanel.style.top = top + 'px';
    mathPanel.style.display = 'grid';
}

function insertMathSymbol(symbol) {
    if (editingElement) {
        const textarea = editingElement;
        const pos = textarea.selectionStart;
        const text = textarea.value;
        const before = text.substring(0, pos);
        const after = text.substring(pos);
        const dollarOpen = (before.match(/\$/g) || []).length % 2 === 1;
        const blockOpen = (before.match(/\$\$/g) || []).length % 2 === 1;
        let insertStr = symbol;
        if (!dollarOpen && !blockOpen) {
            const prevChar = before.slice(-1);
            const nextChar = after.charAt(0);
            if (prevChar === '\n' || prevChar === '' || nextChar === '\n' || nextChar === '') {
                insertStr = '$$' + symbol + '$$';
            } else {
                insertStr = '$' + symbol + '$';
            }
        }
        textarea.value = text.substring(0, pos) + insertStr + text.substring(pos);
        textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = pos + insertStr.length;
        textarea.focus();
    } else {
        fullMarkdown += ' ' + symbol + ' ';
        renderMarkdown(fullMarkdown);
    }
}

// 15. 清空 & 导出（完整）
// =====================================================================
function clearAll() {
    if (confirm('确定清空所有内容吗？')) {
        fullMarkdown = '';
        renderMarkdown('');
    }
}

function exportHTML() {
    const content = preview.innerHTML;
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>MD文档</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.css?v=20260819035723">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.9.0/styles/atom-one-light.min.css?v=20260819035723">
<style>
body{max-width:900px;margin:40px auto;padding:20px;font-family:'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.8;background:#f7f9fc;}
.markdown-body{background:#fff;padding:40px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);}
.markdown-body pre{background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;overflow-x:auto;}
.markdown-body code{background:#eef2f6;padding:0.15rem 0.5rem;border-radius:6px;font-family:monospace;}
.markdown-body table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:1rem 0;}
.markdown-body th{background:#1e293b;color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;text-align:left;}
.markdown-body td{padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;}
.markdown-body blockquote{border-left:4px solid #3b82f6;padding:0.4rem 1.2rem;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;}
.katex-display{text-align:center;margin:1.2rem 0;}
</style></head>
<body><div class="markdown-body">${content}</div></body></html>`;
    const blob = new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'export.html';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

    <script>
        (function (global) {
            'use strict';

                FSHARP: 52,

                POSTGRESQL: 56,
                MYSQL: 57,
                RLANG: 80
            };
            var LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP = {
                python: 71,
                python3: 71,
                python2: 70,
                javascript: 63,
                nodejs: 63,
                js: 63,
                bash: 46,
                shell: 46,
                c: 50,
                cpp: 54,
                'c++': 54,
                java: 62,
                ruby: 72,
                rust: 73,
                typescript: 74,
                ts: 74,
                php: 68,
                go: 60,
                swift: 83,
                r: 80,
                perl: 85,

                haskell: 87,
                elixir: 88,
                erlang: 89,
                clojure: 90,
                kotlin: 91,
                scala: 92,
                dart: 93,
                julia: 94,
                crystal: 95,
                zig: 96,
                nim: 97,
                v: 98,
                groovy: 99,
                csharp: 51,
                'c#': 51,
                fsharp: 52,
                vbnet: 53,
                sqlite: 55,
                postgresql: 56,
                mysql: 57,
                rlang: 80
            };

            function resolveLanguage(lang) {
                if (typeof lang === 'number') return lang;
                if (typeof lang === 'string') {
                    var key = lang.toLowerCase().trim();
                    var id = LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP[key];
                    if (id === undefined) throw new Error('未知语言名称 "' + lang + '"');
                    return id;
                }
                throw new Error('language 参数必须是数字或字符串');
            }

            function utf8ToBase64(str) {
                var bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
                var binary = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
                    binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
                }
                return btoa(binary);
            }

            function base64ToUtf8(base64) {
                var binary = atob(base64);
                var bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
                for (var i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
                    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
                }
                return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
            }

            async function executeCode(params) {
                var source_code = params.source_code,
                    language = params.language,
                    stdin = params.stdin || '',
                    cpu_time_limit = params.cpu_time_limit || 5,
                    memory_limit = params.memory_limit || 256000,
                    apiBase = params.apiBase || 'https://ce.judge0.com';

                if (!source_code || source_code.trim() === '') throw new Error('源代码不能为空');

                var language_id = resolveLanguage(language);

                var encoded_source = utf8ToBase64(source_code);
                var encoded_stdin = stdin ? utf8ToBase64(stdin) : '';

                var payload = {
                    language_id: language_id,
                    source_code: encoded_source,
                    stdin: encoded_stdin,
                    cpu_time_limit: cpu_time_limit,
                    memory_limit: memory_limit
                };

                var url = apiBase + '/submissions?base64_encoded=true&wait=true';

                var response = await fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                if (!response.ok) {
                    var errMsg = 'HTTP ' + response.status;
                    try {
                        var errJson = await response.json();
                        errMsg = errJson.error || errMsg;
                    } catch (_) { }
                    throw new Error('API 请求失败: ' + errMsg);
                }

                var result = await response.json();
                if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error);

                if (result.stdout) result.stdout = base64ToUtf8(result.stdout);
                if (result.stderr) result.stderr = base64ToUtf8(result.stderr);
                if (result.compile_output) result.compile_output = base64ToUtf8(result.compile_output);
                if (result.message) result.message = base64ToUtf8(result.message);

                return result;
            }

            var Judge0Executor = {
                version: '1.0.1',
                Language: Language,
                execute: executeCode,
                resolveLanguage: resolveLanguage,
                languageNameMap: LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP,
                utils: { utf8ToBase64: utf8ToBase64, base64ToUtf8: base64ToUtf8 }
            };

            if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.Judge0Executor = Judge0Executor;
            if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
                module.exports = Judge0Executor;
                module.exports.default = Judge0Executor;
            }
            if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) { define([], function () { return Judge0Executor; }); }
            return Judge0Executor;
        })(this);
    </script>
