    <script>
        (function (global) {
            'use strict';
            if (typeof math === 'undefined') console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 mathjs 全局对象');
            if (typeof katex === 'undefined') console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 katex 全局对象');

            function numericalIntegral(expr, varName, a, b, n) {
                if (typeof math === 'undefined') throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载');
                if (n === undefined || n < 2) n = 1000;
                if (n % 2 === 1) n++;
                var h = (b - a) / n,
                    sum = 0,
                    vars = {};
                for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                    var x = a + i * h;
                    vars[varName] = x;
                    var y = math.evaluate(expr, vars);
                    if (i === 0 || i === n) sum += y;
                    else if (i % 2 === 0) sum += 2 * y;
                    else sum += 4 * y;
                }
                return (sum * h) / 3;
            }

            function latexToMathJS(latex) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') return '';
                var s = latex.trim();
                s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').replace(/\\limits/g, '').replace(/\\,/g, ' ');
                var funcMap = {
                    'sin': 'sin',
                    'cos': 'cos',
                    'tan': 'tan',
                    'cot': 'cot',
                    'sec': 'sec',
                    'csc': 'csc',
                    'arcsin': 'asin',
                    'arccos': 'acos',
                    'arctan': 'atan',
                    'log': 'log',
                    'ln': 'log',
                    'lg': 'log10',
                    'exp': 'exp',
                    'sinh': 'sinh',
                    'cosh': 'cosh',
                    'tanh': 'tanh'
                };
                var prevTrig;
                do {
                    prevTrig = s;
                    for (var f in funcMap) {
                        var mfn = funcMap[f];
                        s = s.replace(new RegExp('\\\\' + f + '\\{([^}]*)\\}', 'g'), function (m, args) {
                            return mfn + '(' + latexToMathJS(args) + ')';
                        });
                        s = s.replace(new RegExp('\\\\' + f + '\\(([^)]*)\\)', 'g'), function (m, args) {
                            return mfn + '(' + latexToMathJS(args) + ')';
                        });
                    }
                } while (s !== prevTrig);
                var prev;
                do {
                    prev = s;
                    s = s.replace(/\\frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}/g, function (m, num, den) {
                        return latexToMathJS(num) + '/' + latexToMathJS(den);
                    });
                } while (s !== prev);
                do {
                    prev = s;
                    s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\[([^{}]*)\]\{([^{}]*)\}/g, function (m, n, expr) {
                        return '(' + latexToMathJS(expr) + ')^(1/(' + latexToMathJS(n) + '))';
                    });
                    s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}/g, function (m, expr) {
                        return 'sqrt(' + latexToMathJS(expr) + ')';
                    });
                } while (s !== prev);
                var constMap = {
                    '\\pi': 'pi',
                    '\\Pi': 'pi',
                    '\\infty': 'Infinity',
                    '\\e': 'e',
                    '\\E': 'e',
                    '\\mathrm{e}': 'e',
                    '\\mathrm{E}': 'e'
                };
                for (var ck in constMap) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(ck.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), constMap[ck]);
                }
                var greekMap = {
                    '\\alpha': 'alpha',
                    '\\beta': 'beta',
                    '\\gamma': 'gamma',
                    '\\delta': 'delta',
                    '\\epsilon': 'epsilon',
                    '\\zeta': 'zeta',
                    '\\eta': 'eta',
                    '\\theta': 'theta',
                    '\\iota': 'iota',
                    '\\kappa': 'kappa',
                    '\\lambda': 'lambda',
                    '\\mu': 'mu',
                    '\\nu': 'nu',
                    '\\xi': 'xi',
                    '\\omicron': 'omicron',
                    '\\pi': 'pi',
                    '\\rho': 'rho',
                    '\\sigma': 'sigma',
                    '\\tau': 'tau',
                    '\\upsilon': 'upsilon',
                    '\\phi': 'phi',
                    '\\chi': 'chi',
                    '\\psi': 'psi',
                    '\\omega': 'omega',
                    '\\Gamma': 'Gamma',
                    '\\Delta': 'Delta',
                    '\\Theta': 'Theta',
                    '\\Lambda': 'Lambda',
                    '\\Xi': 'Xi',
                    '\\Pi': 'Pi',
                    '\\Sigma': 'Sigma',
                    '\\Upsilon': 'Upsilon',
                    '\\Phi': 'Phi',
                    '\\Psi': 'Psi',
                    '\\Omega': 'Omega'
                };
                for (var gk in greekMap) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(gk.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), greekMap[gk]);
                }
                var prev2 = '',
                    maxIter = 80;
                while (maxIter-- > 0 && s !== prev2) {
                    prev2 = s;
                    s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'sum');
                    s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'prod');
                }
                if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(s)) throw new Error('转换失败，残留求和/连乘命令: ' + s);
                s = processIntegrals(s);
                var opMap = {
                    '\\times': '*',
                    '\\cdot': '*',
                    '\\div': '/',
                    '\\pm': '±',
                    '\\mp': '∓',
                    '\\left(': '(',
                    '\\right)': ')',
                    '\\left[': '[',
                    '\\right]': ']',
                    '\\left\\{': '{',
                    '\\right\\}': '}',
                    '\\left|': 'abs(',
                    '\\right|': ')',
                    '\\left.': '',
                    '\\right.': '',
                    '\\left': '',
                    '\\right': ''
                };
                for (var ok in opMap) {
                    s = s.replace(new RegExp(ok.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), opMap[ok]);
                }
                s = s.replace(/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\s*!/g, 'factorial($1)');
                s = s.replace(/\{([^{}]*)\}/g, function (m, content) {
                    if (!/[+\-*/^=<>]/.test(content)) return content;
                    return '(' + content + ')';
                });
                return s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
            }

            function replaceSumOrProd(s, type) {
                if (typeof math === 'undefined') throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载');
                var cmd = type === 'sum' ? 'sum' : 'prod';
                var regex = new RegExp('\\\\' + cmd + '\\s*_\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*\\^\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*((?:\\{[^}]*\\})|\\S+)',
                    'g');
                var newS = s,
                    match;
                while ((match = regex.exec(newS)) !== null) {
                    var fullMatch = match[0],
                        lower = match[1],
                        upper = match[2],
                        expr = match[3];
                    if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
                    if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(expr)) { regex.lastIndex = match.index + fullMatch.length; continue; }
                    var lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower),
                        upperC = latexToMathJS(upper),
                        exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);
                    var varName = 'x',
                        lowerVal = lowerC,
                        eqIdx = lowerC.indexOf('=');
                    if (eqIdx !== -1) {
                        varName = lowerC.substring(0, eqIdx).trim();
                        lowerVal = lowerC.substring(eqIdx + 1).trim();
                    } else {
                        varName = 'i';
                        lowerVal = lowerC;
                    }
                    var upperVal = upperC;

                    function isNumeric(str) { return /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(str.trim()); }
                    var replacement = '';
                    if (isNumeric(lowerVal) && isNumeric(upperVal)) {
                        var lowerNum = parseFloat(lowerVal),
                            upperNum = parseFloat(upperVal);
                        if (lowerNum <= upperNum) {
                            var exprWithVar = exprC.replace(new RegExp('\\b' + varName + '\\b', 'g'), 'x');
                            var result;
                            if (type === 'sum') {
                                result = 0;
                                for (var x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                                    result += math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                                }
                            } else {
                                result = 1;
                                for (var x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) { result *= math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x }); }
                            }
                            replacement = result.toString();
                        } else { replacement = type === 'sum' ? '0' : '1'; }
                    } else {
                        replacement = '(function(){ throw new Error("求和/积的上下限必须为数值"); })()';
                    }
                    newS = newS.replace(fullMatch, replacement);
                    regex.lastIndex = 0;
                    if (!newS.includes('\\' + cmd)) break;
                }
                return newS;
            }

            function processIntegrals(s) {
                if (typeof math === 'undefined') throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载');
                var newS = s,
                    maxLoop = 50;
                while (maxLoop-- > 0) {
                    var idx = newS.indexOf('\\int');
                    if (idx === -1) break;
                    var rest = newS.slice(idx + 4).trimStart();
                    if (!rest.startsWith('_')) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(1);
                    var lower = '',
                        lowerEnd = 0;
                    if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                        var braceCount = 1,
                            i2 = 1;
                        while (i2 < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                            if (rest[i2] === '{') braceCount++;
                            else if (rest[i2] === '}') braceCount--;
                            i2++;
                        }
                        lower = rest.slice(1, i2 - 1);
                        lowerEnd = i2;
                    } else {
                        var i2 = 0;
                        while (i2 < rest.length && rest[i2] !== '^' && !/\s/.test(rest[i2])) i2++;
                        lower = rest.slice(0, i2);
                        lowerEnd = i2;
                    }
                    if (lowerEnd >= rest.length) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(lowerEnd).trimStart();
                    if (!rest.startsWith('^')) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(1);
                    var upper = '',
                        upperEnd = 0;
                    if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                        var braceCount = 1,
                            i3 = 1;
                        while (i3 < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                            if (rest[i3] === '{') braceCount++;
                            else if (rest[i3] === '}') braceCount--;
                            i3++;
                        }
                        upper = rest.slice(1, i3 - 1);
                        upperEnd = i3;
                    } else {
                        var i3 = 0;
                        while (i3 < rest.length && !/\s/.test(rest[i3]) && rest[i3] !== 'd') i3++;
                        upper = rest.slice(0, i3);
                        upperEnd = i3;
                    }
                    if (upperEnd >= rest.length) break;
                    rest = rest.slice(upperEnd);
                    var dxIndex = rest.search(/\s*d\s*x\s*/);
                    if (dxIndex === -1) break;
                    var expr = rest.slice(0, dxIndex).trim();
                    if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
                    var lowerC2 = latexToMathJS(lower),
                        upperC2 = latexToMathJS(upper),
                        exprC2 = latexToMathJS(expr);
                    var a, b;
                    try {
                        a = math.evaluate(lowerC2);
                        b = math.evaluate(upperC2);
                    } catch (_) {
                        var aNum = parseFloat(lowerC2),
                            bNum = parseFloat(upperC2);
                        if (!isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
                            a = aNum;
                            b = bNum;
                        } else break;
                    }
                    if (typeof a !== 'number' || typeof b !== 'number' || !isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)) break;
                    var result;
                    try {
                        result = numericalIntegral(exprC2, 'x', a, b);
                        if (!isFinite(result)) break;
                    } catch (_) { break; }
                    var matchEnd = newS.indexOf('dx', idx) + 2;
                    newS = newS.slice(0, idx) + result.toString() + newS.slice(matchEnd);
                }
                return newS;
            }

            function compute(latex, options) {
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') return { success: false, error: '请输入 LaTeX 公式' };
                try {
                    var mathExpr = latexToMathJS(latex);
                    if (!mathExpr || mathExpr.trim() === '') return { success: false, error: '转换后的表达式为空' };
                    if (mathExpr.includes('throw new Error')) {
                        var errMatch = mathExpr.match(/throw new Error\("([^"]*)"\)/);
                        if (errMatch) return { success: false, error: errMatch[1] };
                    }
                    if (typeof math === 'undefined') return { success: false, error: 'mathjs 库未加载，无法计算' };
                    var result = math.evaluate(mathExpr);
                    var displayResult;
                    if (typeof result === 'number') {
                        if (Number.isInteger(result)) {
                            displayResult = result.toString();
                        } else { displayResult = parseFloat(result.toPrecision(12)).toString(); }
                    } else if (typeof result === 'string') { displayResult = result; } else if (result && typeof result ===
                        'object' && result.toString) { displayResult = result.toString(); } else {
                        displayResult = String(result);
                    }
                    return { success: true, result: displayResult, mathExpr: mathExpr };
                } catch (err) {
                    var msg = err.message || '计算错误';
                    if (msg.includes('undefined')) msg = '表达式包含未定义的变量，请确保所有变量都有数值';
                    return { success: false, error: msg };
                }
            }

            function parse(latex) { return latexToMathJS(latex); }

            function render(latex, target, options) {
                if (!target) return false;
                if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') { target.innerHTML = ''; return false; }
                if (typeof katex === 'undefined') {
                    target.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#c0392b;">⚠️ KaTeX 库未加载</span>';
                    return false;
                }
                try {
                    var html = katex.renderToString(latex, Object.assign({
                        throwOnError: false,
                        displayMode: true,
                        trust: true
                    }, options || {}));
                    target.innerHTML = html;
                    return true;
                } catch (err) {
                    target.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:16px;">⚠️ 渲染失败: ' + err.message + '</span>';
                    return false;
                }
            }
            var LaTeXCalculator = {
                compute: compute,
                parse: parse,
                render: render,
                integral: numericalIntegral,
                version: '1.0.0',
                deps: { mathjs: typeof math !== 'undefined', katex: typeof katex !== 'undefined' }
            };
            if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.LaTeXCalculator = LaTeXCalculator;
            if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
                module.exports = LaTeXCalculator;
                module.exports.default = LaTeXCalculator;
            }
            if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) { define([], function () { return LaTeXCalculator; }); }
            return LaTeXCalculator;
        })(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis :
            typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window :
                typeof global !== 'undefined' ? global :
                    this);
    </script>

    <script>
        // ===== 工具函数 =====
        function showHint(text, duration) {
            duration = duration || 4000;
            var old = document.querySelector('.toast-hint');
            if (old) old.remove();
            var hint = document.createElement('div');
            hint.className = 'toast-hint';
            hint.textContent = text;
            document.body.appendChild(hint);
            setTimeout(function () {
                hint.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(function () { hint.remove(); }, 500);
            }, duration);
        }

        function safeExecute(fn, fallbackMsg) {
            fallbackMsg = fallbackMsg || '操作失败，请重试';
            try { return fn(); } catch (e) {
                console.error('操作异常:', e);
                showHint('❌ ' + fallbackMsg);
                return null;
            }
        }

        function waitForMathLive(callback) {
            if (typeof MathfieldElement !== 'undefined') { callback(); return; }
            var check = setInterval(function () {
                if (typeof MathfieldElement !== 'undefined') {
                    clearInterval(check);
                    callback();
                }
            }, 100);
            setTimeout(function () {
                clearInterval(check);
                console.error('MathLive 加载超时');
                showHint('❌ 公式编辑器加载超时，请刷新页面重试。');
            }, 10000);
        }

        var isHotLoading = false;

        function waitForHandsontable(callback) {
            if (typeof Handsontable !== 'undefined') { callback(); return; }
            if (isHotLoading) {
                var check = setInterval(function () {
                    if (typeof Handsontable !== 'undefined') {
                        clearInterval(check);
                        callback();
                    }
                }, 100);
                return;
            }
            isHotLoading = true;
            var attempts = 0;
            var check = setInterval(function () {
                attempts++;
                if (typeof Handsontable !== 'undefined') {
                    clearInterval(check);
                    isHotLoading = false;
                    callback();
                } else if (attempts > 60) {
                    clearInterval(check);
                    isHotLoading = false;
                    console.error('Handsontable 加载超时');
                    showHint('❌ 表格编辑器加载超时，请刷新页面重试。');
                }
            }, 150);
        }

        // ===== 默认内容 =====
        var DEFAULT_CONTENT = [
            '# 欢迎使用 Vditor + Judge0代码执行 + LaTeX 计算🎉',
            '## 🧮 LaTeX 公式',
            '单击公式块会出现 **✎ 编辑** 和 **🧮 计算** 按钮。',
            '$$\\sum_{i=1}^{10} i = 55$$',
            '$$\\int_{0}^{1} {x^2} dx$$',
            '## ▶ 代码块',
            '单击代码块会出现 **▶ 执行** 按钮。',
            '```python',
            'print("Hello, Judge0!")',
            'for i in range(3):',
            '    print(i)',
            '```',
            '```javascript',
            'console.log("Hello from JS");',
            '```',
            '## 📊 表格',
            '单击表格块出现 **✎ 编辑** 按钮。',
            '<div data-type="html-block" data-block="0" class="vditor-ir__node">',
            '  <pre class="vditor-ir__marker--pre vditor-ir__marker"><code data-type="html-block">&lt;table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;"&gt;',
            '&lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr style="background:#e6f0fa;"&gt;',
            '&lt;th style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;width:100px;"&gt;项目&lt;/th&gt;',

        /**
         * 在 Vditor 工具栏中注入"导出 HTML"按钮
         */
        function injectExportButton() {
            var check = setInterval(function () {
                var toolbar = document.querySelector('.vditor-toolbar');
                if (!toolbar) return;
                if (document.getElementById('export-html-btn')) { clearInterval(check); return; }

                var items = toolbar.querySelectorAll('.vditor-toolbar__item');
                var targetItem = null;
                for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
                    var btn = items[i].querySelector('[data-name="more"]');
                    if (btn) { targetItem = items[i]; break; }
                }
                if (!targetItem) {
                    targetItem = items[items.length - 1];
                }

                var container = document.createElement('span');
                container.className = 'vditor-toolbar__item vditor-toolbar__item--custom';
                container.style.cssText =
                    'display:inline-flex !important; align-items:center !important; height:100% !important; margin-left:4px;';

                var btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.id = 'export-html-btn';
                btn.className = 'btn-icon';
                btn.setAttribute('title', '导出 HTML（样式参考第二个文件）');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', '导出 HTML');
                btn.style.cssText =
                    'background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;padding:0 6px;line-height:1;color:#24292f;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;';
                btn.textContent = '📤';

                btn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    exportToHTML();
                });

                container.appendChild(btn);
                targetItem.parentNode.insertBefore(container, targetItem);

                clearInterval(check);
                console.log('✅ 导出按钮已注入');
            }, 500);
            setTimeout(function () { clearInterval(check); }, 8000);
        }

        /**
        * 清理 Vditor 渲染的 HTML（唯一正确版本）
        * - 表格：提取预览区的 <table>，移除编辑器标记
        * - 公式：提取 $$...$$ 纯文本，供 KaTeX auto-render 渲染
        * - 其他：保留渲染后的 HTML，移除 Vditor 专用类名
        */
        function cleanVditorHtml(html) {
            var div = document.createElement('div');
            div.innerHTML = html;

            // ---------- 1. 处理所有 data-type="html-block" 块 ----------
            var blocks = div.querySelectorAll('[data-type="html-block"]');
            blocks.forEach(function (block) {
                var preview = block.querySelector('.vditor-ir__preview');
                var marker = block.querySelector('.vditor-ir__marker code');

                if (preview) {
                    var table = preview.querySelector('table');
                    if (table) {
                        var newTable = table.cloneNode(true);
                        block.parentNode.replaceChild(newTable, block);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (marker) {
                    var text = marker.textContent || '';
                    var match = text.match(/\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/);
                    if (match) {
                        var latex = match[1].trim();
                        var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                        var textNode = document.createTextNode('\\(' + latex + '\\)');
                        wrapper.appendChild(textNode);
                        block.parentNode.replaceChild(wrapper, block);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (preview) {
                    var content = preview.innerHTML;
                    var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
                    wrapper.innerHTML = content;
                    block.parentNode.replaceChild(wrapper, block);
                } else {
                    var textContent = block.textContent || '';
                    var textNode = document.createTextNode(textContent);
                    block.parentNode.replaceChild(textNode, block);
                }
            });

            // ---------- 2. 处理直接渲染的公式（div.language-math / language-latex） ----------
            var mathDivs = div.querySelectorAll('div.language-math, div.language-latex');
            mathDivs.forEach(function (el) {
                var latex = el.textContent || '';
                latex = latex.trim();
                if (latex) {
                    var wrapper = document.createElement('div'); // 块级容器，保证换行
                    var textNode = document.createTextNode('\\(' + latex + '\\)');
                    wrapper.appendChild(textNode);
                    el.parentNode.replaceChild(wrapper, el);
                } else {
                    el.remove();
                }
            });

            // ---------- 3. 清理所有元素上的 Vditor 类名和数据属性 ----------
            var allElements = div.querySelectorAll('*');
            allElements.forEach(function (el) {
                var classes = el.className ? el.className.split(' ') : [];
                var filtered = classes.filter(function (cls) {
                    return cls && !cls.startsWith('vditor-ir__') && !cls.startsWith('vditor-');
                });
                el.className = filtered.join(' ');
                el.removeAttribute('data-type');
                el.removeAttribute('data-block');
                el.removeAttribute('data-render');
                // 不设置 el.textContent
            });

            // ---------- 4. 清理空段落 ----------
            var emptyP = div.querySelectorAll('p:empty');
            emptyP.forEach(function (p) { p.remove(); });

            // ---------- 5. 修复表格空单元格 ----------
            var tds = div.querySelectorAll('td, th');
            tds.forEach(function (td) {
                if (td.innerHTML.trim() === '') td.innerHTML = '&nbsp;';
            });

            return div.innerHTML;
        }

                            errorCallback: function(msg, err) {

        function downloadFile(content, filename) {
            var blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 10000);
        }

        /**
         * 导出当前编辑器内容为 HTML 文件（样式完美复刻第二个文件 + 公式渲染修复）
         */
        // ================================================================
        // 导出为 HTML（完全修复公式渲染）
        // ================================================================

        function exportToHTML() {
            showHint('⏳ 正在生成 HTML...');
            var html = vditor.getHTML();
            if (!html || html.trim() === '') {
                showHint('⚠️ 编辑器内容为空，无法导出');
                return;
            }
            html = cleanVditorHtml(html);
            var fullHTML = generateHTMLTemplate(html);
            downloadFile(fullHTML, 'export.html');
            showHint('✅ HTML 导出成功');
        }
        /**
         * 生成导出的 HTML 模板（与您的正常文件风格一致）
         */
        function generateHTMLTemplate(content) {
            return `<!DOCTYPE html>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

        integrity="sha384-n8MVd4RsNIU0tAv4ct0nTaAbDJwPJzDEaqSD1odI+WdtXRGWt2kTvGFasHpSy3SV" crossorigin="anonymous">
    <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.js?v=20260824053441"
        integrity="sha384-XjKyOOlGwcjNTAIQHIpgOno0Hl1YQqzUOEleOLALmuqehneUG+vnGctmUb0ZY0l8" crossorigin="anonymous"><\/script>

        integrity="sha384-+VBxd3r6XgURycqtZ117nYw44OOcIax56Z4dCRWbxyPt0Koah1uHoK0o4+/RRE05" crossorigin="anonymous"

        function downloadFile(content, filename) {
            var blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
            var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            var a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = filename;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 10000);
        }

        // ================================================================

        // ===== 光标位置管理 =====
        var savedCursorRange = null;

        function saveCursorPosition() {
            try {
                var selection = window.getSelection();
                if (selection && selection.rangeCount > 0) {
                    savedCursorRange = selection.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
                } else { savedCursorRange = null; }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('保存光标位置失败:', e);
                savedCursorRange = null;
            }
        }

        function restoreCursorPosition() {
            try {
                if (savedCursorRange) {
                    var selection = window.getSelection();
                    selection.removeAllRanges();
                    selection.addRange(savedCursorRange);
                    savedCursorRange = null;
                    return true;
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('恢复光标位置失败:', e); }
            return false;
        }

        // ===== 浮动按钮管理 =====
        var currentFloatContainer = null;
        var currentEditTarget = null;
        var currentEditType = null;
        var _isEditingTable = false;

        function showFloatActions(targetEl, actions) {
            console.log('[showFloatActions] 开始显示浮动按钮，目标元素:', targetEl);
            hideFloatActions();

            targetEl.style.position = 'relative';
            targetEl.style.overflow = 'visible';
            targetEl.classList.add('editable-object');
            targetEl.classList.add('edit-hover');

            var container = document.createElement('div');
            container.className = 'edit-float-container';
            container.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            container.style.zIndex = '9999';

            actions.forEach(function (action) {
                var btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'edit-float-btn' + (action.className ? ' ' + action.className : '');
                btn.innerHTML = action.icon;
                btn.title = action.title;
                btn.setAttribute('aria-label', action.title);
                var handlerFn = function (e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    console.log('[FloatBtn] 按钮被点击，执行操作:', action.title);
                    action.handler(targetEl);
                    hideFloatActions();
                };
                btn.addEventListener('mousedown', handlerFn);
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', handlerFn, { passive: false });
                container.appendChild(btn);
                console.log('[showFloatActions] 添加按钮:', action.title);
            });

            targetEl.appendChild(container);
            console.log('[showFloatActions] 容器已添加到目标元素，子节点数:', container.children.length);

            void container.offsetHeight;
            void targetEl.offsetHeight;

            currentFloatContainer = container;
            currentEditTarget = targetEl;
            currentEditType = 'custom';

            setTimeout(function () {
                var rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                console.log('[showFloatActions] 按钮位置:', rect);
            }, 50);

            document.addEventListener('click', handleOutsideClick, true);
            document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKey);
        }

        function hideFloatActions() {
            console.log('[hideFloatActions] 被调用');
            if (currentFloatContainer && currentFloatContainer.parentNode) {
                currentFloatContainer.parentNode.removeChild(currentFloatContainer);
                console.log('[hideFloatActions] 已移除浮动容器');
            }
            if (currentEditTarget) {
                currentEditTarget.classList.remove('edit-hover');
                if (currentEditTarget.style.overflow === 'visible') {
                    currentEditTarget.style.overflow = '';
                }
            }
            currentFloatContainer = null;
            currentEditTarget = null;
            currentEditType = null;
            document.removeEventListener('click', handleOutsideClick, true);
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKey);
        }

        function handleOutsideClick(e) {
            var target = e.target;
            console.log('[handleOutsideClick] 点击目标:', target);
            if (currentEditTarget && !currentEditTarget.contains(target) &&
                !(currentFloatContainer && currentFloatContainer.contains(target))) {
                console.log('[handleOutsideClick] 点击外部，隐藏浮动按钮');
                hideFloatActions();
            } else {
                console.log('[handleOutsideClick] 点击内部，不隐藏');
            }
        }

        function handleEscapeKey(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { hideFloatActions(); }
        }

        // ===== 检测元素类型 =====

        function findTableBlockFromElement(el) {
            var block = el.closest('div[data-type="html-block"]');
            if (block && block.closest('.vditor-ir')) return block;
            return null;
        }

        function findFormulaBlockFromElement(el) {
            var node = el;
            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                if (node.textContent.trim() === '') return null;
                node = node.parentElement;
            } else if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return null;
            while (node && node !== document.body) {
                var classList = node.classList;
                if (classList) {
                    if (classList.contains('vditor-ir') || classList.contains('vditor-reset') || classList.contains(
                        'vditor-preview')) return null;
                }
                if (node.closest && node.closest('[data-type="html-block"]')) return null;
                var tag = node.tagName;
                if (['P', 'DIV', 'LI', 'BLOCKQUOTE', 'SECTION', 'ARTICLE', 'TD', 'TH'].includes(tag)) {
                    var textContent = node.textContent || '';
                    if (/\$\$[^$]+\$\$/.test(textContent)) return node;
                }
                node = node.parentElement;
            }
            return null;
        }

        function findCodeBlockFromElement(el) {
            var node = el;
            if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                if (node.textContent.trim() === '') return null;
                node = node.parentElement;
            } else if (node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) return null;

            var pre = node;
            if (!pre) return null;

            var ir = pre.closest('.vditor-ir');
            if (!ir) return null;

            var code = pre;
            if (!code) return null;

            if (code.getAttribute('data-type') === 'html-block') return null;

            var hasLanguageClass = code.className && /\blanguage-[\w-]+\b/.test(code.className);
            var isMarkerPre = pre.classList.contains('vditor-ir__marker--pre');

            if (pre.classList.contains('vditor-ir__preview') && !hasLanguageClass) {
                return null;
            }

            if (pre.classList.contains('vditor-ir__marker') && !isMarkerPre) {
                return null;
            }

            if (!isMarkerPre && !hasLanguageClass) {
                return null;
            }

            var codeText = code.textContent || '';
            if (codeText.trim() === '') return null;

            if ((/\$\$/.test(codeText) || /\\[a-zA-Z]+/.test(codeText)) && !hasLanguageClass) {
                return null;
            }

            return pre;
        }

        // ===== 单击编辑触发 =====
        function bindClickEdit() {
            var checkEditor = setInterval(function () {
                var editor = getEditorElement();
                if (editor) {
                    clearInterval(checkEditor);
                    editor.addEventListener('click', handleClickEdit);
                    console.log('✅ 单击编辑事件已绑定');
                }
            }, 300);
            setTimeout(function () { clearInterval(checkEditor); }, 5000);
        }

        function getEditorElement() {
            return document.querySelector('.vditor-ir');
        }

        function handleClickEdit(e) {
            if (_isEditingTable) return;
            var target = e.target;
            console.log('[handleClickEdit] 点击目标:', target);

            if (target.closest('.edit-float-container')) return;
            var editor = getEditorElement();
            if (!editor || !editor.contains(target)) {
                if (currentEditTarget) hideFloatActions();
                return;
            }
            if (target === editor || target === editor.parentNode) {
                if (currentEditTarget) hideFloatActions();
                return;
            }

            var isValid = false;
            if (target.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
                if (target.textContent.trim() !== '') isValid = true;
            } else if (target.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                var classList = target.classList;
                if (classList && (classList.contains('vditor-ir') || classList.contains('vditor-reset') || classList
                    .contains('vditor-preview'))) {
                    isValid = false;
                } else {
                    var text = target.textContent || '';
                    if (text.trim() !== '' || target.querySelector('img, table, [data-type="html-block"]')) {
                        isValid = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!isValid) {
                if (currentEditTarget) hideFloatActions();
                return;
            }

            var tableBlock = findTableBlockFromElement(target);
            if (tableBlock) {
                console.log('[handleClickEdit] ✅ 识别为表格');
                if (currentEditTarget === tableBlock) return;
                hideFloatActions();
                showFloatActions(tableBlock, [{
                    icon: '✎',
                    title: '编辑表格',
                    className: '',
                    handler: function (el) { handleEditTable(el); }
                }]);
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }

            var formulaBlock = findFormulaBlockFromElement(target);
            console.log('[handleClickEdit] 公式块检测结果:', formulaBlock);
            if (formulaBlock) {
                console.log('[handleClickEdit] ✅ 识别为公式');
                if (currentEditTarget === formulaBlock) return;
                hideFloatActions();
                showFloatActions(formulaBlock, [{
                    icon: '✎',
                    title: '编辑公式',
                    className: '',
                    handler: function (el) { handleEditFormula(el); }
                }, {
                    icon: '🧮',
                    title: '计算公式',
                    className: 'calc',
                    handler: function (el) { handleCalculateFormulaFromBlock(el); }
                }]);
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }

            var codeBlock = findCodeBlockFromElement(target);
            console.log('[handleClickEdit] 代码块检测结果:', codeBlock);
            if (codeBlock) {
                console.log('[handleClickEdit] ✅ 识别为代码块，即将显示浮动按钮');
                if (currentEditTarget === codeBlock) return;
                hideFloatActions();
                showFloatActions(codeBlock, [{
                    icon: '▶',
                    title: '执行代码',
                    className: 'exec',
                    handler: function (el) {
                        console.log('[handler] ▶ 执行代码被调用');
                        handleExecuteCodeFromBlock(el);
                    }
                }]);
                e.preventDefault();
                return;
            }

            if (currentEditTarget) {
                hideFloatActions();
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  公式编辑（精确提取）——保持不变
        // ================================================================
        function handleEditFormula(blockEl) {
            console.log('[handleEditFormula] 开始处理，blockEl:', blockEl);

            var irNode = blockEl.closest ? blockEl.closest('.vditor-ir__node') : null;
            if (irNode) {
                blockEl = irNode;
                console.log('[handleEditFormula] 已定位到 vditor-ir__node:', blockEl);
            } else {
                if (blockEl.classList && blockEl.classList.contains('vditor-ir__node')) {
                    console.log('[handleEditFormula] blockEl 本身就是 vditor-ir__node');
                } else {
                    console.warn('[handleEditFormula] 未找到 vditor-ir__node，尝试使用 blockEl 自身');
                }
            }

            var marker = blockEl.querySelector('.vditor-ir__marker--pre, .vditor-ir__marker');
            var fullText = '';
            var formulaText = '';
            var sourceElement = null;
            var codeElement = null;

            if (marker) {
                console.log('[handleEditFormula] 找到 marker:', marker);
                var code = marker.querySelector('code');
                if (code) {
                    codeElement = code;
                    fullText = code.textContent || '';
                    console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从 marker code 获取文本:', fullText);
                    var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                    var match = regex.exec(fullText);
                    if (match) {
                        formulaText = match[1].trim();
                        sourceElement = code;
                    } else {
                        var trimmed = fullText.trim();
                        if (trimmed && !trimmed.includes('$$')) {
                            formulaText = trimmed;
                            sourceElement = code;
                            console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从 code 提取裸 LaTeX:', formulaText);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!formulaText) {
                    fullText = marker.textContent || '';
                    console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从 marker.textContent 获取文本:', fullText);
                    var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                    var match = regex.exec(fullText);
                    if (match) {
                        formulaText = match[1].trim();
                        sourceElement = marker;
                        console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从 marker.textContent 提取公式:', formulaText);
                    } else {
                        var trimmed = fullText.trim();
                        if (trimmed && !trimmed.includes('$$')) {
                            formulaText = trimmed;
                            sourceElement = marker;
                            console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从 marker.textContent 提取裸 LaTeX:', formulaText);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                console.warn('[handleEditFormula] 未找到 marker，尝试从 blockEl 中查找 code');
                var candidates = blockEl.querySelectorAll('code, pre');
                for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                    var el = candidates[i];
                    var text = el.textContent || '';
                    if (/\$\$[^$]+\$\$/.test(text)) {
                        var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                        var match = regex.exec(text);
                        if (match) {
                            formulaText = match[1].trim();
                            sourceElement = el;
                            if (el.tagName === 'CODE') codeElement = el;
                            console.log('[handleEditFormula] 从候选元素提取公式:', formulaText);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!formulaText) {
                showHint('⚠️ 未找到公式内容，请确保公式以 $$...$$ 包裹');
                return;
            }

            formulaText = formulaText.replace(/^\$\$/, '').replace(/\$\$$/, '').trim();
            formulaText = formulaText.replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
            console.log('[handleEditFormula] 最终提取的公式内容:', formulaText);

            var editElement = {
                block: blockEl,
                marker: marker,
                codeElement: codeElement,
                sourceElement: sourceElement,
                formulaText: formulaText,
                fullText: fullText
            };

            waitForMathLive(function () {
                editingFormulaElement = editElement;
                document.getElementById('panel-insert').textContent = '更新公式';
                document.querySelector('#panel-title small').textContent = '· 编辑已有公式';
                openFormulaPanel(formulaText);
                hideFloatActions();
            });
        }

        // ===== 计算公式 =====
        function handleCalculateFormulaFromBlock(blockEl) {
            var node = blockEl.closest ? blockEl.closest('.vditor-ir__node') : null;
            if (node) blockEl = node;

            var marker = blockEl.querySelector('.vditor-ir__marker--pre, .vditor-ir__marker');
            var formulaText = '';
            var sourceElement = null;

            if (marker) {
                var code = marker.querySelector('code');
                if (code) {
                    var fullText = code.textContent || '';
                    var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                    var match = regex.exec(fullText);
                    if (match) {
                        formulaText = match[1].trim();
                        sourceElement = code;
                    } else {
                        var trimmed = fullText.trim();
                        if (trimmed && !trimmed.includes('$$')) {
                            formulaText = trimmed;
                            sourceElement = code;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!formulaText) {
                    var fullText = marker.textContent || '';
                    var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                    var match = regex.exec(fullText);
                    if (match) {
                        formulaText = match[1].trim();
                        sourceElement = marker;
                    } else {
                        var trimmed = fullText.trim();
                        if (trimmed && !trimmed.includes('$$')) {
                            formulaText = trimmed;
                            sourceElement = marker;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                var candidates = blockEl.querySelectorAll('code, pre');
                for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                    var el = candidates[i];
                    var text = el.textContent || '';
                    var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
                    var match = regex.exec(text);
                    if (match) {
                        formulaText = match[1].trim();
                        sourceElement = el;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!formulaText) {
                showHint('⚠️ 未找到公式内容，请确保公式以 $$...$$ 包裹');
                return;
            }

            formulaText = formulaText.replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');

            try {
                var result = LaTeXCalculator.compute(formulaText);
                if (result.success) {
                    var content = '';
                    content += '<div class="label-tag">✅ 计算结果</div>';
                    content += '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-weight:500;color:#1a7f37;">' + result.result + '</div>';
                    if (result.mathExpr) {
                        content += '<div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">MathJS 表达式：<code>' + result
                            .mathExpr + '</code></div>';
                    }
                    try {
                        if (typeof katex !== 'undefined') {
                            var katexHtml = katex.renderToString(formulaText, {
                                throwOnError: false,
                                displayMode: true,
                                trust: true
                            });
                            content += '<div style="margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #e9ecf0;">';
                            content += '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;margin-bottom:6px;">📐 公式预览</div>';
                            content += '<div class="latex-output">' + katexHtml + '</div>';
                            content += '</div>';
                        }
                    } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
                    showResult('🧮 LaTeX 计算结果', content, false);
                } else {
                    var errContent = '<div class="error-text">❌ ' + (result.error || '计算失败') + '</div>';
                    showResult('🧮 LaTeX 计算失败', errContent, true);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                var errContent = '<div class="error-text">❌ 计算异常: ' + (e.message || '未知错误') + '</div>';
                showResult('🧮 LaTeX 计算失败', errContent, true);
            }
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  表格解析（保持不变）
        // ================================================================
        function parseTableFromHtmlBlock(htmlBlockElement) {
            var preview = htmlBlockElement.querySelector('.vditor-ir__preview');
            var table = preview ? preview.querySelector('table') : null;

            if (!table) {
                var code = htmlBlockElement.querySelector('code[data-type="html-block"]');
                if (code) {
                    var htmlStr = code.textContent || '';
                    try {
                        var parser = new DOMParser();
                        var doc = parser.parseFromString(htmlStr, 'text/html');
                        table = doc.querySelector('table');
                    } catch (_) {
                        htmlStr = htmlStr
                            .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
                            .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
                            .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
                            .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
                            .replace(/&#39;/g, "'");
                        var match = htmlStr.match(/<table[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/table>/i);
                        if (match) {
                            var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
                            tempDiv.innerHTML = match[0];
                            table = tempDiv.querySelector('table');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!table) {
                console.warn('[parseTableFromHtmlBlock] 未找到表格，htmlBlockElement:', htmlBlockElement);
                return null;
            }

            var rows = table.querySelectorAll('tr');
            var data = [],
                colHeaders = [],
                rowHeaders = false,
                colWidths = [],
                rowHeights = [],
                bgColors = {};

            var thead = table.querySelector('thead');
            if (thead) {
                var headerRow = thead.querySelector('tr');
                if (headerRow) {
                    var ths = headerRow.querySelectorAll('th');
                    var firstTh = ths[0];
                    if (firstTh && firstTh.textContent.trim() === '#') {
                        rowHeaders = true;
                        ths.forEach(function (th, idx) {
                            if (idx === 0) return;
                            colHeaders.push(th.textContent.trim());
                            var w = th.style.width;
                            if (w) colWidths.push(parseInt(w) || 100);
                            else colWidths.push(100);
                        });
                    } else {
                        ths.forEach(function (th) {
                            colHeaders.push(th.textContent.trim());
                            var w = th.style.width;
                            if (w) colWidths.push(parseInt(w) || 100);
                            else colWidths.push(100);
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            var tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
            if (tbody) {
                var trs = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
                trs.forEach(function (tr, rowIdx) {
                    var tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
                    var rowData = [];
                    tds.forEach(function (td, colIdx) {
                        if (rowHeaders && colIdx === 0) return;
                        var val = td.textContent.trim();
                        rowData.push(val);
                        var bg = td.style.backgroundColor;
                        var key = rowIdx + ',' + (colIdx - (rowHeaders ? 1 : 0));
                        if (bg) bgColors[key] = bg;
                        else bgColors[key] = '#ffffff';
                        var h = tr.style.height || td.style.height;
                        if (h && !rowHeights[rowIdx]) rowHeights[rowIdx] = parseInt(h) || 32;
                    });
                    if (!rowHeights[rowIdx]) rowHeights[rowIdx] = 32;
                    data.push(rowData);
                });
            }

            if (data.length === 0) {
                return {
                    data: [
                        []
                    ],
                    colHeaders: [],
                    rowHeaders: false,
                    colWidths: [],
                    rowHeights: [],
                    bgColors: {}
                };
            }

            var cols = data[0]?.length || 0;
            while (colWidths.length < cols) colWidths.push(100);
            while (colHeaders.length < cols) colHeaders.push(String.fromCharCode(65 + colHeaders.length));

            return {
                data: data,
                colHeaders: colHeaders,
                rowHeaders: rowHeaders,
                colWidths: colWidths,
                rowHeights: rowHeights,
                bgColors: bgColors
            };
        }

        function handleEditTable(rectOrElement) {
            console.log('[handleEditTable] 开始处理，输入参数:', rectOrElement);

            var targetTable = null;
            var sourceBlock = null;

            if (rectOrElement instanceof DOMRect || (rectOrElement && typeof rectOrElement.left === 'number')) {
                var rect = rectOrElement;
                var centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
                var centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

                var element = document.elementFromPoint(centerX, centerY);

                while (element) {
                    if (element.nodeType === 1 && element.tagName === 'TABLE') {
                        var style = window.getComputedStyle(element);
                        if (style.display !== 'none' && style.visibility !== 'hidden' && style.opacity !== '0') {
                            targetTable = element;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    element = element.parentElement;
                }

                if (!targetTable) {
                    console.warn('未找到有效的表格元素，坐标:', centerX, centerY);
                    showHint('⚠️ 未找到有效的表格元素');
                    return;
                }

                sourceBlock = targetTable.closest('[data-type="html-block"]') || targetTable.closest('.vditor-ir__node');

            } else if (rectOrElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
                var el = rectOrElement;
                targetTable = el.querySelector('table') || (el.tagName === 'TABLE' ? el : null);
                sourceBlock = el.closest('[data-type="html-block"]') || el.closest('.vditor-ir__node');
                if (!targetTable && el.getAttribute('data-type') === 'html-block') {
                    var preview = el.querySelector('.vditor-ir__preview');
                    if (preview) targetTable = preview.querySelector('table');
                    if (!targetTable) {
                        var code = el.querySelector('code[data-type="html-block"]');
                        if (code) {
                            var htmlStr = code.textContent || '';
                            try {
                                var parser = new DOMParser();
                                var doc = parser.parseFromString(htmlStr, 'text/html');
                                targetTable = doc.querySelector('table');
                            } catch (_) { }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                console.error('[handleEditTable] 无效的参数类型');
                return;
            }

            if (!sourceBlock && targetTable) {
                var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
                tempDiv.className = 'vditor-ir__node';
                tempDiv.setAttribute('data-type', 'html-block');
                var pre = document.createElement('pre');
                pre.className = 'vditor-ir__preview';
                pre.appendChild(targetTable.cloneNode(true));
                tempDiv.appendChild(pre);
                sourceBlock = tempDiv;
            }

            var parsedData = null;
            if (sourceBlock) {
                parsedData = parseTableFromHtmlBlock(sourceBlock);
            }

            if (!parsedData) {
                console.error('[handleEditTable] 表格解析失败，sourceBlock:', sourceBlock);
                showHint('⚠️ 表格解析失败，请尝试切换到"所见即所得"模式后重试');
                _isEditingTable = false;
                try {
                    if (typeof vditor.renderPreview === 'function') vditor.renderPreview();
                    if (vditor.preview && typeof vditor.preview.render === 'function') vditor.preview.render();
                } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
                return;
            }

            hideFloatActions();
            _isEditingTable = true;
            editingTableElement = sourceBlock;

            waitForHandsontable(function () {
                document.getElementById('table-insert').textContent = '✅ 更新表格';
                document.querySelector('#table-modal-title small').textContent = '· 编辑已有表格';
                openTableEditor(parsedData, sourceBlock);
            });
        }

        // ===== 执行代码 =====
        function handleExecuteCodeFromBlock(blockEl) {
            function getDisplayName(lang) {
                var map = {
                    'python': 'Python',
                    'python3': 'Python 3',
                    'python2': 'Python 2',
                    'javascript': 'JavaScript',
                    'nodejs': 'Node.js',
                    'js': 'JavaScript',
                    'bash': 'Bash',
                    'shell': 'Shell',
                    'c': 'C',
                    'cpp': 'C++',
                    'c++': 'C++',
                    'java': 'Java',
                    'ruby': 'Ruby',
                    'rust': 'Rust',
                    'typescript': 'TypeScript',
                    'ts': 'TypeScript',
                    'php': 'PHP',
                    'go': 'Go',
                    'swift': 'Swift',
                    'r': 'R',
                    'perl': 'Perl',
                    'lua': 'Lua',
                    'haskell': 'Haskell',
                    'elixir': 'Elixir',
                    'erlang': 'Erlang',
                    'clojure': 'Clojure',
                    'kotlin': 'Kotlin',
                    'scala': 'Scala',
                    'dart': 'Dart',
                    'julia': 'Julia',
                    'crystal': 'Crystal',
                    'zig': 'Zig',
                    'nim': 'Nim',
                    'v': 'V',
                    'groovy': 'Groovy',
                    'csharp': 'C#',
                    'c#': 'C#',
                    'fsharp': 'F#',
                    'vbnet': 'VB.NET',
                    'sqlite': 'SQLite',
                    'postgresql': 'PostgreSQL',
                    'mysql': 'MySQL',
                    'rlang': 'R'
                };
                return map[lang] || lang.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lang.slice(1);
            }

            var codeEl = blockEl;
            var code = codeEl ? codeEl.textContent || '' : '';
            code = code.replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '').trim();
            code = code.replace(/[▶]/, '').trim();

            if (!code.trim()) {
                showHint('⚠️ 代码块为空，无法执行');
                return;
            }

            var langSelect = document.getElementById('exec-lang-select');
            var languageId = 71;
            var langName = 'Python 3';
            var autoDetected = false;

            if (codeEl) {
                var classNames = codeEl.className || '';
                var match = classNames.match(/\blanguage-([\w-]+)/);
                if (match) {
                    var detectedLang = match[1];
                    try {
                        var id = Judge0Executor.resolveLanguage(detectedLang);
                        languageId = id;
                        autoDetected = true;
                        langName = getDisplayName(detectedLang);
                        if (langSelect) {
                            for (var i = 0; i < langSelect.options.length; i++) {
                                if (parseInt(langSelect.options[i].value) === id) {
                                    langSelect.value = String(id);
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        if (langSelect) {
                            languageId = parseInt(langSelect.value);
                            var selectedOption = langSelect.options[langSelect.selectedIndex];
                            langName = selectedOption ? selectedOption.text : 'Python 3';
                        }
                        autoDetected = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (langSelect) {
                        languageId = parseInt(langSelect.value);
                        var selectedOption = langSelect.options[langSelect.selectedIndex];
                        langName = selectedOption ? selectedOption.text : 'Python 3';
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (langSelect) {
                    languageId = parseInt(langSelect.value);
                    var selectedOption = langSelect.options[langSelect.selectedIndex];
                    langName = selectedOption ? selectedOption.text : 'Python 3';
                }
            }

            var modeLabel = autoDetected ? '🔍 自动识别' : '🛠️ 手动选择';
            var statusMsg = '⏳ 正在执行代码（' + modeLabel + ': ' + langName + '，ID: ' + languageId + '）';
            var content = '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;margin-bottom:8px;">' + statusMsg + '</div>';
            content += '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#57606a;">';
            content += '<span style="display:inline-block;width:20px;height:20px;border:3px solid #d0d7de;border-top-color:#0969da;border-radius:50%;animation:spin 0.8s linear infinite;"></span>';
            content += '<span>⏳ 正在执行...</span>';
            content += '</div><style>@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}</style>';
            showResult('▶ 代码执行中', content, false);

            Judge0Executor.execute({
                source_code: code,
                language: languageId,
                cpu_time_limit: 5,
                memory_limit: 256000,
                apiBase: 'https://ce.judge0.com'
            }).then(function (result) {
                var output = '';
                var modeLabelResult = autoDetected ? '🔍 自动识别' : '🛠️ 手动选择';
                output += '<div class="label-tag">✅ 执行完成</div>';
                output += '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">' + modeLabelResult +
                    '：<strong>' + langName + '</strong>（ID: ' + languageId + '）</div>';

                if (result.stdout) {
                    output += '<div style="margin-top:10px;"><div style="font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px;">📤 标准输出</div><div class="code-block">' +
                        escapeHtml(result.stdout) + '</div></div>';
                }
                if (result.stderr) {
                    output += '<div style="margin-top:10px;"><div style="font-weight:500;color:#cf222e;margin-bottom:4px;">⚠️ 错误输出</div><div class="code-block" style="border-color:#cf222e;background:#ffebe9;">' +
                        escapeHtml(result.stderr) + '</div></div>';
                }
                if (result.compile_output) {
                    output += '<div style="margin-top:10px;"><div style="font-weight:500;color:#cf222e;margin-bottom:4px;">🔧 编译输出</div><div class="code-block" style="border-color:#cf222e;background:#ffebe9;">' +
                        escapeHtml(result.compile_output) + '</div></div>';
                }
                if (result.status && result.status.description) {
                    output += '<div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">状态：' + result.status
                        .description + '</div>';
                }
                if (result.time) {
                    output += '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">⏱️ 耗时：' + result.time + 's</div>';
                }
                if (result.memory) {
                    output += '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">💾 内存：' + result.memory + ' KB</div>';
                }
                if (!result.stdout && !result.stderr && !result.compile_output) {
                    output += '<div style="margin-top:10px;color:#57606a;">（无输出）</div>';
                }
                output += '<div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #e9ecf0;">';
                output += '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;margin-bottom:4px;">📄 源代码</div>';
                output += '<div class="code-block" style="font-size:13px;">' + escapeHtml(code) + '</div>';
                output += '</div>';

                showResult('▶ 代码执行结果', output, false);
            }).catch(function (err) {
                var errContent = '<div class="error-text">❌ 执行失败: ' + escapeHtml(err.message || '未知错误') +
                    '</div>';
                errContent += '<div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;color:#57606a;">语言：' + langName +
                    '（ID: ' + languageId + '）</div>';
                errContent += '<div style="margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #e9ecf0;">';
                errContent += '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#57606a;margin-bottom:4px;">📄 源代码</div>';
                errContent += '<div class="code-block" style="font-size:13px;">' + escapeHtml(code) + '</div>';
                errContent += '</div>';
                showResult('▶ 代码执行失败', errContent, true);
            });
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
        }

        var resultOverlay = document.getElementById('result-overlay');
        var resultBody = document.getElementById('result-body');
        var resultTitle = document.getElementById('result-title');

        function showResult(title, content, isError) {
            resultTitle.textContent = title || '📋 结果';
            resultBody.innerHTML = content;
            resultOverlay.classList.add('open');
        }

            resultOverlay.classList.remove('open');

            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeResult();
