            if (e.key === 'Escape' && resultOverlay.classList.contains('open')) { closeResult(); }
        });

        // ================================================================
        //  公式面板
        // ================================================================
        var panel = document.getElementById('formula-panel');
        var container = document.getElementById('math-field-container');
        var mathField = null;
        var isPanelOpen = false;
        var editingFormulaElement = null;

        function setupGlobalKeyboard() {
            if (window.mathVirtualKeyboard) { window.mathVirtualKeyboard.container = document.body; } else {
                var check = setInterval(function () {
                    if (window.mathVirtualKeyboard) {
                        window.mathVirtualKeyboard.container = document.body;
                        clearInterval(check);
                    }
                }, 100);
            }
        }
        if (typeof MathfieldElement !== 'undefined') { MathfieldElement.locale = 'zh-CN'; }

        function createMathField() {
            if (mathField) { mathField.value = ''; return mathField; }
            mathField = new MathfieldElement();
            mathField.virtualKeyboardPolicy = 'on';
            mathField.virtualKeyboardMode = 'overlay';
            mathField.smartFence = true;
            mathField.readonly = false;
            mathField.customLatexMacros = { 'exponentialE': '\\mathrm{e}', 'imaginaryI': '\\mathrm{i}' };
            mathField.style.cssText =
                'position:relative;z-index:10000;width:100%;min-height:48px;font-size:20px;touch-action:manipulation;outline:none;';
            mathField.value = '';
            mathField.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    insertFormulaFromPanel();
                    return;
                }
                if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    closeFormulaPanel(true);
                    return;
                }
            }, true);
            mathField.addEventListener('input', function () {
                var latex = mathField.getValue();
                var newLatex = latex.replace(/\\exponentialE/g, '\\mathrm{e}').replace(/\\imaginaryI/g,
                    '\\mathrm{i}');
                if (newLatex !== latex) mathField.value = newLatex;
            });
            mathField.addEventListener('virtual-keyboard-show', function () {
                if (isPanelOpen) setTimeout(function () {
                    adjustPanelForKeyboard(true);
                }, 50);
            });
            mathField.addEventListener('virtual-keyboard-hide', function () {
                if (isPanelOpen)
                    adjustPanelForKeyboard(false);
            });
            mathField.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (isPanelOpen) {
                    panel.classList.add(
                        'keyboard-visible');
                    setTimeout(function () { mathField.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }); },
                        150);
                }
            });
            mathField.addEventListener('blur', function () { panel.classList.remove('keyboard-visible'); });
            container.appendChild(mathField);
            return mathField;
        }

        function adjustPanelForKeyboard(show) {
            if (!isPanelOpen) return;
            if (show) {
                var keyboardHeight = 0;
                if (window.visualViewport) {
                    var vh = window.visualViewport.height,
                        wh = window.innerHeight;
                    keyboardHeight = Math.max(0, wh - vh);
                }
                if (!keyboardHeight) { keyboardHeight = window.innerHeight < 600 ? 280 : 340; }
                var safeBottom = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(
                    '--safe-area-inset-bottom')) || 0;
                var totalOffset = keyboardHeight + safeBottom + 8;
                panel.style.bottom = totalOffset + 'px';
                panel.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - ' + totalOffset + 'px - 16px)';
                panel.style.overflowY = 'auto';
            } else {
                panel.style.bottom = '0px';
                panel.style.maxHeight = '70vh';
                panel.style.overflowY = 'auto';
            }
        }
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', function () {
                if (isPanelOpen) adjustPanelForKeyboard(
                    true);
            });
        }

        function getCursorBlockInfo() {
            var sel = window.getSelection();
            if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0) return null;
            var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
            var node = range.startContainer;
            var block = node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE ? node.parentElement : node;
            while (block && !['P', 'DIV', 'LI', 'BLOCKQUOTE', 'SECTION', 'ARTICLE', 'TD', 'TH'].includes(block.tagName)) {
                block = block.parentElement;
            }
            if (!block) return null;
            var walker = document.createTreeWalker(block, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
            var textNodes = [],
                total = 0,
                current = walker.nextNode();
            while (current) {
                textNodes.push(current);
                total += current.textContent.length;
                current = walker.nextNode();
            }
            var offset = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < textNodes.length; i++) {
                var tn = textNodes[i];
                if (tn === range.startContainer) { offset += range.startOffset; break; } else {
                    offset += tn.textContent.length;
                }
            }
            return { block: block, text: block.textContent, offset: offset, textNodes: textNodes, html: block.innerHTML };
        }

        function getFormulaBlockContent() {
            var info = getCursorBlockInfo();
            if (!info) return null;
            var text = info.text,
                offset = info.offset,
                block = info.block,
                html = info.html;
            var regex = /\$\$([^$]*)\$\$/g;
            var match;
            while ((match = regex.exec(text)) !== null) {
                var start = match.index,
                    end = match.index + match[0].length;
                if (offset >= start && offset <= end) {
                    return {
                        inner: match[1],
                        start: start,
                        end: end,
                        fullText: text,
                        block: block,
                        html: html
                    };
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        function openFormulaPanel(initialLatex) {
            initialLatex = initialLatex || '';
            var mf = createMathField();
            mf.value = initialLatex;
            saveCursorPosition();
            panel.classList.add('open');
            isPanelOpen = true;
            panel.style.bottom = '0px';
            panel.style.maxHeight = '70vh';
            setTimeout(function () {
                mf.focus();
                if (mf.showVirtualKeyboard) mf.showVirtualKeyboard();
                else if (window.mathVirtualKeyboard && window.mathVirtualKeyboard.show) window.mathVirtualKeyboard
                    .show();
                setupGlobalKeyboard();
                setTimeout(function () { if (mf.showVirtualKeyboard) mf.showVirtualKeyboard(); }, 200);
            }, 400);
            setTimeout(function () { panel.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }); }, 300);
        }

        function closeFormulaPanel(cancel) {
            cancel = (cancel !== undefined) ? cancel : true;
            panel.classList.remove('open');
            panel.classList.remove('keyboard-visible');
            isPanelOpen = false;
            panel.style.bottom = '0px';
            panel.style.maxHeight = '70vh';
            if (mathField) {
                mathField.blur();
                if (mathField.hideVirtualKeyboard) mathField.hideVirtualKeyboard();
                else if (window.mathVirtualKeyboard && window.mathVirtualKeyboard.hide) window.mathVirtualKeyboard
                    .hide();
                mathField.value = '';
            }
            if (editingFormulaElement) { editingFormulaElement = null; }
            setTimeout(function () {
                vditor.focus();
                if (cancel) restoreCursorPosition();
            }, 150);
        }

        // ================================================================
        //  插入 / 更新公式
        // ================================================================
        function insertFormulaFromPanel() {
            if (!mathField) return;
            var latex = mathField.getValue('latex-expanded');
            if (!latex || !latex.trim()) {
                closeFormulaPanel(true);
                return;
            }
            var trimmedLatex = latex.trim();
            trimmedLatex = trimmedLatex.replace(/^\$\$/, '').replace(/\$\$$/, '').trim();

            if (editingFormulaElement) {
                var block = editingFormulaElement.block;
                if (!block) {
                    showHint('⚠️ 找不到公式块，更新失败');
                    closeFormulaPanel(true);
                    return;
                }

                var blockId = block.getAttribute('data-block') || '0';
                var newFormula = '$$' + trimmedLatex + '$$';

                var previewHtml = '';
                try {
                    if (typeof katex !== 'undefined') {
                        previewHtml = katex.renderToString(trimmedLatex, {
                            throwOnError: false,
                            displayMode: true,
                            trust: true
                        });
                    } else {
                        previewHtml = '<span style="color:red;">⚠️ KaTeX 未加载</span>';
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    previewHtml = '<span style="color:red;">⚠️ 渲染错误: ' + e.message + '</span>';
                }

                var newBlockHtml = '<div data-type="html-block" data-block="' + blockId +
                    '" class="vditor-ir__node">\n' +
                    '  <pre class="vditor-ir__marker--pre vditor-ir__marker"><code data-type="html-block">' +
                    newFormula + '</code></pre>\n' +
                    '  <pre class="vditor-ir__preview" data-render="1">' + previewHtml + '</pre>\n' +
                    '</div>';

                var parent = block.parentNode;
                var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
                tempDiv.innerHTML = newBlockHtml;
                var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                while (tempDiv.firstChild) {
                    fragment.appendChild(tempDiv.firstChild);
                }
                parent.replaceChild(fragment, block);

                var editor = getEditorElement();
                if (editor) {
                    editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
                }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    try {
                        if (typeof vditor.renderPreview === 'function') vditor.renderPreview();
                        if (vditor.preview && typeof vditor.preview.render === 'function') vditor.preview.render();
                    } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
                }, 100);

                editingFormulaElement = null;
                closeFormulaPanel(false);
                vditor.focus();
                showHint('✅ 公式已更新');
                return;
            }

            closeFormulaPanel(false);
            setTimeout(function () {
                var restored = restoreCursorPosition();
                if (!restored) {
                    vditor.insertValue('$$' + trimmedLatex + '$$');
                    vditor.focus();
                    return;
                }
                var blockInfo = getFormulaBlockContent();
                if (blockInfo) {
                    var block = blockInfo.block,
                        start = blockInfo.start,
                        end = blockInfo.end,
                        fullText = blockInfo.fullText;
                    var newText = fullText.substring(0, start + 2) + trimmedLatex + fullText.substring(end - 2);
                    while (block.firstChild) {
                        block.removeChild(block.firstChild);
                    }
                    block.appendChild(document.createTextNode(newText));
                    var sel = window.getSelection(),
                        range = document.createRange(),
                        pos = Math.min(start + 2 + trimmedLatex.length, newText.length);
                    if (block.firstChild) {
                        range.setStart(block.firstChild, pos);
                        range.collapse(true);
                        sel.removeAllRanges();
                        sel.addRange(range);
                    }
                } else {
                    vditor.insertValue('$$' + trimmedLatex + '$$');
                }
                vditor.focus();
            }, 100);
        }
        document.getElementById('panel-insert').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            safeExecute(insertFormulaFromPanel, '插入/更新公式失败');
        });
        document.getElementById('panel-cancel').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            closeFormulaPanel(true);
        });
        document.getElementById('panel-close').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            closeFormulaPanel(true);
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (!isPanelOpen) return;
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                safeExecute(insertFormulaFromPanel, '插入/更新公式失败');
                return;
            }
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                closeFormulaPanel(true);
                return;
            }
        }, true);

        var resizeTimer = null;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                if (isPanelOpen && mathField) {
                    if (mathField.shadowRoot && mathField.shadowRoot.querySelector('[part="virtual-keyboard"]')) {
                        adjustPanelForKeyboard(true);
                    } else { adjustPanelForKeyboard(false); }
                }
            }, 350);
        });
        window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (isPanelOpen && mathField) {
                    mathField.blur();
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        mathField.focus();
                        if (mathField.showVirtualKeyboard) mathField
                            .showVirtualKeyboard();
                    }, 350);
                }
            }, 500);
        });

        // ================================================================
        //  高级表格编辑器
        // ================================================================
        var hotInstance = null;
        var hotContainer = document.getElementById('handsontable-container');
        var lastSelectedRange = null;
        var tableMarkerElement = null;
        var isHotDestroying = false;
        var editingTableElement = null;
        var isTableEditorOpening = false;
        var _tableInited = false;

        function insertTablePlaceholder() {
            removeTablePlaceholder();
            var editor = getEditorElement();
            if (!editor) { vditor.insertValue('⬡'); return; }
            var sel = window.getSelection(),
                range = sel.rangeCount > 0 ? sel.getRangeAt(0) : null;
            if (!range || !editor.contains(range.commonAncestorContainer)) {
                range = document.createRange();
                range.selectNodeContents(editor);
                range.collapse(false);
                sel.removeAllRanges();
                sel.addRange(range);
            }
            var marker = document.createElement('span');
            marker.dataset.marker = 'table';
            marker.textContent = '⬡';
            marker.style.display = 'inline';
            marker.style.background = 'transparent';
            try {
                range.deleteContents();
                range.insertNode(marker);
                range.setStartAfter(marker);
                range.collapse(true);
                sel.removeAllRanges();
                sel.addRange(range);
                tableMarkerElement = marker;
            } catch (e) {
                vditor.insertValue('⬡');
                setTimeout(function () {
                    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(editor, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
                    var node;
                    while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
                        if (node.textContent === '⬡') {
                            var span = document.createElement('span');
                            span.dataset.marker = 'table';
                            span.style.display = 'inline';
                            span.style.background = 'transparent';
                            span.textContent = '⬡';
                            node.parentNode.replaceChild(span, node);
                            tableMarkerElement = span;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }, 50);
            }
        }

        function removeTablePlaceholder() {
            if (tableMarkerElement && tableMarkerElement.parentNode) {
                tableMarkerElement.parentNode.removeChild(tableMarkerElement);
                tableMarkerElement = null;
            }
        }

        function openTableEditor(editData, editElement) {
            if (isTableEditorOpening) {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!isTableEditorOpening) {
                        openTableEditor(
                            editData, editElement);
                    } else { showHint('⏳ 编辑器正在打开，请稍候...'); }
                }, 300);
                return;
            }
            isTableEditorOpening = true;
            var overlay = document.getElementById('table-modal-overlay');

            function releaseLock() {
                isTableEditorOpening = false;
                _isEditingTable = false;
            }
            try {
                if (overlay.classList.contains('open')) {
                    if (editData && editElement) {
                        editingTableElement = editElement;
                        document.getElementById('table-insert').textContent = '✅ 更新表格';
                        document.querySelector('#table-modal-title small').textContent = '· 编辑已有表格';
                        var data = editData.data,
                            colHeaders = editData.colHeaders,
                            rowHeaders = editData.rowHeaders,
                            colWidths = editData.colWidths,
                            rowHeights = editData.rowHeights,
                            bgColors = editData.bgColors;
                        document.getElementById('ht-rows').value = data.length || 5;
                        document.getElementById('ht-cols').value = (data[0]?.length) || 5;
                        if (colWidths.length > 0) document.getElementById('ht-colwidth').value = colWidths[0] || 100;
                        if (rowHeights.length > 0) document.getElementById('ht-rowheight').value = rowHeights[0] || 32;
                        window._editTableData = {
                            data: data,
                            colHeaders: colHeaders,
                            rowHeaders: rowHeaders,
                            colWidths: colWidths,
                            rowHeights: rowHeights,
                            bgColors: bgColors
                        };
                        if (hotInstance) { updateHandsontableData(); } else { initHandsontable(); }
                        overlay.classList.add('open');
                        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                        releaseLock();
                        return;
                    } else { closeTableEditor(); }
                }
                waitForHandsontable(function () {
                    try {
                        if (document.getElementById('table-modal-overlay').classList.contains('open')) {
                            if (editData && editElement) {
                                editingTableElement = editElement;
                                document.getElementById('table-insert').textContent = '✅ 更新表格';
                                document.querySelector('#table-modal-title small').textContent = '· 编辑已有表格';
                                window._editTableData = {
                                    data: editData.data,
                                    colHeaders: editData.colHeaders,
                                    rowHeaders: editData.rowHeaders,
                                    colWidths: editData.colWidths,
                                    rowHeights: editData.rowHeights,
                                    bgColors: editData.bgColors
                                };
                                if (hotInstance) { updateHandsontableData(); } else { initHandsontable(); }
                                overlay.classList.add('open');
                                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                            }
                            releaseLock();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (editData && editElement) {
                            editingTableElement = editElement;
                            document.getElementById('table-insert').textContent = '✅ 更新表格';
                            document.querySelector('#table-modal-title small').textContent = '· 编辑已有表格';
                            window._editTableData = {
                                data: editData.data,
                                colHeaders: editData.colHeaders,
                                rowHeaders: editData.rowHeaders,
                                colWidths: editData.colWidths,
                                rowHeights: editData.rowHeights,
                                bgColors: editData.bgColors
                            };
                        } else {
                            editingTableElement = null;
                            document.getElementById('table-insert').textContent = '✅ 插入表格';
                            document.querySelector('#table-modal-title small').textContent = '· 类似 Excel 的编辑体验';
                            window._editTableData = null;
                        }
                        overlay.classList.add('open');
                        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
                        var containerEl = document.getElementById('handsontable-container');
                        if (!containerEl) { releaseLock(); return; }
                        containerEl.style.minHeight = '350px';
                        containerEl.style.height = '100%';
                        void containerEl.offsetHeight;
                        var rect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                        if (rect.width > 10 && rect.height > 50) {
                            initHandsontable();
                            releaseLock();
                            return;
                        }
                        var initialized = false;
                        var resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(function (entries) {
                            for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
                                var entry = entries[i];
                                var width = entry.contentRect.width,
                                    height = entry.contentRect.height;
                                if (width > 10 && height > 50 && !initialized) {
                                    initialized = true;
                                    resizeObserver.disconnect();
                                    initHandsontable();
                                    releaseLock();
                                    return;
                                }
                            }
                        });
                        resizeObserver.observe(containerEl);
                        setTimeout(function () {
                            if (!initialized) {
                                initialized = true;
                                resizeObserver.disconnect();
                                initHandsontable();
                                releaseLock();
                            }
                        }, 1500);
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.error('openTableEditor 异步执行出错:', e);
                        showHint('❌ 打开表格编辑器失败，请刷新页面重试');
                        releaseLock();
                    }
                });
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('openTableEditor 执行出错:', e);
                showHint('❌ 打开表格编辑器失败，请刷新页面重试');
                releaseLock();
            }
        }

        function updateHandsontableData() {
            var editData = window._editTableData;
            if (!editData || !hotInstance) return;
            var rows = editData.data.length,
                cols = editData.data[0]?.length || 1;
            var colHeaders = editData.colHeaders || [],
                rowHeaders = editData.rowHeaders || false;
            var colWidths = editData.colWidths || new Array(cols).fill(100);
            var rowHeights = editData.rowHeights || new Array(rows).fill(32);
            var bgColors = editData.bgColors || {};
            while (colHeaders.length < cols) colHeaders.push(String.fromCharCode(65 + colHeaders.length));
            while (colWidths.length < cols) colWidths.push(100);
            while (rowHeights.length < rows) rowHeights.push(32);
            hotInstance.updateSettings({
                data: editData.data,
                colHeaders: colHeaders,
                rowHeaders: rowHeaders,
                colWidths: colWidths,
                rowHeights: rowHeights
            });
            var rowsCount = hotInstance.countRows(),
                colsCount = hotInstance.countCols();
            for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                for (var c = 0; c < colsCount; c++) {
                    var key = r + ',' + c;
                    var bg = bgColors[key] || '#ffffff';
                    hotInstance.setCellMeta(r, c, 'bgColor', bg);
                }
            }
            hotInstance.render();
        }

        function closeTableEditor() {
            if (isHotDestroying) return;
            isHotDestroying = true;
            var overlay = document.getElementById('table-modal-overlay');
            overlay.classList.remove('open');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
            if (hotInstance) {
                try { hotInstance.destroy(); } catch (e) {
                    console.warn('销毁 Handsontable 实例时出错:',
                        e);
                }
                hotInstance = null;
            }
            window._editTableData = null;
            editingTableElement = null;
            _isEditingTable = false;
            _tableInited = false;
            isTableEditorOpening = false;
            setTimeout(function () { isHotDestroying = false; }, 150);
        }

        function initHandsontable() {
            if (_tableInited) { updateHandsontableData(); return; }
            _tableInited = true;
            var editData = window._editTableData || null;
            var rows, cols, initialData, colHeaders, rowHeaders, colWidths, rowHeights, bgColors;
            if (editData) {
                rows = editData.data.length;
                cols = editData.data[0]?.length || 1;
                initialData = editData.data;
                colHeaders = editData.colHeaders || [];
                rowHeaders = editData.rowHeaders || false;
                colWidths = editData.colWidths || new Array(cols).fill(100);
                rowHeights = editData.rowHeights || new Array(rows).fill(32);
                bgColors = editData.bgColors || {};
            } else {
                rows = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-rows').value) || 5;
                cols = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-cols').value) || 5;
                initialData = [];
                for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                    var row = [];
                    for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) row.push('');
                    initialData.push(row);
                }
                colHeaders = [];
                for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) colHeaders.push(String.fromCharCode(65 + c));
                rowHeaders = false;
                colWidths = new Array(cols).fill(parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-colwidth').value) || 100);
                rowHeights = new Array(rows).fill(parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-rowheight').value) || 32);
                bgColors = {};
                for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) { for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) bgColors[r + ',' + c] = '#ffffff'; }
            }
            while (colHeaders.length < cols) colHeaders.push(String.fromCharCode(65 + colHeaders.length));
            while (colWidths.length < cols) colWidths.push(100);
            while (rowHeights.length < rows) rowHeights.push(32);
            var containerEl = document.getElementById('handsontable-container');
            if (containerEl) {
                var rect = containerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                if (rect.height < 100) {
                    containerEl.style.minHeight = '350px';
                    containerEl.style.height = '100%';
                }
            }
            if (hotInstance) { updateHandsontableData(); return; }
            hotInstance = new Handsontable(hotContainer, {
                data: initialData,
                rowHeaders: rowHeaders,
                colHeaders: colHeaders,
                contextMenu: true,
                licenseKey: 'non-commercial-and-evaluation',
                height: '100%',
                width: '100%',
                stretchH: 'all',
                manualColumnResize: true,
                manualRowResize: true,
                allowInsertRow: true,
                allowInsertColumn: true,
                allowRemoveRow: true,
                allowRemoveColumn: true,
                comments: true,
                colWidths: colWidths,
                rowHeights: rowHeights,
                renderer: bgRenderer,
                afterInit: function () {
                    var rowsCount = this.countRows(),
                        colsCount = this.countCols();
                    for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                        for (var c = 0; c < colsCount; c++) {
                            var key = r +
                                ',' + c;
                            var bg = bgColors[key] || '#ffffff';
                            this.setCellMeta(r, c, 'bgColor', bg);
                        }
                    }
                    this.render();
                },
                afterChange: function (changes, source) {
                    if (changes) {
                        var instance = this;
                        var rowsCount = instance.countRows(),
                            colsCount = instance.countCols();
                        for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                            for (var c = 0; c < colsCount; c++) {
                                var meta =
                                    instance.getCellMeta(r, c);
                                if (!meta.bgColor) {
                                    instance.setCellMeta(r, c,
                                        'bgColor', '#ffffff');
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        instance.render();
                    }
                },
                afterSelection: function (row, col, row2, col2) {
                    lastSelectedRange = { rowStart: row, colStart: col, rowEnd: row2, colEnd: col2 };
                    if (this) this.render();
                },
                afterDeselect: function () { }
            });
            document.getElementById('ht-rows').value = rows;
            document.getElementById('ht-cols').value = cols;
        }

        function isCellSelected(instance, row, col) {
            if (!lastSelectedRange) return false;
            var rowStart = lastSelectedRange.rowStart,
                colStart = lastSelectedRange.colStart;
            var rowEnd = lastSelectedRange.rowEnd,
                colEnd = lastSelectedRange.colEnd;
            if (colStart === -1 && colEnd === -1) { if (row >= rowStart && row <= rowEnd) return true; } else if (
                rowStart === -1 && rowEnd === -1) { if (col >= colStart && col <= colEnd) return true; } else {
                if (
                    row >= rowStart && row <= rowEnd && col >= colStart && col <= colEnd) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        function bgRenderer(instance, td, row, col, prop, value, cellProperties) {
            td.textContent = (value !== undefined && value !== null) ? value : '';
            td.style.cssText =
                'white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word;vertical-align:middle;text-align:left;padding:6px 10px;';
            var bgColor = cellProperties.bgColor || '#ffffff';
            if (row >= 0 && col >= 0 && isCellSelected(instance, row, col)) { bgColor = '#c7e0f5'; }
            td.style.backgroundColor = bgColor;
            if (row === -1 || col === -1) { td.style.backgroundColor = '#f0f2f5'; }
        }

        function getSelectedRange() {
            if (!hotInstance) return null;
            try {
                var ranges = hotInstance.getSelectedRange();
                if (ranges && ranges.length > 0) {
                    var range = ranges[0];
                    if (range) {
                        var r1 = range.from.row,
                            c1 = range.from.col,
                            r2 = range.to.row,
                            c2 = range.to.col;
                        if (typeof r1 === 'number' && typeof c1 === 'number' && typeof r2 === 'number' && typeof c2 ===
                            'number') { lastSelectedRange = { rowStart: r1, colStart: c1, rowEnd: r2, colEnd: c2 }; return lastSelectedRange; }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
            var sel = hotInstance.getSelected();
            if (sel && sel.length > 0 && sel[0]) {
                var rowStart = sel[0][0],
                    colStart = sel[0][1],
                    rowEnd = sel[0][2],
                    colEnd = sel[0][3];
                if (typeof rowStart === 'number' && typeof colStart === 'number' && typeof rowEnd === 'number' &&
                    typeof colEnd === 'number') {
                    lastSelectedRange = {
                        rowStart: rowStart,
                        colStart: colStart,
                        rowEnd: rowEnd,
                        colEnd: colEnd
                    };
                    return lastSelectedRange;
                }
            }
            var lastSel = hotInstance.getSelectedLast();
            if (lastSel) {
                var rowStart = lastSel[0],
                    colStart = lastSel[1],
                    rowEnd = lastSel[2],
                    colEnd = lastSel[3];
                if (typeof rowStart === 'number' && typeof colStart === 'number' && typeof rowEnd === 'number' &&
                    typeof colEnd === 'number') {
                    lastSelectedRange = {
                        rowStart: rowStart,
                        colStart: colStart,
                        rowEnd: rowEnd,
                        colEnd: colEnd
                    };
                    return lastSelectedRange;
                }
            }
            return lastSelectedRange || null;
        }

        function normalizeRange(range) {
            if (!range) return null;
            var rowStart = range.rowStart,
                colStart = range.colStart,
                rowEnd = range.rowEnd,
                colEnd = range.colEnd;
            var totalRows = hotInstance.countRows(),
                totalCols = hotInstance.countCols();
            if (typeof rowStart !== 'number') rowStart = 0;
            if (typeof colStart !== 'number') colStart = 0;
            if (typeof rowEnd !== 'number') rowEnd = rowStart;
            if (typeof colEnd !== 'number') colEnd = colStart;
            if (rowStart === -1) {
                rowStart = 0;
                rowEnd = totalRows - 1;
            }
            if (colStart === -1) {
                colStart = 0;
                colEnd = totalCols - 1;
            }
            if (rowStart < 0) rowStart = 0;
            if (colStart < 0) colStart = 0;
            if (rowEnd >= totalRows) rowEnd = totalRows - 1;
            if (colEnd >= totalCols) colEnd = totalCols - 1;
            return { rowStart: rowStart, colStart: colStart, rowEnd: rowEnd, colEnd: colEnd };
        }

        function resizeTable() {
            if (!hotInstance) { initHandsontable(); return; }
            var rows = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-rows').value) || 1;
            var cols = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-cols').value) || 1;
            var currentData = hotInstance.getData();
            var newData = [];
            for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
                var row = [];
                for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                    row.push((currentData[
                        r] && currentData[r][c] !== undefined) ? currentData[r][c] : '');
                }
                newData.push(row);
            }
            var colHeaders = [];
            for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++) colHeaders.push(String.fromCharCode(65 + c));
            var defaultWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-colwidth').value) || 100;
            var defaultHeight = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-rowheight').value) || 32;
            var colWidths = new Array(cols).fill(defaultWidth);
            var rowHeights = new Array(rows).fill(defaultHeight);
            hotInstance.updateSettings({
                data: newData,
                colHeaders: colHeaders,
                colWidths: colWidths,
                rowHeights: rowHeights
            });
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (hotInstance) {
                    var rowsCount = hotInstance.countRows(),
                        colsCount = hotInstance.countCols();
                    for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                        for (var c = 0; c < colsCount; c++) {
                            var meta =
                                hotInstance.getCellMeta(r, c);
                            if (!meta.bgColor) hotInstance.setCellMeta(r, c,
                                'bgColor', '#ffffff');
                        }
                    }
                    hotInstance.render();
                }
            }, 50);
        }

        function applyBgToSelected() {
            if (!hotInstance) { showHint('请先打开表格编辑器！'); return; }
            var range = getSelectedRange();
            if (!range) { showHint('请先选中一个或多个单元格！'); return; }
            var norm = normalizeRange(range);
            if (!norm) return;
            var rowStart = norm.rowStart,
                colStart = norm.colStart,
                rowEnd = norm.rowEnd,
                colEnd = norm.colEnd;
            var color = document.getElementById('ht-bgcolor').value;
            for (var r = rowStart; r <= rowEnd; r++) {
                for (var c = colStart; c <= colEnd; c++) {
                    hotInstance
                        .setCellMeta(r, c, 'bgColor', color);
                }
            }
            hotInstance.render();
            showHint('✅ 已应用背景色到 ' + (rowEnd - rowStart + 1) + ' 行 × ' + (colEnd - colStart + 1) + ' 列');
        }

        function clearBgFromSelected() {
            if (!hotInstance) { showHint('请先打开表格编辑器！'); return; }
            var range = getSelectedRange();
            if (!range) { showHint('请先选中一个或多个单元格！'); return; }
            var norm = normalizeRange(range);
            if (!norm) return;
            var rowStart = norm.rowStart,
                colStart = norm.colStart,
                rowEnd = norm.rowEnd,
                colEnd = norm.colEnd;
            for (var r = rowStart; r <= rowEnd; r++) {
                for (var c = colStart; c <= colEnd; c++) {
                    hotInstance
                        .setCellMeta(r, c, 'bgColor', '#ffffff');
                }
            }
            hotInstance.render();
            showHint('✅ 已清除选中区域背景色');
        }

        function applyColWidthToSelected() {
            if (!hotInstance) { showHint('请先打开表格编辑器！'); return; }
            var range = getSelectedRange();
            if (!range) { showHint('请先选中一个或多个单元格！'); return; }
            var norm = normalizeRange(range);
            if (!norm) return;
            var colStart = norm.colStart,
                colEnd = norm.colEnd;
            var width = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-colwidth').value) || 100;
            var currentColWidths = hotInstance.getSettings().colWidths || [];
            var newColWidths = currentColWidths.slice();
            for (var c = colStart; c <= colEnd; c++) newColWidths[c] = width;
            hotInstance.updateSettings({ colWidths: newColWidths });
            hotInstance.render();
            showHint('✅ 已应用列宽 ' + width + 'px 到 ' + (colEnd - colStart + 1) + ' 列');
        }

        function applyRowHeightToSelected() {
            if (!hotInstance) { showHint('请先打开表格编辑器！'); return; }
            var range = getSelectedRange();
            if (!range) { showHint('请先选中一个或多个单元格！'); return; }
            var norm = normalizeRange(range);
            if (!norm) return;
            var rowStart = norm.rowStart,
                rowEnd = norm.rowEnd;
            var height = parseInt(document.getElementById('ht-rowheight').value) || 32;
            var currentRowHeights = hotInstance.getSettings().rowHeights || [];
            var newRowHeights = currentRowHeights.slice();
            for (var r = rowStart; r <= rowEnd; r++) newRowHeights[r] = height;
            hotInstance.updateSettings({ rowHeights: newRowHeights });
            hotInstance.render();
            showHint('✅ 已应用行高 ' + height + 'px 到 ' + (rowEnd - rowStart + 1) + ' 行');
        }

        function generateHTMLTable() {
            if (!hotInstance) return '<table><tr><td>空表格</td></tr></table>';
            var data = hotInstance.getData();
            var settings = hotInstance.getSettings();
            var colHeaders = settings.colHeaders || [],
                rowHeaders = settings.rowHeaders || false;
            var colWidths = settings.colWidths || [],
                rowHeights = settings.rowHeights || [];
            var bgColors = {};
            var rowsCount = data.length,
                colsCount = rowsCount > 0 ? data[0]?.length || 0 : 0;
            for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                for (var c = 0; c < (data[r]?.length || 0); c++) {
                    try {
                        var meta =
                            hotInstance.getCellMeta(r, c);
                        bgColors[r + ',' + c] = meta.bgColor || '#ffffff';
                    } catch (e) {
                        bgColors[r + ',' + c] =
                            '#ffffff';
                    }
                }
            }
            if (rowsCount === 0 || colsCount === 0) { return '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;"><tr><td style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;">空表格</td></tr></table>'; }
            var colHeadersFull = [];
            for (var c = 0; c < colsCount; c++) { colHeadersFull.push(colHeaders[c] || String.fromCharCode(65 + c)); }
            var html = '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:14px;">';
            if (colHeadersFull.length > 0) {
                html += '<thead><tr>';
                if (rowHeaders) {
                    html +=
                        '<th style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;background:#f0f2f5;font-weight:600;text-align:center;">#</th>';
                }
                for (var c = 0; c < colHeadersFull.length; c++) {
                    var width = colWidths[c] ? 'width:' + colWidths[c] +
                        'px;' : '';
                    html += '<th style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;background:#f0f2f5;font-weight:600;' +
                        width + '">' + (colHeadersFull[c] || '') + '</th>';
                }
                html += '</tr></thead>';
            }
            html += '<tbody>';
            for (var r = 0; r < rowsCount; r++) {
                var row = data[r] || [];
                var height = rowHeights[r] ? 'height:' + rowHeights[r] + 'px;' : '';
                html += '<tr>';
                if (rowHeaders) {
                    html += '<td style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;background:#f9fafb;font-weight:500;text-align:center;' +
                        height + '">' + (r + 1) + '</td>';
                }
                for (var c = 0; c < Math.min(row.length, colsCount); c++) {
                    var bgKey = r + ',' + c;
                    var bg = bgColors[bgKey] || '#ffffff';
                    var bgStyle = 'background-color:' + bg + ';';
                    var width = colWidths[c] ? 'width:' + colWidths[c] + 'px;' : '';
                    var val = (row[c] !== undefined && row[c] !== null) ? String(row[c]) : '';
                    html += '<td style="border:1px solid #ccc;padding:6px 10px;' + bgStyle + width + height + '">' +
                        val + '</td>';
                }
                html += '</tr>';
            }
            html += '</tbody></table>';
            return html;
        }

        function insertTableToVditor() {
            if (!hotInstance) { showHint('请先编辑表格内容！'); return; }
            var htmlTable = generateHTMLTable();
            if (!htmlTable) { showHint('生成表格失败，请重试。'); return; }
            var escapedHtml = htmlTable.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
            var htmlBlock = '<div data-type="html-block" data-block="0" class="vditor-ir__node">\n  <pre class="vditor-ir__marker--pre vditor-ir__marker"><code data-type="html-block">' +
                escapedHtml + '</code></pre>\n  <pre class="vditor-ir__preview" data-render="1">' + htmlTable +
                '</pre>\n</div>';
            if (editingTableElement) {
                var parent = editingTableElement.parentNode;
                var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
                tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlBlock;
                var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                while (tempDiv.firstChild) { fragment.appendChild(tempDiv.firstChild); }
                parent.replaceChild(fragment, editingTableElement);
                editingTableElement = null;
                closeTableEditor();
                showHint('✅ 表格已更新');
                vditor.focus();
                return;
            }
            closeTableEditor();
            setTimeout(function () {
                var marker = tableMarkerElement;
                if (marker && marker.parentNode) {
                    var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    tempDiv.innerHTML = htmlBlock;
                    var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                    while (tempDiv.firstChild) { fragment.appendChild(tempDiv.firstChild); }
                    marker.parentNode.replaceChild(fragment, marker);
                    tableMarkerElement = null;
                } else {
                    restoreCursorPosition();
                    var success = insertHTMLFallback(htmlBlock);
                    if (!success) { vditor.insertValue(htmlBlock); }
                }
                var editorEl = getEditorElement();
                if (editorEl) { editorEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    try {
                        if (typeof vditor.renderPreview === 'function') vditor.renderPreview();
                        if (vditor.preview && typeof vditor.preview.render === 'function') vditor.preview.render();
                    } catch (e) { /* 忽略 */ }
                    vditor.focus();
                }, 120);
                showHint('✅ 表格已插入（单击表格可弹出编辑按钮）');
            }, 200);
        }

        function insertHTMLFallback(html) {
            try {
                if (vditor.caret && typeof vditor.caret.insertHTML === 'function') {
                    vditor.caret.insertHTML(html);
                    var editor = getEditorElement();
                    if (editor) { editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }
                    return true;
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('caret.insertHTML 失败', e); }
            try {
                var sel = window.getSelection();
                if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0) {
                    var editor = getEditorElement();
                    if (editor) {
                        var range = document.createRange();
                        range.selectNodeContents(editor);
                        range.collapse(false);
                        sel.removeAllRanges();
                        sel.addRange(range);
                    }
                }
                var success = document.execCommand('insertHTML', false, html);
                if (success) {
                    var editor = getEditorElement();
                    if (editor) { editor.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); }
                    return true;
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn('execCommand 失败', e); }
            return false;
        }

        // 表格事件绑定
        document.getElementById('table-modal-close').addEventListener('click', closeTableEditor);
        document.getElementById('table-cancel').addEventListener('click', closeTableEditor);
        document.getElementById('table-modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeTableEditor();
        });
        document.getElementById('table-insert').addEventListener('click', function () {
            safeExecute(insertTableToVditor, '表格插入/更新失败');
        });
        document.getElementById('ht-resize-btn').addEventListener('click', resizeTable);
        document.getElementById('ht-apply-bg').addEventListener('click', applyBgToSelected);
        document.getElementById('ht-clear-bg').addEventListener('click', clearBgFromSelected);
        document.getElementById('ht-apply-colwidth').addEventListener('click', applyColWidthToSelected);
        document.getElementById('ht-apply-rowheight').addEventListener('click', applyRowHeightToSelected);

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            var overlay = document.getElementById('table-modal-overlay');
            if (!overlay.classList.contains('open')) return;
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                e.preventDefault();
                closeTableEditor();
            }
            if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Insert') && e.ctrlKey) {
                e.preventDefault();
                safeExecute(insertTableToVditor, '表格插入/更新失败');
            }
        });

        var hotResizeTimer = null;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
            clearTimeout(hotResizeTimer);
            hotResizeTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (hotInstance) hotInstance.render(); }, 300);
        });

        // ================================================================

/**
 * Judge0 代码执行器 - 轻量核心
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 通过语言常量或名称执行代码，内置语言常量集合
 * @dependencies 无 (使用原生 fetch)
 *
 * @example
 * // 浏览器引入
 * <script src="judge0-executor.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const result = await Judge0Executor.execute({
 *       source_code: 'print("Hello")',
 *       language: Judge0Executor.Language.PYTHON   // 使用常量
 *   });
 *   console.log(result.stdout);
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // ES Module
 * import Judge0Executor from './judge0-executor.js';
 * const result = await Judge0Executor.execute({
 *     source_code: 'console.log("Hi")',
 *     language: Judge0Executor.Language.JAVASCRIPT
 * });
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 语言常量集合 (枚举)
    // ============================================================
    const Language = {
        PYTHON: 71,
        PYTHON3: 71,
        PYTHON2: 70,
        JAVASCRIPT: 63,
        NODEJS: 63,
        JS: 63,
        BASH: 46,
        SHELL: 46,
        C: 50,
        CPP: 54,
        C_PLUS_PLUS: 54,
        JAVA: 62,
        RUBY: 72,
        RUST: 73,
        TYPESCRIPT: 74,
        TS: 74,
        PHP: 68,
        GO: 60,
        SWIFT: 83,
        R: 80,
        PERL: 85,
        LUA: 86,
        HASKELL: 87,
        ELIXIR: 88,
        ERLANG: 89,
        CLOJURE: 90,
        KOTLIN: 91,
        SCALA: 92,
        DART: 93,
        JULIA: 94,
        CRYSTAL: 95,
        ZIG: 96,
        NIM: 97,
        V: 98,
        GROOVY: 99,
        CSHARP: 51,
        C_SHARP: 51,
        FSHARP: 52,
        VBNET: 53,
        SQLITE: 55,
        POSTGRESQL: 56,
        MYSQL: 57,
        RLANG: 80,
    };

    // ============================================================
    // 辅助：字符串名称映射（可选，便于兼容）
    // ============================================================
    const LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP = {
        python: 71,
        python3: 71,
        python2: 70,
        javascript: 63,
        nodejs: 63,
        js: 63,
        bash: 46,
        shell: 46,
        c: 50,
        cpp: 54,
        'c++': 54,
        java: 62,
        ruby: 72,
        rust: 73,
        typescript: 74,
        ts: 74,
        php: 68,
        go: 60,
        swift: 83,
        r: 80,
        perl: 85,
        lua: 86,
        haskell: 87,
        elixir: 88,
        erlang: 89,
        clojure: 90,
        kotlin: 91,
        scala: 92,
        dart: 93,
        julia: 94,
        crystal: 95,
        zig: 96,
        nim: 97,
        v: 98,
        groovy: 99,
        csharp: 51,
        'c#': 51,
        fsharp: 52,
        vbnet: 53,
        sqlite: 55,
        postgresql: 56,
        mysql: 57,
        rlang: 80,
    };

    /**
     * 解析语言参数：接受数字 ID、字符串名称或 undefined
     * @param {number|string} lang - 语言 ID 或名称
     * @returns {number} 语言 ID
     * @throws {Error} 如果无法识别
     */
    function resolveLanguage(lang) {
        if (typeof lang === 'number') {
            return lang;
        }
        if (typeof lang === 'string') {
            const key = lang.toLowerCase().trim();
            const id = LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP[key];
            if (id === undefined) {
                throw new Error(`未知语言名称 "${lang}"`);
            }
            return id;
        }
        throw new Error('language 参数必须是数字或字符串');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 核心执行函数
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 在 Judge0 上执行代码
     * @param {Object} params
     * @param {string} params.source_code - 源代码
     * @param {number|string} params.language - 语言 ID 或名称（推荐使用 Language 常量）
     * @param {string} [params.stdin=''] - 标准输入
     * @param {number} [params.cpu_time_limit=5] - CPU 时间限制（秒）
     * @param {number} [params.memory_limit=256000] - 内存限制（KB）
     * @param {string} [params.apiBase='https://ce.judge0.com'] - API 地址
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} 执行结果
     */
    async function executeCode(params) {
        const {
            source_code,
            language,
            stdin = '',
            cpu_time_limit = 5,
            memory_limit = 256000,
            apiBase = 'https://ce.judge0.com',
        } = params;

        if (!source_code || source_code.trim() === '') {
            throw new Error('源代码不能为空');
        }

        const language_id = resolveLanguage(language);

        const payload = {
            language_id,
            source_code,
            stdin,
            cpu_time_limit,
            memory_limit,
        };

        const url = `${apiBase}/submissions?base64_encoded=false&wait=true`;

        const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            let errMsg = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
            try {
                const errJson = await response.json();
                errMsg = errJson.error || errMsg;
            } catch (_) { }
            throw new Error(`API 请求失败: ${errMsg}`);
        }

        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.error) {
            throw new Error(result.error);
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 导出
    // ============================================================

    const Judge0Executor = {
        version: '1.0.0',
        Language,               // 语言常量集合
        execute: executeCode,
        // 工具函数（可选）
        resolveLanguage,
        languageNameMap: LANGUAGE_NAME_MAP,
    };

    // 浏览器全局
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.Judge0Executor = Judge0Executor;
    }

    // CommonJS / Node.js
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = Judge0Executor;
        module.exports.default = Judge0Executor;
    }

    // AMD
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return Judge0Executor;
        });
    }

    return Judge0Executor;
})(this);

/**
 * LaTeX 公式计算器 - 独立核心库
 * @version 1.0.0
 * @description 支持 LaTeX 公式转 MathJS 表达式、数值计算、KaTeX 渲染
 * @dependencies mathjs (全局 math), katex (全局 katex)
 *
 * @example
 * // 在 HTML 中通过 script 标签引入
 * <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mathjs/11.8.0/math.min.js"></script>
 * <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/KaTeX/0.16.9/katex.min.js"></script>
 * <script src="latex-calculator.js"></script>
 * <script>
 *   const result = LaTeXCalculator.compute('\\sum_{i=1}^{10} i');
 *   console.log(result); // { success: true, result: '55', mathExpr: '55' }
 * </script>
 *
 * @example
 * // 在 ES Module 中使用
 * import LaTeXCalculator from './latex-calculator.js';
 * const result = LaTeXCalculator.compute('\\int_{0}^{1} {x^2} dx');
 * console.log(result.result); // 0.3333333333333333
 */

(function (global) {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    // 1. 依赖检查
    // ============================================================
    if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 mathjs 全局对象，请先加载 mathjs 库。');
    }
    if (typeof katex === 'undefined') {
        console.warn('[LaTeXCalculator] 未找到 katex 全局对象，请先加载 katex 库。');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 2. 工具函数 - 数值积分（复合辛普森法）
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 使用复合辛普森法计算数值积分
     * @param {string} expr - MathJS 表达式，变量名为 varName
     * @param {string} varName - 积分变量名（默认 'x'）
     * @param {number} a - 积分下限
     * @param {number} b - 积分上限
     * @param {number} [n=1000] - 等分数（自动调整为偶数）
     * @returns {number} 积分近似值
     * @throws {Error} 如果表达式求值失败
     */
    function numericalIntegral(expr, varName, a, b, n) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法进行数值积分');
        }
        if (n === undefined || n < 2) n = 1000;
        if (n % 2 === 1) n++; // 确保为偶数
        const h = (b - a) / n;
        let sum = 0;
        const vars = {};
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            const x = a + i * h;
            vars[varName] = x;
            const y = math.evaluate(expr, vars);
            if (i === 0 || i === n) {
                sum += y;
            } else if (i % 2 === 0) {
                sum += 2 * y;
            } else {
                sum += 4 * y;
            }
        }
        return (sum * h) / 3;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3. 核心转换函数 - LaTeX → MathJS
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 将 LaTeX 公式转换为 MathJS 可计算的表达式字符串
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
     * @throws {Error} 如果转换失败
     */
    function latexToMathJS(latex) {
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') return '';
        let s = latex.trim();
        s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

        // ---- 0. 预处理：移除 \limits 和 \, ----
        s = s.replace(/\\limits/g, '');
        s = s.replace(/\\,/g, ' ');

        // ---- 1. 三角函数等（递归处理参数） ----
        const funcMap = {
            'sin': 'sin',
            'cos': 'cos',
            'tan': 'tan',
            'cot': 'cot',
            'sec': 'sec',
            'csc': 'csc',
            'arcsin': 'asin',
            'arccos': 'acos',
            'arctan': 'atan',
            'log': 'log',
            'ln': 'log',
            'lg': 'log10',
            'exp': 'exp',
            'sinh': 'sinh',
            'cosh': 'cosh',
            'tanh': 'tanh'
        };
        let prevTrig;
        do {
            prevTrig = s;
            for (const [latexCmd, mathFn] of Object.entries(funcMap)) {
                const regex1 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\{([^}]*)\\}', 'g');
                const regex2 = new RegExp('\\\\' + latexCmd + '\\(([^)]*)\\)', 'g');
                s = s.replace(regex1, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
                s = s.replace(regex2, (m, args) => `${mathFn}(${latexToMathJS(args)})`);
            }
        } while (s !== prevTrig);

        // ---- 2. 分数 ----
        let prev;
        do {
            prev = s;
            s = s.replace(/\\frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, num, den) => {
                return `${latexToMathJS(num)}/${latexToMathJS(den)}`;
            });
        } while (s !== prev);

        // ---- 3. 根号 ----
        do {
            prev = s;
            s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\[([^{}]*)\]\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, n, expr) => {
                return `(${latexToMathJS(expr)})^(1/(${latexToMathJS(n)}))`;
            });
            s = s.replace(/\\sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, expr) => {
                return `sqrt(${latexToMathJS(expr)})`;
            });
        } while (s !== prev);

        // ---- 4. 常数替换 ----
        const constMap = {
            '\\pi': 'pi',
            '\\Pi': 'pi',
            '\\infty': 'Infinity',
            '\\e': 'e',
            '\\E': 'e',
            '\\mathrm{e}': 'e',
            '\\mathrm{E}': 'e'
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(constMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 5. 希腊字母 ----
        const greekMap = {
            '\\alpha': 'alpha',
            '\\beta': 'beta',
            '\\gamma': 'gamma',
            '\\delta': 'delta',
            '\\epsilon': 'epsilon',
            '\\zeta': 'zeta',
            '\\eta': 'eta',
            '\\theta': 'theta',
            '\\iota': 'iota',
            '\\kappa': 'kappa',
            '\\lambda': 'lambda',
            '\\mu': 'mu',
            '\\nu': 'nu',
            '\\xi': 'xi',
            '\\omicron': 'omicron',
            '\\pi': 'pi',
            '\\rho': 'rho',
            '\\sigma': 'sigma',
            '\\tau': 'tau',
            '\\upsilon': 'upsilon',
            '\\phi': 'phi',
            '\\chi': 'chi',
            '\\psi': 'psi',
            '\\omega': 'omega',
            '\\Gamma': 'Gamma',
            '\\Delta': 'Delta',
            '\\Theta': 'Theta',
            '\\Lambda': 'Lambda',
            '\\Xi': 'Xi',
            '\\Pi': 'Pi',
            '\\Sigma': 'Sigma',
            '\\Upsilon': 'Upsilon',
            '\\Phi': 'Phi',
            '\\Psi': 'Psi',
            '\\Omega': 'Omega'
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(greekMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 6. 求和与连乘 ----
        let prev2 = '';
        let maxIter = 80;
        while (maxIter-- > 0 && s !== prev2) {
            prev2 = s;
            s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'sum');
            s = replaceSumOrProd(s, 'prod');
        }
        if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(s)) {
            throw new Error('转换失败，残留求和/连乘命令: ' + s);
        }

        // ---- 7. 定积分 ----
        s = processIntegrals(s);

        // ---- 8. 运算符映射 ----
        const opMap = {
            '\\times': '*',
            '\\cdot': '*',
            '\\div': '/',
            '\\pm': '±',
            '\\mp': '∓',
            '\\left(': '(',
            '\\right)': ')',
            '\\left[': '[',
            '\\right]': ']',
            '\\left\\{': '{',
            '\\right\\}': '}',
            '\\left|': 'abs(',
            '\\right|': ')',
            '\\left.': '',
            '\\right.': '',
            '\\left': '',
            '\\right': ''
        };
        for (const [lc, mc] of Object.entries(opMap)) {
            s = s.replace(new RegExp(lc.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g'), mc);
        }

        // ---- 9. 阶乘支持 (i! → factorial(i)) ----
        s = s.replace(/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\s*!/g, 'factorial($1)');

        // ---- 10. 清理孤立的 { } ----
        s = s.replace(/\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (match, content) => {
            if (!/[+\-*/^=<>]/.test(content)) return content;
            return `(${content})`;
        });

        s = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
        return s;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 4. 辅助函数 - 处理求和 / 连乘
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 替换 LaTeX 中的 \sum 或 \prod 为数值计算结果
     * @param {string} s - 当前字符串
     * @param {string} type - 'sum' 或 'prod'
     * @returns {string} 替换后的字符串
     */
    function replaceSumOrProd(s, type) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法计算求和/连乘');
        }
        const cmd = type === 'sum' ? 'sum' : 'prod';
        const regex = new RegExp(
            `\\\\${cmd}\\s*_\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*\\^\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}\\s*((?:\\{[^}]*\\})|\\S+)`,
            'g'
        );

        let newS = s;
        let match;
        while ((match = regex.exec(newS)) !== null) {
            const fullMatch = match[0];
            const lower = match[1];
            const upper = match[2];
            let expr = match[3];
            if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) {
                expr = expr.slice(1, -1);
            }

            if (/\\sum|\\prod/.test(expr)) {
                regex.lastIndex = match.index + fullMatch.length;
                continue;
            }

            const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
            const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
            const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);

            let varName = 'x';
            let lowerVal = lowerC;
            const eqIdx = lowerC.indexOf('=');
            if (eqIdx !== -1) {
                varName = lowerC.substring(0, eqIdx).trim();
                lowerVal = lowerC.substring(eqIdx + 1).trim();
            } else {
                varName = 'i';
                lowerVal = lowerC;
            }

            const upperVal = upperC;

            function isNumeric(str) {
                return /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(str.trim());
            }

            let replacement = '';
            if (isNumeric(lowerVal) && isNumeric(upperVal)) {
                const lowerNum = parseFloat(lowerVal);
                const upperNum = parseFloat(upperVal);
                if (lowerNum <= upperNum) {
                    const exprWithVar = exprC.replace(new RegExp(`\\b${varName}\\b`, 'g'), 'x');
                    let result;
                    if (type === 'sum') {
                        result = 0;
                        for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                            result += math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                        }
                    } else {
                        result = 1;
                        for (let x = lowerNum; x <= upperNum; x++) {
                            result *= math.evaluate(exprWithVar, { x: x });
                        }
                    }
                    replacement = result.toString();
                } else {
                    replacement = type === 'sum' ? '0' : '1';
                }
            } else {
                replacement = `(function(){ throw new Error("求和/积的上下限必须为数值"); })()`;
            }

            newS = newS.replace(fullMatch, replacement);
            regex.lastIndex = 0;
            if (!newS.includes(`\\${cmd}`)) break;
        }
        return newS;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 5. 辅助函数 - 处理定积分
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 处理 LaTeX 中的 \int 定积分，替换为数值计算结果
     * @param {string} s - 当前字符串
     * @returns {string} 替换后的字符串
     */
    function processIntegrals(s) {
        if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('mathjs 库未加载，无法计算定积分');
        }
        let newS = s;
        let maxLoop = 50;
        while (maxLoop-- > 0) {
            const idx = newS.indexOf('\\int');
            if (idx === -1) break;

            let rest = newS.slice(idx + 4);
            rest = rest.trimStart();
            if (!rest.startsWith('_')) break;
            rest = rest.slice(1);

            // 提取下限
            let lower = '';
            let lowerEnd = 0;
            if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                let braceCount = 1;
                let i = 1;
                while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                    if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                    else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                    i++;
                }
                lower = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                lowerEnd = i;
            } else {
                let i = 0;
                while (i < rest.length && rest[i] !== '^' && !/\s/.test(rest[i])) i++;
                lower = rest.slice(0, i);
                lowerEnd = i;
            }
            if (lowerEnd >= rest.length) break;
            rest = rest.slice(lowerEnd);
            rest = rest.trimStart();
            if (!rest.startsWith('^')) break;
            rest = rest.slice(1);

            // 提取上限
            let upper = '';
            let upperEnd = 0;
            if (rest.startsWith('{')) {
                let braceCount = 1;
                let i = 1;
                while (i < rest.length && braceCount > 0) {
                    if (rest[i] === '{') braceCount++;
                    else if (rest[i] === '}') braceCount--;
                    i++;
                }
                upper = rest.slice(1, i - 1);
                upperEnd = i;
            } else {
                let i = 0;
                while (i < rest.length && !/\s/.test(rest[i]) && rest[i] !== 'd') i++;
                upper = rest.slice(0, i);
                upperEnd = i;
            }
            if (upperEnd >= rest.length) break;
            rest = rest.slice(upperEnd);

            // 找到 dx 位置
            const dxIndex = rest.search(/\s*d\s*x\s*/);
            if (dxIndex === -1) break;
            let expr = rest.slice(0, dxIndex).trim();
            if (expr.startsWith('{') && expr.endsWith('}')) expr = expr.slice(1, -1);

            const lowerC = latexToMathJS(lower);
            const upperC = latexToMathJS(upper);
            const exprC = latexToMathJS(expr);

            let a, b;
            try {
                a = math.evaluate(lowerC);
                b = math.evaluate(upperC);
            } catch (_) {
                const aNum = parseFloat(lowerC);
                const bNum = parseFloat(upperC);
                if (!isNaN(aNum) && !isNaN(bNum)) {
                    a = aNum;
                    b = bNum;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (typeof a !== 'number' || typeof b !== 'number' || !isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b)) break;

            let result;
            try {
                result = numericalIntegral(exprC, 'x', a, b);
                if (!isFinite(result)) break;
            } catch (_) {
                break;
            }

            const matchEnd = newS.indexOf('dx', idx) + 2;
            newS = newS.slice(0, idx) + result.toString() + newS.slice(matchEnd);
        }
        return newS;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 6. 高层 API - 计算与渲染
    // ============================================================

    /**
     * 计算 LaTeX 公式
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @param {Object} [options] - 可选配置
     * @param {number} [options.integralSteps=1000] - 积分等分数
     * @returns {Object} { success: boolean, result?: string, mathExpr?: string, error?: string }
     */
    function compute(latex, options) {
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
            return { success: false, error: '请输入 LaTeX 公式' };
        }
        try {
            const mathExpr = latexToMathJS(latex);
            if (!mathExpr || mathExpr.trim() === '') {
                return { success: false, error: '转换后的表达式为空' };
            }
            if (mathExpr.includes('throw new Error')) {
                const errMatch = mathExpr.match(/throw new Error\("([^"]*)"\)/);
                if (errMatch) return { success: false, error: errMatch[1] };
            }
            if (typeof math === 'undefined') {
                return { success: false, error: 'mathjs 库未加载，无法计算' };
            }
            const result = math.evaluate(mathExpr);
            let displayResult;
            if (typeof result === 'number') {
                if (Number.isInteger(result)) {
                    displayResult = result.toString();
                } else {
                    displayResult = parseFloat(result.toPrecision(12)).toString();
                }
            } else if (typeof result === 'string') {
                displayResult = result;
            } else if (result && typeof result === 'object' && result.toString) {
                displayResult = result.toString();
            } else {
                displayResult = String(result);
            }
            return { success: true, result: displayResult, mathExpr };
        } catch (err) {
            let msg = err.message || '计算错误';
            if (msg.includes('undefined')) {
                msg = '表达式包含未定义的变量，请确保所有变量都有数值';
            }
            return { success: false, error: msg };
        }
    }

    /**
     * 将 LaTeX 转换为 MathJS 表达式字符串（不计算）
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
     * @throws {Error} 如果转换失败
     */
    function parse(latex) {
        return latexToMathJS(latex);
    }

    /**
     * 使用 KaTeX 渲染 LaTeX 到目标 DOM 元素
     * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
     * @param {HTMLElement} target - 目标 DOM 元素
     * @param {Object} [options] - KaTeX 渲染选项
     * @returns {boolean} 是否渲染成功
     */
    function render(latex, target, options) {
        if (!target) return false;
        if (!latex || latex.trim() === '') {
            target.innerHTML = '';
            return false;
        }
        if (typeof katex === 'undefined') {
            target.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#c0392b;">⚠️ KaTeX 库未加载</span>';
            return false;
        }
        try {
            const html = katex.renderToString(latex, Object.assign({
                throwOnError: false,
                displayMode: true,
                trust: true,
            }, options || {}));
            target.innerHTML = html;
            return true;
        } catch (err) {
            target.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:16px;">⚠️ 渲染失败: ${err.message}</span>`;
            return false;
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 7. 导出
    // ============================================================

    const LaTeXCalculator = {
        /**
         * 计算 LaTeX 公式
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @param {Object} [options] - 可选配置
         * @returns {Object} { success, result, mathExpr } 或 { success, error }
         */
        compute: compute,

        /**
         * 将 LaTeX 转换为 MathJS 表达式字符串（不计算）
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @returns {string} MathJS 表达式字符串
         */
        parse: parse,

        /**
         * 使用 KaTeX 渲染 LaTeX 到 DOM 元素
         * @param {string} latex - LaTeX 公式字符串
         * @param {HTMLElement} target - 目标元素
         * @param {Object} [options] - KaTeX 选项
         * @returns {boolean} 是否成功
         */
        render: render,

        /**
         * 数值积分工具函数（复合辛普森法）
         * @param {string} expr - MathJS 表达式
         * @param {string} varName - 变量名
         * @param {number} a - 下限
         * @param {number} b - 上限
         * @param {number} [n=1000] - 等分数
         * @returns {number} 积分值
         */
        integral: numericalIntegral,

        /**
         * 版本号
         */
        version: '1.0.0',

        /**
         * 依赖检查
         */
        deps: {
            mathjs: typeof math !== 'undefined',
            katex: typeof katex !== 'undefined'
        }
    };

    // ---- 浏览器全局 ----
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.LaTeXCalculator = LaTeXCalculator;
    }

    // ---- CommonJS / Node.js ----
    if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
        module.exports = LaTeXCalculator;
        module.exports.default = LaTeXCalculator;
    }

    // ---- AMD ----
    if (typeof define === 'function' && define.amd) {
        define([], function () {
            return LaTeXCalculator;
        });
    }

    // ---- 返回（用于 IIFE 链式调用） ----
    return LaTeXCalculator;

})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis :
    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window :
        typeof global !== 'undefined' ? global :
            this);
